$00:9C6F AE F4 1D     LDX.W $1DF4                     ; X = offset into the demo script [$1DF4]
$00:9C72 CE F5 1D     DEC.W $1DF5                     ; Demo time left [$1DF5]--
$00:9C75 D0 0B        BNE $9C82                       ; Not elapsed: keep the current buttons
$00:9C77 BD 20 9C     LDA.W ItrCntrlrSqnc,X           ; A = time of the next segment
$00:9C7A 8D F5 1D     STA.W $1DF5                     ; [$1DF5] = it
$00:9C7D E8           INX                             ; \
$00:9C7E E8           INX                             ; / X += 2: next segment
$00:9C7F 8E F4 1D     STX.W $1DF4                     ; Save the script offset
$00:9C82 BD 1D 9C     LDA.W ADDR_009C1D,X             ; A = buttons of the current segment
$00:9C85 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; $FF is the end marker
$00:9C87 D0 06        BNE $9C8F                       ; Not the end: apply the buttons
$00:9C89 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2
$00:9C8B 8C 00 01     STY.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode = 2 (fade to title screen again, demo restarts)
$00:9C8E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:9C8F 29 DF        AND.B #$DF                      ; Clear bit 5 (Select)
$00:9C91 85 15        STA RAM_ControllerA             ; Controller 1 held buttons [$15] = A
$00:9C93 DD 1D 9C     CMP.W ADDR_009C1D,X             ; Compare with the table value
$00:9C96 D0 02        BNE $9C9A                       ; Differs (Select was set): keep A
$00:9C98 29 9F        AND.B #$9F                      ; Clear bits 6-5 (Y, Select) for the just-pressed copy
$00:9C9A 85 16        STA $16                         ; Controller 1 just pressed [$16] = A
$00:9C9C 4C DA A1     JMP.W InLevelGameMode           ; Run the level (demo plays on screen)

$00:9C9F 22 00 80 7F  JSL.L RAM_7F8000                ; Hide all sprites (RAM routine at $7F8000)
$00:9CA3 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = $04
$00:9CA5 8D 2C 21     STA.W $212C                     ; Main screen = BG3 only
$00:9CA8 A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; A = $13
$00:9CAA 8D 2D 21     STA.W $212D                     ; Sub screen = BG1, BG2 and sprites
$00:9CAD 9C 9F 0D     STZ.W $0D9F                     ; Disable all HDMA
$00:9CB0 A9 E9        LDA.B #$E9                      ; A = $E9
$00:9CB2 8D 09 01     STA.W $0109                     ; [$0109] = $E9 (intro level flag; $E9 - $24 = $C5)
$00:9CB5 20 06 9F     JSR.W CODE_WRITEOW              ; Initialize new save data (CODE_WRITEOW)
$00:9CB8 20 38 9D     JSR.W $9D38                     ; Draw the file select tilemap ($9D38)
$00:9CBB 4C 17 94     JMP.W $9417                     ; Game mode++ and return

$00:9CBE A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; A = controller 1 byte 2 ([$17], A X L R)
$00:9CC0 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; Keep A and X
$00:9CC2 D0 06        BNE $9CCA                       ; Pressed: return NZ
$00:9CC4 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; A = controller 1 byte 1 ([$15], B Y Select Start D-pad)
$00:9CC6 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; Keep B, Y, Select, Start
$00:9CC8 D0 00        BNE $9CCA                       ; Pressed: return NZ (BNE to the next instruction either way)
$00:9CCA 60           RTS                             ; Return (Z = no button pressed)



;;; $9CCB..9CCE: Table: SRAM offsets of save files ;;;
;; High and low bytes of the SRAM offset of each of the 3 save files ($0000, $008F, $011E; $8F bytes each).
;;     The backup copy is $1AD bytes after.
$00:9CCB              .db $00,$00,$01                 ; SRAM offset high bytes of the 3 save files

$00:9CCE              .db $00,$8F,$1E                 ; SRAM offset low bytes (offsets $0000, $008F, $011E)


;;; $9CD1: Game mode 08: file select, mode 0A: players ;;;
;; $009CD1: file select (game mode 08). Selecting ERASE DATA goes to game mode 09. Selecting a file checks its
;;     checksum, repairs the
;; other copy from the good one, loads the file into $1F49-$1FD5 and goes to the player select (game mode 0A).
;; $009D38: copies the file menu tilemap into the stripe buffer and prints each file's exit count. $009DB5:
;;     verifies a file's checksum
;; (sum of $8D bytes + stored word = $5A5A) with fallback to the backup copy; returns Z set when valid, X =
;;     offset of the valid copy.
;; $009DFA: game mode 0A: 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYER; $009E17 resets lives, powerups and score for a new game and
;;     goes to game mode $0B.
$00:9CD1 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$00:9CD3 A9 93 73     LDA.W #$7393                    ; |
$00:9CD6 A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; } BG color = $7393, CGADSUB = $20 ($9D30)
$00:9CD8 20 30 9D     JSR.W $9D30                     ; /
$00:9CDB A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$00:9CDD 20 CB 9A     JSR.W $9ACB                     ; / Menu with 4 entries (Y = 2); returns only when one is chosen
$00:9CE0 EE 00 01     INC.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode++ (09, erase file, unless a file is picked)
$00:9CE3 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; \
$00:9CE5 D0 08        BNE $9CEF                       ; / Branch unless entry 3 (ERASE DATA) was chosen
$00:9CE7 9C DE 0D     STZ.W $0DDE                     ; No files marked for erasing yet ([$0DDE] = 0)
$00:9CEA A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$00:9CEC 4C 3A 9D     JMP.W $9D3A                     ; / Show the erase data menu (stripe data offset 0)

$00:9CEF 8E 0A 01     STX.W $010A                     ; Save file number [$010A] = chosen file
$00:9CF2 20 B5 9D     JSR.W $9DB5                     ; Verify the checksum ($9DB5); X = valid copy, Y = other copy
$00:9CF5 D0 2B        BNE $9D22                       ; Bad data or empty file: start a new game
$00:9CF7 DA           PHX                             ; Save X (offset of the valid copy)
$00:9CF8 9C 09 01     STZ.W $0109                     ; [$0109] = 0: no intro level
$00:9CFB A9 8F        LDA.B #$8F                      ; A = $8F: bytes per file slot
$00:9CFD 85 00        STA $00                         ; Counter [$00] = $8F
$00:9CFF BF 00 00 70  LDA.L $700000,X                 ; A = byte of the valid copy
$00:9D03 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:9D04 BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (offset of the other copy)
$00:9D05 9F 00 00 70  STA.L $700000,X                 ; Write the byte there
$00:9D09 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:9D0A E8           INX                             ; Next source byte
$00:9D0B C8           INY                             ; Next destination byte
$00:9D0C C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Count down
$00:9D0E D0 EF        BNE $9CFF                       ; Loop: both copies now identical
$00:9D10 FA           PLX                             ; X = offset of the valid copy
$00:9D11 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0
$00:9D14 BF 00 00 70  LDA.L $700000,X                 ; A = byte of the save file
$00:9D18 99 49 1F     STA.W $1F49,Y                   ; Copy to the working save data $1F49+Y
$00:9D1B E8           INX                             ; Next source byte
$00:9D1C C8           INY                             ; Next destination byte
$00:9D1D C0 8D 00     CPY.W #$008D                    ; All $8D bytes copied?
$00:9D20 90 F2        BCC $9D14                       ; No: loop
$00:9D22 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:9D24 A0 12        LDY.B #$12                      ; \
$00:9D26 EE 00 01     INC.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Y = $12 (stripe image: 1 PLAYER GAME / 2 PLAYER GAME); game mode++ (0A)
$00:9D29 84 12        STY $12                         ; Stripe image [$12] = Y
$00:9D2B A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: empty the RAM stripe buffer
$00:9D2D 4C D4 9E     JMP.W $9ED4                     ; Reset the buffer and return

$00:9D30 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; BG color (CGRAM mirror $0701) = A
$00:9D33 84 40        STY $40                         ; CGADSUB mirror [$40] = Y
$00:9D35 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:9D37 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:9D38 A2 CB        LDX.B #$CB                      ; X = $CB: offset of the file select menu in $B6FE
$00:9D3A 64 05        STZ $05                         ; No files treated as empty
$00:9D3C C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers 16-bit
$00:9D3E A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: write index into the stripe buffer
$00:9D41 BF FE B6 05  LDA.L $B6FE,X                   ; A = menu tilemap data, X = read index
$00:9D45 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:9D46 BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (write index)
$00:9D47 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Store in the RAM stripe buffer $7F:837D
$00:9D4B FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:9D4C E8           INX                             ; Next source byte
$00:9D4D C8           INY                             ; Next buffer byte
$00:9D4E C0 CC 00     CPY.W #$00CC                    ; Copied $CC bytes?
$00:9D51 D0 EE        BNE $9D41                       ; No: loop
$00:9D53 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:9D55 A9 84        LDA.B #$84                      ; A = $84
$00:9D57 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = $84: buffer offset of file 2's exits count (the last entry)
$00:9D59 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; \
$00:9D5B 86 04        STX $04                         ; / File counter [$04] = 2 (files 2, 1, 0)
$00:9D5D 46 05        LSR $05                         ; \
$00:9D5F B0 45        BCS $9DA6                       ; / Next bit of [$05]; 1 = file is empty, keep the EMPTY text
$00:9D61 20 B5 9D     JSR.W $9DB5                     ; Verify the checksum of file X ($9DB5)
$00:9D64 D0 40        BNE $9DA6                       ; Invalid: keep the EMPTY text
$00:9D66 BF 8C 00 70  LDA.L $70008C,X                 ; A = number of exits completed in this file
$00:9D6A E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:9D6C C9 60        CMP.B #$60                      ; \
$00:9D6E 90 06        BCC $9D76                       ; / Exits < 96: print as number
$00:9D70 A0 87        LDY.B #$87                      ; \
$00:9D72 A9 88        LDA.B #$88                      ; / Exits = 96: two tiles $87 and $88 (the 96 graphic)
$00:9D74 80 04        BRA $9D7A                       ; Skip the decimal conversion

$00:9D76 20 45 90     JSR.W HexToDec                  ; A = ones, X = tens (HexToDec)
$00:9D79 9B           TXY                             ; Y = tens
$00:9D7A A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = buffer offset of this file's entry
$00:9D7C 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; Store the ones tile
$00:9D80 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:9D81 D0 02        BNE $9D85                       ; / Tens digit zero? Then use a blank tile
$00:9D83 A0 FC        LDY.B #$FC                      ; Y = $FC: blank tile
$00:9D85 98           TYA                             ; A = tens tile
$00:9D86 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; Store the tens tile
$00:9D8A A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; A = $38: tile properties (palette, priority)
$00:9D8C 9F 80 83 7F  STA.L $7F8380,X                 ; \
$00:9D90 9F 82 83 7F  STA.L $7F8382,X                 ; / Set the properties of both digit tiles
$00:9D94 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:9D96 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: three more tiles
$00:9D98 A9 FC 38     LDA.W #$38FC                    ; A = blank tile with properties $38
$00:9D9B 9F 83 83 7F  STA.L $7F8383,X                 ; Overwrite the rest of the word EMPTY
$00:9D9F E8           INX                             ; Next tile
$00:9DA0 E8           INX                             ; (2 bytes per tile)
$00:9DA1 88           DEY                             ; Count down
$00:9DA2 D0 F4        BNE $9D98                       ; Loop
$00:9DA4 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:9DA6 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:9DA8 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$00:9DAA 38           SEC                             ; } Buffer offset [$00] -= $24 (size of one file entry)
$00:9DAB E9 24        SBC.B #$24                      ; /
$00:9DAD 85 00        STA $00                         ; Save it
$00:9DAF A6 04        LDX $04                         ; \
$00:9DB1 CA           DEX                             ; } File counter - 1; repeat until file 0 is done
$00:9DB2 10 A7        BPL $9D5B                       ; /
$00:9DB4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:9DB5 BD CB 9C     LDA.W $9CCB,X                   ; A = high byte of file X's SRAM offset
$00:9DB8 EB           XBA                             ; Move it to the high half of A
$00:9DB9 BD CE 9C     LDA.W $9CCE,X                   ; A = low byte of the offset
$00:9DBC C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:9DBE AA           TAX                             ; X = SRAM offset of the primary copy
$00:9DBF 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:9DC0 69 AD 01     ADC.W #$01AD                    ; A += $01AD
$00:9DC3 A8           TAY                             ; Y = offset of the backup copy
$00:9DC4 DA           PHX                             ; Push X
$00:9DC5 5A           PHY                             ; Push Y
$00:9DC6 BF 8D 00 70  LDA.L $70008D,X                 ; A = stored checksum word at offset $8D
$00:9DCA 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; [$8A] = it
$00:9DCC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:9DCE A0 8D 00     LDY.W #$008D                    ; Y = $8D: data bytes to sum
$00:9DD1 BF 00 00 70  LDA.L $700000,X                 ; A = byte of the save data
$00:9DD5 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:9DD6 65 8A        ADC $8A                         ; } [$8A] += A (16-bit, carry below)
$00:9DD8 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; /
$00:9DDA 90 02        BCC $9DDE                       ; \
$00:9DDC E6 8B        INC $8B                         ; / Add the carry into [$8B]
$00:9DDE E8           INX                             ; Next byte
$00:9DDF 88           DEY                             ; Count down
$00:9DE0 D0 EF        BNE $9DD1                       ; Loop
$00:9DE2 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:9DE4 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$00:9DE5 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:9DE6 A5 8A        LDA $8A                         ; A = checksum + sum of data
$00:9DE8 C9 5A 5A     CMP.W #$5A5A                    ; Valid when it equals $5A5A
$00:9DEB F0 0A        BEQ $9DF7                       ; Valid: Z set, return
$00:9DED E0 AC 01     CPX.W #$01AC                    ; Already checked the backup copy?
$00:9DF0 B0 05        BCS $9DF7                       ; Yes: return with Z clear (invalid)
$00:9DF2 DA           PHX                             ; \
$00:9DF3 BB           TYX                             ; } Swap X and Y: now try the backup copy
$00:9DF4 7A           PLY                             ; /
$00:9DF5 80 CD        BRA $9DC4                       ; Checksum the backup copy

$00:9DF7 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:9DF9 60           RTS                             ; Return (Z = valid, X = offset of the valid copy)

$00:9DFA A5 16        LDA $16                         ; A = buttons just pressed on controller 1
$00:9DFC 05 18        ORA $18                         ; Or in controller 2's
$00:9DFE 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; Bit 6 (Y or X): back
$00:9E00 F0 06        BEQ $9E08                       ; Not pressed: run the menu
$00:9E02 CE 00 01     DEC.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode-- (to 09)
$00:9E05 4C 2C 9B     JMP.W $9B2C                     ; Go back to file select (decrements once more)

$00:9E08 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4: menu of 2 entries (1 PLAYER, 2 PLAYER)
$00:9E0A 20 CB 9A     JSR.W $9ACB                     ; Move the cursor (returns only when chosen)
$00:9E0D 8E B2 0D     STX.W $0DB2                     ; [$0DB2] = X: number of players - 1
$00:9E10 20 95 A1     JSR.W ConfMapFromSave           ; Load the overworld data from the save file
$00:9E13 22 AD DA 04  JSL.L $DAAD                     ; Initialize the overworld from the save ($DAAD)
$00:9E17 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80
$00:9E19 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; Music request [$1DFB] = $80 (fade out the music)
$00:9E1C A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF
$00:9E1E 8D B5 0D     STA.W $0DB5                     ; [$0DB5] = $FF
$00:9E21 AE B2 0D     LDX.W $0DB2                     ; X = number of players - 1
$00:9E24 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4 (lives stored minus one: start with 5 lives)
$00:9E26 9D B4 0D     STA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; Player X's lives = 4
$00:9E29 CA           DEX                             ; Next player
$00:9E2A 10 FA        BPL $9E26                       ; Loop for all players
$00:9E2C 8D BE 0D     STA.W RAM_StatusLives           ; Status bar lives = 4
$00:9E2F 9C BF 0D     STZ.W RAM_StatusCoins           ; Coins on the status bar = 0
$00:9E32 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Mario has no Yoshi on the overworld
$00:9E35 64 19        STZ RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Mario's powerup = small
$00:9E37 9C C2 0D     STZ.W $0DC2                     ; Reserve item = none
$00:9E3A 9C C9 13     STZ.W $13C9                     ; [$13C9] = 0: not in the CONTINUE/END menu
$00:9E3D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:9E3F 9C B6 0D     STZ.W RAM_PlayerCoins           ; Both players' coins = 0
$00:9E42 9C B8 0D     STZ.W RAM_PlayerPowerUp         ; Both players' powerups = small
$00:9E45 9C BA 0D     STZ.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor        ; Both players' Yoshi colors = 0
$00:9E48 9C C2 0D     STZ.W $0DC2                     ; Both players' reserve items = none
$00:9E4B 9C 48 0F     STZ.W $0F48                     ; Clear [$0F48] (probably bonus star counters)
$00:9E4E 9C 34 0F     STZ.W $0F34                     ; Player 1 score low word = 0
$00:9E51 9C 37 0F     STZ.W $0F37                     ; Player 2 score low word = 0
$00:9E54 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:9E56 9C 36 0F     STZ.W $0F36                     ; Player 1 score high byte = 0
$00:9E59 9C 39 0F     STZ.W $0F39                     ; Player 2 score high byte = 0
$00:9E5C 9C D5 0D     STZ.W $0DD5                     ; [$0DD5] = 0 (level exit type)
$00:9E5F 9C B3 0D     STZ.W $0DB3                     ; Current player = Mario
$00:9E62 20 29 9F     JSR.W KeepModeActive            ; Fade delay counter [$0DB1] = 1
$00:9E65 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B
$00:9E67 4C 8B 9C     JMP.W $9C8B                     ; Game mode = $0B (fade out of the title screen)



;;; $9E6A..9E72: Table: menu entry counts ;;;
;; Number of entries for each menu type (index = Y passed to the cursor routine): 2, 4, 2, 2, 4.
$00:9E6A              .db $02,$00,$04,$00,$02,$00,$02,$00 ; Entry counts: 2, 4, 2, 2, 4 (index = menu type * 2)
$00:9E72              .db $04,$00                     ; (last menu type: 4 entries)


;;; $9E74..9E7C: Table: menu cursor VRAM addresses ;;;
;; VRAM address (BG3 tilemap) of the first cursor tile of each menu type; the following entries are $40 (one
;;     tile row) apart.
$00:9E74              .db $CB,$51,$E8,$51,$08,$52,$C4,$51 ; VRAM address of the first cursor tile per menu type: $51CB, $51E8, $5208, $51C4, $51E5
$00:9E7C              .db $E5,$51                     ; (last menu type: $51E5)


;;; $9E7E..9E7E: Table: cursor position bit masks ;;;
$00:9E7E              .db $01,$02,$04,$08             ; Bit for cursor position 0-3 (1, 2, 4, 8)


;;; $9E82: Draw blinking menu cursor ;;;
;; Writes one stripe record per menu entry (cursor tile $2E or blank). The cursor blinks using [$1B91];
;;     position is [$1B92].
;; Parameters: Y: menu type (0, 2, 4, 6, 8).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9AD3: Menu cursor handler
$00:9E82 AE 92 1B     LDX.W $1B92                     ; X = cursor position [$1B92]
$00:9E85 BD 7E 9E     LDA.W $9E7E,X                   ; A = bit mask for that position
$00:9E88 AA           TAX                             ; X = mask
$00:9E89 AD 91 1B     LDA.W $1B91                     ; A = blink counter [$1B91]
$00:9E8C 49 1F        EOR.B #$1F                      ; Invert the low bits
$00:9E8E 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; Bits 3-4: blink phase
$00:9E90 D0 02        BNE $9E94                       ; Cursor visible in this phase
$00:9E92 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; Hidden: no entry gets the cursor (X = 0)
$00:9E94 86 00        STX $00                         ; [$00] = cursor bit mask
$00:9E96 AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; A = stripe buffer write index
$00:9E9A AA           TAX                             ; X = write index
$00:9E9B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:9E9D B9 6A 9E     LDA.W $9E6A,Y                   ; A = number of menu entries
$00:9EA0 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; \
$00:9EA2 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$8A] = [$02] = entry counter
$00:9EA4 B9 74 9E     LDA.W $9E74,Y                   ; A = VRAM address of the entry's cursor tile
$00:9EA7 EB           XBA                             ; Swap to big-endian for the stripe image header
$00:9EA8 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Write the VRAM address into the buffer
$00:9EAC EB           XBA                             ; Back to little-endian
$00:9EAD 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:9EAE 69 40 00     ADC.W #$0040                    ; } Next entry's VRAM address = this + $40 (pushed for later, never used)
$00:9EB1 48           PHA                             ; /
$00:9EB2 A9 00 01     LDA.W #$0100                    ; A = $0100: record length word (one tile)
$00:9EB5 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; Write it into the buffer
$00:9EB9 A9 FC 38     LDA.W #$38FC                    ; A = blank tile with properties $38
$00:9EBC 46 00        LSR $00                         ; Shift the mask; carry = this entry has the cursor
$00:9EBE 90 03        BCC $9EC3                       ; No cursor: use the blank tile
$00:9EC0 A9 2E 3D     LDA.W #$3D2E                    ; A = cursor tile $2E with properties $3D
$00:9EC3 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; Write the tile into the buffer
$00:9EC7 68           PLA                             ; Discard the pushed address
$00:9EC8 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:9EC9 E8           INX                             ; |
$00:9ECA E8           INX                             ; |
$00:9ECB E8           INX                             ; |
$00:9ECC E8           INX                             ; } Write index += 6 (one record)
$00:9ECD E8           INX                             ; /
$00:9ECE C6 02        DEC $02                         ; Next entry
$00:9ED0 D0 D5        BNE $9EA7                       ; Loop
$00:9ED2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:9ED4 8A           TXA                             ; A = write index
$00:9ED5 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; Save it as the new buffer index ($7F:837B)
$00:9ED9 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF: end marker
$00:9EDB 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Terminate the stripe image
$00:9EDF 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $9EE0: Table: new game save data entries (TBL_009EE0) ;;;
;; Pairs of (offset into the save data, value) written by CODE_WRITEOW: offset $28 = 3, $4D = 1, $52 = 1, $53
;;     = 1, $5B = 8, $5C = 2,
;; $57 = 4, $30 = 1. The first offset is at TBL_009EE0 and the first value at $9EE1.
$00:9EE0              .db $28                         ; Offset into the save data of the first byte

$00:9EE1              .db $03,$4D,$01,$52,$01,$53,$01,$5B ; Value, then (offset, value) pairs: $4D=1, $52=1, $53=1, $5B=8, $5C=2, $57=4, $30=1
$00:9EE9              .db $08,$5C,$02,$57,$04,$30,$01 ; (offset, value) pairs, continued


;;; $9EF0: Table: new game overworld state (TBL_009EF0) ;;;
;; 22 initial bytes written to the save data copy of $1F11-$1F26 (Mario and Luigi submap, positions, etc).
$00:9EF0              .db $01,$01,$02,$00,$02,$00,$68,$00 ; Initial overworld state for $1F11-$1F26 (submaps, positions): 22 bytes
$00:9EF8              .db $78,$00,$68,$00,$78,$00,$06,$00 ; Initial overworld state, continued
$00:9F00              .db $07,$00,$06,$00,$07,$00     ; Initial overworld state, last bytes


;;; $9F06: Initialize new save file data (CODE_WRITEOW) ;;;
;; Clears the working save data $1F49-$1FD5 and writes the defaults from TBL_009EE0 and TBL_009EF0.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9CB5: Game mode 07: title screen and demo (GAMEMODE_07)
$00:9F06 A2 8D        LDX.B #$8D                      ; X = $8D: size of the save data
$00:9F08 9E 48 1F     STZ.W $1F48,X                   ; Clear a byte of $1F49-$1FD5
$00:9F0B CA           DEX                             ; Next byte
$00:9F0C D0 FA        BNE $9F08                       ; Loop
$00:9F0E A2 0E        LDX.B #$0E                      ; X = $0E: last pair
$00:9F10 BC E0 9E     LDY.W TBL_009EE0,X              ; Y = offset into the save data
$00:9F13 BD E1 9E     LDA.W $9EE1,X                   ; A = value to write
$00:9F16 99 49 1F     STA.W $1F49,Y                   ; Save data[Y] = value
$00:9F19 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:9F1A CA           DEX                             ; / Next pair (X -= 2)
$00:9F1B 10 F3        BPL $9F10                       ; Loop
$00:9F1D A2 15        LDX.B #$15                      ; X = $15: bytes of the initial map state
$00:9F1F BD F0 9E     LDA.W TBL_009EF0,X              ; A = initial map state byte
$00:9F22 9D B8 1F     STA.W $1FB8,X                   ; Store at $1FB8+X (save data copy of $1F11-$1F26)
$00:9F25 CA           DEX                             ; Next byte
$00:9F26 10 F7        BPL $9F1F                       ; Loop
$00:9F28 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $9F29: Set fade step delay (KeepModeActive) ;;;
;; Sets the fade delay counter [$0DB1] to 1. $009F2B sets it to A.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9622: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:9E62: Game mode 08: file select, mode 0A: players
;;     $00:9F3C: Game modes 0F/13: fade with mosaic (TmpFade)
;;     $00:9F74: Advance game mode, apply mosaic; fade (GM++Mosaic)
;;     $00:A176: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
;;     $00:A5D2: Game mode 12: prepare level (GM04Load)
$00:9F29 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$00:9F2B 8D B1 0D     STA.W $0DB1                     ; Fade delay counter [$0DB1] = A
$00:9F2E 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $9F2F..9F33: Table: fade step values ;;;
;; Indexed by fade direction ([$0DAF]). $009F2F: brightness step (+1, -1). $009F31: mosaic size step (-$10,
;;     +$10).
;; $009F33: brightness that ends the fade ($0F, $00); two further entries ($00, $F0) look unused.
$00:9F2F              .db $01,$FF                     ; Brightness step per fade: +1 (fade in), -1 (fade out)

$00:9F31              .db $F0,$10                     ; Mosaic size step: -$10 (fade in), +$10 (fade out)

$00:9F33              .db $0F,$00,$00,$F0             ; Final brightness: $0F (in), $00 (out); other two entries unused


;;; $9F37: Game modes 0F/13: fade with mosaic (TmpFade) ;;;
;; Fades brightness [$0DAE] and mosaic size [$0DB0] by one step every other frame. When the final brightness
;;     is reached the game
;; mode is incremented and the direction [$0DAF] is flipped. Mosaic is applied to BG1 and BG2.
$00:9F37 CE B1 0D     DEC.W $0DB1                     ; Fade delay counter [$0DB1]--
$00:9F3A 10 32        BPL $9F6E                       ; Still positive: wait another frame
$00:9F3C 20 29 9F     JSR.W KeepModeActive            ; Delay counter = 1: step every other frame
$00:9F3F AC AF 0D     LDY.W $0DAF                     ; Y = fade direction [$0DAF] (0 = in, 1 = out)
$00:9F42 AD B0 0D     LDA.W $0DB0                     ; A = mosaic size [$0DB0]
$00:9F45 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:9F46 79 31 9F     ADC.W $9F31,Y                   ; / Mosaic size += step (high nibble = size)
$00:9F49 8D B0 0D     STA.W $0DB0                     ; Save it
$00:9F4C AD AE 0D     LDA.W $0DAE                     ; A = brightness [$0DAE]
$00:9F4F 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:9F50 79 2F 9F     ADC.W $9F2F,Y                   ; / Brightness += step (+1 or -1)
$00:9F53 8D AE 0D     STA.W $0DAE                     ; Save it
$00:9F56 D9 33 9F     CMP.W $9F33,Y                   ; Reached the final brightness?
$00:9F59 D0 0B        BNE $9F66                       ; No: update mosaic and return

;;; $9F5B: Advance game mode, apply mosaic; fade (GM++Mosaic) ;;;
;; $009F5B: game mode++, flip the fade direction, set MOSAIC. $009F6F: fade step without mosaic (brightness
;;     only) used by many game
;; modes. $009F7C: slower fade (delay 8) used for the ending fade.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:97C4: Game mode 11: Mario Start, level music (MarioStartGameMode)
$00:9F5B EE 00 01     INC.W RAM_GameMode              ; Fade finished: game mode++
$00:9F5E AD AF 0D     LDA.W $0DAF                     ; \
$00:9F61 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Flip the fade direction [$0DAF] ^= 1
$00:9F63 8D AF 0D     STA.W $0DAF                     ; /
$00:9F66 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:9F68 0D B0 0D     ORA.W $0DB0                     ; / A = $03 | mosaic size: mosaic on BG1 and BG2
$00:9F6B 8D 06 21     STA.W $2106                     ; MOSAIC = A
$00:9F6E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:9F6F CE B1 0D     DEC.W $0DB1                     ; Fade delay counter [$0DB1]--
$00:9F72 10 FA        BPL $9F6E                       ; Still positive: return
$00:9F74 20 29 9F     JSR.W KeepModeActive            ; Delay counter = 1
$00:9F77 AC AF 0D     LDY.W $0DAF                     ; Y = fade direction [$0DAF]
$00:9F7A 80 D0        BRA $9F4C                       ; Do the fade step (brightness only, shares TmpFade code)

$00:9F7C CE B1 0D     DEC.W $0DB1                     ; Fade delay counter [$0DB1]--
$00:9F7F 10 ED        BPL $9F6E                       ; Still positive: return
$00:9F81 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8
$00:9F83 20 2B 9F     JSR.W $9F2B                     ; Fade delay counter = 8 (slow fade)
$00:9F86 80 EF        BRA $9F77                       ; Do the fade step



;;; $9F88..9FB0: Table: layer 3 setup per tileset ;;;
;; 16 tilesets x 3 bytes (layer 3 type 1-3). Positive: effect value for [$1403]. $80: copy palette, $81: image
;;     with BG3 scroll, $C0: none.
$00:9F88              .db $01,$02,$C0,$01,$80,$81,$01,$02 ; Layer 3 setup per tileset, 3 bytes each (layer 3 type 1-3); tileset 0, 1, 2...
$00:9F90              .db $C0,$01,$02,$81,$01,$02,$80,$01 ; Layer 3 setup table, continued (positive = effect, $80/$81/$C0 = static image)
$00:9F98              .db $02,$81,$01,$02,$81,$01,$02,$C0 ; Layer 3 setup table, continued (positive = effect, $80/$81/$C0 = static image)
$00:9FA0              .db $01,$02,$C0,$01,$02,$81,$01,$02 ; Layer 3 setup table, continued (positive = effect, $80/$81/$C0 = static image)
$00:9FA8              .db $80,$01,$02,$80,$01,$02,$80,$01 ; Layer 3 setup table, continued (positive = effect, $80/$81/$C0 = static image)
$00:9FB0              .db $02,$81,$01,$02,$81,$01,$02,$80 ; Layer 3 setup table, continued (positive = effect, $80/$81/$C0 = static image)


;;; $9FB8: Set up layer 3 (BG3) for the level ;;;
;; Looks up the layer 3 setup in $9F88 for tileset [$1931] and type [$1BE3], sets BG3 scroll, color math
;;     and uploads the
;; layer 3 image through Layer3Ptr. Called when a level is loaded.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:A5C3: Game mode 12: prepare level (GM04Load)
$00:9FB8 AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; \
$00:9FBB 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:9FBC 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:9FBD 6D 31 19     ADC.W $1931                     ; } [$00] = tileset [$1931] * 3
$00:9FC0 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:9FC2 AD E3 1B     LDA.W $1BE3                     ; A = layer 3 type [$1BE3] (0 = none)
$00:9FC5 F0 4B        BEQ $A012                       ; None: go to $00A012 (BG3 scroll $D0, no image)
$00:9FC7 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$00:9FC8 18           CLC                             ; } A = (type - 1) + tileset * 3
$00:9FC9 65 00        ADC $00                         ; /
$00:9FCB AA           TAX                             ; X = table index
$00:9FCC BD 88 9F     LDA.W $9F88,X                   ; A = layer 3 setup for this tileset and type
$00:9FCF 30 19        BMI $9FEA                       ; Bit 7 set: static image, go to $009FEA
$00:9FD1 8D 03 14     STA.W $1403                     ; [$1403] = layer 3 effect value (1 or 2)
$00:9FD4 4A           LSR                             ; A >>= 1, Z = effect value was 1
$00:9FD5 08           PHP                             ; Save the flags
$00:9FD6 20 45 A0     JSR.W $A045                     ; Clear layer 3 tilemap RAM and set the vertical flag ($A045)
$00:9FD9 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; BG3 Y scroll = $70
$00:9FDB 28           PLP                             ; Restore flags
$00:9FDC F0 02        BEQ $9FE0                       ; Effect 1: keep $70
$00:9FDE A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; Effect 2: BG3 Y scroll = $40
$00:9FE0 85 24        STA $24                         ; BG3 vertical scroll low [$24] = A
$00:9FE2 64 25        STZ $25                         ; High byte [$25] = 0
$00:9FE4 22 72 BC 05  JSL.L $BC72                     ; Initialize the layer 3 effect ($BC72)
$00:9FE8 80 31        BRA $A01B                       ; Skip the image upload code, go to $00A01B

$00:9FEA 0A           ASL                             ; A <<= 1: bit 7 -> carry, $C0 -> $80, $80 -> $00, $81 -> $02
$00:9FEB 30 25        BMI $A012                       ; $C0: handled like no layer 3 (go to $00A012)
$00:9FED F0 18        BEQ $A007                       ; $80: copy palette colors
$00:9FEF AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; A = tileset
$00:9FF2 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Tileset 1 (castle)?
$00:9FF4 F0 04        BEQ $9FFA                       ; Yes: scroll BG3 with BG1
$00:9FF6 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; Tileset 3 (underground)?
$00:9FF8 D0 25        BNE $A01F                       ; No: just load the image
$00:9FFA C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:9FFC A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; A = layer 1 X position
$00:9FFE 4A           LSR                             ; A / 2
$00:9FFF 85 22        STA $22                         ; BG3 horizontal scroll [$22] = layer 1 X / 2


;;; $A001: Layer 3 setup, continued; clear L3 RAM (in1Remember) ;;;
;; $00A001-$00A044: second half of the layer 3 setup (palette copy for type $80, BG3 scroll, image upload).
;; $00A045: clears $B0 bytes of every $100-byte block of $7E:E400-$7E:FAFF and sets bit 7 of
;;     [RAM_IsVerticalLvl].
; You can get somewhere quick by pressing ctrl+f and typing in the address.


$00:A001 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A003 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; A = $C0
$00:A005 80 10        BRA $A017                       ; BG3 vertical scroll = $C0 (skip to the store)

$00:A007 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7
$00:A009 BD 6C B6     LDA.W $B66C,X                   ; A = palette byte from $B66C
$00:A00C 9D 1B 07     STA.W $071B,X                   ; Store in the CGRAM mirror $071B+X
$00:A00F CA           DEX                             ; Next byte
$00:A010 10 F7        BPL $A009                       ; Loop
$00:A012 EE D5 13     INC.W $13D5                     ; [$13D5]++ (no animated layer 3 flag)
$00:A015 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$00:A017 85 24        STA $24                         ; BG3 vertical scroll low [$24] = A
$00:A019 64 25        STZ $25                         ; High byte [$25] = 0
$00:A01B A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = $04
$00:A01D 14 40        TRB $40                         ; CGADSUB: BG3 not in color math ([$40] bit 2 cleared)
$00:A01F AD E3 1B     LDA.W $1BE3                     ; A = layer 3 type
$00:A022 F0 20        BEQ $A044                       ; None: return
$00:A024 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$00:A025 18           CLC                             ; } A = type - 1 + tileset * 3
$00:A026 65 00        ADC $00                         ; /
$00:A028 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = it
$00:A02A 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:A02B 18           CLC                             ; } A = A * 3 (3-byte pointers)
$00:A02C 65 01        ADC $01                         ; /
$00:A02E AA           TAX                             ; X = offset into Layer3Ptr
$00:A02F BF 00 90 05  LDA.L Layer3Ptr,X               ; Pointer low byte
$00:A033 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = it
$00:A035 BF 01 90 05  LDA.L Layer3Ptr+1,X             ; Pointer high byte
$00:A039 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = it
$00:A03B BF 02 90 05  LDA.L Layer3Ptr+2,X             ; Pointer bank
$00:A03F 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = it
$00:A041 20 1E 87     JSR.W $871E                     ; Upload the layer 3 image (stripe image) to VRAM
$00:A044 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:A045 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:A047 A2 00 01     LDX.W #$0100                    ; X = $0100: start offset
$00:A04A A0 58 00     LDY.W #$0058                    ; Y = $58: words to clear per block
$00:A04D A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; A = 0
$00:A050 9F 00 E3 7E  STA.L $7EE300,X                 ; Clear a word at $7E:E300+X
$00:A054 E8           INX                             ; X += 2 (next word)
$00:A055 E8           INX                             ; (second INX)
$00:A056 88           DEY                             ; Count down
$00:A057 D0 F7        BNE $A050                       ; Loop for $B0 bytes
$00:A059 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:A05A 18           CLC                             ; } X += $0100: next block (stride $100)
$00:A05B 69 00 01     ADC.W #$0100                    ; /
$00:A05E AA           TAX                             ; X = it
$00:A05F E0 00 1B     CPX.W #$1B00                    ; X reached $1B00?
$00:A062 90 E6        BCC $A04A                       ; No: clear the next block
$00:A064 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:A066 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80
$00:A068 04 5B        TSB RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; Set bit 7 of [RAM_IsVerticalLvl]
$00:A06A 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A06B..A073: Table: overworld X start per submap ;;;
;; Layer 1 X position for each overworld submap 0-6, indexed by submap * 2.
$00:A06B              .db $00,$00,$EF,$FF,$EF,$FF,$EF,$FF ; Layer 1 X start of each overworld submap: 0000, FFEF x3, 00F0 x3
$00:A073              .db $F0,$00,$F0,$00,$F0,$00     ; (submaps 4-6: $00F0)


;;; $A079..A081: Table: overworld Y start per submap ;;;
;; Layer 1 Y position for each overworld submap 0-6, indexed by submap * 2.
$00:A079              .db $00,$00,$D8,$FF,$80,$00,$28,$01 ; Layer 1 Y start per submap: 0000, FFD8, 0080, 0128, FFD8, 0080, 0128
$00:A081              .db $D8,$FF,$80,$00,$28,$01     ; (submaps 4-6, continued)

;;; New labels (not in original all.log):
;;; $A087 => LoadMapGameMode
;;; $A195 => ConfMapFromSave

;;; JSR subroutine
;;; Implements game mode $0C, load the world map (the overworld).
;;;
;;; 00A087:

;;; $A087: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode) ;;;
;; Loads the overworld. If [$0109] is non-zero the map is skipped and the game goes straight to Mario Start
;;     (game mode $10).
;; Otherwise it uploads graphics and palettes, saves the player's lives, powerup, coins, Yoshi and reserve
;;     item, handles the game over
;; case (reload saved data, CONTINUE/END or title screen), and positions the map for the current player's
;;     submap.
$00:A087 20 7D 93     JSR.W TurnOffIO                 ; Disable NMI, HDMA and the screen
$00:A08A AD 9C 1B     LDA.W $1B9C                     ; A = [$1B9C] (overworld event flag?)
$00:A08D F0 04        BEQ $A093                       ; Zero: skip
$00:A08F 22 3B 85 04  JSL.L $853B                     ; Run the overworld routine $853B
$00:A093 20 A6 A1     JSR.W Clear_1A_13D3             ; Clear [$1A]-[$D7] and $13D3-$1BA1
$00:A096 AD 09 01     LDA.W $0109                     ; A = [$0109]
$00:A099 F0 15        BEQ $A0B0                       ; Zero: enter the overworld normally

;; | only runs if using RAM $0109 to bypass the world map
;; V
$00:A09B A9 B0        LDA.B #$B0                      ; A = $B0
$00:A09D 8D F5 1D     STA.W $1DF5                     ; [$1DF5] = $B0 (delay timer)
$00:A0A0 9C 11 1F     STZ.W $1F11                     ; Mario's submap [$1F11] = 0
$00:A0A3 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; A = $F0
$00:A0A5 8D B0 0D     STA.W $0DB0                     ; [$0DB0] = $F0 (mosaic size: start of fade)
$00:A0A8 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$00:A0AA 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode = $10 (skip the map, straight to Mario Start)
$00:A0AD 4C F7 93     JMP.W Mode04Finish              ; Enable NMI and return

;; | runs if entering the world map
;; |   (after opening save, completing level, or dying)
;; V
$00:A0B0 20 FA 85     JSR.W $85FA                     ; Clear BG3 and sprites ($85FA)
$00:A0B3 20 0E 81     JSR.W UploadMusicBank1          ; Upload music bank 1 (overworld music)
$00:A0B6 20 79 8A     JSR.W SetUpScreen               ; Set up the PPU registers (SetUpScreen)
$00:A0B9 9C DA 0D     STZ.W $0DDA                     ; [$0DDA] = 0: no music request pending
$00:A0BC AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; X = current player (0 Mario, 1 Luigi)
$00:A0BF AD BE 0D     LDA.W RAM_StatusLives           ; A = lives on the status bar
$00:A0C2 10 03        BPL $A0C7                       ; \
$00:A0C4 EE 87 1B     INC.W $1B87                     ; / Negative lives: [$1B87]++ to trigger the game over message
$00:A0C7 9D B4 0D     STA.W RAM_PlayerLives,X         ; Save lives for the current player
$00:A0CA A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = Mario powerup
$00:A0CC 9D B8 0D     STA.W RAM_PlayerPowerUp,X       ; Save for the current player
$00:A0CF AD BF 0D     LDA.W RAM_StatusCoins           ; A = coins
$00:A0D2 9D B6 0D     STA.W RAM_PlayerCoins,X         ; Save for the current player
$00:A0D5 AD C1 0D     LDA.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; A = player has Yoshi on the map?
$00:A0D8 F0 03        BEQ $A0DD                       ; No: Yoshi color 0
$00:A0DA AD C7 13     LDA.W RAM_YoshiColor            ; Yes: A = Yoshi color
$00:A0DD 9D BA 0D     STA.W RAM_PlyrYoshiColor,X      ; Save Yoshi color for the current player
$00:A0E0 AD C2 0D     LDA.W $0DC2                     ; A = reserve item
$00:A0E3 9D BC 0D     STA.W $0DBC,X                   ; Save for the current player
$00:A0E6 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; A = $03
$00:A0E8 85 44        STA $44                         ; Color window settings [$44] = $03
$00:A0EA A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30: CGADSUB for the normal case
$00:A0EC A2 15        LDX.B #$15                      ; X = $15: main screen layers (BG1, BG3, sprites)
$00:A0EE AC C9 13     LDY.W $13C9                     ; Y = [$13C9] (CONTINUE/END flag)
$00:A0F1 F0 28        BEQ $A11B                       ; Not returning after a game over: skip ahead

;; | runs if returning to world map after Game Over
;; V
$00:A0F3 20 95 A1     JSR.W ConfMapFromSave           ; Revert to the saved overworld data
$00:A0F6 AD 2E 1F     LDA.W $1F2E                     ; A = number of exits cleared
$00:A0F9 D0 06        BNE $A101                       ; Non-zero: show the CONTINUE/END menu
$00:A0FB 20 89 9C     JSR.W $9C89                     ; No exits: set game mode 2 (title)
$00:A0FE 4C F4 93     JMP.W $93F4                     ; Game mode++ and exit
$00:A101 22 AD DA 04  JSL.L $DAAD                     ; Initialize the overworld from the save ($DAAD)
$00:A105 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:A107 A9 8C 31     LDA.W #$318C                    ; A = $318C
$00:A10A 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; BG color = $318C (darker background)
$00:A10D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A10F A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30
$00:A111 85 43        STA $43                         ; Window mask settings [$43] = $30
$00:A113 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$00:A115 85 44        STA $44                         ; Color math window [$44] = $20
$00:A117 A9 B3        LDA.B #$B3                      ; A = $B3: CGADSUB
$00:A119 A2 17        LDX.B #$17                      ; X = $17: main screen layers
;; fall through

;; |  If continuing after Game Over: A = $B3, X = $17
;; V If came here by skipping ahead: A = $30, X = $15
$00:A11B A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: sub screen layers (BG2)
$00:A11D 20 FD 93     JSR.W ScreenSettings            ; Set CGADSUB, main and sub screens (ScreenSettings)
$00:A120 8E 2E 21     STX.W $212E                     ; Main screen window mask = X
$00:A123 8C 2F 21     STY.W $212F                     ; Sub screen window mask = Y
$00:A126 22 09 DC 04  JSL.L $DC09                     ; Load all overworld layers ($DC09)
$00:A12A AE B3 0D     LDX.W $0DB3                     ; X = current player
$00:A12D BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; A = submap of the current player
$00:A130 0A           ASL                             ; A * 2
$00:A131 AA           TAX                             ; X = word index
$00:A132 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:A134 BD 6B A0     LDA.W $A06B,X                   ; A = X start position of the submap
$00:A137 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$00:A139 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; / Layer 1 X [$1A] = layer 2 X [$1E] = A
$00:A13B BD 79 A0     LDA.W $A079,X                   ; A = Y start position of the submap
$00:A13E 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$00:A140 85 20        STA $20                         ; / Layer 1 Y [$1C] = layer 2 Y [$20] = A
$00:A142 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A144 20 DA A9     JSR.W UploadSpriteGFX           ; Upload sprite graphics (UploadSpriteGFX)
$00:A147 A0 14        LDY.B #$14                      ; Y = $14: graphics file number
$00:A149 22 28 BA 00  JSL.L $BA28                     ; Decompress that graphics file ($BA28)
$00:A14D 20 25 AD     JSR.W $AD25                     ; Load the overworld palettes ($AD25)
$00:A150 20 2F 92     JSR.W $922F                     ; Set up the window HDMA ($922F)
$00:A153 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$00:A155 85 12        STA $12                         ; / Stripe image $06: overworld border
$00:A157 20 D2 85     JSR.W LoadScrnImage             ; Upload it (LoadScrnImage)
$00:A15A 22 F2 DB 05  JSL.L $DBF2                     ; Build more tilemap data in the stripe buffer ($DBF2)
$00:A15E 20 D2 85     JSR.W LoadScrnImage             ; Upload it (LoadScrnImage)
$00:A161 22 91 8D 04  JSL.L $8D91                     ; Overworld sprite / path setup ($8D91)
$00:A165 22 E9 D6 04  JSL.L $D6E9                     ; Overworld setup ($D6E9)
$00:A169 A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; A = $F0
$00:A16B 85 3F        STA $3F                         ; OAM priority index [$3F] = $F0
$00:A16D 20 94 84     JSR.W $8494                     ; Pack the OAM size bits ($8494)
$00:A170 20 D2 85     JSR.W LoadScrnImage             ; Upload the stripe image (LoadScrnImage)
$00:A173 9C D9 13     STZ.W $13D9                     ; [$13D9] = 0 (overworld process: normal)
$00:A176 20 29 9F     JSR.W KeepModeActive            ; Fade delay counter = 1
$00:A179 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$00:A17B 8D 9B 0D     STA.W $0D9B                     ; [$0D9B] = 2 (special level mode: overworld)
$00:A17E C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$00:A180 A2 BE 01     LDX.W #$01BE                    ; X = $01BE
$00:A183 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; A = $FF
$00:A185 9E A0 04     STZ.W $04A0,X                   ; Clear [$04A0+X] (probably resets a sprite table)
$00:A188 9D A1 04     STA.W $04A1,X                   ; [$04A1+X] = $FF
$00:A18B CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:A18C CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:A18D 10 F6        BPL $A185                       ; Loop
$00:A18F 20 A0 92     JSR.W $92A0                     ; Enable HDMA channel 7 ($92A0)
$00:A192 4C F4 93     JMP.W $93F4                     ; Game mode++ and exit

;;; JSR subroutine
;;;
;;; Configures the world map. Sets the level settings (RAM $7e1ea2..$7e1f01),
;;; event flags (RAM $7e1f02..$7e1f10), and Mario and Luigi (RAM $7e1f11..$7e1f26),
;;; switch place status (RAM $7e1f27..$7e1f2a), unknown (RAM $7e1f2b..$7e1f2d) and
;;; number of exits (RAM $7e1f2e),
;;;   by loading everything from the open save file (RAM $7e1f49..$7e1fd5).
;;;
;;; 00A195:

;;; $A195: Copy save data to overworld state (ConfMapFromSave) ;;;
;; Copies $8D bytes from $1F49-$1FD5 (save data in RAM) to $1EA2-$1F2E (live overworld data).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9E10: Game mode 08: file select, mode 0A: players
;;     $00:A0F3: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
$00:A195 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers 16-bit
$00:A197 A2 8C 00     LDX.W #$008C                    ; X = $8C: 141 bytes
$00:A19A BD 49 1F     LDA.W $1F49,X                   ; A = save data byte at $1F49+X
$00:A19D 9D A2 1E     STA.W $1EA2,X                   ; Copy to the live table $1EA2+X
$00:A1A0 CA           DEX                             ; Next byte
$00:A1A1 10 F7        BPL $A19A                       ; Loop
$00:A1A3 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:A1A5 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $A1A6: Clear RAM; game mode 0E: overworld (Clear_1A_13D3) ;;;
;; $00A1A6: clears [$1A]-[$D7] and $13D3-$1BA1.
;; $00A1BE: game mode 0E: runs the overworld each frame (SetUp0DA0GM4, hides sprites, GameMode_0E_Prim in bank
;;     $04, packs OAM size bits).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:946B: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:95C4: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:9640: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:A093: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
$00:A1A6 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers 16-bit
$00:A1A8 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A1AA A2 BD 00     LDX.W #$00BD                    ; X = $BD
$00:A1AD 74 1A        STZ RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; Clear [$1A+X]
$00:A1AF CA           DEX                             ; Next
$00:A1B0 10 FB        BPL $A1AD                       ; Loop: clears [$1A]-[$D7]
$00:A1B2 A2 CE 07     LDX.W #$07CE                    ; X = $07CE
$00:A1B5 9E D3 13     STZ.W $13D3,X                   ; Clear $13D3+X
$00:A1B8 CA           DEX                             ; Next
$00:A1B9 10 FA        BPL $A1B5                       ; Loop: clears $13D3-$1BA1
$00:A1BB E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:A1BD 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:A1BE 20 74 9A     JSR.W SetUp0DA0GM4              ; Check controllers (SetUp0DA0GM4)
$00:A1C1 E6 14        INC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; Frame counter B [$14]++
$00:A1C3 22 00 80 7F  JSL.L RAM_7F8000                ; Hide all sprites
$00:A1C7 22 41 82 04  JSL.L GameMode_0E_Prim          ; Run the overworld (GameMode_0E_Prim, bank $04)
$00:A1CB 4C 94 84     JMP.W $8494                     ; Pack OAM size bits and return



;;; $A1CE: Table: ground shake Y offset (low) (GrndShakeDispYLo) ;;;
$00:A1CE              .db $FE,$00,$02,$00             ; Ground shake Y offsets (low): -2, 0, +2, 0


;;; $A1D2: Table: ground shake Y offset (high); unknown (GrndShakeDispYHi) ;;;
;; $00A1D2: high bytes of the ground shake offsets. $00A1D6: unknown 4 byte table ($12, $22, $12, $02).
$00:A1D2              .db $FF,$00,$00,$00             ; Ground shake Y offsets (high): $FF, 0, 0, 0

$00:A1D6              .db $12,$22,$12,$02             ; Unknown table: $12, $22, $12, $02


;;; $A1DA: Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode) ;;;
;; Runs once per frame while playing a level. Runs the message box instead if one is open; handles bonus game
;;     ending input lock, the pause toggle (Start),
;; and leaving the level with Select (only for levels already beaten). When not paused: sprites off-screen,
;;     scroll, layer updates, animated tiles,
;; ground shake, status bar, Mario, sprites, then OAM size packing.
;; Quirk: $00A249-$00A259 and $00A274-$00A27B are unreachable debug code (slow motion, beat level with
;;     Select).
;; $00A2F3: copies Mario's X/Y position to [$D1]/[$D3] (previous-frame position).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9C9C: Game mode 07: title screen and demo (GAMEMODE_07)
$00:A1DA AD 26 14     LDA.W $1426                     ; \
$00:A1DD F0 05        BEQ $A1E4                       ; / If a message box is open ([$1426] != 0), run it and return
$00:A1DF 22 0C B1 05  JSL.L $B10C                     ; Run the message box routine ($B10C)
$00:A1E3 60           RTS                             ; Return (no game logic while the message box is up)

$00:A1E4 AD 25 14     LDA.W $1425                     ; \
$00:A1E7 F0 17        BEQ $A200                       ; / [$1425] = 0 (not in the bonus game): skip the bonus game checks
$00:A1E9 AD AB 14     LDA.W $14AB                     ; \
$00:A1EC F0 12        BEQ $A200                       ; / [$14AB] = 0: bonus game timer not running, skip
$00:A1EE C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; \
$00:A1F0 B0 0E        BCS $A200                       ; / [$14AB] >= $40: plenty of time left, skip
$00:A1F2 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Clear controller input (NoButtons)
$00:A1F5 C9 1C        CMP.B #$1C                      ; \
$00:A1F7 B0 07        BCS $A200                       ; / [$14AB] >= $1C: not yet time for the end pose, skip
$00:A1F9 20 31 CA     JSR.W SetMarioPeaceImg          ; Set Mario's peace sign pose (SetMarioPeaceImg)
$00:A1FC A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$00:A1FE 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = $0D (probably an unintended, glitchy animation value)
$00:A200 05 71        ORA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$00:A202 0D 93 14     ORA.W $1493                     ; } A = [Mario animation] | [$1493]; if both 0 (nothing special going on) skip
$00:A205 F0 0A        BEQ $A211                       ; /
$00:A207 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:A209 14 15        TRB RAM_ControllerA             ; / Mario is busy: ignore Down held ([$15] bit 2)
$00:A20B A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$00:A20D 14 16        TRB $16                         ; } Also ignore Y just pressed ([$16] bit 6) and X just pressed ([$18] bit 6)
$00:A20F 14 18        TRB $18                         ; /
$00:A211 AD D3 13     LDA.W $13D3                     ; \
$00:A214 F0 05        BEQ $A21B                       ; / [$13D3] (pause delay) = 0: pausing allowed, else skip to the next check
$00:A216 CE D3 13     DEC.W $13D3                     ; \
$00:A219 80 27        BRA $A242                       ; / Delay running: [$13D3]--, skip the pause check

$00:A21B A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$00:A21D 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Start not just pressed ([$16] bit 4 clear): skip the pause check
$00:A21F F0 21        BEQ $A242                       ; /
$00:A221 AD 93 14     LDA.W $1493                     ; \
$00:A224 D0 1C        BNE $A242                       ; / [$1493] != 0 (level is ending): skip
$00:A226 A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$00:A228 C9 09        CMP.B #$09                      ; } Mario animation >= 9 (death, level end, ...): skip
$00:A22A B0 16        BCS $A242                       ; /
$00:A22C A9 3C        LDA.B #$3C                      ; \
$00:A22E 8D D3 13     STA.W $13D3                     ; / Pause delay [$13D3] = $3C frames
$00:A231 A0 12        LDY.B #$12                      ; Y = $12 (sound effect: unpause)
$00:A233 AD D4 13     LDA.W $13D4                     ; \
$00:A236 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Toggle pause flag [$13D4]
$00:A238 8D D4 13     STA.W $13D4                     ; /
$00:A23B F0 02        BEQ $A23F                       ; Now 0 (unpaused): keep Y = $12
$00:A23D A0 11        LDY.B #$11                      ; Y = $11 (sound effect: pause)
$00:A23F 8C F9 1D     STY.W $1DF9                     ; Play the pause/unpause sound ([$1DF9])
$00:A242 AD D4 13     LDA.W $13D4                     ; \
$00:A245 F0 43        BEQ $A28A                       ; / [$13D4] = 0 (not paused): run the game logic at $00A28A
$00:A247 80 12        BRA $A25B                       ; Paused: go handle Select (exit level)

$00:A249 2C A7 0D     BIT.W $0DA7                     ; \
$00:A24C 70 0B        BVS $A259                       ; / Unused debug slow motion: [$0DA7] bit 6 set runs the frame normally
$00:A24E AD A3 0D     LDA.W $0DA3                     ; \
$00:A251 10 08        BPL $A25B                       ; / Unused: [$0DA3] bit 7 clear: stay paused
$00:A253 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:A255 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Unused: otherwise run game logic only every 16th frame
$00:A257 D0 02        BNE $A25B                       ; /
$00:A259 80 2F        BRA $A28A                       ; Unused: run this frame's game logic

$00:A25B A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:A25D 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Select not held ([$15] bit 5 clear): return
$00:A25F F0 28        BEQ $A289                       ; /
$00:A261 AC BF 13     LDY.W $13BF                     ; \
$00:A264 B9 A2 1E     LDA.W $1EA2,Y                   ; } Y = translevel [$13BF]; [$1EA2+Y] bit 7 clear (level not beaten yet): can't exit, return
$00:A267 10 20        BPL $A289                       ; /
$00:A269 AD D5 0D     LDA.W $0DD5                     ; \
$00:A26C F0 02        BEQ $A270                       ; / [$0DD5] = 0: no exit set yet, continue
$00:A26E 10 19        BPL $A289                       ; Exit already set (positive value): return
$00:A270 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80: exit type for leaving with Select
$00:A272 80 0A        BRA $A27E                       ; Skip the unused debug code

$00:A274 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; Unused debug: A = 1 (normal exit)
$00:A276 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:A278 10 01        BPL $A27B                       ; / Unused debug: if B is held ([$15] bit 7)
$00:A27A 1A           INC A                           ; Unused debug: A = 2 (secret exit)
$00:A27B 8D CE 13     STA.W $13CE                     ; Unused debug: [$13CE] = A (probably the midway flag)
$00:A27E 8D D5 0D     STA.W $0DD5                     ; [$0DD5] = exit type (level ends via Select)
$00:A281 EE E9 1D     INC.W $1DE9                     ; [$1DE9]++ (general transition counter, probably)
$00:A284 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:A286 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Game mode = $0B (fade out, back to the overworld)
$00:A289 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:A28A AD 9B 0D     LDA.W $0D9B                     ; \
$00:A28D 10 06        BPL $A295                       ; / [$0D9B] bit 7 clear (normal level): go to $00A295
$00:A28F 20 7D 98     JSR.W $987D                     ; Mode 7 boss room: run the boss room frame code ($987D)
$00:A292 4C A9 A2     JMP.W $A2A9                     ; Skip the normal level code, continue at $00A2A9

$00:A295 22 00 80 7F  JSL.L RAM_7F8000                ; Move all sprites off-screen (RAM routine $7F8000)
$00:A299 22 DB F6 00  JSL.L $F6DB                     ; Handle screen scrolling ($F6DB)
$00:A29D 22 00 BC 05  JSL.L $BC00                     ; Scroll the background layers ($BC00)
$00:A2A1 22 F1 86 05  JSL.L $86F1                     ; Load map16 columns/rows as the screen scrolls ($86F1)
$00:A2A5 22 39 BB 05  JSL.L $BB39                     ; Build the animated tile graphics for this frame ($BB39)
$00:A2A9 A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$00:A2AB 48           PHA                             ; |
$00:A2AC A5 1D        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; } Save the layer 1 Y scroll position on the stack
$00:A2AE 48           PHA                             ; /
$00:A2AF 9C 88 18     STZ.W RAM_Layer1DispYLo         ; \
$00:A2B2 9C 89 18     STZ.W RAM_Layer1DispYHi         ; / Layer 1 Y displacement [$1888] = 0
$00:A2B5 AD 87 18     LDA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; \
$00:A2B8 F0 1B        BEQ $A2D5                       ; / Shake ground timer [$1887] = 0: no shaking
$00:A2BA CE 87 18     DEC.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; [$1887]--
$00:A2BD 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$00:A2BF A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1887] & 3: index into the shake tables
$00:A2C0 B9 CE A1     LDA.W GrndShakeDispYLo,Y        ; A = GrndShakeDispYLo[Y] ($FE, 0, 2, 0)
$00:A2C3 8D 88 18     STA.W RAM_Layer1DispYLo         ; [$1888] = displacement low byte
$00:A2C6 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:A2C7 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } Layer 1 Y scroll low += displacement low
$00:A2C9 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; /
$00:A2CB B9 D2 A1     LDA.W GrndShakeDispYHi,Y        ; A = GrndShakeDispYHi[Y]
$00:A2CE 8D 89 18     STA.W RAM_Layer1DispYHi         ; [$1889] = displacement high byte
$00:A2D1 65 1D        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; \
$00:A2D3 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; / Layer 1 Y scroll high += displacement high (+ carry)
$00:A2D5 20 1A 8E     JSR.W $8E1A                     ; Update the status bar ($8E1A)
$00:A2D8 22 BD E2 00  JSL.L $E2BD                     ; Draw Mario into OAM ($E2BD)
$00:A2DC 20 F3 A2     JSR.W $A2F3                     ; Remember Mario's position for next frame
$00:A2DF 20 7E C4     JSR.W $C47E                     ; Run Mario: movement and interaction ($C47E)
$00:A2E2 22 8C 80 01  JSL.L $808C                     ; Run sprites ($808C)
$00:A2E6 22 B1 8A 02  JSL.L $8AB1                     ; Run extended sprites and other misc objects ($8AB1, probably)
$00:A2EA 68           PLA                             ; \
$00:A2EB 85 1D        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi          ; |
$00:A2ED 68           PLA                             ; } Restore the layer 1 Y scroll saved above (high, then low)
$00:A2EE 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; /
$00:A2F0 4C 94 84     JMP.W $8494                     ; Pack the OAM size bits and return ($8494)

$00:A2F3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:A2F5 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:A2F7 85 D1        STA $D1                         ; |
$00:A2F9 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; } [$D1] = Mario X position, [$D3] = Mario Y position (previous-frame copies)
$00:A2FB 85 D3        STA $D3                         ; /
$00:A2FD E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A2FF 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $A300: DMA Mario graphics and palette (MarioGFXDMA) ;;;
;; NMI-time upload. If [$0D84] != 0, DMAs 10 colors from [$0D82] to CGRAM $86 (Mario's palette). Then DMAs one
;;     tile from $7E:[$0D99] to VRAM $67F0, and Mario's
;; top row tiles (pointers at [$0D85]) to VRAM $6000 and bottom row (pointers at [$0D8F]) to $6100, $40 bytes
;;     each, looping while X < [$0D84]. Uses DMA channel 2.
;; $00A390: DMAs up to three $80-byte animated tile blocks queued in [$0D76]-[$0D80], then falls into the
;;     animated palette color write.
;; $00A41A: writes one animated color (A = CGRAM index, [$00] = set offset) from MorePalettes, stepped by
;;     [$14] bits 2-4.
;; $00A436: if [$1935] is set, clears it and DMAs $C0 bytes from $0BF6 and $0CB6 to VRAM $64A0 and $65A0.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:821D: NMI handler: sound, PPU mirrors, DMA (NMIStart)
;;     $00:823A: NMI handler: sound, PPU mirrors, DMA (NMIStart)
;;     $00:82D7: NMI tail: scroll, IRQ setup, Mode 7 path (NMINotSpecialLv)
$00:A300 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:A302 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: enable bit for DMA channel 2
$00:A304 AC 84 0D     LDY.W $0D84                     ; \
$00:A307 F0 1F        BEQ $A328                       ; / [$0D84] = 0: no Mario palette to upload, skip to $00A328
$00:A309 A0 86        LDY.B #$86                      ; \
$00:A30B 8C 21 21     STY.W $2121                     ; / CGRAM address = $86 (Mario's palette: palette 8, colors 6-F)
$00:A30E A9 00 22     LDA.W #$2200                    ; \
$00:A311 8D 20 43     STA.W $4320                     ; / DMA channel 2: write to CGDATA ($2122), 1 register
$00:A314 AD 82 0D     LDA.W $0D82                     ; \
$00:A317 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; |
$00:A31A A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; } Source = [$0D82], bank $00 (Mario's palette)
$00:A31C 8C 24 43     STY.W $4324                     ; /
$00:A31F A9 14 00     LDA.W #$0014                    ; \
$00:A322 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $14 bytes (10 colors)
$00:A325 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA: upload Mario's palette
$00:A328 A0 80        LDY.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A32A 8C 15 21     STY.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80: VRAM address increments after high-byte writes
$00:A32D A9 01 18     LDA.W #$1801                    ; \
$00:A330 8D 20 43     STA.W $4320                     ; / DMA channel 2: write to VMDATA ($2118/$2119), 2 registers
$00:A333 A9 F0 67     LDA.W #$67F0                    ; \
$00:A336 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $67F0 (tile $7F of the sprite graphics)
$00:A339 AD 99 0D     LDA.W $0D99                     ; \
$00:A33C 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; |
$00:A33F A0 7E        LDY.B #$7E                      ; } Source = [$0D99] in bank $7E
$00:A341 8C 24 43     STY.W $4324                     ; /
$00:A344 A9 20 00     LDA.W #$0020                    ; \
$00:A347 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $20 bytes (one 8x8 4bpp tile)
$00:A34A 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA: one extra Mario tile
$00:A34D A9 00 60     LDA.W #$6000                    ; \
$00:A350 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $6000 (top row of Mario's tiles)
$00:A353 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the pointer lists
$00:A355 BD 85 0D     LDA.W $0D85,X                   ; \
$00:A358 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; / Source = [$0D85+X] (pointer to the next pair of tiles)
$00:A35B A9 40 00     LDA.W #$0040                    ; \
$00:A35E 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $40 bytes (two 8x8 tiles)
$00:A361 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; \
$00:A363 8C 0B 42     STY.W $420B                     ; / Start DMA channel 2
$00:A366 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:A367 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$00:A368 EC 84 0D     CPX.W $0D84                     ; \
$00:A36B 90 E8        BCC $A355                       ; / Repeat while X < [$0D84]
$00:A36D A9 00 61     LDA.W #$6100                    ; \
$00:A370 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $6100 (bottom row of Mario's tiles)
$00:A373 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$00:A375 BD 8F 0D     LDA.W $0D8F,X                   ; \
$00:A378 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; / Source = [$0D8F+X] (pointer to the next pair of tiles)
$00:A37B A9 40 00     LDA.W #$0040                    ; \
$00:A37E 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $40 bytes
$00:A381 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; \
$00:A383 8C 0B 42     STY.W $420B                     ; / Start DMA channel 2
$00:A386 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:A387 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$00:A388 EC 84 0D     CPX.W $0D84                     ; \
$00:A38B 90 E8        BCC $A375                       ; / Repeat while X < [$0D84]
$00:A38D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A38F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:A390 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit (queued animated tile DMA)
$00:A392 A0 80        LDY.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A394 8C 15 21     STY.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80: increment after high-byte writes
$00:A397 A9 01 18     LDA.W #$1801                    ; \
$00:A39A 8D 20 43     STA.W $4320                     ; / DMA channel 2: write to VMDATA, 2 registers
$00:A39D A0 7E        LDY.B #$7E                      ; \
$00:A39F 8C 24 43     STY.W $4324                     ; / Source bank = $7E
$00:A3A2 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: DMA channel 2 enable bit
$00:A3A4 AD 80 0D     LDA.W $0D80                     ; \
$00:A3A7 F0 12        BEQ $A3BB                       ; / [$0D80] = VRAM destination of tile block 1; 0 = none, skip
$00:A3A9 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; VRAM address = [$0D80]
$00:A3AC AD 7A 0D     LDA.W $0D7A                     ; Source = [$0D7A]
$00:A3AF 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; A Address (Low Byte)
$00:A3B2 A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; \
$00:A3B5 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $80 bytes
$00:A3B8 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA
$00:A3BB AD 7E 0D     LDA.W $0D7E                     ; \
$00:A3BE F0 12        BEQ $A3D2                       ; / [$0D7E] = VRAM destination of tile block 2; 0 = none, skip
$00:A3C0 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; VRAM address = [$0D7E]
$00:A3C3 AD 78 0D     LDA.W $0D78                     ; Source = [$0D78]
$00:A3C6 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; A Address (Low Byte)
$00:A3C9 A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; \
$00:A3CC 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $80 bytes
$00:A3CF 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA
$00:A3D2 AD 7C 0D     LDA.W $0D7C                     ; \
$00:A3D5 F0 41        BEQ $A418                       ; / [$0D7C] = VRAM destination of tile block 3; 0 = none, skip to palette
$00:A3D7 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; VRAM address = [$0D7C]
$00:A3DA C9 00 08     CMP.W #$0800                    ; \
$00:A3DD F0 11        BEQ $A3F0                       ; / Destination = $0800: special case, go to $00A3F0
$00:A3DF AD 76 0D     LDA.W $0D76                     ; Source = [$0D76]
$00:A3E2 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; A Address (Low Byte)
$00:A3E5 A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; \
$00:A3E8 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $80 bytes
$00:A3EB 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA
$00:A3EE 80 28        BRA $A418                       ; Done with the tile blocks, go to the palette animation

$00:A3F0 AD 76 0D     LDA.W $0D76                     ; Special case: source = [$0D76]
$00:A3F3 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; A Address (Low Byte)
$00:A3F6 A9 40 00     LDA.W #$0040                    ; \
$00:A3F9 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $40 bytes
$00:A3FC 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA: first half to VRAM $0800
$00:A3FF A9 00 09     LDA.W #$0900                    ; \
$00:A402 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $0900
$00:A405 AD 76 0D     LDA.W $0D76                     ; \
$00:A408 18           CLC                             ; } Source = [$0D76] + $40 (second half)
$00:A409 69 40 00     ADC.W #$0040                    ; /
$00:A40C 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; A Address (Low Byte)
$00:A40F A9 40 00     LDA.W #$0040                    ; \
$00:A412 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $40 bytes
$00:A415 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA
$00:A418 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A41A A9 64        LDA.B #$64                      ; \
$00:A41C 64 00        STZ $00                         ; } CGRAM address = $64 and offset [$00] = 0: animated palette color
$00:A41E 8D 21 21     STA.W $2121                     ; /
$00:A421 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$00:A423 29 1C        AND.B #$1C                      ; |
$00:A425 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = ([$14] & $1C) / 2 + [$00]: index of this frame's color (8 frames, 2 bytes each)
$00:A426 65 00        ADC $00                         ; /
$00:A428 A8           TAY                             ; Y = animation step
$00:A429 B9 0C B6     LDA.W MorePalettes,Y            ; Write the color low byte from MorePalettes[Y]
$00:A42C 8D 22 21     STA.W $2122                     ; Data for CG-RAM Write
$00:A42F B9 0D B6     LDA.W $B60D,Y                   ; Write the color high byte from $B60D[Y]
$00:A432 8D 22 21     STA.W $2122                     ; Data for CG-RAM Write
$00:A435 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:A436 AD 35 19     LDA.W $1935                     ; A = flag [$1935]: upload extra tile rows?
$00:A439 F0 43        BEQ $A47E                       ; Flag clear: return
$00:A43B 9C 35 19     STZ.W $1935                     ; Clear the flag
$00:A43E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:A440 A0 80        LDY.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A442 8C 15 21     STY.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80
$00:A445 A9 A0 64     LDA.W #$64A0                    ; \
$00:A448 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $64A0
$00:A44B A9 01 18     LDA.W #$1801                    ; \
$00:A44E 8D 20 43     STA.W $4320                     ; / DMA channel 2: write to VMDATA, 2 registers
$00:A451 A9 F6 0B     LDA.W #$0BF6                    ; \
$00:A454 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; |
$00:A457 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; } Source = $00:0BF6
$00:A459 8C 24 43     STY.W $4324                     ; /
$00:A45C A9 C0 00     LDA.W #$00C0                    ; \
$00:A45F 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $C0 bytes
$00:A462 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; \
$00:A464 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; / X = 4: start DMA channel 2
$00:A467 A9 A0 65     LDA.W #$65A0                    ; \
$00:A46A 8D 16 21     STA.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $65A0
$00:A46D A9 B6 0C     LDA.W #$0CB6                    ; Source = $00:0CB6
$00:A470 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; A Address (Low Byte)
$00:A473 A9 C0 00     LDA.W #$00C0                    ; \
$00:A476 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; / Size = $C0 bytes
$00:A479 8E 0B 42     STX.W $420B                     ; Start DMA
$00:A47C E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A47E 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A47F..A481: Table: palette buffer pointers ;;;
;; 3 bytes per entry (low, high, bank), indexed by [$0680] = 0, 3, 6: $00:0682, $00:0905, $00:0703.
$00:A47F              .db $82                         ; [$0680] = 0: low byte of $00:0682

$00:A480              .db $06                         ; High byte of the buffer address

$00:A481              .db $00,$05,$09,$00,$03,$07,$00 ; Bank $00; then entry [$0680] = 3: $00:0905, entry 6: $00:0703 (3 bytes each)


;;; $A488: Upload queued palette records to CGRAM (MoreDMA) ;;;
;; Reads records at the buffer selected by [$0680]: length, CGRAM address, then colors; DMAs each to CGRAM
;;     (channel 2) until a length of 0.
;; Then sets the fixed color via $AE47 and clears [$0680] (and [$0681]/[$0682] for buffer 0).
;; $00A4E3: DMA $0160 bytes from $00:0AF6 to VRAM $0750, then (unless [$13D9] = $0A) writes animated colors
;;     $6D and $7D.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:82EB: NMI tail: scroll, IRQ setup, Mode 7 path (NMINotSpecialLv)
$00:A488 AC 80 06     LDY.W $0680                     ; Y = [$0680]: which palette buffer to upload (0, 3 or 6)
$00:A48B BE 81 A4     LDX.W $A481,Y                   ; X = bank of the buffer
$00:A48E 86 02        STX $02                         ; [$02] = bank
$00:A490 64 01        STZ $01                         ; [$01] = 0
$00:A492 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0: pointer [$00] = bank:0000, so [$00],Y reads bank:Y
$00:A494 64 04        STZ $04                         ; [$04] = 0
$00:A496 B9 80 A4     LDA.W $A480,Y                   ; A = high byte of the buffer address
$00:A499 EB           XBA                             ; Move it to the high half of A
$00:A49A B9 7F A4     LDA.W $A47F,Y                   ; A = low byte of the buffer address
$00:A49D C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers 16-bit
$00:A49F A8           TAY                             ; Y = address of the buffer
$00:A4A0 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; A = length of the next record (bytes of colors)
$00:A4A2 F0 2B        BEQ $A4CF                       ; Length 0: end of the list, go to $00A4CF
$00:A4A4 8E 24 43     STX.W $4324                     ; DMA channel 2 source bank
$00:A4A7 8D 25 43     STA.W $4325                     ; Size low = length
$00:A4AA 85 03        STA $03                         ; [$03] = length
$00:A4AC 9C 26 43     STZ.W $4326                     ; Size high = 0
$00:A4AF C8           INY                             ; Y++
$00:A4B0 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; A = CGRAM start address of the record
$00:A4B2 8D 21 21     STA.W $2121                     ; Set the CGRAM address
$00:A4B5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:A4B7 A9 00 22     LDA.W #$2200                    ; \
$00:A4BA 8D 20 43     STA.W $4320                     ; / DMA channel 2: write to CGDATA, 1 register
$00:A4BD C8           INY                             ; \
$00:A4BE 98           TYA                             ; } Source = address of the color data (just after the 2-byte header)
$00:A4BF 8D 22 43     STA.W $4322                     ; /
$00:A4C2 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:A4C3 65 03        ADC $03                         ; } Y += length: next record
$00:A4C5 A8           TAY                             ; /
