$00:A4C6 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:A4C8 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:A4CA 8D 0B 42     STA.W $420B                     ; / Start DMA channel 2: upload the colors
$00:A4CD 80 D1        BRA $A4A0                       ; Next record

$00:A4CF E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:A4D1 20 47 AE     JSR.W $AE47                     ; Set the fixed color from the backdrop color ($AE47)
$00:A4D4 AD 80 06     LDA.W $0680                     ; \
$00:A4D7 D0 06        BNE $A4DF                       ; / [$0680] != 0: skip clearing buffer 0
$00:A4D9 9C 81 06     STZ.W $0681                     ; Buffer 0: clear [$0681] (probably the write index)
$00:A4DC 9C 82 06     STZ.W $0682                     ; Clear [$0682], the first record length (empty list)
$00:A4DF 9C 80 06     STZ.W $0680                     ; [$0680] = 0: nothing more to upload
$00:A4E2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:A4E3 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index registers 16-bit (overworld/other-mode DMA)
$00:A4E5 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A4E7 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80
$00:A4EA A0 50 07     LDY.W #$0750                    ; \
$00:A4ED 8C 16 21     STY.W $2116                     ; / VRAM address = $0750
$00:A4F0 A0 01 18     LDY.W #$1801                    ; \
$00:A4F3 8C 20 43     STY.W $4320                     ; / DMA channel 2: write to VMDATA, 2 registers
$00:A4F6 A0 F6 0A     LDY.W #$0AF6                    ; \
$00:A4F9 8C 22 43     STY.W $4322                     ; } Source = $00:0AF6
$00:A4FC 9C 24 43     STZ.W $4324                     ; /
$00:A4FF A0 60 01     LDY.W #$0160                    ; \
$00:A502 8C 25 43     STY.W $4325                     ; / Size = $0160 bytes
$00:A505 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:A507 8D 0B 42     STA.W $420B                     ; / Start DMA channel 2
$00:A50A E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index registers 8-bit
$00:A50C AD D9 13     LDA.W $13D9                     ; \
$00:A50F C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; } [$13D9] = $0A? (overworld process, probably): skip the palette animation
$00:A511 F0 CF        BEQ $A4E2                       ; /
$00:A513 A9 6D        LDA.B #$6D                      ; A = $6D: CGRAM color to animate
$00:A515 20 1C A4     JSR.W $A41C                     ; Animate that color from set 0 ($A41C)
$00:A518 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; Offset = $10 (second set of animation colors)
$00:A51A 85 00        STA $00                         ; Store it in [$00]
$00:A51C A9 7D        LDA.B #$7D                      ; A = $7D: CGRAM color to animate
$00:A51E 4C 1E A4     JMP.W $A41E                     ; Animate that color (continues at $A41E, then returns)



;;; $A521..A525: Table: tilemap page offsets ;;;
;; Two 4-byte tables indexed by Y: VRAM high byte steps ($00, $04, $08, $0C) and source high byte steps ($00,
;;     $08, $10, $18).
$00:A521              .db $00,$04,$08,$0C             ; $00 - offsets $00, $04, $08, $0C (VRAM high byte steps for each page)

$00:A525              .db $00,$08,$10,$18             ; $00 - offsets $00, $08, $10, $18 (source high byte steps, $800 bytes per page)


;;; $A529: DMA tilemap pages to VRAM ;;;
;; Probably overworld. Y = page index (0-3). DMAs $0800 bytes from $7F:4000 (or $7F:6000 if the player's
;;     submap [$1F11+x] is non-zero) + $800 * Y to VRAM $3000 + $400 * Y,
;; then $0800 bytes from $7E:E400 to VRAM $2000 + $400 * Y. Uses DMA channel 1.
;; Parameters: Y: page index.
$00:A529 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A52B 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80
$00:A52E 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; VRAM address low = 0
$00:A531 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$00:A533 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:A534 79 21 A5     ADC.W $A521,Y                   ; } VRAM address high = $30 + $A521[Y]: destination page $3000, $3400, ...
$00:A537 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; /
$00:A53A A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; X = 6: copy 7 bytes of DMA setup
$00:A53C BD 86 A5     LDA.W $A586,X                   ; Read a setup byte from $A586
$00:A53F 9D 10 43     STA.W $4310,X                   ; Write it to $4310-$4316 (DMA channel 1)
$00:A542 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:A543 10 F7        BPL $A53C                       ; Loop until X < 0
$00:A545 AD D6 0D     LDA.W $0DD6                     ; A = [$0DD6] / 4 = player index (probably)
$00:A548 4A           LSR                             ; A >>= 1
$00:A549 4A           LSR                             ; A >>= 1 (done)
$00:A54A AA           TAX                             ; X = index
$00:A54B BD 11 1F     LDA.W $1F11,X                   ; A = [$1F11+X]: submap the player is on
$00:A54E F0 05        BEQ $A555                       ; Submap 0: keep source $7F:4000
$00:A550 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; Other submap: source high byte = $60 ($7F:6000)
$00:A552 8D 13 43     STA.W $4313                     ; Write it to the A-bus high byte
$00:A555 AD 13 43     LDA.W $4313                     ; Read back the source high byte
$00:A558 18           CLC                             ; Prepare to add the page offset
$00:A559 79 25 A5     ADC.W $A525,Y                   ; Add $A525[Y]: source advances $800 bytes per page
$00:A55C 8D 13 43     STA.W $4313                     ; Store the source high byte
$00:A55F A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: DMA channel 1 enable bit
$00:A561 8D 0B 42     STA.W $420B                     ; Start DMA: $800 bytes to VRAM (tilemap page)
$00:A564 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A566 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80
$00:A569 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; VRAM address low = 0
$00:A56C A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$00:A56E 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:A56F 79 21 A5     ADC.W $A521,Y                   ; } VRAM address high = $20 + $A521[Y]
$00:A572 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; /
$00:A575 A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; X = 6: copy 7 bytes of DMA setup
$00:A577 BD 8D A5     LDA.W $A58D,X                   ; Read a setup byte from $A58D
$00:A57A 9D 10 43     STA.W $4310,X                   ; Write it to $4310-$4316
$00:A57D CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:A57E 10 F7        BPL $A577                       ; Loop until X < 0
$00:A580 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2: DMA channel 1 enable bit
$00:A582 8D 0B 42     STA.W $420B                     ; Start DMA: $800 bytes from $7E:E400 to VRAM (second tilemap page)
$00:A585 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A586..A58D: Table: DMA setup for tilemap pages ;;;
;; Two 7-byte blocks copied to $4310-$4316: DMAP $01, B-bus $18, source $7F:4000 / $7E:E400, size $0800.
$00:A586              .db $01,$18,$00,$40,$7F,$00,$08 ; DMAP $01, B-bus $18, source $7F:4000, size $0800

$00:A58D              .db $01,$18,$00,$E4,$7E,$00,$08 ; DMAP $01, B-bus $18, source $7E:E400, size $0800


;;; $A594: Long wrapper for CODE_00AD25 ;;;
;; Sets the data bank to $00, runs $AD25 and returns with RTL. Called from bank $04.
;; Called by:
;;     $04:DBAE: Submap switch states and iris effect (Ptrs04DAF8)
$00:A594 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$00:A595 4B           PHK                             ; Push the program bank
$00:A596 AB           PLB                             ; Data bank = $00
$00:A597 20 25 AD     JSR.W $AD25                     ; Run $AD25
$00:A59A AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:A59B 6B           RTL                             ; Return long (called from bank $04)


;;; $A59C: Game mode 12: prepare level (GM04Load) ;;;
;; Turns off the screen and I/O, loads the level ($809E), uploads sprite graphics and palettes, sets up
;;     the scroll and tile animation,
;; draws Mario, copies the palette mirror $0703 to $0905 ($01F0 bytes), then increments the game mode (to $13,
;;     fade into level).
;; Boss rooms ([$0D9B] bit 7) use $97BC instead of the normal graphics/palette setup.
;; $00A5F9: pre-runs 8 steps of tile animation ($BB39 + $A390) so tiles are ready at the first
;;     frame.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9595: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:9A8E: Detect connected controllers into [$0DA0] (SetUp0DA0GM4)
$00:A59C 20 FA 85     JSR.W $85FA                     ; Turn off NMI/IRQ, HDMA and the screen ($85FA)
$00:A59F 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Clear controller input (NoButtons)
$00:A5A2 9C 3A 14     STZ.W $143A                     ; [$143A] = 0: no Mario Start! graphics to upload
$00:A5A5 20 79 8A     JSR.W SetUpScreen               ; Reset screen settings (SetUpScreen)
$00:A5A8 20 FF 8C     JSR.W GM04DoDMA                 ; Initial VRAM DMA (GM04DoDMA)
$00:A5AB 22 9E 80 05  JSL.L $809E                     ; Load the level ($809E)
$00:A5AF AD 9B 0D     LDA.W $0D9B                     ; \
$00:A5B2 10 05        BPL $A5B9                       ; / [$0D9B] bit 7 clear: normal level, go to $00A5B9
$00:A5B4 20 BC 97     JSR.W $97BC                     ; Mode 7 boss room: set up the room ($97BC)
$00:A5B7 80 16        BRA $A5CF                       ; Skip the normal level setup

$00:A5B9 20 DA A9     JSR.W UploadSpriteGFX           ; Upload sprite graphics (UploadSpriteGFX)
$00:A5BC 20 ED AB     JSR.W LoadPalette               ; Load the palettes (LoadPalette)
$00:A5BF 22 8A BE 05  JSL.L $BE8A                     ; Initialize the layer 2/3 scroll variables ($BE8A)
$00:A5C3 20 B8 9F     JSR.W $9FB8                     ; Tileset-dependent setup ($9FB8, uses tileset [$1931])
$00:A5C6 20 F9 A5     JSR.W $A5F9                     ; Pre-run 8 frames of tile animation ($A5F9)
$00:A5C9 20 60 92     JSR.W $9260                     ; Disable HDMA and clear the window HDMA table ($9260)
$00:A5CC 20 60 98     JSR.W $9860                     ; Draw Mario into OAM ($9860)
$00:A5CF 20 2F 92     JSR.W $922F                     ; Make the first two palette bytes black and DMA them to CGRAM ($922F)
$00:A5D2 20 29 9F     JSR.W KeepModeActive            ; Enable NMI and joypad (KeepModeActive)
$00:A5D5 20 1A 8E     JSR.W $8E1A                     ; Update the status bar ($8E1A)
$00:A5D8 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:A5DA 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$00:A5DB A2 03 07     LDX.W #$0703                    ; X = $0703: source (palette mirror)
$00:A5DE A0 05 09     LDY.W #$0905                    ; Y = $0905: destination
$00:A5E1 A9 EF 01     LDA.W #$01EF                    ; A = $01EF: copy $01F0 bytes
$00:A5E4 54 00 00     MVN $00,$00                     ; Copy the palette mirror to $0905 (block move)
$00:A5E7 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:A5E8 AE 01 07     LDX.W $0701                     ; X = [$0701] (backdrop color)
$00:A5EB 8E 03 09     STX.W $0903                     ; Store it at [$0903] (backdrop color of the copy)
$00:A5EE E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:A5F0 20 9B 91     JSR.W $919B                     ; Castle entry animation or, if [$141A] = 0, coins to collect [$0DC0] = 30 ($919B)
$00:A5F3 20 94 84     JSR.W $8494                     ; Pack the OAM size bits ($8494)
$00:A5F6 4C F4 93     JMP.W $93F4                     ; Game mode++ (to $13, fading into the level)

$00:A5F9 A9 E7        LDA.B #$E7                      ; \
$00:A5FB 14 14        TRB RAM_FrameCounterB           ; / Clear bits 0-2 and 5-7 of the frame counter [$14] (keep bits 3-4)
$00:A5FD 22 39 BB 05  JSL.L $BB39                     ; Build animated tile graphics for the current step ($BB39)
$00:A601 20 90 A3     JSR.W $A390                     ; DMA the queued animated tiles to VRAM ($A390)
$00:A604 E6 14        INC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; [$14]++
$00:A606 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; A = [$14]


;;; $A608: Instruction: AND #$07 (Instr00A608) ;;;
;; An AND #$07 encoded as .db $29,$07; part of the loop in $A5F9 (8 iterations).
$00:A608              .db $29,$07                     ; A &= 7 (instruction stored as data)

$00:A60A D0 F1        BNE $A5FD                       ; Not yet 8 steps: repeat from $00A5FD
$00:A60C 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A60D..A619: Data: unreferenced, purpose unclear ;;;
$00:A60D              .db $00,$01,$01,$01             ; Unreferenced data, purpose unclear

$00:A611              .db $0D,$00,$F3,$FF,$FE,$FF,$FE,$FF ; Unreferenced data, purpose unclear
$00:A619              .db $00,$00,$00,$00             ; Unreferenced data, purpose unclear

$00:A61D              .db $0A,$00,$00,$00,$1A,$1A,$0A,$0A ; Unreferenced data, purpose unclear
$00:A625              .db $00,$80,$40,$00,$01,$02,$40,$00 ; Unreferenced data, purpose unclear
$00:A62D              .db $40,$00,$00,$00,$00,$02,$00,$00 ; Unreferenced data, purpose unclear


;;; $A635: Level start setup, Mario Start! graphics ;;;
;; $00A635: level start reset. Cancels POW/star timers (forcing normal music), clears Mario and level state,
;;     then positions Mario for the
;; level entrance type [$192A] (start in the air, from a pipe, water level, keyhole, Yoshi Wings bonus).
;;     Several parts are guesses.
;; $00A796: initializes layer 2 vertical scroll offset [$1417] from [$1414], [$1C], [$20], and [$142A] =
;;     $0080.
;; $00A7C2: DMAs the buffer at $7F:977B to VRAM $6000, $6100, $64A0 and $65A0 ($C0 bytes each) for the Mario
;;     Start! graphics.
;; $00A82D: builds those tiles: decompresses GFX file $0F, converts 24 tiles from 3bpp to 4bpp into $7F:977B
;;     (+$30 offset if [$1425]),
;; also converts 12 tiles of file 0 into $0BF6, sets [$143A] and [$1935] so NMI DMAs them.
;; Called by:

$00:A8C3              .db $00,$01,$13,$02,$00,$01,$12,$03 ; Sprite GFX list Forest ($00), Castle ($01) - 4 files each
$00:A8CB              .db $00,$01,$13,$05,$00,$01,$13,$04 ; Sprite GFX list Mushroom ($02), Underground ($03) - 4 files each
$00:A8D3              .db $00,$01,$13,$06,$00,$01,$13,$09 ; Sprite GFX list Water ($04), Pokey ($05) - 4 files each
$00:A8DB              .db $00,$01,$13,$04,$00,$01,$06,$11 ; Sprite GFX list Underground 2 ($06), Ghost House ($07) - 4 files each
$00:A8E3              .db $00,$01,$13,$20,$00,$01,$13,$0F ; Sprite GFX list Banzai Bill ($08), Yoshi's House ($09) - 4 files each
$00:A8EB              .db $00,$01,$13,$23,$00,$01,$0D,$14 ; Sprite GFX list Dino-Rhino ($0A), Switch Palace ($0B) - 4 files each
$00:A8F3              .db $00,$01,$24,$0E,$00,$01,$0A,$22 ; Sprite GFX list Mechakoopa ($0C), Wendy/Lemmy ($0D) - 4 files each
$00:A8FB              .db $00,$01,$13,$0E,$00,$01,$13,$14 ; Sprite GFX list Ninji ($0E), Unused ($0F) - 4 files each
$00:A903              .db $00,$00,$00,$08,$10,$0F,$1C,$1D ; Sprite GFX list $10, $11 - 4 files each
$00:A90B              .db $00,$01,$24,$22,$00,$01,$25,$22 ; Sprite GFX list $12, $13 - 4 files each
$00:A913              .db $00,$22,$13,$2D,$00,$01,$0F,$22 ; Sprite GFX list $14, $15 - 4 files each
$00:A91B              .db $00,$26,$2E,$22,$21,$0B,$25,$0A ; Sprite GFX list $16, $17 - 4 files each
$00:A923              .db $00,$0D,$24,$22,$2C,$30,$2D,$0E ; Sprite GFX list $18, $19 - 4 files each

;;; $A92B: Table: tileset GFX lists, raw GFX upload (OBJECTGFXLIST) ;;;
;; 4 GFX file numbers per tileset, indexed by [$1931] * 4. The first file goes to VRAM $0000, the last to
;;     $1800.
;; $00A993: uploads GFX files $28-$2B uncompressed (1024 words each) to VRAM $4000 and file 0 to $6000 via
;;     UploadGFXFile.
$00:A92B              .db $14,$17,$19,$15,$14,$17,$1B,$18 ; Tileset GFX list Normal 1 ($00), Castle 1 ($01) - 4 files each
$00:A933              .db $14,$17,$1B,$16,$14,$17,$0C,$1A ; Tileset GFX list Rope 1 ($02), Underground 1 ($03) - 4 files each
$00:A93B              .db $14,$17,$1B,$08,$14,$17,$0C,$07 ; Tileset GFX list Switch Palace 1 ($04), Ghost House 1 ($05) - 4 files each
$00:A943              .db $14,$17,$0C,$16,$14,$17,$1B,$15 ; Tileset GFX list Rope 2 ($06), Normal 2 ($07) - 4 files each
$00:A94B              .db $14,$17,$19,$16,$14,$17,$0D,$1A ; Tileset GFX list Rope 3 ($08), Underground 2 ($09) - 4 files each
$00:A953              .db $14,$17,$1B,$08,$14,$17,$1B,$18 ; Tileset GFX list Switch Palace 2 ($0A), Castle 2 ($0B) - 4 files each
$00:A95B              .db $14,$17,$19,$1F,$14,$17,$0D,$07 ; Tileset GFX list Cloud/Forest ($0C), Ghost House 2 ($0D) - 4 files each
$00:A963              .db $14,$17,$19,$1A,$14,$17,$14,$14 ; Tileset GFX list Underground 2 ($0E), $0F - 4 files each
$00:A96B              .db $0E,$0F,$17,$17,$1C,$1D,$08,$1E ; Tileset GFX list $10, $11 - 4 files each
$00:A973              .db $1C,$1D,$08,$1E,$1C,$1D,$08,$1E ; Tileset GFX list $12, $13 - 4 files each
$00:A97B              .db $1C,$1D,$08,$1E,$1C,$1D,$08,$1E ; Tileset GFX list $14, $15 - 4 files each
$00:A983              .db $1C,$1D,$08,$1E,$1C,$1D,$08,$1E ; Tileset GFX list $16, $17 - 4 files each
$00:A98B              .db $14,$17,$19,$2C,$19,$17,$1B,$18 ; Tileset GFX list $18, $19 - 4 files each

$00:A993 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; \
$00:A996 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; } VRAM address = $4000
$00:A998 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; /
$00:A99B A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:A99D 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = 3: four files
$00:A99F A9 28        LDA.B #$28                      ; \
$00:A9A1 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / [$0E] = $28: first GFX file number
$00:A9A3 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$00:A9A5 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$0E]
$00:A9A6 22 28 BA 00  JSL.L $BA28                     ; Decompress GFX file Y, [$00] = pointer ($BA28)
$00:A9AA C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:A9AC A2 FF 03     LDX.W #$03FF                    ; X = $03FF: 1024 words
$00:A9AF A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0
$00:A9B2 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; A = next word of the decompressed data
$00:A9B4 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; Write it straight to VRAM (no 4bpp conversion)
$00:A9B7 C8           INY                             ; \
$00:A9B8 C8           INY                             ; / Y += 2
$00:A9B9 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:A9BA 10 F6        BPL $A9B2                       ; / Loop for 1024 words
$00:A9BC E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:A9BE E6 0E        INC $0E                         ; Next file number
$00:A9C0 C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; \
$00:A9C2 10 DF        BPL $A9A3                       ; / Loop for 4 files ($28-$2B)
$00:A9C4 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; \
$00:A9C7 A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; } VRAM address = $6000
$00:A9C9 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; /
$00:A9CC A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: GFX file 0
$00:A9CE 20 6B AA     JSR.W UploadGFXFile             ; Convert and upload file 0 (UploadGFXFile)
$00:A9D1 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A9D2..A9D6: Table: VRAM slot addresses for GFX upload ;;;
;; $A9D2: sprite slots, $A9D6: FG/BG slots. High byte of the VRAM word address, one per slot.
$00:A9D2              .db $78,$70,$68,$60             ; VRAM word address high bytes for sprite GFX slots 0-3 ($78, $70, $68, $60)

$00:A9D6              .db $18,$10,$08,$00             ; VRAM word address high bytes for FG/BG GFX slots 0-3 ($18, $10, $08, $00)


;;; $A9DA: Upload sprite and tileset GFX to VRAM (UploadSpriteGFX) ;;;
;; Loads the 4 sprite GFX files for list [$192B] into VRAM $6000-$7FFF, then the 4 FG/BG files for tileset
;;     [$1931] into $0000-$1FFF.
;; [$0101]-[$0104] and [$0105]-[$0108] remember the file in each slot, so a slot whose file is unchanged is
;;     not re-uploaded.
;; Parameters: [$192B]: sprite GFX list. [$1931]: tileset.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:94D7: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:95E9: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:9658: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:9840: Game mode 11: Mario Start, level music (MarioStartGameMode)
;;     $00:A144: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
;;     $00:A5B9: Game mode 12: prepare level (GM04Load)
$00:A9DA A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:A9DC 8D 15 21     STA.W $2115                     ; / VMAIN = $80: increment after high-byte writes
$00:A9DF A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3
$00:A9E1 AD 2B 19     LDA.W $192B                     ; A = [$192B] (sprite GFX list index)
$00:A9E4 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:A9E5 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = [$192B] * 4 (four files per entry)
$00:A9E6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:A9E7 B9 C3 A8     LDA.W SPRITEGFXLIST,Y           ; A = SPRITEGFXLIST[Y]
$00:A9EA 95 04        STA $04,X                       ; [$04+X] = file number (first list entry ends up in [$07])
$00:A9EC C8           INY                             ; Next list byte
$00:A9ED CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:A9EE 10 F7        BPL $A9E7                       ; Loop for 4 files
$00:A9F0 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:A9F2 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = 3: slot counter

;;; $A9F4: Sprite GFX: upload loop over 4 slots (GFXTransferLoop) ;;;
;; Slot 3 down to 0: set the VRAM address from $A9D2 and upload the file unless it is already loaded.
$00:A9F4 A6 0F        LDX $0F                         ; X = [$0F]: slot number
$00:A9F6 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; VRAM address low = 0
$00:A9F9 BD D2 A9     LDA.W $A9D2,X                   ; \
$00:A9FC 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address high = $A9D2[X] (slot base $60-$78)
$00:A9FF B4 04        LDY $04,X                       ; Y = file number for this slot
$00:AA01 BD 01 01     LDA.W $0101,X                   ; \
$00:AA04 D5 04        CMP $04,X                       ; } File already in this slot ([$0101+X]): skip the upload
$00:AA06 F0 03        BEQ Don'tUploadSpr              ; /
$00:AA08 20 6B AA     JSR.W UploadGFXFile             ; Convert and upload GFX file Y (UploadGFXFile)

;;; $AA0B: Sprite GFX: next slot (Don'tUploadSpr) ;;;
$00:AA0B C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; \
$00:AA0D 10 E5        BPL GFXTransferLoop             ; / Next slot: [$0F]--
$00:AA0F A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3

;;; $AA11: Remember loaded sprite GFX files (UpdtCrrntSpritGFX) ;;;
;; Copies [$04]-[$07] to [$0101]-[$0104].
$00:AA11 B5 04        LDA $04,X                       ; \
$00:AA13 9D 01 01     STA.W $0101,X                   ; |
$00:AA16 CA           DEX                             ; } [$0101+X] = [$04+X] (remember which sprite GFX is loaded)
$00:AA17 10 F8        BPL UpdtCrrntSpritGFX           ; /
$00:AA19 AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; A = tileset [$1931]
$00:AA1C C9 FE        CMP.B #$FE                      ; \
$00:AA1E B0 3B        BCS SetallFGBG80                ; / Tileset >= $FE: go to SetallFGBG80
$00:AA20 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3
$00:AA22 AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; \
$00:AA25 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:AA26 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = tileset * 4 (four files per entry)
$00:AA27 A8           TAY                             ; /

;;; $AA28: FG/BG GFX: pick files and upload (PrepLoadFGBG) ;;;
;; Tileset >= $FE goes to SetallFGBG80. Otherwise copies the 4 files of OBJECTGFXLIST for the tileset to
;;     [$04]-[$07] and uploads each changed slot.
$00:AA28 B9 2B A9     LDA.W OBJECTGFXLIST,Y           ; A = OBJECTGFXLIST[Y]
$00:AA2B 95 04        STA $04,X                       ; [$04+X] = file number (first list entry ends up in [$07])
$00:AA2D C8           INY                             ; Next list byte
$00:AA2E CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:AA2F 10 F7        BPL PrepLoadFGBG                ; Loop for 4 files
$00:AA31 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:AA33 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = 3: slot counter
$00:AA35 A6 0F        LDX $0F                         ; X = [$0F]: slot number
$00:AA37 9C 16 21     STZ.W $2116                     ; VRAM address low = 0
$00:AA3A BD D6 A9     LDA.W $A9D6,X                   ; \
$00:AA3D 8D 17 21     STA.W $2117                     ; / VRAM address high = $A9D6[X] (slot base $00-$18)
$00:AA40 B4 04        LDY $04,X                       ; Y = file number for this slot
$00:AA42 BD 05 01     LDA.W $0105,X                   ; \
$00:AA45 D5 04        CMP $04,X                       ; } File already in this slot ([$0105+X]): skip the upload
$00:AA47 F0 03        BEQ NoUploadFGBG                ; /
$00:AA49 20 6B AA     JSR.W UploadGFXFile             ; Convert and upload GFX file Y (UploadGFXFile)

;;; $AA4C: FG/BG GFX: next slot (NoUploadFGBG) ;;;
$00:AA4C C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; \
$00:AA4E 10 E5        BPL $AA35                       ; / Next slot: [$0F]--; loop for 4 slots
$00:AA50 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3

;;; $AA52: Remember loaded FG/BG GFX files (UpdateCurrentFGBG) ;;;
;; Copies [$04]-[$07] to [$0105]-[$0108].
$00:AA52 B5 04        LDA $04,X                       ; \
$00:AA54 9D 05 01     STA.W $0105,X                   ; |
$00:AA57 CA           DEX                             ; } [$0105+X] = [$04+X] (remember which FG/BG GFX is loaded)
$00:AA58 10 F8        BPL UpdateCurrentFGBG           ; /
$00:AA5A 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $AA5B: Tileset $FE/$FF: Mode 7 upload, empty slots (SetallFGBG80) ;;;
;; Tileset $FF uploads the Mode 7 tile graphics ($AB42). Both then mark all FG/BG slots as empty ($80).
$00:AA5B F0 03        BEQ NoUpdateVRAM80              ; Tileset = $FE: skip the Mode 7 upload
$00:AA5D 20 42 AB     JSR.W $AB42                     ; Tileset = $FF: upload the 3-bit packed Mode 7 tiles (file $27)

;;; $AA60: Mark all FG/BG slots empty (NoUpdateVRAM80) ;;;
$00:AA60 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3
$00:AA62 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; A = $80: not a real file number, so every FG/BG slot reloads next time

;;; $AA64: Store $80 in FG/BG slot table (Store80) ;;;
$00:AA64 9D 05 01     STA.W $0105,X                   ; [$0105+X] = $80
$00:AA67 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AA68 10 FA        BPL Store80                     ; / Loop for 4 slots
$00:AA6A 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $AA6B: Decompress GFX file and start upload (UploadGFXFile) ;;;
;; Decompresses file Y into the $7E:AD00 buffer. For file 1, if the Special World is completed ([$1EEB] bit 7)
;;     file $31 replaces it.
;; Then picks the 3bpp to 4bpp conversion mode (see below). Parameters: Y = GFX file number; VRAM address
;;     already set.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:A9CE: Table: tileset GFX lists, raw GFX upload (OBJECTGFXLIST)
;;     $00:AA08: Sprite GFX: upload loop over 4 slots (GFXTransferLoop)
;;     $00:AA49: FG/BG GFX: pick files and upload (PrepLoadFGBG)
$00:AA6B 22 28 BA 00  JSL.L $BA28                     ; Decompress GFX file Y to $7E:AD00, [$00] = pointer ($BA28)
$00:AA6F C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; \
$00:AA71 D0 0D        BNE SkipSpecial                 ; / File != 1: go to SkipSpecial
$00:AA73 AD EB 1E     LDA.W $1EEB                     ; \
$00:AA76 10 08        BPL SkipSpecial                 ; / [$1EEB] bit 7 clear (Special World not completed): go to SkipSpecial
$00:AA78 A0 31        LDY.B #$31                      ; Y = $31
$00:AA7A 22 28 BA 00  JSL.L $BA28                     ; Decompress GFX file $31 instead (post-Special World graphics)
$00:AA7E A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1 again (conversion below treats it as file 1)

;;; $AA80: Choose 3bpp conversion mode (SkipSpecial) ;;;
;; File $1E, or file 8 in tilesets >= $11, goes to the full conversion; every other file continues at $00AA99.
$00:AA80 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:AA82 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; A = 0
$00:AA85 AE 31 19     LDX.W $1931                     ; X = tileset [$1931]
$00:AA88 E0 11        CPX.B #$11                      ; \
$00:AA8A 90 04        BCC $AA90                       ; / Tileset < $11: go to AA90
$00:AA8C C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$00:AA8E F0 06        BEQ JumpTo_____                 ; / File 8 (tileset >= $11): go to JumpTo_____
$00:AA90 C0 1E        CPY.B #$1E                      ; \
$00:AA92 F0 02        BEQ JumpTo_____                 ; / File $1E: go to JumpTo_____
$00:AA94 D0 03        BNE $AA99                       ; Otherwise go to AA99 (always taken)

;;; $AA96: Convert 3bpp GFX to 4bpp, upload to VRAM (JumpTo_____) ;;;
;; Converts 128 tiles of 24 bytes (3bpp) to 4bpp while writing them to VRAM. Plane 3 is the mask [$0A] AND
;;     (plane 0 | 1 | 2) of each row.
;; Files other than 1 and $17: plane 3 empty. Files 1 and $17: plane 3 filled only for tiles $6E-$6F and
;;     $7E-$7F.
$00:AA96 4C 02 AB     JMP.W FilterSomeRAM             ; Full conversion: plane 3 = OR of planes 0-2 (FilterSomeRAM)

$00:AA99 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; [$0A] = 0: plane 3 mask empty (plain 3bpp to 4bpp)
$00:AA9B A9 FF FF     LDA.W #$FFFF                    ; A = $FFFF
$00:AA9E C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; \
$00:AAA0 F0 07        BEQ $AAA9                       ; / File 1: keep $FFFF
$00:AAA2 C0 17        CPY.B #$17                      ; \
$00:AAA4 F0 03        BEQ $AAA9                       ; / File $17: keep $FFFF
$00:AAA6 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; Other files: A = 0
$00:AAA9 8D BC 1B     STA.W $1BBC                     ; [$1BBC] = $FFFF for files 1 and $17, else 0
$00:AAAC A0 7F        LDY.B #$7F                      ; Y = $7F: tile counter (128 tiles)
$00:AAAE AD BC 1B     LDA.W $1BBC                     ; \
$00:AAB1 F0 1A        BEQ $AACD                       ; / [$1BBC] = 0: go to AACD (mask stays empty)
$00:AAB3 C0 7E        CPY.B #$7E                      ; \
$00:AAB5 90 07        BCC $AABE                       ; / Tile < $7E: go to AABE
$00:AAB7 A9 00 FF     LDA.W #$FF00                    ; \
$00:AABA 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = $FF00: plane 3 = OR of planes 0-2
$00:AABC D0 0F        BNE $AACD                       ; Go to AACD
$00:AABE C0 6E        CPY.B #$6E                      ; \
$00:AAC0 90 06        BCC $AAC8                       ; / Tile < $6E: go to AAC8
$00:AAC2 C0 70        CPY.B #$70                      ; \
$00:AAC4 B0 02        BCS $AAC8                       ; / Tile >= $70: go to AAC8
$00:AAC6 90 EF        BCC $AAB7                       ; Tile $6E-$6F: go to AAB7
$00:AAC8 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; \
$00:AACB 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = 0: plane 3 empty
$00:AACD A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: 8 rows
$00:AACF A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; A = bitplanes 0 and 1 of this row
$00:AAD1 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; Write them to VRAM
$00:AAD4 EB           XBA                             ; \
$00:AAD5 07 00        ORA [$00]                       ; } [$1BB2+X] = plane 0 | plane 1 of this row (both bytes)
$00:AAD7 9D B2 1B     STA.W $1BB2,X                   ; /
$00:AADA E6 00        INC $00                         ; \
$00:AADC E6 00        INC $00                         ; / [$00] += 2
$00:AADE CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AADF 10 EE        BPL $AACF                       ; / Loop for 8 rows
$00:AAE1 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: 8 rows
$00:AAE3 A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; \
$00:AAE5 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$0C] = bitplane 2 byte of this row
$00:AAE8 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; /
$00:AAEA A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; \
$00:AAEC EB           XBA                             ; |
$00:AAED 1D B2 1B     ORA.W $1BB2,X                   ; |
$00:AAF0 25 0A        AND $0A                         ; |
$00:AAF2 05 0C        ORA $0C                         ; } Write plane 2 (low) and plane 3 = (plane 2 | [$1BB2+X]) & [$0A] (high) to VRAM
$00:AAF4 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; /
$00:AAF7 E6 00        INC $00                         ; [$00]++
$00:AAF9 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AAFA 10 E7        BPL $AAE3                       ; / Loop for 8 rows
$00:AAFC 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:AAFD 10 AF        BPL $AAAE                       ; / Next tile: loop for 128 tiles
$00:AAFF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:AB01 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $AB02: Full 3bpp to 4bpp conversion setup (FilterSomeRAM) ;;;
;; Sets mask [$0A] = $FF00 (plane 3 = OR of planes 0-2) for all 128 tiles and falls into the loop.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:AA96: Convert 3bpp GFX to 4bpp, upload to VRAM (JumpTo_____)
$00:AB02 A9 00 FF     LDA.W #$FF00                    ; \
$00:AB05 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = $FF00: plane 3 = OR of planes 0-2 for every tile
$00:AB07 A0 7F        LDY.B #$7F                      ; Y = $7F: tile counter (128 tiles)

;;; $AB09: 3bpp to 4bpp: tile loop start (Upload????ToVRAM) ;;;
;; Starts with a compare and branch that do nothing.
$00:AB09 C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; \
$00:AB0B B0 00        BCS $AB0D                       ; / Useless compare, the branch goes to the next instruction
$00:AB0D A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: 8 rows

;;; $AB0F: 3bpp to 4bpp: planes 0-1 of a tile (AddressWrite1) ;;;
;; Writes 8 rows of plane 0/1 words to VRAM and keeps each row's plane 0 | plane 1 in [$1BB2+X].
$00:AB0F A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; A = bitplanes 0 and 1 of this row
$00:AB11 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; Write them to VRAM
$00:AB14 EB           XBA                             ; \
$00:AB15 07 00        ORA [$00]                       ; } [$1BB2+X] = plane 0 | plane 1 of this row (both bytes)
$00:AB17 9D B2 1B     STA.W $1BB2,X                   ; /
$00:AB1A E6 00        INC $00                         ; \
$00:AB1C E6 00        INC $00                         ; / [$00] += 2
$00:AB1E CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AB1F 10 EE        BPL AddressWrite1               ; / Loop for 8 rows
$00:AB21 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: 8 rows

;;; $AB23: 3bpp to 4bpp: planes 2-3; Mode 7 upload (AddressWrite2) ;;;
;; Writes the plane 2/3 words of the tile's 8 rows, then loops to the next tile.
;; $00AB42: uploads GFX file $27 as Mode 7 tile graphics. The file is packed 3 bits per pixel; each pixel is
;;     written to the VRAM high byte
;; ($2119, Mode 7 tile data lives there), 8192 pixels, then another $2000 high bytes are cleared. $00ABC4
;;     extracts 3 bits into [$04].
$00:AB23 A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; \
$00:AB25 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } [$0C] = bitplane 2 byte of this row
$00:AB28 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; /
$00:AB2A A7 00        LDA [$00]                       ; \
$00:AB2C EB           XBA                             ; |
$00:AB2D 1D B2 1B     ORA.W $1BB2,X                   ; |
$00:AB30 25 0A        AND $0A                         ; |
$00:AB32 05 0C        ORA $0C                         ; } Write plane 2 (low) and plane 3 = (plane 2 | [$1BB2+X]) & [$0A] (high) to VRAM
$00:AB34 8D 18 21     STA.W $2118                     ; /
$00:AB37 E6 00        INC $00                         ; [$00]++
$00:AB39 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AB3A 10 E7        BPL AddressWrite2               ; / Loop for 8 rows
$00:AB3C 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:AB3D 10 CA        BPL Upload????ToVRAM            ; / Next tile: loop for 128 tiles
$00:AB3F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit

$00:AB42 A0 27        LDY.B #$27                      ; Y = $27: GFX file number

$00:AB4A A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: source offset
$00:AB4D A2 FF 03     LDX.W #$03FF                    ; X = $03FF: 1024 groups of 3 bytes (8 pixels each)
$00:AB50 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$00:AB52 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = next source byte
$00:AB54 20 C4 AB     JSR.W $ABC4                     ; [$04] = top 3 bits of [$0F] (pixel 0)
$00:AB57 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AB59 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 0 to the VRAM high byte
$00:AB5C 20 C4 AB     JSR.W $ABC4                     ; Pixel 1: next 3 bits
$00:AB5F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AB61 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 1 to the VRAM high byte
$00:AB64 64 04        STZ $04                         ; \
$00:AB66 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; |
$00:AB68 26 04        ROL $04                         ; |
$00:AB6A 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; } [$04] = last 2 bits of byte 0 (pixel 2 takes 1 more bit from byte 1)
$00:AB6C 26 04        ROL $04                         ; /
$00:AB6E C8           INY                             ; Next source byte
$00:AB6F B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$00:AB71 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = byte 1
$00:AB73 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; \
$00:AB75 26 04        ROL $04                         ; / Shift in 1 bit from byte 1: pixel 2 complete
$00:AB77 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AB79 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 2 to the VRAM high byte
$00:AB7C 20 C4 AB     JSR.W $ABC4                     ; Pixel 3: next 3 bits
$00:AB7F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AB81 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 3 to the VRAM high byte
$00:AB84 20 C4 AB     JSR.W $ABC4                     ; Pixel 4: next 3 bits
$00:AB87 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AB89 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 4 to the VRAM high byte
$00:AB8C 64 04        STZ $04                         ; \
$00:AB8E 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; } [$04] = last bit of byte 1 (pixel 5 takes 2 more bits from byte 2)
$00:AB90 26 04        ROL $04                         ; /
$00:AB92 C8           INY                             ; Next source byte
$00:AB93 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$00:AB95 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = byte 2
$00:AB97 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; \
$00:AB99 26 04        ROL $04                         ; |
$00:AB9B 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; } Shift in 2 bits from byte 2: pixel 5 complete
$00:AB9D 26 04        ROL $04                         ; /
$00:AB9F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:ABA1 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 5 to the VRAM high byte
$00:ABA4 20 C4 AB     JSR.W $ABC4                     ; Pixel 6: next 3 bits
$00:ABA7 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:ABA9 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 6 to the VRAM high byte
$00:ABAC 20 C4 AB     JSR.W $ABC4                     ; Pixel 7: next 3 bits
$00:ABAF A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:ABB1 8D 19 21     STA.W $2119                     ; / Write pixel 7 to the VRAM high byte
$00:ABB4 C8           INY                             ; Next source byte
$00:ABB5 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:ABB6 10 98        BPL $AB50                       ; / Loop for 1024 groups
$00:ABB8 A2 00 20     LDX.W #$2000                    ; X = $2000: bytes to clear
$00:ABBB 9C 19 21     STZ.W $2119                     ; Write 0 to the VRAM high byte
$00:ABBE CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:ABBF D0 FA        BNE $ABBB                       ; / Loop $2000 times (clears the next 128 Mode 7 tiles)
$00:ABC1 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; X and Y 8-bit
$00:ABC3 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:ABC4 64 04        STZ $04                         ; \
$00:ABC6 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; |
$00:ABC8 26 04        ROL $04                         ; |
$00:ABCA 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; |
$00:ABCC 26 04        ROL $04                         ; |
$00:ABCE 26 0F        ROL $0F                         ; } [$04] = top 3 bits of [$0F], shifted out of it
$00:ABD0 26 04        ROL $04                         ; /
$00:ABD2 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $ABED: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette) ;;;

;;     colors-1, $08 = palettes-1).

$00:AC0F A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; |
$00:AC12 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AC14 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; |
$00:AC17 85 08        STA $08                         ; } Colors 8-15 of BG palettes 0-1 from $00:B170 (layer 3 palettes)
$00:AC19 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; /
$00:AC1C A9 50 B2     LDA.W #$B250                    ; \
$00:AC1F 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:AC21 A9 84 00     LDA.W #$0084                    ; |
$00:AC24 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AC26 A9 05 00     LDA.W #$0005                    ; |
$00:AC29 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AC2B A9 09 00     LDA.W #$0009                    ; |
$00:AC2E 85 08        STA $08                         ; } Colors 2-7 of palettes 4-D from $00:B250 (shared BG and sprite colors)
$00:AC30 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; /
$00:AC33 AD 2F 19     LDA.W $192F                     ; \
$00:AC36 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$00:AC39 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:AC3A A8           TAY                             ; |
$00:AC3B B9 A0 B0     LDA.W Palettes?,Y               ; } [$0701] = Palettes?[([$192F] & $F) * 2] (backdrop color)
$00:AC3E 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; /
$00:AC41 A9 90 B1     LDA.W #$B190                    ; \
$00:AC44 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $B190: base of the FG palette sets
$00:AC46 AD 2D 19     LDA.W $192D                     ; \
$00:AC49 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$00:AC4C A8           TAY                             ; |
$00:AC4D B9 D3 AB     LDA.W $ABD3,Y                   ; |
$00:AC50 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$00:AC53 18           CLC                             ; |

$00:AC56 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:AC58 A9 44 00     LDA.W #$0044                    ; \

$00:AC60 85 06        STA $06                         ; |

$00:AC65 85 08        STA $08                         ; } Colors 2-7 of BG palettes 2-3 from [$00]
$00:AC67 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; /

$00:AC7F 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:AC81 A9 C4 01     LDA.W #$01C4                    ; \

$00:AC89 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AC8B A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; |
$00:AC8E 85 08        STA $08                         ; } Colors 2-7 of sprite palettes 6-7 (E-F) from [$00]
$00:AC90 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; /
$00:AC93 A9 B0 B0     LDA.W #$B0B0                    ; \
$00:AC96 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $B0B0: base of the BG palette sets
$00:AC98 AD 30 19     LDA.W $1930                     ; \
$00:AC9B 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$00:AC9E A8           TAY                             ; |
$00:AC9F B9 D3 AB     LDA.W $ABD3,Y                   ; |
$00:ACA2 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$00:ACA5 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:ACA6 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } [$00] += $ABD3[[$1930] & $F] (selected BG palette set)
$00:ACA8 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:ACAA A9 04 00     LDA.W #$0004                    ; \
$00:ACAD 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:ACAF A9 05 00     LDA.W #$0005                    ; |
$00:ACB2 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:ACB4 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; |

$00:ACB9 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; /

$00:ACC1 A9 52 00     LDA.W #$0052                    ; |
$00:ACC4 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:ACC6 A9 06 00     LDA.W #$0006                    ; |

$00:ACD0 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; /

$00:ACD6 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:ACD8 A9 32 01     LDA.W #$0132                    ; |
$00:ACDB 85 04        STA $04                         ; |

$00:ACE0 85 06        STA $06                         ; |

;;; $ACED: Set one color in 8 palettes (LoadCol8Pal) ;;;
;; Writes [$04] to the buffer at $0703+X, then every $20 bytes. Parameters: X = buffer offset, [$04] = color.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:ABF7: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:AC02: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
$00:ACED A0 07 00     LDY.W #$0007                    ; Y = 7: 8 palettes
$00:ACF0 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; A = color value [$04]
$00:ACF2 9D 03 07     STA.W $0703,X                   ; Store in the palette buffer at $0703+X
$00:ACF5 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:ACF6 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:ACF7 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; } X += $20 (next palette)
$00:ACFA AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:ACFB 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:ACFC 10 F2        BPL $ACF0                       ; / Loop for 8 palettes
$00:ACFE 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $ACFF: Load rows of colors into palette buffer (LoadColors) ;;;
;; Copies rows of colors from ROM into the palette buffer at $0703 (the CGRAM mirror).
;; Each row is [$06]+1 colors; after every row the buffer offset advances by $20 (the next 16-color palette).
;; Parameters: [$00]: source address (bank $00); [$04]: buffer byte offset (color number * 2); [$06]: colors
;;     per row - 1; [$08]: rows - 1.
;; Called with A, X and Y 16-bit. [$00] is left pointing after the last color read.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:AC19: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:AC30: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:AC67: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:AC90: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:ACB9: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:ACD0: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:ACE7: Load level palettes into buffer (LoadPalette)
;;     $00:AD5B: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes
;;     $00:AD72: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes
;;     $00:AD89: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes
;;     $00:ADA0: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes
;;     $00:ADBC: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes
;;     ... and 4 more
$00:ACFF A6 04        LDX $04                         ; X = [$04]: byte offset into the palette buffer $0703 (color number * 2)
$00:AD01 A4 06        LDY $06                         ; Y = [$06]: colors per row - 1
$00:AD03 B2 00        LDA ($00)                       ; A = next color (BGR555) from the source at [$00]
$00:AD05 9D 03 07     STA.W $0703,X                   ; Store it in the palette buffer
$00:AD08 E6 00        INC $00                         ; \
$00:AD0A E6 00        INC $00                         ; / [$00] += 2: next source color
$00:AD0C E8           INX                             ; \
$00:AD0D E8           INX                             ; / X += 2: next buffer slot
$00:AD0E 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:AD0F 10 F2        BPL $AD03                       ; / Y--, repeat until Y < 0 (one row of colors)
$00:AD11 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AD13 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:AD14 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; } A = [$04] + $20: start of the next palette row (16 colors on)
$00:AD17 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:AD19 C6 08        DEC $08                         ; \
$00:AD1B 10 E2        BPL LoadColors                  ; / [$08]--, repeat for the next row while [$08] >= 0
$00:AD1D 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $AD1E..AD1E: Table: overworld palette set by map ;;;
;; Indexed by ([$1931] & $0F) - 1; gives the overworld palette set number (0-5) used by $AD25.

;;; $AD25: Load overworld, title and boss room palettes ;;;
;; $00AD25: overworld palettes. Picks a layer palette set from [$1931] (base $B3D8, or $B732 if bit 7 of
;;     [$1EEB] is set) and loads it,
;; then loads the shared overworld colors from $B528, $B57C and $B5EC.
;; $00ADA6: title screen palettes (colors 8-F of palettes 0 and 1).
;; $00ADD9: palettes for the Mode 7 boss rooms with [$0D9B] bit 6 clear (Iggy/Larry). $00AE15: same for the
;;     other Mode 7 boss rooms.
;; All four routines return in 8-bit mode.
;; Called by:

$00:AD25 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit

$00:AD2A AD EA 1E     LDA.W $1EEA                     ; A = [$1EEA] (16-bit load, so N = bit 7 of [$1EEB])

$00:AD2F A0 32 B7     LDY.W #$B732                    ; Bit set: alternate sets at $B732 (probably post-game colors)

$00:AD3F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Keep the low byte
$00:AD42 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:AD43 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = set number * 2
$00:AD44 B9 DF AB     LDA.W $ABDF,Y                   ; A = set number * $38 (size of one set: 4 palettes x 7 colors)
$00:AD47 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:AD48 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$00:AD4A 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] += A: source = start of the chosen set
$00:AD4C A9 82 00     LDA.W #$0082                    ; \
$00:AD4F 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AD51 A9 06 00     LDA.W #$0006                    ; |
$00:AD54 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AD56 A9 03 00     LDA.W #$0003                    ; } [$04] = $82, [$06] = 6, [$08] = 3: palettes 4-7, colors 1-7
$00:AD59 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$00:AD5B 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:AD5E A9 28 B5     LDA.W #$B528                    ; \
$00:AD61 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:AD63 A9 52 00     LDA.W #$0052                    ; |
$00:AD66 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AD68 A9 06 00     LDA.W #$0006                    ; |
$00:AD6B 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AD6D A9 05 00     LDA.W #$0005                    ; } Source $B528, [$04] = $52, [$06] = 6, [$08] = 5: palettes 2-7, colors 9-F
$00:AD70 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$00:AD72 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:AD75 A9 7C B5     LDA.W #$B57C                    ; \
$00:AD78 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:AD7A A9 02 01     LDA.W #$0102                    ; |
$00:AD7D 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AD7F A9 06 00     LDA.W #$0006                    ; |
$00:AD82 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AD84 A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; } Source $B57C, [$04] = $102, [$06] = 6, [$08] = 7: palettes 8-F, colors 1-7
$00:AD87 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$00:AD89 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:AD8C A9 EC B5     LDA.W #$B5EC                    ; \
$00:AD8F 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:AD91 A9 10 00     LDA.W #$0010                    ; |
$00:AD94 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AD96 A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; |
$00:AD99 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AD9B A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; } Source $B5EC, [$04] = $10, [$06] = 7, [$08] = 1: palettes 0-1, colors 8-F
$00:AD9E 85 08        STA $08                         ; /

$00:ADA3 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit

$00:ADA6 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:ADA8 A9 3C B6     LDA.W #$B63C                    ; \

$00:ADB2 A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; |
$00:ADB5 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:ADB7 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; } Source $B63C, [$04] = $10, [$06] = 7, [$08] = 0: palette 0, colors 8-F
$00:ADBA 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$00:ADBC 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:ADBF A9 2C B6     LDA.W #$B62C                    ; \

$00:ADC4 A9 30 00     LDA.W #$0030                    ; |

$00:ADC9 A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; |
$00:ADCC 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:ADCE A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; } Source $B62C, [$04] = $30, [$06] = 7, [$08] = 0: palette 1, colors 8-F
$00:ADD1 85 08        STA $08                         ; /

$00:ADE9 A9 10 00     LDA.W #$0010                    ; |
$00:ADEC 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:ADEE A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; |
$00:ADF1 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:ADF3 A9 01 00     LDA.W #$0001                    ; } Source $B170, [$04] = $10, [$06] = 7, [$08] = 1: palettes 0-1, colors 8-F
$00:ADF6 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$00:ADF8 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:ADFB A9 5C B6     LDA.W #$B65C                    ; \
$00:ADFE 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:AE00 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; |
$00:AE03 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AE05 A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; |
$00:AE08 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AE0A A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; } Source $B65C, [$04] = 0, [$06] = 7, [$08] = 0: palette 0, colors 0-7
$00:AE0D 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$00:AE0F 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:AE12 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:AE14 60           RTS                             ; Return

; |
; V Init palette for special levels?
$00:AE15 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:AE17 8D 2E 19     STA.W $192E                     ; / Sprite palette set [$192E] = 2
$00:AE1A A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$00:AE1C 8D 2D 19     STA.W $192D                     ; / Foreground palette set [$192D] = 7
$00:AE1F 20 ED AB     JSR.W LoadPalette               ; Load the standard palettes (LoadPalette)
$00:AE22 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:AE24 A9 17 00     LDA.W #$0017                    ; \
$00:AE27 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; / Backdrop color [$0701] = $0017 (very dark red)
$00:AE2A A9 F4 B5     LDA.W #$B5F4                    ; \
$00:AE2D 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:AE2F A9 18 00     LDA.W #$0018                    ; |
$00:AE32 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:AE34 A9 03 00     LDA.W #$0003                    ; |
$00:AE37 85 06        STA $06                         ; |
$00:AE39 64 08        STZ $08                         ; / Source $B5F4, [$04] = $18, [$06] = 3, [$08] = 0: palette 0, colors C-F
$00:AE3B 20 FF AC     JSR.W LoadColors                ; Load the colors (LoadColors)
$00:AE3E E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:AE40 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $AE41..AE44: Tables: color channel shifts and COLDATA bits ;;;
;; $AE41: shift counts 0, 5, 10. $AE44: COLDATA plane bits $20, $40, $80. Used by $AE47.
$00:AE41              .db $00,$05,$0A                 ; Shift counts: red 0, green 5, blue 10

$00:AE44              .db $20,$40,$80                 ; COLDATA channel select bits: $20 red, $40 green, $80 blue


;;; $AE47: Set fixed color from backdrop color ;;;
;; Writes the backdrop color [$0701] to the PPU fixed color (COLDATA $2132), one channel at a time (blue,
;;     green, red).
;; Called at the end of MoreDMA so that color math against the fixed color matches the backdrop.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:A4D1: Upload queued palette records to CGRAM (MoreDMA)
$00:AE47 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; X = 2: blue first, then green, then red
$00:AE49 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:AE4B AD 01 07     LDA.W $0701                     ; A = backdrop color [$0701] (BGR555)
$00:AE4E BC 41 AE     LDY.W $AE41,X                   ; Y = bit shift of this channel (0, 5 or 10)
$00:AE51 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:AE52 30 03        BMI $AE57                       ; |
$00:AE54 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AE55 80 FA        BRA $AE51                       ; / A >>= Y: move the channel down to bits 0-4

$00:AE57 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:AE59 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; Keep the 5-bit channel value
$00:AE5B 1D 44 AE     ORA.W $AE44,X                   ; Add the channel select bit
$00:AE5E 8D 32 21     STA.W $2132                     ; COLDATA: set that channel of the fixed color
$00:AE61 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AE62 10 E5        BPL $AE49                       ; / Next channel, X = 2..0
$00:AE64 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $AE65..AEEF: Tables: color masks, fade steps and dither masks ;;;
;; Used by the level end palette fade ($AFC0). Masks and -1/+1 steps are per color channel (red, green,
;;     blue).
;; $AE77: for each 5-bit channel value, two 16-bit masks whose set bits total the value: the channel
;;     loses 1 on each step
;; whose bit is set, so a channel of value v reaches 0 after the 32 steps.
$00:AE65              .db $1F,$00,$E0,$03,$00,$7C     ; Channel field masks: $001F red, $03E0 green, $7C00 blue

$00:AE6B              .db $FF,$FF,$E0,$FF,$00,$FC     ; Step -1 in each channel field: $FFFF, $FFE0, $FC00

$00:AE71              .db $01,$00,$20,$00,$00,$04     ; Step +1 in each channel field: $0001, $0020, $0400

$00:AE77              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$00,$00,$00 ; Dither masks, channel values 0 and 1 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AE7F              .db $00,$80,$00,$80,$20,$80,$00,$04 ; Dither masks, channel values 2 and 3 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AE87              .db $80,$80,$80,$80,$08,$82,$40,$10 ; Dither masks, channel values 4 and 5 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AE8F              .db $20,$84,$20,$84,$44,$88,$10,$22 ; Dither masks, channel values 6 and 7 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AE97              .db $88,$88,$88,$88,$22,$91,$88,$44 ; Dither masks, channel values 8 and 9 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AE9F              .db $48,$92,$48,$92,$92,$A4,$24,$49 ; Dither masks, channel values 10 and 11 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEA7              .db $A4,$A4,$A4,$A4,$49,$A9,$94,$52 ; Dither masks, channel values 12 and 13 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEAF              .db $AA,$AA,$94,$52,$AA,$AA,$54,$55 ; Dither masks, channel values 14 and 15 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEB7              .db $AA,$AA,$AA,$AA,$AA,$D5,$AA,$AA ; Dither masks, channel values 16 and 17 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEBF              .db $AA,$D5,$AA,$D5,$B5,$D6,$6A,$AD ; Dither masks, channel values 18 and 19 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEC7              .db $DA,$DA,$DA,$DA,$6D,$DB,$DA,$B6 ; Dither masks, channel values 20 and 21 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AECF              .db $B6,$ED,$B6,$ED,$DD,$EE,$76,$BB ; Dither masks, channel values 22 and 23 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AED7              .db $EE,$EE,$EE,$EE,$BB,$F7,$EE,$DD ; Dither masks, channel values 24 and 25 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEDF              .db $DE,$FB,$DE,$FB,$F7,$FD,$BE,$EF ; Dither masks, channel values 26 and 27 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEE7              .db $FE,$FE,$FE,$FE,$DF,$FF,$FE,$FB ; Dither masks, channel values 28 and 29 (2 words each, value bits set in total)
$00:AEEF              .db $FE,$FF,$FE,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FE,$FF ; Dither masks, channel values 30 and 31 (2 words each, value bits set in total)

;;; $AEF7..AF0F: Table: dither step bit masks ;;;
;; 16 one-hot words ($8000 down to $0001) selecting which bit of the dither masks applies on each fade step.
$00:AEF7              .db $00,$80,$00,$40,$00,$20,$00,$10 ; One-hot masks for step index 0-3: bits 15 down to 12
$00:AEFF              .db $00,$08,$00,$04,$00,$02,$00,$01 ; One-hot masks for step index 4-7: bits 11 down to 8
$00:AF07              .db $80,$00,$40,$00,$20,$00,$10,$00 ; One-hot masks for step index 8-11: bits 7 down to 4
$00:AF0F              .db $08,$00,$04,$00,$02,$00,$01,$00 ; One-hot masks for step index 12-15: bits 3 down to 0


;;; $AF17: Level end dithered palette fade ;;;
;; $00AF17: per-frame level end handler. Counts [$1493] down every other frame (stops at 1). Below $A0 it also
;;     forces Mode 1 with BG3 out of color math
;; and runs the level end sequence ($CBFF). $00AF35: every 4th frame, while [$1495] < $40, fades
;;     palettes 0-7 (colors 1-7), palette 0 colors D-F
;; and the backdrop by one dithered step. Results go into the CGRAM DMA list at $0905 and [$0680] = 3 queues
;;     the upload.
;; $00AFA3: advances [$1495] by 2 and builds the dither masks [$0C]/[$0E] from the old value.
;; $00AFC0: one dither step. Parameters: A: original color; [$02]: working color; [$0C], [$0E]: masks.
;;     Returns: [$04]: new color.
;; If [$1493] bit 7 is set each step is +1 instead of -1 (purpose unclear).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:C96B: Mario animation A: scripted walk, level end (EnterCastleAni)
$00:AF17 AC 93 14     LDY.W $1493                     ; Y = [$1493] (level end timer)
$00:AF1A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:AF1C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AF1D 90 06        BCC $AF25                       ; / Skip the decrement on even frames
$00:AF1F 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:AF20 F0 03        BEQ $AF25                       ; |
$00:AF22 8C 93 14     STY.W $1493                     ; / Y--, stored back unless it would hit 0 (timer stops at 1)
$00:AF25 C0 A0        CPY.B #$A0                      ; \
$00:AF27 B0 0C        BCS $AF35                       ; / Timer >= $A0: skip the screen mode change
$00:AF29 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:AF2B 14 40        TRB $40                         ; / Clear bit 2 of [$40] (CGADSUB mirror): BG3 out of color math
$00:AF2D A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:AF2F 85 3E        STA $3E                         ; / [$3E] = $09 (BGMODE mirror): Mode 1, BG3 on top
$00:AF31 22 FF CB 05  JSL.L $CBFF                     ; Run the level end sequence code ($CBFF, probably the Course Clear screen)
$00:AF35 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:AF37 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:AF39 D0 67        BNE $AFA2                       ; / Only continue every 4th frame
$00:AF3B AD 95 14     LDA.W $1495                     ; \
$00:AF3E C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; |
$00:AF40 B0 60        BCS $AFA2                       ; / Return once the fade step [$1495] has reached $40
$00:AF42 20 A3 AF     JSR.W $AFA3                     ; Advance [$1495] by 2 and build the dither masks [$0C], [$0E]
$00:AF45 A9 FE 01     LDA.W #$01FE                    ; \
$00:AF48 8D 05 09     STA.W $0905                     ; / DMA list header at $0905: $FE bytes of colors starting at color 1
$00:AF4B A2 EE 00     LDX.W #$00EE                    ; X = $EE: offset of palette 7 color 7
$00:AF4E A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; \
$00:AF51 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = 7 colors per palette (colors 7 down to 1)
$00:AF53 BD 05 09     LDA.W $0905,X                   ; \
$00:AF56 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = working color from the DMA list
$00:AF58 BD 03 07     LDA.W $0703,X                   ; A = original color from the palette buffer (picks the dither pattern)
$00:AF5B 20 C0 AF     JSR.W $AFC0                     ; Dither one step; new color in [$04] ($AFC0)
$00:AF5E A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AF60 9D 05 09     STA.W $0905,X                   ; / Store the new color in the DMA list
$00:AF63 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AF64 CA           DEX                             ; / X -= 2: previous color
$00:AF65 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$00:AF67 D0 EA        BNE $AF53                       ; / Repeat for 7 colors
$00:AF69 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:AF6A 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:AF6B E9 12 00     SBC.W #$0012                    ; } X -= $12: skip color 0 and go to the previous palette
$00:AF6E AA           TAX                             ; |
$00:AF6F 10 DD        BPL $AF4E                       ; / Repeat for palettes 7 down to 0
$00:AF71 A2 04 00     LDX.W #$0004                    ; X = 4: three colors (palette 0 colors F, E, D)
$00:AF74 BD 1F 09     LDA.W $091F,X                   ; \
$00:AF77 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = working color
$00:AF79 BD 1D 07     LDA.W $071D,X                   ; A = original color
$00:AF7C 20 C0 AF     JSR.W $AFC0                     ; Dither one step ($AFC0)
$00:AF7F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AF81 9D 1F 09     STA.W $091F,X                   ; / Store the new color in the DMA list
$00:AF84 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:AF85 CA           DEX                             ; |
$00:AF86 10 EC        BPL $AF74                       ; / Next color, X = 4, 2, 0
$00:AF88 AD 01 07     LDA.W $0701                     ; \
$00:AF8B 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = working backdrop color [$0701]
$00:AF8D AD 03 09     LDA.W $0903                     ; A = original backdrop color (copy at [$0903])
$00:AF90 20 C0 AF     JSR.W $AFC0                     ; Dither one step ($AFC0)
$00:AF93 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:AF95 8D 01 07     STA.W $0701                     ; / [$0701] = new backdrop color
$00:AF98 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:AF9A 9C 05 0A     STZ.W $0A05                     ; End of the DMA list: [$0A05] = 0
$00:AF9D A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:AF9F 8D 80 06     STA.W $0680                     ; / [$0680] = 3: upload the list at $0905 to CGRAM in NMI (MoreDMA)
$00:AFA2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:AFA3 A8           TAY                             ; Y = A = current step [$1495]
$00:AFA4 1A           INC A                           ; \
$00:AFA5 1A           INC A                           ; |
$00:AFA6 8D 95 14     STA.W $1495                     ; / [$1495] = step + 2
$00:AFA9 98           TYA                             ; A = step
$00:AFAA 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:AFAB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AFAC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AFAD 4A           LSR                             ; / A = step >> 4
$00:AFAE C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:AFB0 29 02 00     AND.W #$0002                    ; \
$00:AFB3 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = 2 if step bit 5 is set (second word of each dither entry), else 0
$00:AFB5 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:AFB6 29 1E 00     AND.W #$001E                    ; |
$00:AFB9 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = step & $1E: word index
$00:AFBA B9 F7 AE     LDA.W $AEF7,Y                   ; \
$00:AFBD 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / [$0E] = one-hot mask: the dither bit that applies this step
$00:AFBF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:AFC0 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; [$0A] = original color
$00:AFC2 29 1F 00     AND.W #$001F                    ; \
$00:AFC5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:AFC6 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:AFC7 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = red * 4
$00:AFC9 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$00:AFCB 29 E0 03     AND.W #$03E0                    ; |
$00:AFCE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AFCF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AFD0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:AFD1 85 08        STA $08                         ; / [$08] = green * 4
$00:AFD3 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$00:AFD5 29 7C 00     AND.W #$007C                    ; |
$00:AFD8 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = blue * 4 (bits 10-14 of the color)
$00:AFDA 64 04        STZ $04                         ; [$04] = 0: result color
$00:AFDC A0 04 00     LDY.W #$0004                    ; Y = 4: channel index (blue, then green, then red)
$00:AFDF 5A           PHY                             ; Save the channel index
$00:AFE0 B9 06 00     LDA.W $0006,Y                   ; \
$00:AFE3 05 0C        ORA $0C                         ; |
$00:AFE5 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = channel value * 4 | [$0C]: offset into the dither table
$00:AFE6 B9 77 AE     LDA.W $AE77,Y                   ; A = dither mask word for this channel value
$00:AFE9 7A           PLY                             ; Y = channel index again
$00:AFEA 25 0E        AND $0E                         ; Test this step's bit
$00:AFEC F0 0B        BEQ $AFF9                       ; Bit clear: this channel keeps its working value
$00:AFEE B9 6B AE     LDA.W $AE6B,Y                   ; A = -1 in this channel's field
$00:AFF1 2C 93 14     BIT.W $1493                     ; \
$00:AFF4 10 03        BPL $AFF9                       ; / [$1493] bit 7 clear: keep the -1 step
$00:AFF6 B9 71 AE     LDA.W $AE71,Y                   ; [$1493] bit 7 set: A = +1 in this channel's field (brightens, purpose unclear)
$00:AFF9 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:AFFA 65 02        ADC $02                         ; A = working color + step (A = 0 if no step)
$00:AFFC 39 65 AE     AND.W $AE65,Y                   ; Keep only this channel's field
$00:AFFF 04 04        TSB $04                         ; Merge it into the result [$04]

;;; $B001: Finish pose: add offsets, store frame (Remember) ;;;
;; Parameters: A = walk frame, X = |X speed|.
;; Stores the walk frame in [$13DB], adds the pose offset [$13DE] (+7 carrying an item, +4 when fast), then
;;     handles the 45 degree
;; slope poses. Entries at $D01A (A = final pose) and $D003 are jumped to from the code above.
; You can get somewhere quick by pressing ctrl+f and typing in the address.

$00:B001 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:B002 88           DEY                             ; |
$00:B003 10 DA        BPL $AFDF                       ; / Next channel, Y = 4, 2, 0
$00:B005 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:B006 8B           PHB                             ; \
$00:B007 4B           PHK                             ; |
$00:B008 AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $00
$00:B009 20 A3 AF     JSR.W $AFA3                     ; Advance [$1495] and build the dither masks (A = old step)
$00:B00C A2 6E 00     LDX.W #$006E                    ; X = $6E
$00:B00F A0 08 00     LDY.W #$0008                    ; Y = 8 colors per group
$00:B012 BD 07 09     LDA.W $0907,X                   ; \
$00:B015 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = working color [$0907+X]
$00:B017 BD 83 07     LDA.W $0783,X                   ; A = source color [$0783+X] (picks the dither pattern)
$00:B01A 5A           PHY                             ; Save the counter
$00:B01B 20 C0 AF     JSR.W $AFC0                     ; Dither one step ($AFC0)
$00:B01E 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the counter
$00:B01F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:B021 9D 07 09     STA.W $0907,X                   ; / Store the new color at [$0907+X]
$00:B024 BD 83 07     LDA.W $0783,X                   ; \
$00:B027 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:B028 E5 04        SBC $04                         ; |
$00:B02A 9D 79 09     STA.W $0979,X                   ; / [$0979+X] = source color - new color
$00:B02D CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B02E CA           DEX                             ; / X -= 2
$00:B02F 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:B030 D0 E0        BNE $B012                       ; / Repeat for 8 colors
$00:B032 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:B033 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:B034 E9 10 00     SBC.W #$0010                    ; } X -= $10: skip the next 8 colors
$00:B037 AA           TAX                             ; |
$00:B038 10 D5        BPL $B00F                       ; / Repeat while X >= 0 (4 groups)
$00:B03A E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:B03C AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:B03D 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$00:B03E 20 35 AF     JSR.W $AF35                     ; Fade one step: background palettes ($AF35)
$00:B041 AD 80 06     LDA.W $0680                     ; \
$00:B044 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$00:B046 D0 48        BNE $B090                       ; / Only if a step was just done ([$0680] = 3)
$00:B048 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:B04A 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = 0: bank of the pointer in [$00]
$00:B04C C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:B04E AD 82 0D     LDA.W $0D82                     ; \
$00:B051 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = [$0D82]: pointer to the player's palette
$00:B053 A0 14 00     LDY.W #$0014                    ; Y = $14: copy 11 words
$00:B056 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; \
$00:B058 99 11 0A     STA.W $0A11,Y                   ; / Copy a word of the player's palette into the second DMA list
$00:B05B 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:B05C 88           DEY                             ; |
$00:B05D 10 F7        BPL $B056                       ; / Next word, Y = $14..0
$00:B05F A9 EE 81     LDA.W #$81EE                    ; \
$00:B062 8D 05 0A     STA.W $0A05                     ; / Second list header at $0A05: $EE bytes of colors from color $81
$00:B065 A2 CE 00     LDX.W #$00CE                    ; X = $CE: offset of palette F color 7
$00:B068 A9 07 00     LDA.W #$0007                    ; \
$00:B06B 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = 7 colors per palette
$00:B06D BD 25 0A     LDA.W $0A25,X                   ; \
$00:B070 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = working color from the second list
$00:B072 BD 23 08     LDA.W $0823,X                   ; A = original color from the palette buffer
$00:B075 20 C0 AF     JSR.W $AFC0                     ; Dither one step ($AFC0)
$00:B078 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:B07A 9D 25 0A     STA.W $0A25,X                   ; / Store the new color in the second list
$00:B07D CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B07E CA           DEX                             ; / X -= 2
$00:B07F C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$00:B081 D0 EA        BNE $B06D                       ; / Repeat for 7 colors
$00:B083 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:B084 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:B085 E9 12 00     SBC.W #$0012                    ; } X -= $12: skip color 0 and go to the previous palette
$00:B088 AA           TAX                             ; |
$00:B089 10 DD        BPL $B068                       ; / Repeat for palettes F down to 9
$00:B08B E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$00:B08D 9C F5 0A     STZ.W $0AF5                     ; End of the second list: [$0AF5] = 0
$00:B090 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $B091..B099: Padding ($FF) ;;;
$00:B091              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$00:B099              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF


;;; $B0A0: Palette data: backdrop, BG, FG and sprite sets (Palettes?) ;;;
;; $B0A0: backdrop colors ([$192F]). $B0B0: 8 background palette sets of 24 bytes ([$1930]), colors 2-7 of
;;     palettes 0-1.
;; $B170: layer 3 colors 8-F of palettes 0-1. $B190: 8 foreground palette sets ([$192D]), colors 2-7 of
;;     palettes 2-3.
;; $B250: colors 2-7 of palettes 4-D. $B2C8: unclear. $B318: 8 sprite palette sets ([$192E]), colors 2-7 of
;;     sprite palettes 6-7.
;; All loaded by LoadPalette ($00ABED); offsets come from $ABD3 (set * $18). Colors are BGR555.
