;;; $B70E: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes) ;;;
;; Starts with palette data (15-bit BGR words): three 12-byte sets copied to $08A7/$08C7/$08E7 by the title
;;     screen code, followed by more color words.
;; $B888 (called once from game mode 00): decompresses Mario graphics (GFX32 at $08:BFC0) to $7E:2000,
;;     expands each 24-byte 3bpp tile
;; to a 32-byte 4bpp tile in place going backwards (bitplane 3 = 0, result ends at $7E:AD00), then
;;     decompresses the stream at $08:8000 to $7E:2000.
;; $B8DE: LZ2 decompressor. Parameters: [$8A]-[$8C] = source, [$00]-[$02] = destination. Commands: top 3
;;     bits = type, low 5 bits = length - 1;
;; types 0 copy, 1 byte fill, 2 word fill, 3 incrementing fill, 4 copy earlier output (16-bit offset, high
;;     byte first); 111 = long form (10-bit length); $FF ends.
$00:B70E              .db $C4,$44,$20,$03,$DF,$4A,$00,$02 ; Palette 1, colors 0-3 (15-bit BGR words); first 12 bytes copied to $08A7 (palette buffer)
$00:B716              .db $3B,$01,$08,$4E             ; Palette 1, colors 4-5

$00:B71A              .db $C4,$44,$1F,$39,$DF,$4A,$74,$28 ; Palette 2, colors 0-3; 12 bytes copied to $08C7 (palette buffer)
$00:B722              .db $3F,$01,$08,$4E             ; Palette 2, colors 4-5

$00:B726              .db $D2,$28,$1E,$55,$5F,$63,$1F,$7B ; Palette 3, colors 0-3; 12 bytes copied to $08E7 (palette buffer)
$00:B72E              .db $FB,$01,$DE,$02,$00,$00,$33,$15 ; Palette 3, colors 4-5, then more color words with no named reference

$00:B7BE              .db $E7,$1C,$F3,$19,$B9,$32,$7F,$4B
$00:B7C6              .db $1F,$00,$FF,$7F,$E7,$1C,$E7,$1C
$00:B7CE              .db $F3,$19,$B9,$32,$7F,$4B,$C6,$58
$00:B7D6              .db $D5,$3A,$9C,$5B,$00,$00,$6D,$1D
$00:B7DE              .db $D0,$29,$33,$36,$6B,$2D,$F9,$4E
$00:B7E6              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$DE,$7B,$33,$36
$00:B7EE              .db $82,$30,$6B,$2D,$BF,$37,$7F,$2D
$00:B7F6              .db $00,$00,$A7,$00,$2B,$15,$8E,$21
$00:B7FE              .db $6B,$2D,$F9,$4E,$82,$30,$00,$00

$00:B846              .db $35,$11,$98,$1D,$C7,$2C,$F0,$69

$00:B856              .db $FF,$7F,$00,$00,$60,$45,$80,$66

$00:B866              .db $2C,$41,$F0,$69,$B2,$66,$D5,$67

$00:B876              .db $F0,$69,$B2,$66,$D5,$67,$2C,$41
$00:B87E              .db $D5,$3A,$9C,$5B,$C0,$BF,$08,$00 ; Last color words; then bytes C0 BF 08 = unreferenced pointer $08:BFC0 (GFX32)
$00:B886              .db $80,$08                     ; 00 80 08 (continued): unreferenced pointer $08:8000

$00:B888 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit
$00:B88A A0 C0 BF     LDY.W #$BFC0                    ; \
$00:B88D 84 8A        STY $8A                         ; |
$00:B88F A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; } $8A-$8C = $08:BFC0: compressed Mario graphics (GFX32)
$00:B891 85 8C        STA $8C                         ; /
$00:B893 A0 00 20     LDY.W #$2000                    ; \
$00:B896 84 00        STY $00                         ; |
$00:B898 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; } $00-$02 = $7E:2000: decompression destination
$00:B89A 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$00:B89C 20 DE B8     JSR.W $B8DE                     ; Decompress it (LZ2) to $7E:2000
$00:B89F A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$00:B8A1 85 8F        STA $8F                         ; |
$00:B8A3 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; |
$00:B8A5 A9 FE AC     LDA.W #$ACFE                    ; } $8D-$8F = $7E:ACFE: write pointer for the 4bpp copy, filled backwards
$00:B8A8 85 8D        STA $8D                         ; /
$00:B8AA A2 FF 23     LDX.W #$23FF                    ; X = $23FF: last byte of the $2400-byte 3bpp data (384 tiles of 24 bytes)
$00:B8AD A0 08 00     LDY.W #$0008                    ; Y = 8 rows of bitplane 2
$00:B8B0 BF 00 20 7E  LDA.L $7E2000,X                 ; \
$00:B8B4 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Bitplane 2 byte of a row becomes a word (bitplane 3 = 0), stored at [$8D]
$00:B8B7 87 8D        STA [$8D]                       ; /
$00:B8B9 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B8BA C6 8D        DEC $8D                         ; } X--; $8D -= 2
$00:B8BC C6 8D        DEC $8D                         ; /
$00:B8BE 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:B8BF D0 EF        BNE $B8B0                       ; / Repeat for 8 rows
$00:B8C1 A0 08 00     LDY.W #$0008                    ; Y = 8 rows of bitplanes 0/1
$00:B8C4 CA           DEX                             ; X-- (X now points at the high byte of the next word)
$00:B8C5 BF 00 20 7E  LDA.L $7E2000,X                 ; A = bitplane 0/1 word of one row
$00:B8C9 87 8D        STA [$8D]                       ; Store it at [$8D]
$00:B8CB CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B8CC 30 09        BMI $B8D7                       ; / X--; all tiles done when X < 0
$00:B8CE C6 8D        DEC $8D                         ; \
$00:B8D0 C6 8D        DEC $8D                         ; / $8D -= 2
$00:B8D2 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:B8D3 D0 EF        BNE $B8C4                       ; / Repeat for 8 rows
$00:B8D5 80 D6        BRA $B8AD                       ; Next tile: back to the bitplane 2 loop

$00:B8D7 A9 00 80     LDA.W #$8000                    ; \
$00:B8DA 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; / $8A = $8000: next stream is at $08:8000 (bank in $8C unchanged)
$00:B8DC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit; falls into the decompressor (probably GFX33, left at $7E:2000)
$00:B8DE C2 10        REP #$10                        ; Index 16-bit (LZ2 decompressor: source [$8A], destination [$00])
$00:B8E0 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0: output offset into [$00]
$00:B8E3 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Read the next command byte (ReadByte)
$00:B8E6 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:B8E8 D0 03        BNE $B8ED                       ; / Command $FF: end of data
$00:B8EA E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; Index 8-bit
$00:B8EC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:B8ED 85 8F        STA $8F                         ; Remember the command byte in [$8F]
$00:B8EF 29 E0        AND.B #$E0                      ; \
$00:B8F1 C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; } Bits 7-5 = 111: long command with a 10-bit length, go to $00B8FF
$00:B8F3 F0 0A        BEQ $B8FF                       ; /
$00:B8F5 48           PHA                             ; Push command type (bits 7-5 in place)
$00:B8F6 A5 8F        LDA $8F                         ; \
$00:B8F8 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; } A = length - 1 = bits 4-0 of the command
$00:B8FA 29 1F 00     AND.W #$001F                    ; /
$00:B8FD 80 12        BRA $B911                       ; Go to $00B911

$00:B8FF A5 8F        LDA $8F                         ; \
$00:B901 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:B902 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:B903 0A           ASL                             ; } Long command: type = bits 4-2, moved to bits 7-5
$00:B904 29 E0        AND.B #$E0                      ; /
$00:B906 48           PHA                             ; Push command type
$00:B907 A5 8F        LDA $8F                         ; \
$00:B909 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Bits 1-0 = high bits of length - 1, parked in B
$00:B90B EB           XBA                             ; /
$00:B90C 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Read the low byte of length - 1
$00:B90F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit: A = length - 1
$00:B911 1A           INC A                           ; A = length
$00:B912 85 8D        STA $8D                         ; $8D = byte count
$00:B914 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:B916 68           PLA                             ; Pull the command type
$00:B917 F0 17        BEQ $B930                       ; Type 000: direct copy
$00:B919 30 4B        BMI $B966                       ; Type 1xx: copy from earlier output
$00:B91B 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:B91C 10 21        BPL $B93F                       ; / Type 001: byte fill
$00:B91E 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:B91F 10 2B        BPL $B94C                       ; / Type 010: word fill
$00:B921 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Type 011 (incrementing fill): read the start value
$00:B924 A6 8D        LDX $8D                         ; X = count
$00:B926 97 00        STA [$00],Y                     ; Store the value in the output
$00:B928 1A           INC A                           ; Value++
$00:B929 C8           INY                             ; Output offset++
$00:B92A CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B92B D0 F9        BNE $B926                       ; / Repeat count times
$00:B92D 4C E3 B8     JMP.W $B8E3                     ; Next command

$00:B930 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Direct copy: read a byte
$00:B933 97 00        STA [$00],Y                     ; Store it in the output
$00:B935 C8           INY                             ; Output offset++
$00:B936 A6 8D        LDX $8D                         ; \
$00:B938 CA           DEX                             ; } $8D = count - 1
$00:B939 86 8D        STX $8D                         ; /
$00:B93B D0 F3        BNE $B930                       ; Repeat until the count is 0
$00:B93D 80 A4        BRA $B8E3                       ; Next command

$00:B93F 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Byte fill: read the fill value
$00:B942 A6 8D        LDX $8D                         ; X = count
$00:B944 97 00        STA [$00],Y                     ; Store the value in the output
$00:B946 C8           INY                             ; Output offset++
$00:B947 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B948 D0 FA        BNE $B944                       ; / Repeat count times
$00:B94A 80 97        BRA $B8E3                       ; Next command

$00:B94C 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Word fill: read the first fill byte
$00:B94F EB           XBA                             ; Park it in B
$00:B950 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; Read the second fill byte
$00:B953 A6 8D        LDX $8D                         ; X = count
$00:B955 EB           XBA                             ; A = first byte
$00:B956 97 00        STA [$00],Y                     ; Store it in the output
$00:B958 C8           INY                             ; Output offset++
$00:B959 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B95A F0 07        BEQ $B963                       ; / Count exhausted: next command ($00B963)
$00:B95C EB           XBA                             ; A = second byte
$00:B95D 97 00        STA [$00],Y                     ; Store it in the output
$00:B95F C8           INY                             ; Output offset++
$00:B960 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:B961 D0 F2        BNE $B955                       ; / Alternate the two bytes until count is 0
$00:B963 4C E3 B8     JMP.W $B8E3                     ; Next command

$00:B966 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; \
$00:B969 EB           XBA                             ; |
$00:B96A 20 83 B9     JSR.W ReadByte                  ; } X = source offset in the output (16-bit, high byte stored first)
$00:B96D AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:B96E 5A           PHY                             ; \
$00:B96F 9B           TXY                             ; |
$00:B970 B7 00        LDA [$00],Y                     ; |
$00:B972 BB           TYX                             ; } A = output[X], Y preserved
$00:B973 7A           PLY                             ; /
$00:B974 97 00        STA [$00],Y                     ; Append it to the output
$00:B976 C8           INY                             ; Output offset++
$00:B977 E8           INX                             ; Source offset++
$00:B978 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$00:B97A C6 8D        DEC $8D                         ; } $8D-- (count, 16-bit)
$00:B97C E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /
$00:B97E D0 EE        BNE $B96E                       ; Repeat until the count is 0
$00:B980 4C E3 B8     JMP.W $B8E3                     ; Next command


;;; $B983: Read byte from 24-bit source pointer (ReadByte) ;;;
;; Returns the byte at [$8A] in A and advances the pointer, moving to $8000 of the next bank when it wraps.
;; Parameters: [$8A]-[$8C]: 24-bit source pointer. Returns: A = byte; X is clobbered; A and X sizes are the
;;     caller's.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:B8E3: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B90C: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B921: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B930: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B93F: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B94C: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B950: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B966: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
;;     $00:B96A: Ending palettes and GFX decompression (TheEndPalettes)
$00:B983 A7 8A        LDA [$8A]                       ; A = byte at the 24-bit source pointer [$8A]
$00:B985 A6 8A        LDX $8A                         ; \
$00:B987 E8           INX                             ; / X = pointer + 1
$00:B988 D0 05        BNE $B98F                       ; No wrap: go store the pointer
$00:B98A A2 00 80     LDX.W #$8000                    ; \
$00:B98D E6 8C        INC $8C                         ; / Pointer wrapped past $FFFF: restart at $8000 of the next bank
$00:B98F 86 8A        STX $8A                         ; Store the advanced pointer
$00:B991 60           RTS                             ; Return (A = byte, X clobbered)

;;; $BA28: Decompress GFX file to buffer ;;;
;; Looks up the ROM address of GFX file Y and decompresses it to the GFX buffer at $7E:AD00 using the LZ2
;;     decompressor.
;; Parameters: Y: GFX file number ($00-$31). Returns: Y and the data bank preserved; RTL.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9560: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:A149: Game mode 0C: load overworld (LoadMapGameMode)
;;     $00:A82F: Level start setup, Mario Start! graphics
;;     $00:A873: Level start setup, Mario Start! graphics
;;     $00:A9A6: Table: tileset GFX lists, raw GFX upload (OBJECTGFXLIST)
;;     $00:AA6B: Decompress GFX file and start upload (UploadGFXFile)
;;     $00:AA7A: Decompress GFX file and start upload (UploadGFXFile)
;;     $00:AB44: 3bpp to 4bpp: planes 2-3; Mode 7 upload (AddressWrite2)
;;     $03:DDC8: Mode 7 boss graphics and palette setup (KoopaPalPtrHi)
$00:BA28 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$00:BA29 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y (GFX file number)
$00:BA2A 4B           PHK                             ; \
$00:BA2B AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $00
$00:BA2C B9 92 B9     LDA.W $B992,Y                   ; \
$00:BA2F 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; |
$00:BA31 B9 C4 B9     LDA.W $B9C4,Y                   ; |
$00:BA34 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; |
$00:BA36 B9 F6 B9     LDA.W $B9F6,Y                   ; } $8A-$8C = ROM address of GFX file Y (from the three tables)
$00:BA39 85 8C        STA $8C                         ; /
$00:BA3B A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:BA3D 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:BA3F A9 AD        LDA.B #$AD                      ; |
$00:BA41 85 01        STA $01                         ; |
$00:BA43 A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; } $00-$02 = $7E:AD00 (GFX buffer)
$00:BA45 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$00:BA47 20 DE B8     JSR.W $B8DE                     ; Decompress the file to the buffer (LZ2)
$00:BA4A 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$00:BA4B AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:BA4C 6B           RTL                             ; Return long



;;; $BA4D..BA5D: Unused. Padding ($FF bytes) ;;;
$00:BA4D              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$00:BA55              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$00:BA5D              .db $FF,$FF,$FF


;;; $BA60..BA68: Table: layer 1 horizontal screen offsets, low byte ;;;
;; Low byte of the Map16 offset of screen n (n * $1B0). Together with $BA9C: $C800 + n * $1B0. Used by
;;     the level loading code in banks 01, 02 and 00.
$00:BA60              .db $00,$B0,$60,$10,$C0,$70,$20,$D0 ; Screens $00-$07: layer 1 horizontal, offset low byte (n * $1B0)
$00:BA68              .db $80,$30,$E0,$90,$40,$F0,$A0,$50 ; Screens $08-$0F: layer 1 horizontal, offset low byte (n * $1B0)

;;; $BA70..BA78: Table: layer 2 horizontal screen offsets, low byte ;;;
;; Same low bytes as $BA60, for layer 2 (high bytes in $BAAC: $E300 + n * $1B0).
$00:BA70              .db $00,$B0,$60,$10,$C0,$70,$20,$D0 ; Screens $00-$07: layer 2 horizontal, offset low byte (n * $1B0)
$00:BA78              .db $80,$30,$E0,$90,$40,$F0,$A0,$50 ; Screens $08-$0F: layer 2 horizontal, offset low byte (n * $1B0)

;;; $BA80..BA88: Table: layer 1 vertical screen offsets, low byte ;;;
;; All zero: vertical screens are $0200 bytes (high bytes in $BABC).
$00:BA80              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Screens $00-$07: layer 1 vertical, offset low byte (n * $200, always 0)
$00:BA88              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00     ; Screens $08-$0D: layer 1 vertical, offset low byte (n * $200, always 0)


;;; $BA8E..BA96: Table: layer 2 vertical screen offsets, low byte ;;;

;;; $BEB0: Generate Map16 tile at block position (GenerateTile) ;;;
;; Called with JSL to turn a block into another tile (e.g. a hit block becoming a used block, or a vine/coin
;;     spot). Parameters: [$9C]: block to generate (0 = none),
;; [$98]/[$99] block Y, [$9A]/[$9B] block X, [$1933] layer. Finds the Map16 buffer of the screen, computes the
;;     VRAM position in $04-$07 and the reference
;; scroll position in $08/$0A, then dispatches through TileGenerationPtr with A = block - 1. Does nothing if
;;     the position is outside the level ($0200+).
;; Quirk: PHK/PER builds a fake JSL return address so ExecutePtr reads TileGenerationPtr as its table.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:F25C: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
;;     $00:F285: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
;;     $00:F2D1: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
;;     $00:F36F: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
;;     $01:BCB5: Spawn sprite from the magic (StoreSpriteNum)
;;     $01:C1E9: Growing vine (GrowingVine)
;;     $01:E33F: Monty Mole states and routines (Ptrs01E2D8)
;;     $02:8784: Break turn block (BreakTurnBlock)
;;     $02:87E8: Find bounce sprite slot (FindTurningBlkSlot)
;;     $02:91E8: Generate block at bounce sprite position (TileFromBounceSpr1)
;;     $02:B9B8: Block and sprite helpers: berries and silver coins (GenTileFromSpr0)
;;     $02:BB06: Block and sprite helpers: berries and silver coins (GenTileFromSpr0)
;;     ... and 10 more
$00:BEB0 08           PHP                             ; Save flags
$00:BEB1 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:BEB3 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:BEB4 A5 9C        LDA RAM_BlockBlock              ; \
$00:BEB6 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } Block to generate [$9C] = 0: nothing to do, exit
$00:BEB9 D0 03        BNE $BEBE                       ; /
$00:BEBB 4C B9 BF     JMP.W $BFB9                     ; Exit

$00:BEBE A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; A = block X position
$00:BEC0 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; $0C = X position
$00:BEC2 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; A = block Y position
$00:BEC4 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; $0E = Y position
$00:BEC6 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; A = 0 (clears the high byte)
$00:BEC9 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:BECB A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$00:BECD 85 09        STA $09                         ; / $09 = vertical level flags ($5B)
$00:BECF AD 33 19     LDA.W $1933                     ; \
$00:BED2 F0 02        BEQ $BED6                       ; / Layer 1: keep bit 0; layer 2 ([$1933] != 0): use bit 1 instead
$00:BED4 46 09        LSR $09                         ; $09 >>= 1
$00:BED6 A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; Y = Y position (horizontal level: position across the level)
$00:BED8 A5 09        LDA $09                         ; \
$00:BEDA 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Horizontal layer: go to $00BEEC
$00:BEDC F0 0E        BEQ $BEEC                       ; /
$00:BEDE A5 9B        LDA RAM_BlockXHi                ; \
$00:BEE0 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$00:BEE2 A5 99        LDA RAM_BlockYHi                ; |
$00:BEE4 85 9B        STA RAM_BlockXHi                ; |
$00:BEE6 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; } Vertical layer: swap the X and Y high bytes
$00:BEE8 85 99        STA RAM_BlockYHi                ; /
$00:BEEA A4 0C        LDY $0C                         ; Y = X position (the coordinate across a vertical level)
$00:BEEC C0 00 02     CPY.W #$0200                    ; \
$00:BEEF B0 CA        BCS $BEBB                       ; / Coordinate across the level >= $0200: outside the level, exit
$00:BEF1 AD 33 19     LDA.W $1933                     ; \
$00:BEF4 0A           ASL                             ; } X = [$1933] * 2 (layer index)
$00:BEF5 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:BEF6 BF A8 BE 00  LDA.L LoadBlkPtrs,X             ; \
$00:BEFA 85 65        STA $65                         ; / $65 = low byte of pointer from LoadBlkPtrs[layer]
$00:BEFC BF A9 BE 00  LDA.L LoadBlkPtrs+1,X           ; \
$00:BF00 85 66        STA $66                         ; / $66 = high byte of that pointer
$00:BF02 64 67        STZ $67                         ; $67 = 0: bank $00
$00:BF04 AD 25 19     LDA.W $1925                     ; \
$00:BF07 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = level mode [$1925] * 2
$00:BF08 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:BF09 B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; \
$00:BF0B 85 04        STA $04                         ; / $04 = low byte of the screen table address for this mode
$00:BF0D C8           INY                             ; Y++
$00:BF0E B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; \
$00:BF10 85 05        STA $05                         ; / $05 = high byte of the screen table address
$00:BF12 64 06        STZ $06                         ; $06 = 0: bank $00
$00:BF14 A5 9B        LDA RAM_BlockXHi                ; \
$00:BF16 85 07        STA $07                         ; / $07 = block X high byte (screen number)
$00:BF18 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:BF19 18           CLC                             ; } A = screen number * 3 (3-byte entries)
$00:BF1A 65 07        ADC $07                         ; /
$00:BF1C A8           TAY                             ; Y = offset into the screen table
$00:BF1D B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; \
$00:BF1F 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; } $6B/$6E = low byte of this screen's Map16 address
$00:BF21 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; /
$00:BF23 C8           INY                             ; Y++
$00:BF24 B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; \
$00:BF26 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; } $6C/$6F = high byte of this screen's Map16 address
$00:BF28 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; /
$00:BF2A A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \
$00:BF2C 85 6D        STA $6D                         ; / $6D = $7E: $6B-$6D points at the Map16 low byte
$00:BF2E 1A           INC A                           ; \
$00:BF2F 85 70        STA $70                         ; / $70 = $7F: $6E-$70 points at the Map16 high byte (page) table
$00:BF31 A5 09        LDA $09                         ; \
$00:BF33 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Horizontal layer: go to $00BF41
$00:BF35 F0 0A        BEQ $BF41                       ; /
$00:BF37 A5 99        LDA RAM_BlockYHi                ; \
$00:BF39 4A           LSR                             ; / Vertical layer: carry = bit 0 of block Y high byte
$00:BF3A A5 9B        LDA RAM_BlockXHi                ; \
$00:BF3C 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; / A = bit 0 of block X high byte

$00:BF41 A5 9B        LDA RAM_BlockXHi                ; \
$00:BF43 4A           LSR                             ; / Horizontal layer: carry = bit 0 of block X high byte
$00:BF44 A5 99        LDA RAM_BlockYHi                ; A = block Y high byte
$00:BF46 2A           ROL                             ; \

$00:BF48 0A           ASL                             ; /
$00:BF49 09 20        ORA.B #$20                      ; Add $20: base of the VRAM tilemap high byte (probably BG1 at $2000)
$00:BF4B 85 04        STA $04                         ; $04 = tilemap page
$00:BF4D E0 00 00     CPX.W #$0000                    ; \
$00:BF50 F0 05        BEQ $BF57                       ; / Layer 1 (X = 0): keep $20
$00:BF52 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:BF53 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Layer 2: add $10 to the page
$00:BF55 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:BF57 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:BF59 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$00:BF5B 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:BF5C 0A           ASL                             ; } A = (block Y & $F0) * 4: tilemap row offset (64 words per 16 pixel row)
$00:BF5D 2A           ROL                             ; /
$00:BF5E 85 05        STA $05                         ; $05 = row offset low part
$00:BF60 2A           ROL                             ; \
$00:BF61 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } A = row offset overflow bits | page
$00:BF63 05 04        ORA $04                         ; /
$00:BF65 85 06        STA $06                         ; $06 = VRAM address high byte of the tile
$00:BF67 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:BF69 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$00:BF6B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:BF6C 4A           LSR                             ; } A = (block X & $F0) / 8: column offset in words
$00:BF6D 4A           LSR                             ; /
$00:BF6E 85 04        STA $04                         ; $04 = column offset
$00:BF70 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; \
$00:BF72 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; } Combine with the row bits
$00:BF74 05 04        ORA $04                         ; /
$00:BF76 85 07        STA $07                         ; $07 = VRAM address low byte of the tile
$00:BF78 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:BF7A A5 09        LDA $09                         ; \
$00:BF7C 29 01 00     AND.W #$0001                    ; } Vertical layer: go to $00BF9B
$00:BF7F D0 1A        BNE $BF9B                       ; /
$00:BF81 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$00:BF83 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:BF84 E9 80 00     SBC.W #$0080                    ; } X = layer 1 screen boundary X - $80
$00:BF87 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:BF88 A4 1C        LDY RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Y = layer 1 screen boundary Y
$00:BF8A AD 33 19     LDA.W $1933                     ; \
$00:BF8D F0 23        BEQ $BFB2                       ; / Layer 1: go to $00BFB2
$00:BF8F A6 1E        LDX $1E                         ; Layer 2: X = layer 2 scroll X
$00:BF91 A5 20        LDA $20                         ; \
$00:BF93 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:BF94 E9 80 00     SBC.W #$0080                    ; } Y = layer 2 scroll Y - $80
$00:BF97 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:BF98 4C B2 BF     JMP.W $BFB2                     ; Go to $00BFB2

$00:BF9B A6 1A        LDX RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Vertical layer 1: X = screen boundary X
$00:BF9D A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$00:BF9F 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:BFA0 E9 80 00     SBC.W #$0080                    ; } Y = screen boundary Y - $80
$00:BFA3 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:BFA4 AD 33 19     LDA.W $1933                     ; \
$00:BFA7 F0 09        BEQ $BFB2                       ; / Layer 1: go to $00BFB2
$00:BFA9 A5 1E        LDA $1E                         ; \
$00:BFAB 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:BFAC E9 80 00     SBC.W #$0080                    ; } Layer 2: X = layer 2 scroll X - $80
$00:BFAF AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:BFB0 A4 20        LDY $20                         ; Y = layer 2 scroll Y
$00:BFB2 86 08        STX $08                         ; $08 = reference X position
$00:BFB4 84 0A        STY $0A                         ; $0A = reference Y position
$00:BFB6 20 BC BF     JSR.W $BFBC                     ; Run the handler for this block ($BFBC)
$00:BFB9 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:BFBA 28           PLP                             ; Restore flags
$00:BFBB 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$00:BFBC E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A and index 8-bit
$00:BFBE A5 9C        LDA RAM_BlockBlock              ; \
$00:BFC0 3A           DEC A                           ; / A = block number - 1: index into TileGenerationPtr
$00:BFC1 4B           PHK                             ; \
$00:BFC2 62 03 00     PER $0003                       ; / Push a fake JSL return address so the pointer table follows (at TileGenerationPtr)
$00:BFC5 5C DF 86 00  JMP.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the handler selected by A (ExecutePtr)



;;; $BFC9: Pointer table: tile generation handlers (TileGenerationPtr) ;;;
;; Indexed by block number - 1 ($01-$1B). Handlers $C074/00C077/00C0C4/00C0C1/00C1AC/00C334/00C3D1 place
;;     the new tile and queue its drawing.
$00:BFC9 74 C0        .dw $C074                       ; Block $01: empty space (flags the spot in $19F8 first)
$00:BFCB 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $02: empty space
$00:BFCD 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $03: vine
$00:BFCF 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $04: tree background (for berries)
$00:BFD1 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $05: always turning block
$00:BFD3 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $06: coin
$00:BFD5 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $07: mushroom scale base
$00:BFD7 77 C0        .dw $C077                       ; Block $08: mole hole
$00:BFD9 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $09: invisible solid block
$00:BFDB C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $0A: multiple coin turn block
$00:BFDD C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $0B: multiple coin ? block
$00:BFDF C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $0C: turn block
$00:BFE1 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $0D: used block
$00:BFE3 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $0E: music block
$00:BFE5 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $0F: music block variant
$00:BFE7 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $10: all-way music block
$00:BFE9 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $11: sideways turn block
$00:BFEB C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $12: translucent block
$00:BFED C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $13: ON/OFF block
$00:BFEF C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $14: side of pipe, left
$00:BFF1 C4 C0        .dw $C0C4                       ; Block $15: side of pipe, right
$00:BFF3 C1 C0        .dw $C0C1                       ; Block $16: used block variant
$00:BFF5 C1 C0        .dw $C0C1                       ; Block $17: O block from the 1-up game
$00:BFF7 AC C1        .dw $C1AC                       ; Block $18: invisible block containing wings
$00:BFF9 34 C3        .dw $C334                       ; Block $19: cage
$00:BFFB 34 C3        .dw $C334                       ; Block $1A: cage
$00:BFFD D1 C3        .dw $C3D1                       ; Block $1B: purpose unknown

$00:BFFF              .db $00,$00,$80,$00,$00,$01     ; Words $0000, $0080, $0100: offsets into the $19F8 table, indexed by [$13BE] & $0F


$00:C005              .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01 ; Bit masks, bit 7 first: bit for the column within a 128 pixel span

$00:C00D C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:C00F A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:C011 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; |
$00:C014 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C015 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C016 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C017 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C018 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C019 4A           LSR                             ; } $04 = (block X & $FF00) / 64: screen number * 4
$00:C01A 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:C01C A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:C01E 29 80 00     AND.W #$0080                    ; |
$00:C021 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C022 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C023 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C024 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C025 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C026 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C027 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C028 05 04        ORA $04                         ; } $04 |= (block X & $80) / 128: left or right half of the screen
$00:C02A 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:C02C A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:C02E 29 00 01     AND.W #$0100                    ; } Block Y bit 8 set?
$00:C031 F0 07        BEQ $C03A                       ; /
$00:C033 A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:C035 09 02 00     ORA.W #$0002                    ; } $04 |= 2: lower half of the level
$00:C038 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:C03A AD BE 13     LDA.W $13BE                     ; \
$00:C03D 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; |
$00:C040 0A           ASL                             ; } X = ([$13BE] & $0F) * 2
$00:C041 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:C042 BF FF BF 00  LDA.L $BFFF,X                   ; \
$00:C046 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:C047 65 04        ADC $04                         ; } $04 += word from $BFFF
$00:C049 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:C04B A8           TAY                             ; Y = byte index into the $19F8 bit table
$00:C04C A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:C04E 29 70 00     AND.W #$0070                    ; |
$00:C051 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C052 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C053 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C054 4A           LSR                             ; } X = (block X & $70) / 16: column within the 128 pixel span
$00:C055 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:C056 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:C058 B9 F8 19     LDA.W $19F8,Y                   ; A = current bits
$00:C05B 1F 05 C0 00  ORA.L $C005,X                   ; Set the bit for this column ($C005)
$00:C05F 99 F8 19     STA.W $19F8,Y                   ; Store the bits back: marks this spot in the $19F8 table (probably "tile was changed")
$00:C062 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $C063..C063: Unused. Bit masks to clear one bit ;;;
$00:C063              .db $7F,$BF,$DF,$EF,$F7,$FB,$FD,$FE ; Unused: masks that clear one bit (inverse of $C005)

;;; $C06B: Table: Map16 tile per generated block, page 0 (TileToGeneratePg0) ;;;
;; Indexed by block number $00-$08: the Map16 tile ($25 empty, $06 vine, $49 tree background, $48, $2B coin,
;;     $A2, $C6 mole hole).
;; Followed by $C074 (flags the spot in $19F8, then falls into) $C077: places the tile for blocks
;;     $01-$08 and continues at $C0FB.
$00:C06B              .db $25,$25,$25,$06,$49,$48,$2B,$A2 ; Map16 tile for block $00-$07: $25 empty, $25, $25, $06 vine, $49 tree bg, $48, $2B coin, $A2
$00:C073              .db $C6                         ; Map16 tile for block $08: $C6 (mole hole)

$00:C074 20 0D C0     JSR.W $C00D                     ; Blocks $01: flag the spot in $19F8 ($C00D), then fall through
$00:C077 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:C079 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:C07B 29 F0 01     AND.W #$01F0                    ; } $04 = (block Y & $01F0): row offset in the Map16 screen (16 bytes per row)
$00:C07E 85 04        STA $04                         ; /
$00:C080 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:C082 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C083 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C084 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C085 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C086 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; } A = (block X / 16) & $0F | row offset
$00:C089 05 04        ORA $04                         ; /
$00:C08B A8           TAY                             ; Y = index of the tile within the screen's Map16 data
$00:C08C A5 9C        LDA RAM_BlockBlock              ; \
$00:C08E 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = block number (index into TileToGeneratePg0)
$00:C091 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:C092 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:C094 B7 6E        LDA [$6E],Y                     ; \
$00:C096 29 FE        AND.B #$FE                      ; } Clear bit 0 of the Map16 high byte ($6E): use page 0
$00:C098 97 6E        STA [$6E],Y                     ; /
$00:C09A BF 6B C0 00  LDA.L TileToGeneratePg0,X       ; \
$00:C09E 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Store the Map16 tile for this block at [$6B],Y
$00:C0A0 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$00:C0A2 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$00:C0A5 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = tile number * 2
$00:C0A6 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:C0A7 4C FB C0     JMP.W $C0FB                     ; Continue at $C0FB (draws the tile)



;;; $C0AA..C0AA: Unused. Bit mask table (duplicate) ;;;
$00:C0AA              .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01 ; Unused: duplicate of the bit mask table at $C005

;;; $C0B2: Generate Map16 tiles: page 1 and wings block (TileToGeneratePg1) ;;;
;; Block generation (tile generated by a sprite or block action, block number in [$9C]). The first routine
;;     handles blocks $09-$17: it
;; looks up the Map16 tile number in the table, writes it into the level Map16 map at ([$6B]),Y / ([$6E],Y bit
;;     0 = page 1) and queues a
;; stripe image update for the 16x16 block when the block is inside the visible area ([$08]/[$0C] horizontal,
;;     [$0A]/[$0E] vertical).
;; The tail at $00C0FB is shared with the page 0 routine. Records are appended to the buffer at $7F:837D
;;     (write index $7F:837B).
;; $00C1AC: block $18 (invisible block containing wings): sets this block and the one below to Map16 tile $25
;;     and queues vertical records.
$00:C0B2              .db $52,$1B,$23,$1E,$32,$13,$15,$16 ; Map16 tiles $152,$11B,$123,$11E,$132,$113,$115,$116 for blocks $09-$10 (page 1)
$00:C0BA              .db $2B,$2C,$12,$68,$69,$32,$5E ; Map16 tiles $12B,$12C,$112,$168,$169,$132,$15E for blocks $11-$17 (page 1)

$00:C0C1 20 0D C0     JSR.W $C00D                     ; Mark the block in the generated-tile bitmap ($19F8) ($C00D)
$00:C0C4 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$00:C0C6 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:C0C8 29 F0 01     AND.W #$01F0                    ; |
$00:C0CB 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$00:C0CD A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$00:C0CF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C0D0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C0D1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C0D2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:C0D3 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; } $04 = (BlockY & $1F0) | ((BlockX >> 4) & $0F): block offset in the Map16 page
$00:C0D6 05 04        ORA $04                         ; /
$00:C0D8 A8           TAY                             ; Y = offset of the block in the Map16 tables
$00:C0D9 A5 9C        LDA RAM_BlockBlock              ; \
$00:C0DB 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:C0DC E9 09 00     SBC.W #$0009                    ; |
$00:C0DF 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; } X = [$9C] - 9: index into TileToGeneratePg1
$00:C0E2 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:C0E3 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:C0E5 B7 6E        LDA [$6E],Y                     ; \
$00:C0E7 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; } Set bit 0 of the Map16 high byte: tile is in page 1 ($100-$1FF)
$00:C0E9 97 6E        STA [$6E],Y                     ; /
$00:C0EB BF B2 C0 00  LDA.L TileToGeneratePg1,X       ; \
$00:C0EF 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Map16 low byte = TileToGeneratePg1[X]
$00:C0F1 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:C0F3 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; \
$00:C0F6 09 00 01     ORA.W #$0100                    ; |
$00:C0F9 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = ($100 | tile) * 2: index into the Map16 tile pointer table at $0FBE
$00:C0FA A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:C0FB A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$00:C0FD 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = [$5B] (vertical level flags)
$00:C0FF AD 33 19     LDA.W $1933                     ; /
$00:C102 F0 02        BEQ $C106                       ; Layer 1 being processed: keep bit 0
$00:C104 46 00        LSR $00                         ; Layer 2 ([$1933] != 0): use bit 1 (layer 2 vertical flag)
$00:C106 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; A = vertical-level flag of the current layer
$00:C108 29 01 00     AND.W #$0001                    ; Keep only bit 0
$00:C10B D0 1A        BNE $C127                       ; Vertical level: go to the vertical range check ($00C127)
$00:C10D A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$00:C10F 29 F0 FF     AND.W #$FFF0                    ; / A = [$08] & $FFF0: left edge of the view minus $80, 16-pixel aligned
$00:C112 30 06        BMI $C11A                       ; Negative: skip the first compare
$00:C114 C5 0C        CMP $0C                         ; Compare with [$0C] (block X position, set by the caller)
$00:C116 F0 26        BEQ $C13E                       ; Equal: block is at the left edge, draw it
$00:C118 B0 0A        BCS $C124                       ; Left edge > block: block is left of the view, skip
$00:C11A 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:C11B 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; / A += $200: right edge of the area that gets drawn
$00:C11E C5 0C        CMP $0C                         ; Compare with [$0C]
$00:C120 F0 02        BEQ $C124                       ; Equal: just past the right edge, skip
$00:C122 B0 1A        BCS $C13E                       ; Block inside the window: build the VRAM update
$00:C124 4C AB C1     JMP.W $C1AB                     ; Off screen: return without a VRAM update

$00:C127 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$00:C129 29 F0 FF     AND.W #$FFF0                    ; / Same range check for vertical levels: A = [$0A] & $FFF0
$00:C12C 30 06        BMI $C134                       ; Negative: skip the first compare
$00:C12E C5 0E        CMP $0E                         ; Compare with [$0E] (block Y position, set by the caller)
$00:C130 F0 0C        BEQ $C13E                       ; Equal: draw it
$00:C132 B0 77        BCS $C1AB                       ; View edge > block: skip
$00:C134 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:C135 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; / A += $200
$00:C138 C5 0E        CMP $0E                         ; Compare with [$0E]
$00:C13A F0 6F        BEQ $C1AB                       ; Equal: skip
$00:C13C 90 6D        BCC $C1AB                       ; A < [$0E]: skip; otherwise fall into the VRAM update
$00:C13E AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$00:C142 AA           TAX                             ; / X = write index into the stripe image buffer at $7F:837D
$00:C143 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:C145 A5 06        LDA $06                         ; \
$00:C147 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; } Records 1 and 2: VRAM address high = [$06]
$00:C14B 9F 85 83 7F  STA.L $7F8385,X                 ; /
$00:C14F A5 07        LDA $07                         ; \
$00:C151 9F 7E 83 7F  STA.L $7F837E,X                 ; |
$00:C155 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:C156 69 20        ADC.B #$20                      ; } Record address low: [$07] for record 1, [$07] + $20 (next tile row) for record 2
$00:C158 9F 86 83 7F  STA.L $7F8386,X                 ; /
$00:C15C A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:C15E 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; } Records 1 and 2: flags = 0 (horizontal, no RLE)
$00:C162 9F 87 83 7F  STA.L $7F8387,X                 ; /
$00:C166 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:C168 9F 80 83 7F  STA.L $7F8380,X                 ; } Records 1 and 2: length $03 = 4 bytes (2 tiles) each
$00:C16C 9F 88 83 7F  STA.L $7F8388,X                 ; /
$00:C170 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:C172 9F 8D 83 7F  STA.L $7F838D,X                 ; / End marker $FF after the second record
$00:C176 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; A = $0D: bank of the Map16 tile data
$00:C178 85 06        STA $06                         ; [$06] = $0D (VRAM address in [$06] is no longer needed)
$00:C17A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:C17C B9 BE 0F     LDA.W $0FBE,Y                   ; \
$00:C17F 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = pointer to the tile's 8 bytes of tile words (table at $0FBE)
$00:C181 A0 00 00     LDY.W #$0000                    ; Y = 0
$00:C184 B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; \
$00:C186 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; / Record 1, first tile = word 0
$00:C18A C8           INY                             ; \
$00:C18B C8           INY                             ; |
$00:C18C B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; } Record 2, first tile = word 1
$00:C18E 9F 89 83 7F  STA.L $7F8389,X                 ; /
$00:C192 C8           INY                             ; \
$00:C193 C8           INY                             ; |
$00:C194 B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; } Record 1, second tile = word 2
$00:C196 9F 83 83 7F  STA.L $7F8383,X                 ; /
$00:C19A C8           INY                             ; \
$00:C19B C8           INY                             ; |
$00:C19C B7 04        LDA [$04],Y                     ; } Record 2, second tile = word 3
$00:C19E 9F 8B 83 7F  STA.L $7F838B,X                 ; /
$00:C1A2 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:C1A3 18           CLC                             ; |

$00:C3CC 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; /

$00:C3D1 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 16-bit

$00:C3D5 29 F0 01     AND.W #$01F0                    ; |
$00:C3D8 85 04        STA $04                         ; |

$00:C3E3 05 04        ORA $04                         ; /

$00:C3EB E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit

$00:C3F1 C8           INY                             ; Y + 1: block to the right
$00:C3F2 A9 25        LDA.B #$25                      ; \

;;; $C470..C478: Tables: keyhole window animation ;;;
;; Per keyhole phase [$1435]: target circle size ($90/$00), size step per frame (+4/-4) and WOBJSEL value
;;     ($30/$33).
$00:C470              .db $90,$00,$90,$00             ; Keyhole circle target size by phase [$1435]: $90, $00, $90, $00

$00:C474              .db $04,$FC,$04,$FC             ; Keyhole circle size step per frame by phase: +4, -4, +4, -4

$00:C478              .db $30,$33,$33,$30,$01,$00     ; Keyhole WOBJSEL value by phase ($30/$33); last 2 bytes ($01,$00) probably unused


;;; $C47E: Per-frame Mario state: keyhole, timers, animation ;;;
;; Called every frame from the Mario/sprite interaction code. Runs the keyhole closing animation (circle HDMA
;;     window around the keyhole,
;; freezes Mario and sprites, secret exit when done), counts down the timers $1496-$14A8 each frame and
;;     $14A9-$14AE every 4th frame,
;; switches music for the bonus game and the P-switch timers, then runs the current Mario animation ([$71]).
;;     Select drops the item box item.
;; $00C593: runs the Mario animation routine from AnimationSeqPtr.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9551: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:A2DF: Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode)
$00:C47E 64 78        STZ $78                         ; [$78] = 0
$00:C480 AD CB 13     LDA.W $13CB                     ; A = [$13CB] (bit 7 = give Mario a star)
$00:C483 10 07        BPL $C48C                       ; Bit 7 clear: skip
$00:C485 22 80 C5 01  JSL.L $C580                     ; Unreachable: start star power ($C580)
$00:C489 9C CB 13     STZ.W $13CB                     ; Clear [$13CB]
$00:C48C AC 34 14     LDY.W $1434                     ; \
$00:C48F F0 29        BEQ $C4BA                       ; / Y = [$1434] (keyhole animation active); if 0 skip the keyhole code
$00:C491 8C FB 13     STY.W $13FB                     ; [$13FB] = Y: freeze Mario while the keyhole animation runs
$00:C494 84 9D        STY RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites too
$00:C496 AE 35 14     LDX.W $1435                     ; X = [$1435] (keyhole animation phase)
$00:C499 AD 33 14     LDA.W $1433                     ; A = [$1433] (keyhole circle size)
$00:C49C DD 70 C4     CMP.W $C470,X                   ; Reached the target size for this phase?
$00:C49F D0 1B        BNE $C4BC                       ; No: step the size ($00C4BC)
$00:C4A1 88           DEY                             ; Y - 1
$00:C4A2 D0 13        BNE $C4B7                       ; Y still non-zero: store it and go on
$00:C4A4 EE 35 14     INC.W $1435                     ; Next phase: [$1435]++
$00:C4A7 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:C4A8 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = bit 0 of the old phase
$00:C4A9 90 4D        BCC $C4F8                       ; Even phase: continue at $00C4F8
$00:C4AB 20 EC FC     JSR.W $FCEC                     ; Odd phase (animation done): clear all 12 sprite slots ($FCEC)
$00:C4AE A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:C4B0 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; } Exit the level with exit type 2 (secret exit), Y = $0B ($C9FE)
$00:C4B2 20 FE C9     JSR.W $C9FE                     ; /
$00:C4B5 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: keyhole animation finished
$00:C4B7 8C 34 14     STY.W $1434                     ; Store Y in [$1434]
$00:C4BA 80 3C        BRA $C4F8                       ; Continue at $00C4F8

$00:C4BC 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:C4BD 7D 74 C4     ADC.W $C474,X                   ; } [$1433] += $C474[X]: grow or shrink the circle
$00:C4C0 8D 33 14     STA.W $1433                     ; /
$00:C4C3 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$00:C4C5 85 41        STA $41                         ; / [$41] = $22: window mask BG1/BG2
$00:C4C7 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:C4C9 85 42        STA $42                         ; / [$42] = $02: window mask BG3/BG4
$00:C4CB BD 78 C4     LDA.W $C478,X                   ; \
$00:C4CE 85 43        STA $43                         ; / [$43] = $C478[X]: window mask OBJ/color
$00:C4D0 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$00:C4D2 85 44        STA $44                         ; / [$44] = $12: color window control
$00:C4D4 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:C4D6 A9 93 CB     LDA.W #$CB93                    ; \
$00:C4D9 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = $CB93: address of the circle window shape data
$00:C4DB 64 06        STZ $06                         ; [$06] = 0 (bank)
$00:C4DD E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:C4DF AD 36 14     LDA.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; \
$00:C4E2 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:C4E3 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$00:C4E5 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:C4E6 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } [$00] = keyhole X - screen X + 4 (on-screen circle center X)
$00:C4E8 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:C4EA AD 38 14     LDA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; \
$00:C4ED 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:C4EE E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$00:C4F0 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:C4F1 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } [$01] = keyhole Y - screen Y + $10 (on-screen circle center Y)
$00:C4F3 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$00:C4F5 20 88 CA     JSR.W $CA88                     ; Build the circle window HDMA table ($CA88)
$00:C4F8 AD FB 13     LDA.W $13FB                     ; A = [$13FB] (Mario frozen)
$00:C4FB F0 03        BEQ $C500                       ; Not frozen: go on
$00:C4FD 4C 8F C5     JMP.W $C58F                     ; Frozen: skip the timers, finish at $00C58F

$00:C500 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$00:C502 D0 65        BNE $C569                       ; / Sprites locked: skip the timers ($00C569)
$00:C504 E6 14        INC RAM_FrameCounterB           ; Count a frame: [$14]++
$00:C506 A2 13        LDX.B #$13                      ; X = $13
$00:C508 BD 95 14     LDA.W $1495,X                   ; \
$00:C50B F0 03        BEQ $C510                       ; } Decrement [$1496]..[$14A8] if non-zero (every unlocked frame)
$00:C50D DE 95 14     DEC.W $1495,X                   ; /
$00:C510 CA           DEX                             ; Next timer
$00:C511 D0 F5        BNE $C508                       ; Loop
$00:C513 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$00:C515 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Rest runs only every 4th frame ([$14] & 3 = 0)
$00:C517 D0 50        BNE $C569                       ; /
$00:C519 AD 25 14     LDA.W $1425                     ; \
$00:C51C F0 15        BEQ $C533                       ; / [$1425] = 0: skip the next block (probably not the bonus game)
$00:C51E AD AB 14     LDA.W $14AB                     ; A = [$14AB] (probably the bonus game timer)
$00:C521 C9 44        CMP.B #$44                      ; $44?
$00:C523 D0 05        BNE $C52A                       ; No: check for 1
$00:C525 A0 14        LDY.B #$14                      ; Y = $14
$00:C527 8C FB 1D     STY.W $1DFB                     ; Change music to $14
$00:C52A C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Reached 1?
$00:C52C D0 05        BNE $C533                       ; No
$00:C52E A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B
$00:C530 8C 00 01     STY.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode = $0B (bonus game over: fade to overworld)
$00:C533 AC AD 14     LDY.W RAM_BluePowTimer          ; \
$00:C536 CC AE 14     CPY.W RAM_SilverPowTimer        ; |
$00:C539 B0 03        BCS $C53E                       ; } Y = max([$14AD] blue P-switch timer, [$14AE] silver P-switch timer)
$00:C53B AC AE 14     LDY.W RAM_SilverPowTimer        ; /
$00:C53E AD DA 0D     LDA.W $0DDA                     ; A = [$0DDA] (level music to resume)
$00:C541 30 0C        BMI $C54F                       ; Bit 7 set: no music restore
$00:C543 C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; P-switch timer at 1 (about to end)?
$00:C545 D0 08        BNE $C54F                       ; No
$00:C547 AC 0C 19     LDY.W $190C                     ; Y = [$190C]
$00:C54A D0 03        BNE $C54F                       ; Non-zero: skip
$00:C54C 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; Resume the level music: [$1DFB] = [$0DDA]
$00:C54F C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; [$0DDA] = $FF?
$00:C551 F0 09        BEQ $C55C                       ; Yes: skip the warning sound
$00:C553 C0 1E        CPY.B #$1E                      ; P-switch timer = $1E (about to run out)?
$00:C555 D0 05        BNE $C55C                       ; No
$00:C557 A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$00:C559 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $24 (running-out warning)
$00:C55C A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; X = 6
$00:C55E BD A8 14     LDA.W $14A8,X                   ; \
$00:C561 F0 03        BEQ $C566                       ; } Decrement [$14A9]..[$14AE] (X = 6..1) if non-zero, every 4th frame
$00:C563 DE A8 14     DEC.W $14A8,X                   ; /
$00:C566 CA           DEX                             ; Next timer
$00:C567 D0 F5        BNE $C55E                       ; Loop (includes both P-switch timers)
$00:C569 20 93 C5     JSR.W $C593                     ; Run the current Mario animation ($C593)
$00:C56C A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$00:C56E 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Select newly pressed? If not, skip to $00C58F
$00:C570 F0 1D        BEQ $C58F                       ; /
$00:C572 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:C574 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; / A = Up held bit of [$15]
$00:C576 80 0D        BRA $C585                       ; Always taken (patch to BEQ to reach the debug code)

$00:C578 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:C57A 1A           INC A                           ; / Unreachable debug: power-up + 1
$00:C57B C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$00:C57D 90 02        BCC $C581                       ; / Wrap after 3 (flower)
$00:C57F A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Power-up = 0
$00:C581 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Store Mario's power-up
$00:C583 80 0A        BRA $C58F                       ; Continue at $00C58F

$00:C585 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$00:C586 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:C588 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $02
$00:C589 AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:C58A 22 08 80 02  JSL.L $8008                     ; Select pressed: item box action ($8008, probably drops the reserve item)
$00:C58E AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:C58F 9C 02 14     STZ.W $1402                     ; [$1402] = 0
$00:C592 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:C593 A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; A = [$71]: Mario animation number
$00:C595 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Run the animation routine from AnimationSeqPtr


;;; $C599: Pointer table: Mario animation routines (AnimationSeqPtr) ;;;
;; Indexed by [$71] (Mario animation number), used with ExecutePtr.
$00:C599 68 CC        .dw ResetAni                    ; 0 - Reset: normal control
$00:C59B 29 D1        .dw PowerDownAni                ; 1 - Power down (hit while big)
$00:C59D 47 D1        .dw MushroomAni                 ; 2 - Mushroom power up
$00:C59F 5F D1        .dw CapeAni                     ; 3 - Cape power up
$00:C5A1 6F D1        .dw FlowerAni                   ; 4 - Fire flower power up
$00:C5A3 97 D1        .dw DoorPipeAni                 ; 5 - Exit door or horizontal pipe
$00:C5A5 03 D2        .dw VertPipeAni                 ; 6 - Exit vertical pipe
$00:C5A7 87 D2        .dw PipeCannonAni               ; 7 - Shot out of diagonal pipe
$00:C5A9 FD C7        .dw YoshiWingsAni               ; 8 - Yoshi wings exit
$00:C5AB B6 D0        .dw MarioDeathAni               ; 9 - Death
$00:C5AD 70 C8        .dw EnterCastleAni              ; A - Enter castle
$00:C5AF B5 C5        .dw UnknownAniB                 ; B - Freeze with message box
$00:C5B1 E7 C6        .dw UnknownAniC                 ; C - Scripted cutscene movement
$00:C5B3 92 C5        .dw $C592                       ; D - Freeze forever (just returns)


;;; $C5B5: Mario animation B: freeze with message box (UnknownAniB) ;;;
;; Clears [$13DE]/[$13ED]. If the end-of-level timer is set outside a level, leaves the level; otherwise shows
;;     an expanding message box
;; ([$1B88] = 1), clears the controls and runs Mario's physics.
$00:C5B5 9C DE 13     STZ.W $13DE                     ; \
$00:C5B8 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; / Clear [$13DE] and [$13ED] (Mario state flags)
$00:C5BB AD 93 14     LDA.W $1493                     ; \
$00:C5BE F0 0E        BEQ $C5CE                       ; / End-of-level timer [$1493] = 0: skip to $00C5CE
$00:C5C0 22 13 AB 0C  JSL.L $AB13                     ; Run the end-of-level routine in bank $0C ($AB13)
$00:C5C4 AD 00 01     LDA.W RAM_GameMode              ; \
$00:C5C7 C9 14        CMP.B #$14                      ; } In a level (game mode $14): go to the message box code
$00:C5C9 F0 06        BEQ $C5D1                       ; /
$00:C5CB 4C 5B C9     JMP.W $C95B                     ; Elsewhere: leave the level, normal exit ($C95B)

$00:C5CE 9C 9F 0D     STZ.W $0D9F                     ; Turn off HDMA
$00:C5D1 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:C5D3 8D 88 1B     STA.W $1B88                     ; / [$1B88] = 1: message box is expanding
$00:C5D6 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$00:C5D8 8D 28 19     STA.W $1928                     ; / [$1928] = 7
$00:C5DB 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Clear the controller mirrors (NoButtons)
$00:C5DE 4C 24 CD     JMP.W $CD24                     ; Run Mario's movement and physics ($CD24)



;;; $C5E1..C6D9: Data: cutscene poses and Mario movement scripts ;;;
;; $00C5E1: Mario pose numbers. $00C5E8 on: scripts for UnknownAniC, one per cutscene [$13C6] = 1-7, each a
;;     list of (command, frames) pairs ending
;; in command $FF. A command without bit 5 is a controller byte; with bit 5 it is a special action. Bit 4 also
;;     runs a bank $0C helper.
$00:C5E1              .db $10,$30,$31,$32,$33,$34,$0E ; Mario pose numbers for script commands $27-$2D: $10,$30-$34,$0E (index = low nibble - 7)

$00:C629              .db $0A,$00,$40,$82,$10,$02,$20,$00 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs

$00:C649              .db $20,$01,$58,$00,$2C,$31,$01,$3A ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C651              .db $10,$31,$01,$3A,$10,$31,$01,$3A ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C659              .db $20,$28,$A0,$28,$40,$29,$04,$28 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs

$00:C669              .db $40,$22,$01,$FF,$01,$02,$48,$00 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; cutscene 4 script starts at $C66E; $FF at $C66C ends a script
$00:C671              .db $60,$01,$09,$80,$08,$00,$20,$04 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C679              .db $60,$10,$20,$31,$01,$18,$60,$31 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C681              .db $01,$3B,$80,$31,$01,$3C,$40,$FF ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; $FF at $C688 ends a script
$00:C689              .db $01,$02,$48,$00,$60,$02,$30,$01 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; cutscene 3 script starts at $C68A
$00:C691              .db $84,$00,$20,$23,$01,$01,$16,$02 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C699              .db $20,$20,$01,$01,$20,$02,$20,$01 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C6A1              .db $02,$00,$80,$FF,$01,$02,$48,$00 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; cutscene 6 script starts at $C6A6; $FF at $C6A4 ends a script
$00:C6A9              .db $60,$02,$28,$01,$83,$00,$28,$24 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C6B1              .db $01,$02,$01,$00,$FF,$00,$40,$20 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C6B9              .db $01,$00,$40,$02,$60,$00,$30,$FF ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; $FF at $C6C0 ends a script
$00:C6C1              .db $01,$02,$48,$00,$60,$01,$4E,$00 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; cutscene 7 script starts at $C6C2
$00:C6C9              .db $40,$26,$01,$00,$1E,$20,$01,$00 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C6D1              .db $20,$08,$10,$20,$01,$2D,$18,$00 ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs
$00:C6D9              .db $A0,$20,$01,$2E,$01,$FF     ; Cutscene scripts: (command, frames) pairs; $FF at $C6DE ends a script


;;; $C6DF..C6DF: Table: cutscene script offsets ;;;
;; Offset added to [$8F] to find the script of cutscene [$13C6] (cutscenes 1-7 use entries 1-7).
$00:C6DF              .db $01,$00,$10,$A0,$84,$50,$BC,$D8 ; Script start offset by cutscene [$13C6] (0-7)


;;; $C6E7: Mario animation C: scripted cutscene movement (UnknownAniC) ;;;
;; Plays a script from the table at $00C5E8 for cutscene [$13C6]: held buttons or special actions per command.
;;     Also lands Mario at Y = $58 and
;; makes scripted hops. Purpose partly unclear (probably the post-castle cutscenes).
$00:C6E7 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; No buttons allowed (NoButtons)
$00:C6EA 9C DE 13     STZ.W $13DE                     ; Clear [$13DE]
$00:C6ED 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Process Mario's Y speed ($DC2D)
$00:C6F0 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:C6F2 30 4B        BMI $C73F                       ; / Moving upward: skip the landing and hop checks
$00:C6F4 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:C6F6 C9 58        CMP.B #$58                      ; } Mario Y >= $58 (scene ground level): land at $00C739
$00:C6F8 B0 3F        BCS $C739                       ; /
$00:C6FA A4 94        LDY RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:C6FC C0 40        CPY.B #$40                      ; } Mario X < $40: skip
$00:C6FE 90 3F        BCC $C73F                       ; /
$00:C700 C0 60        CPY.B #$60                      ; \
$00:C702 90 18        BCC $C71C                       ; / X $40-$5F: scripted hop at $00C71C
$00:C704 A4 1C        LDY RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$00:C706 F0 37        BEQ $C73F                       ; / X >= $60: skip if the layer is not scrolled ([$1C] = 0)
$00:C708 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:C709 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$00:C70B C9 1C        CMP.B #$1C                      ; } Skip if Mario Y + [$1C] < $1C
$00:C70D 30 30        BMI $C73F                       ; /
$00:C70F 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:C710 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } A = Mario Y; Y speed = $D0 (-$30)
$00:C712 A2 D0        LDX.B #$D0                      ; /
$00:C714 A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$00:C716 F0 18        BEQ $C730                       ; / Facing left: keep X speed
$00:C718 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; \
$00:C71A 80 12        BRA $C72E                       ; / Facing right: X speed = 0

$00:C71C C9 4C        CMP.B #$4C                      ; \
$00:C71E 90 1F        BCC $C73F                       ; / Mario Y < $4C: skip
$00:C720 A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; \
$00:C722 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $1B
$00:C725 EE 3E 14     INC.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Next cutscene step: [$143E]++
$00:C728 A9 4C        LDA.B #$4C                      ; \
$00:C72A A0 F4        LDY.B #$F4                      ; } Hop: Y pos $4C, X speed $F4 (-$0C), Y speed $C0 (-$40)
$00:C72C A2 C0        LDX.B #$C0                      ; /
$00:C72E 84 7B        STY RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = Y
$00:C730 86 7D        STX RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = X
$00:C732 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; \
$00:C734 8E F9 1D     STX.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 1
$00:C737 80 04        BRA $C73D                       ; Continue at $00C73D

$00:C739 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Not flying
$00:C73B A9 58        LDA.B #$58                      ; A = $58
$00:C73D 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Mario Y = A (snap to the ground)
$00:C73F AE C6 13     LDX.W $13C6                     ; X = [$13C6] (cutscene number)
$00:C742 A5 8F        LDA $8F                         ; \
$00:C744 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:C745 7D DF C6     ADC.W $C6DF,X                   ; } X = script position [$8F] + start offset for this cutscene
$00:C748 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:C749 A5 88        LDA $88                         ; A = [$88]: frames left for the current command
$00:C74B D0 17        BNE $C764                       ; Not expired: keep running the current command
$00:C74D E6 8F        INC $8F                         ; \
$00:C74F E6 8F        INC $8F                         ; / Script position += 2
$00:C751 E8           INX                             ; X += 2
$00:C752 E8           INX                             ; Next pair
$00:C753 BD E9 C5     LDA.W $C5E9,X                   ; \
$00:C756 85 88        STA $88                         ; / [$88] = duration of the next command
$00:C758 BD E8 C5     LDA.W $C5E8,X                   ; \
$00:C75B C9 2D        CMP.B #$2D                      ; / Command $2D?
$00:C75D D0 05        BNE $C764                       ; No
$00:C75F A9 1E        LDA.B #$1E                      ; \
$00:C761 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $1E
$00:C764 BD E8 C5     LDA.W $C5E8,X                   ; \
$00:C767 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; / A = command; $FF = end of script
$00:C769 D0 03        BNE $C76E                       ; Not the end: run it
$00:C76B 4C F8 C7     JMP.W $C7F8                     ; End of script: return

$00:C76E 48           PHA                             ; Save the command
$00:C76F 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; \
$00:C771 F0 04        BEQ $C777                       ; / Bit 4 clear: skip
$00:C773 22 A4 D4 0C  JSL.L $D4A4                     ; Bit 4 set: run a cutscene helper in bank $0C ($D4A4)
$00:C777 68           PLA                             ; Restore the command
$00:C778 A8           TAY                             ; Y = command
$00:C779 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; \
$00:C77B D0 0C        BNE $C789                       ; / Bit 5 set: special command ($00C789)
$00:C77D 84 15        STY RAM_ControllerA             ; Held buttons [$15] = command byte
$00:C77F 98           TYA                             ; A = command
$00:C780 29 BF        AND.B #$BF                      ; \
$00:C782 85 16        STA $16                         ; / Newly pressed buttons [$16] = command without bit 6 (Y button)
$00:C784 20 39 CD     JSR.W $CD39                     ; Run Mario's movement with these inputs ($CD39)
$00:C787 80 6D        BRA $C7F6                       ; Continue at $00C7F6

$00:C789 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:C78A 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Low nibble of the command >= 7: set a Mario pose ($00C7E9)
$00:C78C C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; /
$00:C78E B0 59        BCS $C7E9                       ; Pose command
$00:C790 3A           DEC A                           ; Nibble - 1
$00:C791 10 0F        BPL $C7A2                       ; Nibble >= 1: next test
$00:C793 AD 98 14     LDA.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; Command $20: [$1498] (pick-up image timer) set?
$00:C796 F0 05        BEQ $C79D                       ; No
$00:C798 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:C79A 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect 9
$00:C79D EE 3E 14     INC.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Next cutscene step: [$143E]++
$00:C7A0 80 54        BRA $C7F6                       ; Done

$00:C7A2 D0 05        BNE $C7A9                       ; Nibble 1?
$00:C7A4 EE 45 14     INC.W $1445                     ; Command $21: [$1445]++
$00:C7A7 80 4D        BRA $C7F6                       ; Done

$00:C7A9 3A           DEC A                           ; Nibble 2?
$00:C7AA D0 0A        BNE $C7B6                       ; No
$00:C7AC A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; \
$00:C7AE 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Command $22: play sound effect $0E
$00:C7B1 EE 46 14     INC.W $1446                     ; [$1446]++
$00:C7B4 80 40        BRA $C7F6                       ; Done

$00:C7B6 3A           DEC A                           ; Nibble 3?
$00:C7B7 D0 07        BNE $C7C0                       ; No
$00:C7B9 A0 88        LDY.B #$88                      ; Command $23: Y = $88
$00:C7BB 8C 45 14     STY.W $1445                     ; [$1445] = $88
$00:C7BE 80 36        BRA $C7F6                       ; Done

$00:C7C0 3A           DEC A                           ; Nibble 4?
$00:C7C1 D0 0B        BNE $C7CE                       ; No
$00:C7C3 A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; \
$00:C7C5 8D 46 14     STA.W $1446                     ; / Command $24: [$1446] = $38
$00:C7C8 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$00:C7CA 14 94        TRB RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Round Mario's X position down to a multiple of 8
$00:C7CC 80 28        BRA $C7F6                       ; Done

$00:C7CE 3A           DEC A                           ; Nibble 5?
$00:C7CF D0 0E        BNE $C7DF                       ; No
$00:C7D1 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:C7D3 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Command $25: play sound effect 9 on port $1DFC
$00:C7D6 A9 D8        LDA.B #$D8                      ; \
$00:C7D8 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = $D8
$00:C7DA EE 3E 14     INC.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; Next cutscene step: [$143E]++
$00:C7DD 80 BE        BRA $C79D                       ; Then the same increment again ($00C79D)

$00:C7DF A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$00:C7E1 8D 98 14     STA.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; / Command $26: [$1498] (pick-up image timer) = $20
$00:C7E4 EE 8F 14     INC.W $148F                     ; [$148F]++
$00:C7E7 80 0D        BRA $C7F6                       ; Done

$00:C7E9 A8           TAY                             ; Y = nibble (>= 7)
$00:C7EA B9 DA C5     LDA.W ADDR_00C5DA,Y             ; \
$00:C7ED 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / Mario pose [$13E0] = table at $00C5E1[nibble - 7]
$00:C7F0 9C 8F 14     STZ.W $148F                     ; [$148F] = 0
$00:C7F3 20 E4 D7     JSR.W $D7E4                     ; Update Mario's flying/cape state ($D7E4)
$00:C7F6 C6 88        DEC $88                         ; Frames left for this command - 1
$00:C7F8 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $C7F9..C7F9: Table: Yoshi wings exit thresholds ;;;
$00:C7F9              .db $C0,$FF,$A0,$00             ; Yoshi wings exit: Mario Y thresholds as signed words: -$40 (leaving), $A0 (returning)


;;; $C7FD: Mario animation 8: Yoshi wings exit (YoshiWingsAni) ;;;
;; Mario flies up (Y speed -$0D per frame up to -$70) while X speed decays to 0. When he passes the threshold
;;     in $C7F9[[$1B95]] the
;; level reloads (phase 0, sets [$1B95] = 2) or normal control resumes (phase 2).
$00:C7FD 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; No buttons allowed (NoButtons)
$00:C800 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:C802 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / Flying state [$72] = $0B
$00:C804 20 E4 D7     JSR.W $D7E4                     ; Update Mario's flying/cape state ($D7E4)
$00:C807 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:C809 10 04        BPL $C80F                       ; / Y speed >= 0: accelerate upward
$00:C80B C9 90        CMP.B #$90                      ; \
$00:C80D 90 05        BCC $C814                       ; / Y speed already past -$70: skip
$00:C80F 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:C810 E9 0D        SBC.B #$0D                      ; } Y speed -= $0D (fly up)
$00:C812 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; /
$00:C814 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$00:C816 A4 7B        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:C818 F0 0D        BEQ $C827                       ; / No X speed: skip
$00:C81A 30 02        BMI $C81E                       ; Moving left: add 2
$00:C81C A9 FE        LDA.B #$FE                      ; Moving right: add -2
$00:C81E 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:C81F 65 7B        ADC RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; } X speed += A: decay toward 0
$00:C821 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; /
$00:C823 50 02        BVC $C827                       ; No overflow: ok
$00:C825 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Unreachable: X speed = 0
$00:C827 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Process Mario's Y speed ($DC2D)
$00:C82A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:C82C AC 95 1B     LDY.W $1B95                     ; Y = [$1B95] (phase: 0 = going out, 2 = coming back)
$00:C82F A5 80        LDA $80                         ; A = [$80] (Mario Y relative to the screen)
$00:C831 D9 F9 C7     CMP.W $C7F9,Y                   ; Compare with the phase threshold (signed)
$00:C834 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:C836 10 0D        BPL Instr00C845                 ; Above the threshold: keep flying
$00:C838 64 71        STZ RAM_MarioAnimation          ; Mario animation = 0 (normal control)
$00:C83A 98           TYA                             ; A = phase
$00:C83B D0 08        BNE Instr00C845                 ; Coming back: done ($00C845)
$00:C83D C8           INY                             ; \
$00:C83E C8           INY                             ; } Phase = 2 for the return trip
$00:C83F 8C 95 1B     STY.W $1B95                     ; /
$00:C842 20 73 D2     JSR.W $D273                     ; Load the next level ($D273)


;;; $C845: Jump stub and demo input script (Instr00C845) ;;;
;; $00C845: JMP to the Yoshi check at the end of Mario physics ($CD8F).
;; $C848: input script for EnterCastleAni, pairs of (controller byte, frame count), $FF ends it. Bit 6
;;     of a byte has a special meaning (see code).
$00:C845              .db $4C,$8F,$CD                 ; Jump to the Yoshi check at the end of Mario's physics ($CD8F)

$00:C848              .db $01,$5F,$00,$30,$08,$30,$00,$20 ; Demo input script, pairs: controller byte, frames (01 = right, 08 = up, 40 = Y/run)
$00:C850              .db $40,$01,$00,$30,$01,$80,$FF,$01 ; (demo input script continues)
$00:C858              .db $3F,$00,$30,$20,$01,$80,$06,$00 ; (demo input script continues)
$00:C860              .db $3A,$01,$38,$00,$30,$08,$30,$00 ; (demo input script continues)
$00:C868              .db $20,$40,$01,$00,$30,$01,$80,$FF ; (demo input script continues)


;;; $C870: Mario animation A: scripted walk, level end (EnterCastleAni) ;;;
;; Mario animation $0A (Enter Castle): Mario plays back the controller script at $C848 and the normal
