;;     physics run on it; any new button press, or $FF in the script, ends it and sets the next game mode.
;; $00C915: level end handler for the end-of-level timer [$1493] (goal, switch palace, cutscene triggers),
;;     jumped to from ResetAni.
;; Phase 1 walks Mario right while the timer runs, then starts the iris-out; phase 2 ($C9AF) shows the
;;     peace pose, closes the iris and selects the next game mode and [$0DD5] exit type.
$00:C870 9C E2 13     STZ.W $13E2                     ; [$13E2] = 0
$00:C873 AE 31 19     LDX.W $1931                     ; \
$00:C876 3C 25 A6     BIT.W $A625,X                   ; |
$00:C879 30 0E        BMI $C889                       ; |
$00:C87B 70 06        BVS $C883                       ; } Look up flags for tileset [$1931] in $A625: bit 7 set = third routine, bit 6 set = second, else first
$00:C87D 22 7C F5 02  JSL.L $F57C                     ; \
$00:C881 80 0A        BRA $C88D                       ; / Default tileset: call $F57C (probably tileset-specific GFX/music setup), then continue

$00:C883 22 8C F5 02  JSL.L $F58C                     ; \
$00:C887 80 04        BRA $C88D                       ; / Bit 6 tileset: call $F58C, then continue

$00:C889 22 84 F5 02  JSL.L $F584                     ; Bit 7 tileset: call $F584
$00:C88D A6 88        LDX $88                         ; X = [$88]: current offset into the input script
$00:C88F A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$00:C891 05 18        ORA $18                         ; } A = [$16] | [$18] (newly pressed buttons)
$00:C893 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; / Clear the controller mirrors (NoButtons); N set if any new button press: skip the script
$00:C896 30 63        BMI $C8FB                       ; Any new press: end the animation ($C8FB)
$00:C898 9C DE 13     STZ.W $13DE                     ; [$13DE] = 0
$00:C89B C6 89        DEC $89                         ; Frames remaining in this script step: [$89]--
$00:C89D D0 09        BNE $C8A8                       ; Still counting: keep the current step
$00:C89F E8           INX                             ; \
$00:C8A0 E8           INX                             ; |
$00:C8A1 86 88        STX $88                         ; } Next script step: [$88] += 2
$00:C8A3 BD 47 C8     LDA.W ADDR_00C847,X             ; \
$00:C8A6 85 89        STA $89                         ; / [$89] = frame count of the new step
$00:C8A8 BD 46 C8     LDA.W ADDR_00C846,X             ; A = controller byte of the current step
$00:C8AB C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:C8AD F0 4C        BEQ $C8FB                       ; / $FF = end of script: end the animation
$00:C8AF 29 DF        AND.B #$DF                      ; \
$00:C8B1 85 15        STA RAM_ControllerA             ; / [$15] = held buttons = byte with bit 5 cleared (bit 5 is not a controller input, used as flag)
$00:C8B3 DD 46 C8     CMP.W ADDR_00C846,X             ; \
$00:C8B6 F0 04        BEQ $C8BC                       ; / Was bit 5 set in the script byte? If not, skip the new-press fake
$00:C8B8 A0 80        LDY.B #$80                      ; \
$00:C8BA 84 18        STY $18                         ; / Fake a new A-button press ([$18] = $80), i.e. jump
$00:C8BC 0A           ASL                             ; Script bit 6 into the sign flag
$00:C8BD 10 12        BPL $C8D1                       ; Clear: skip the next block
$00:C8BF 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Bit 6 set: clear the controller mirrors again
$00:C8C2 A0 B0        LDY.B #$B0                      ; Y = $B0
$00:C8C4 AE 31 19     LDX.W $1931                     ; \
$00:C8C7 3C 25 A6     BIT.W $A625,X                   ; |
$00:C8CA 30 02        BMI $C8CE                       ; } Tileset flag bit 7 clear: Y = $7F instead
$00:C8CC A0 7F        LDY.B #$7F                      ; Y = $7F
$00:C8CE 8C D9 18     STY.W $18D9                     ; [$18D9] = Y (purpose unclear)
$00:C8D1 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Apply Mario's speed to his position ($DC2D)
$00:C8D4 A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$00:C8D6 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / Mario is in the air state $24 (pretend jumping) while walking in
$00:C8D8 A9 6F        LDA.B #$6F                      ; A = $6F: ground Y position for Mario
$00:C8DA AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:C8DD F0 02        BEQ $C8E1                       ; } Riding Yoshi?
$00:C8DF A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; Yes: ground Y = $5F (Yoshi is taller)
$00:C8E1 AE 31 19     LDX.W $1931                     ; \
$00:C8E4 3C 25 A6     BIT.W $A625,X                   ; |
$00:C8E7 50 03        BVC $C8EC                       ; } Tileset flag bit 6: ground is $10 higher
$00:C8E9 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:C8EA E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; / Ground Y -= $10
$00:C8EC C5 96        CMP RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:C8EE B0 08        BCS $C8F8                       ; / Mario Y position still above (or on) the ground line: skip landing
$00:C8F0 1A           INC A                           ; \
$00:C8F1 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Land: Mario Y position = ground Y + 1
$00:C8F3 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario is no longer in the air
$00:C8F5 9C 0D 14     STZ.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; Not spin jumping
$00:C8F8 4C 82 CD     JMP.W $CD82                     ; Run the normal Mario physics from $CD82

$00:C8FB EE 1D 14     INC.W $141D                     ; [$141D]++ (probably flags that the walk-in finished)
$00:C8FE A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$00:C900 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Game mode = $0F
$00:C903 E0 11        CPX.B #$11                      ; \
$00:C905 90 03        BCC $C90A                       ; / Script offset [$88] >= $11 (longer path)?
$00:C907 EE C1 0D     INC.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Yes: [$0DC1]++ (RAM_OWHasYoshi)
$00:C90A A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:C90C 8D 9B 1B     STA.W $1B9B                     ; / [$1B9B] = 1
$00:C90F A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:C911 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / Play sound effect 3 on port $1DFA
$00:C914 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:C915 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Clear the controller mirrors: Mario ignores input at level end
$00:C918 9C C2 18     STZ.W $18C2                     ; [$18C2] = 0
$00:C91B 9C DE 13     STZ.W $13DE                     ; [$13DE] = 0
$00:C91E 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; [$13ED] = 0 (no slope sliding)
$00:C921 A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$00:C923 4A           LSR                             ; } Vertical level?
$00:C924 B0 1E        BCS $C944                       ; / Yes: skip to $C944
$00:C926 AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$00:C929 0D D2 13     ORA.W $13D2                     ; } A = [$13C6] | [$13D2] (cutscene number | switch palace flag, probably)
$00:C92C F0 3D        BEQ $C96B                       ; Both zero: goal tape style ending ($C96B)
$00:C92E A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:C930 F0 03        BEQ $C935                       ; } Mario in the air?
$00:C932 20 E0 CC     JSR.W $CCE0                     ; / Yes: run his physics ($CCE0)
$00:C935 AD D2 13     LDA.W $13D2                     ; [$13D2] non-zero (probably switch palace): go to $C948
$00:C938 D0 0E        BNE $C948                       ; Skip the next step
$00:C93A 20 3E B0     JSR.W $B03E                     ; Level end processing ($B03E)
$00:C93D AD 95 14     LDA.W $1495                     ; \
$00:C940 C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; } [$1495] < $40: wait (return)
$00:C942 90 26        BCC $C96A                       ; /
$00:C944 22 FF CB 05  JSL.L $CBFF                     ; Call $CBFF (level end routine in bank 05)
$00:C948 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; \
$00:C94A 84 9D        STY RAM_SpritesLocked           ; / Lock sprites ([$9D] = 1)
$00:C94C A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:C94E 4A           LSR                             ; } Every other frame:
$00:C94F 90 19        BCC $C96A                       ; /
$00:C951 CE 93 14     DEC.W $1493                     ; [$1493]--: level end timer
$00:C954 D0 14        BNE $C96A                       ; Not zero yet: return
$00:C956 AD D2 13     LDA.W $13D2                     ; \
$00:C959 D0 07        BNE $C962                       ; } [$13D2] set?
$00:C95B A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B (game mode)
$00:C95D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: normal exit
$00:C95F 4C FE C9     JMP.W $C9FE                     ; Jump to the exit code at $C9FE

$00:C962 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$00:C964 8D F5 1D     STA.W $1DF5                     ; / [$1DF5] = $A0
$00:C967 EE 26 14     INC.W $1426                     ; [$1426]++ (show the message box)
$00:C96A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:C96B 20 17 AF     JSR.W $AF17                     ; Count down the level end timer, fade out BG3 ($AF17)
$00:C96E AD 99 1B     LDA.W $1B99                     ; \
$00:C971 D0 3C        BNE $C9AF                       ; } [$1B99] non-zero: phase 2 ($C9AF)
$00:C973 AD 93 14     LDA.W $1493                     ; \
$00:C976 C9 28        CMP.B #$28                      ; } Level end timer >= $28: Mario still walks right
$00:C978 90 0A        BCC $C984                       ; /
$00:C97A A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:C97C 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; | Mario faces right
$00:C97E 85 15        STA RAM_ControllerA             ; | Hold right on the controller
$00:C980 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; |
$00:C982 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = 5
$00:C984 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:C986 F0 03        BEQ $C98B                       ; } In the air?
$00:C988 20 6B D7     JSR.W $D76B                     ; / Yes: handle slope/ground speed ($D76B)
$00:C98B A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:C98D D0 15        BNE Instr00C9A4                 ; / Mario still moving: run normal physics (Instr00C9A4)
$00:C98F 9C 11 14     STZ.W $1411                     ; [$1411] = 0 (no horizontal scrolling)
$00:C992 20 3E CA     JSR.W $CA3E                     ; Start the iris-out: [$1433] = $F0 ($CA3E)
$00:C995 EE 99 1B     INC.W $1B99                     ; [$1B99]++: next phase
$00:C998 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$00:C99A 8D 92 14     STA.W $1492                     ; / [$1492] = $40: pause before the end music
$00:C99D 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:C99E 8D 94 14     STA.W $1494                     ; } [$1494] = $80
$00:C9A1 9C 95 14     STZ.W $1495                     ; [$1495] = 0


;;; $C9A4: Jump to Mario physics, cutscene level list (Instr00C9A4) ;;;
;; $00C9A4: JMP to $CD24 (Mario physics). $C9A7: level numbers ([$13BF]) that start cutscenes 1-8
;;     when beaten.
$00:C9A4              .db $4C,$24,$CD                 ; Jump to Mario's physics ($CD24)

$00:C9A7              .db $25,$07,$40,$0E,$20,$1A,$34,$32 ; Level numbers ([$13BF]) that trigger cutscenes 1-8 (read backwards, index = cutscene)

$00:C9AF 20 31 CA     JSR.W SetMarioPeaceImg          ; Phase 2: show Mario's peace pose (SetMarioPeaceImg)
$00:C9B2 AD 92 14     LDA.W $1492                     ; \
$00:C9B5 F0 0B        BEQ $C9C2                       ; } [$1492] pause timer zero?
$00:C9B7 CE 92 14     DEC.W $1492                     ; [$1492]--
$00:C9BA D0 05        BNE $C9C1                       ; Still counting: return
$00:C9BC A9 11        LDA.B #$11                      ; \
$00:C9BE 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Request music $11 (level clear fanfare, probably)
$00:C9C1 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:C9C2 20 44 CA     JSR.W $CA44                     ; Shrink the iris circle by 4 ($CA44)
$00:C9C5 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:C9C7 85 15        STA RAM_ControllerA             ; / Hold right
$00:C9C9 20 24 CD     JSR.W $CD24                     ; Run Mario's physics ($CD24)
$00:C9CC AD 33 14     LDA.W $1433                     ; \
$00:C9CF D0 5F        BNE $CA30                       ; / Iris not fully closed: return
$00:C9D1 AD 1C 14     LDA.W $141C                     ; \
$00:C9D4 1A           INC A                           ; |
$00:C9D5 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$00:C9D7 D0 06        BNE $C9DF                       ; } Branch unless [$141C]+1 = 3 (value 2 never occurs)
$00:C9D9 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \ Unreachable
$00:C9DB 8D 11 1F     STA.W $1F11                     ; | Set the submap to Yoshi's Island
$00:C9DE 4A           LSR                             ; / A = 0
$00:C9DF A0 0C        LDY.B #$0C                      ; Y = $0C (game mode to enter: probably overworld load)
$00:C9E1 AE 25 14     LDX.W $1425                     ; \
$00:C9E4 F0 12        BEQ $C9F8                       ; } [$1425] non-zero?
$00:C9E6 A2 FF        LDX.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:C9E8 8E 25 14     STX.W $1425                     ; / Yes: [$1425] = $FF
$00:C9EB A2 F0        LDX.B #$F0                      ; \
$00:C9ED 8E B0 0D     STX.W $0DB0                     ; / [$0DB0] = $F0
$00:C9F0 9C 93 14     STZ.W $1493                     ; [$1493] = 0
$00:C9F3 9C DA 0D     STZ.W $0DDA                     ; [$0DDA] = 0
$00:C9F6 A0 10        LDY.B #$10                      ; Y = $10 (other game mode)
$00:C9F8 9C AE 0D     STZ.W $0DAE                     ; Screen brightness [$0DAE] = 0
$00:C9FB 9C AF 0D     STZ.W $0DAF                     ; [$0DAF] = 0
$00:C9FE 8D D5 0D     STA.W $0DD5                     ; [$0DD5] = A: exit type (1 = normal, 2 = secret)
$00:CA01 AD C6 13     LDA.W $13C6                     ; \
$00:CA04 F0 1F        BEQ $CA25                       ; / [$13C6] = 0 (no cutscene): skip to $CA25
$00:CA06 A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: number of entries to search
$00:CA08 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; A = current level number [$13BF]
$00:CA0B C9 13        CMP.B #$13                      ; \
$00:CA0D D0 03        BNE $CA12                       ; / Level $13? No: skip
$00:CA0F EE D5 0D     INC.W $0DD5                     ; Yes: [$0DD5]++
$00:CA12 C9 31        CMP.B #$31                      ; \
$00:CA14 F0 0A        BEQ $CA20                       ; / Level $31: always cutscene 8
$00:CA16 DD A6 C9     CMP.W ADDR_00C9A6,X             ; \
$00:CA19 F0 05        BEQ $CA20                       ; / Search the list at $C9A7 backwards
$00:CA1B CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:CA1C D0 F8        BNE $CA16                       ; / Loop for all 8 entries
$00:CA1E 80 05        BRA $CA25                       ; Not found: no cutscene

$00:CA20 8E C6 13     STX.W $13C6                     ; [$13C6] = X: cutscene number
$00:CA23 A0 18        LDY.B #$18                      ; Y = $18: game mode (probably cutscene)
$00:CA25 8C 00 01     STY.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode = Y
$00:CA28 EE E9 1D     INC.W $1DE9                     ; [$1DE9]++
$00:CA2B A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:CA2D 8D CE 13     STA.W $13CE                     ; / [$13CE] = 1
$00:CA30 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $CA31: Peace pose and iris-out effect (SetMarioPeaceImg) ;;;
;; SetMarioPeaceImg: sets Mario frame $26 (peace sign), $14 on Yoshi.
;; $00CA3E: starts the iris-out by setting [$1433] = $F0. $00CA44: each frame while [$1433] is non-zero,
;;     shrinks the radius by 4 and rebuilds the circle window.
;; $00CA6D: A = radius change. Builds a per-scanline window table (left, right) at $04A0 for HDMA channel 7,
;;     centered on Mario, using the table at [$04]/[$06]; sets [$0D9F] = $80.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:A1F9: Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode)
;;     $00:C9AF: Jump to Mario physics, cutscene level list (Instr00C9A4)
$00:CA31 A9 26        LDA.B #$26                      ; \
$00:CA33 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$00:CA36 F0 02        BEQ $CA3A                       ; } Mario frame = $26 (peace sign), or $14 when riding Yoshi
$00:CA38 A9 14        LDA.B #$14                      ; |
$00:CA3A 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / Store as Mario's pose
$00:CA3D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CA3E A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; \
$00:CA40 8D 33 14     STA.W $1433                     ; / Iris-out radius [$1433] = $F0
$00:CA43 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CA44 AD 33 14     LDA.W $1433                     ; \
$00:CA47 D0 01        BNE $CA4A                       ; / Iris active? [$1433] = 0: return
$00:CA49 60           RTS                             ; Return (iris finished)

$00:CA4A 20 61 CA     JSR.W $CA61                     ; Point the table pointers at the circle table ($CA61)
$00:CA4D A9 FC        LDA.B #$FC                      ; \
$00:CA4F 20 6D CA     JSR.W $CA6D                     ; / Shrink the radius by 4 and rebuild the HDMA window table ($CA6D)
$00:CA52 A9 33        LDA.B #$33                      ; \
$00:CA54 85 41        STA $41                         ; |
$00:CA56 85 43        STA $43                         ; / [$41] = [$43] = $33: window 1 on BG1, BG2, OBJ, color
$00:CA58 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:CA5A 85 42        STA $42                         ; / [$42] = $03
$00:CA5C A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$00:CA5E 85 44        STA $44                         ; / [$44] = $22: color window = window 1 inside
$00:CA60 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CA61 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CA63 A9 12 CB     LDA.W #$CB12                    ; \
$00:CA66 85 04        STA $04                         ; | [$04] = [$06] = $CB12 (circle shape table)
$00:CA68 85 06        STA $06                         ; /
$00:CA6A E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CA6C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CA6D 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:CA6E 6D 33 14     ADC.W $1433                     ; |
$00:CA71 8D 33 14     STA.W $1433                     ; } [$1433] += A (iris radius)
$00:CA74 A5 7E        LDA $7E                         ; \
$00:CA76 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:CA77 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$00:CA79 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = Mario screen X + 8: iris center X
$00:CA7B A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; \
$00:CA7D A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$00:CA7F F0 02        BEQ $CA83                       ; |
$00:CA81 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; | A = $18 (small Mario) or $10 (powered up)
$00:CA83 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:CA84 65 80        ADC $80                         ; |
$00:CA86 85 01        STA $01                         ; } [$01] = Mario screen Y + A: iris center Y
$00:CA88 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A and X/Y 16-bit
$00:CA8A 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; \
$00:CA8D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:CA8E 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$00:CA8F 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:CA90 A8           TAY                             ; } Y = (centerY * 2 - 1) * 2: HDMA table offset of the mirrored line below
$00:CA91 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CA93 A2 00 00     LDX.W #$0000                    ; X = 0: HDMA table offset of the top line
$00:CA96 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$00:CA98 CD 33 14     CMP.W $1433                     ; } [$01] = vertical distance to center; inside the circle?
$00:CA9B 90 20        BCC $CABD                       ; / Yes: compute the window edges
$00:CA9D A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:CA9F 9D A0 04     STA.W $04A0,X                   ; | Outside the circle: window left = $FF, right = $00 (empty)
$00:CAA2 9E A1 04     STZ.W $04A1,X                   ; /
$00:CAA5 C0 C0 01     CPY.W #$01C0                    ; \
$00:CAA8 B0 07        BCS $CAB1                       ; } Mirrored line index beyond the table: skip
$00:CAAA 99 A0 04     STA.W $04A0,Y                   ; \
$00:CAAD 1A           INC A                           ; |
$00:CAAE 99 A1 04     STA.W $04A1,Y                   ; / Same empty window on the mirrored line (left $FF, right $00)
$00:CAB1 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:CAB2 E8           INX                             ; |
$00:CAB3 88           DEY                             ; |
$00:CAB4 88           DEY                             ; / Next line: X += 2, Y -= 2
$00:CAB5 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$00:CAB7 F0 51        BEQ $CB0A                       ; / Distance 0: done
$00:CAB9 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; [$01]--
$00:CABB 80 D9        BRA $CA96                       ; Next line

$00:CABD 20 14 CC     JSR.W $CC14                     ; Compute half-widths [$02] and [$03] for distance [$01] ($CC14)
$00:CAC0 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:CAC1 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$00:CAC3 90 02        BCC $CAC7                       ; | Right edge = center X + [$02], clamped to $FF
$00:CAC5 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:CAC7 9D A1 04     STA.W $04A1,X                   ; / Top line window right edge
$00:CACA A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$00:CACC 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:CACD E5 02        SBC $02                         ; |
$00:CACF B0 02        BCS $CAD3                       ; | Left edge = center X - [$02], clamped to 0
$00:CAD1 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$00:CAD3 9D A0 04     STA.W $04A0,X                   ; / Top line window left edge
$00:CAD6 C0 E0 01     CPY.W #$01E0                    ; \
$00:CAD9 B0 23        BCS $CAFE                       ; / Mirrored line out of range: skip
$00:CADB A5 07        LDA $07                         ; \
$00:CADD D0 08        BNE $CAE7                       ; / High byte of [$06] is zero: use an empty window
$00:CADF A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:CAE1 99 A1 04     STA.W $04A1,Y                   ; | Left = 0, right = 0 on the mirrored line, then A = $FF
$00:CAE4 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$00:CAE5 80 14        BRA $CAFB                       ; / Store the left edge

$00:CAE7 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; \
$00:CAE9 65 00        ADC $00                         ; |
$00:CAEB 90 02        BCC $CAEF                       ; | Right edge = center X + [$03], clamped to $FF
$00:CAED A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:CAEF 99 A1 04     STA.W $04A1,Y                   ; / Mirrored line window right edge
$00:CAF2 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$00:CAF4 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:CAF5 E5 03        SBC $03                         ; |
$00:CAF7 B0 02        BCS $CAFB                       ; | Left edge = center X - [$03], clamped to 0
$00:CAF9 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$00:CAFB 99 A0 04     STA.W $04A0,Y                   ; / Mirrored line window left edge
$00:CAFE E8           INX                             ; \
$00:CAFF E8           INX                             ; |
$00:CB00 88           DEY                             ; |
$00:CB01 88           DEY                             ; / Next line: X += 2, Y -= 2
$00:CB02 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$00:CB04 F0 04        BEQ $CB0A                       ; / Distance 0: done
$00:CB06 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$00:CB08 D0 B3        BNE $CABD                       ; / [$01]--, loop while non-zero
$00:CB0A A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:CB0C 8D 9F 0D     STA.W $0D9F                     ; / Enable HDMA channel 7 ([$0D9F] = $80) for the window
$00:CB0F E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; X and Y 8-bit
$00:CB11 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CB12..CC12: Data: iris shape tables ;;;
;; Circle half-width table (128 entries, then $00) followed by a second shape table (probably the keyhole).
$00:CB12              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF ; Iris circle table: 256*sqrt(1 - t^2) for t = 0..1 in 128 steps
$00:CB1A              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FE,$FE,$FE,$FE
$00:CB22              .db $FD,$FD,$FD,$FD,$FC,$FC,$FC,$FB
$00:CB2A              .db $FB,$FB,$FA,$FA,$F9,$F9,$F8,$F8
$00:CB32              .db $F7,$F7,$F6,$F6,$F5,$F5,$F4,$F3
$00:CB3A              .db $F3,$F2,$F1,$F1,$F0,$EF,$EE,$EE
$00:CB42              .db $ED,$EC,$EB,$EA,$E9,$E9,$E8,$E7
$00:CB4A              .db $E6,$E5,$E4,$E3,$E2,$E1,$DF,$DE
$00:CB52              .db $DD,$DC,$DB,$DA,$D8,$D7,$D6,$D5
$00:CB5A              .db $D3,$D2,$D0,$CF,$CD,$CC,$CA,$C9
$00:CB62              .db $C7,$C6,$C4,$C2,$C1,$BF,$BD,$BB
$00:CB6A              .db $B9,$B7,$B6,$B4,$B1,$AF,$AD,$AB
$00:CB72              .db $A9,$A7,$A4,$A2,$9F,$9D,$9A,$97
$00:CB7A              .db $95,$92,$8F,$8C,$89,$86,$82,$7F
$00:CB82              .db $7B,$78,$74,$70,$6C,$67,$63,$5E
$00:CB8A              .db $59,$53,$4D,$46,$3F,$37,$2D,$1F
$00:CB92              .db $00,$54,$53,$52,$52,$51,$50,$50 ; End of circle table ($00); the $54.. values after it start another (probably keyhole) shape table
$00:CB9A              .db $4F,$4E,$4E,$4D,$4C,$4C,$4B,$4A
$00:CBA2              .db $4A,$4B,$48,$48,$47,$46,$46,$45
$00:CBAA              .db $44,$44,$43,$42,$42,$41,$40,$40
$00:CBB2              .db $3F,$3E,$3E,$3D,$3C,$3C,$3B,$3A
$00:CBBA              .db $3A,$39,$38,$38,$37,$36,$36,$35
$00:CBC2              .db $34,$34,$33,$32,$32,$31,$33,$35
$00:CBCA              .db $38,$3A,$3C,$3E,$3F,$41,$43,$44
$00:CBD2              .db $45,$47,$48,$49,$4A,$4B,$4C,$4D
$00:CBDA              .db $4E,$4E,$4F,$50,$50,$51,$51,$52
$00:CBE2              .db $52,$53,$53,$53,$53,$53,$53,$53
$00:CBEA              .db $53,$53,$53,$53,$53,$53,$52,$52
$00:CBF2              .db $51,$51,$50,$50,$4F,$4E,$4E,$4D
$00:CBFA              .db $4C,$4B,$4A,$49,$48,$47,$45,$44
$00:CC02              .db $43,$41,$3F,$3E,$3C,$3A,$38,$35
$00:CC0A              .db $33,$30,$2D,$2A,$26,$23,$1E,$18
$00:CC12              .db $11,$00


;;; $CC14: Iris half-width lookup ;;;
;; Computes the half-width of the iris window at vertical distance [$01] from its center, for radius [$1433],
;;     using the hardware divider and multiplier.
;; Parameters: [$01]: distance, [$04]/[$06]: shape tables. Returns: [$02] and [$03]: half-widths, A = [$02].
;; Called by:
;;     $00:CABD: Peace pose and iris-out effect (SetMarioPeaceImg)
$00:CC14 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$00:CC15 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$00:CC17 8D 05 42     STA.W $4205                     ; | Hardware divide: ([$01] * 256) / radius [$1433]
$00:CC1A 9C 04 42     STZ.W $4204                     ; |
$00:CC1D AD 33 14     LDA.W $1433                     ; |
$00:CC20 8D 06 42     STA.W $4206                     ; / (distance / radius as a fraction of 256)
$00:CC23 EA           NOP                             ; \
$00:CC24 EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC25 EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC26 EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC27 EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC28 EA           NOP                             ; / Wait for the divide (16 cycles)
$00:CC29 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CC2B AD 14 42     LDA.W $4214                     ; \
$00:CC2E 4A           LSR                             ; | Y = quotient / 2: index 0-127 into the shape table
$00:CC2F A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:CC30 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CC32 B1 06        LDA ($06),Y                     ; \
$00:CC34 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; | Hardware multiply: [($06) + Y] * radius
$00:CC37 AD 33 14     LDA.W $1433                     ; |
$00:CC3A 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; /
$00:CC3D EA           NOP                             ; \
$00:CC3E EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC3F EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC40 EA           NOP                             ; / Wait for the multiply
$00:CC41 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; \
$00:CC44 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = high byte of the product (half-width from table at [$06])
$00:CC46 B1 04        LDA ($04),Y                     ; \
$00:CC48 8D 02 42     STA.W $4202                     ; | Same with the table at [$04]
$00:CC4B AD 33 14     LDA.W $1433                     ; |
$00:CC4E 8D 03 42     STA.W $4203                     ; /
$00:CC51 EA           NOP                             ; \
$00:CC52 EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC53 EA           NOP                             ; |
$00:CC54 EA           NOP                             ; / Wait for the multiply
$00:CC55 AD 17 42     LDA.W $4217                     ; \
$00:CC58 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = half-width from the table at [$04]
$00:CC5A 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$00:CC5B 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CC5C..CC64: Data: debug free roam speeds ;;;
$00:CC5C              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$02,$00,$06,$00 ; Debug free roam speeds (words): 0, 0, +2, +6, -2, -6
$00:CC64              .db $FE,$FF,$FA,$FF             ; (speed table continues)


;;; $CC68: Mario animation 0: normal per-frame handling (ResetAni) ;;;
;; Mario animation 0: the normal per-frame Mario routine. Debug mode toggle (unreachable), end-of-level
;;     handler, L/R scrolling, lock timer, physics dispatch (normal, boss room/keyhole, climbing, swimming,
;;     flying), pipe pose and Yoshi pose.
;; Returns with the Mario frame in $13E0 set when relevant.
$00:CC68 A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; \
$00:CC6A 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; |
$00:CC6C F0 13        BEQ $CC81                       ; / L button held? (else skip the debug toggle)
$00:CC6E A5 18        LDA $18                         ; \
$00:CC70 C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; |
$00:CC72 D0 0D        BNE $CC81                       ; / ...and A newly pressed? (else skip)
$00:CC74 EE 01 1E     INC.W $1E01                     ; Cycle debug mode [$1E01]: 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0
$00:CC77 AD 01 1E     LDA.W $1E01                     ; \
$00:CC7A C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$00:CC7C 90 03        BCC $CC81                       ; |
$00:CC7E 9C 01 1E     STZ.W $1E01                     ; / Wrap to 0 after 2
$00:CC81 AD 01 1E     LDA.W $1E01                     ; A = debug mode [$1E01]
$00:CC84 80 35        BRA $CCBB                       ; Always skip the debug code (change to BEQ to enable it)

$00:CC86 4A           LSR                             ; Unused debug code: mode 1 = fill P-meter, mode 2 = free roaming
$00:CC87 F0 2A        BEQ $CCB3                       ; Mode 1: fill the P-meter
$00:CC89 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:CC8B 8D 97 14     STA.W $1497                     ; / [$1497] = $FF: Mario invincible
$00:CC8E A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:CC90 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:CC92 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:CC93 0A           ASL                             ; | Y = left/right buttons * 4: index into the speed table
$00:CC94 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; / X = 0: horizontal
$00:CC96 20 9F CC     JSR.W $CC9F                     ; Move Mario in X
$00:CC99 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:CC9B 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; | Up/down buttons
$00:CC9D A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; / X = 2: vertical
$00:CC9F 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:CCA1 50 02        BVC $CCA5                       ; | Y button held: use the faster speed
$00:CCA3 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; / (add 2 to the index)
$00:CCA5 A8           TAY                             ; Y = index into the speed table
$00:CCA6 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CCA8 B5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos,X             ; \
$00:CCAA 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:CCAB 79 5C CC     ADC.W $CC5C,Y                   ; | Mario position (X or Y) += speed
$00:CCAE 95 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos,X             ; /
$00:CCB0 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CCB2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CCB3 A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; \
$00:CCB5 8D E4 13     STA.W $13E4                     ; / P-meter [$13E4] = $70
$00:CCB8 8D 9F 14     STA.W $149F                     ; Take-off timer [$149F] = $70
$00:CCBB AD 93 14     LDA.W $1493                     ; \
$00:CCBE F0 03        BEQ $CCC3                       ; } Level end timer [$1493] running?
$00:CCC0 4C 15 C9     JMP.W $C915                     ; / Yes: level end handler ($C915)

$00:CCC3 20 DD CD     JSR.W $CDDD                     ; L/R scroll handling ($CDDD)
$00:CCC6 A5 9D        LDA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; \
$00:CCC8 D0 15        BNE $CCDF                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$00:CCCA 9C E8 13     STZ.W $13E8                     ; \
$00:CCCD 9C DE 13     STZ.W $13DE                     ; / [$13E8] = [$13DE] = 0 (no cape interaction)
$00:CCD0 AD BD 18     LDA.W RAM_LockMarioTimer        ; \
$00:CCD3 F0 0B        BEQ $CCE0                       ; } Mario lock timer [$18BD] zero? Yes: run physics
$00:CCD5 CE BD 18     DEC.W RAM_LockMarioTimer        ; Timer--
$00:CCD8 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$00:CCDA A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$00:CCDC 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / Mario frame = $0F (entering pipe pose)
$00:CCDF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CCE0 AD 9B 0D     LDA.W $0D9B                     ; \
$00:CCE3 10 3F        BPL $CD24                       ; } [$0D9B] bit 7 clear: normal level, run Mario physics ($CD24)
$00:CCE5 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:CCE6 B0 3C        BCS $CD24                       ; / Bit 0 set: same
$00:CCE8 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; \
$00:CCEB 70 2F        BVS $CD1C                       ; / Bit 6 set: skip keyhole movement
$00:CCED A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:CCEF D0 2B        BNE $CD1C                       ; / Mario in the air: skip keyhole movement
$00:CCF1 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CCF3 AD 36 14     LDA.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; \
$00:CCF6 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; | Mario X position = keyhole X [$1436]
$00:CCF8 AD 38 14     LDA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; |
$00:CCFB 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y position = keyhole Y [$1438]
$00:CCFD E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CCFF 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Apply Mario's speed ($DC2D)
$00:CD02 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CD04 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:CD06 8D 36 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; | Store the new X back in [$1436] and [$14B4]
$00:CD09 8D B4 14     STA.W $14B4                     ; /
$00:CD0C A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:CD0E 29 F0 FF     AND.W #$FFF0                    ; |
$00:CD11 8D 38 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; | Store Y (low 4 bits cleared) in [$1438] and [$14B6]
$00:CD14 8D B6 14     STA.W $14B6                     ; /
$00:CD17 20 C9 F9     JSR.W $F9C9                     ; Update the keyhole ($F9C9)
$00:CD1A 80 03        BRA $CD1F                       ; Continue at $CD1F

$00:CD1C 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Apply Mario's speed ($DC2D)
$00:CD1F 20 F2 F8     JSR.W $F8F2                     ; Boss room interaction ($F8F2)
$00:CD22 80 12        BRA $CD36                       ; Skip the normal interaction

$00:CD24 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:CD26 10 08        BPL $CD30                       ; } Mario moving down (Y speed >= 0): skip
$00:CD28 A5 77        LDA RAM_MarioObjStatus          ; \
$00:CD2A 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$00:CD2C F0 02        BEQ $CD30                       ; } Moving up: blocked above by an object ([$77] bit 3)?
$00:CD2E 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Yes: Y speed = 0
$00:CD30 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Apply Mario's speed to his position ($DC2D)
$00:CD33 20 2B E9     JSR.W $E92B                     ; Mario interaction with level objects ($E92B)
$00:CD36 20 95 F5     JSR.W $F595                     ; Keep Mario inside the screen limits ($F595)
$00:CD39 9C DD 13     STZ.W RAM_ChangingDir           ; [$13DD] = 0: not changing direction
$00:CD3C AC F3 13     LDY.W $13F3                     ; \
$00:CD3F D0 54        BNE $CD95                       ; / [$13F3] non-zero: pipe pose, $CD95
$00:CD41 AD BE 18     LDA.W $18BE                     ; \
$00:CD44 F0 04        BEQ $CD4A                       ; } [$18BE] set?
$00:CD46 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; \
$00:CD48 85 8B        STA $8B                         ; / Yes: [$8B] = $1F (touching all climbable tiles)
$00:CD4A A5 74        LDA RAM_IsClimbing              ; \
$00:CD4C D0 24        BNE $CD72                       ; / Already climbing: continue climbing ($CD72)
$00:CD4E AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F               If mario isn't holding something or riding yoshi ; \
$00:CD51 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi         jump to the status tests to determine his physical abilities ; } Holding an item or riding Yoshi: skip the climb check
$00:CD54 D0 23        BNE $CD79           else, continue on. ; /
$00:CD56 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$00:CD58 29 1B        AND.B #$1B                      ; |
$00:CD5A C9 1B        CMP.B #$1B                      ; } Mario touching the necessary climb tiles ([$8B] & $1B = $1B)?
$00:CD5C D0 1B        BNE $CD79                       ; /
$00:CD5E A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:CD60 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; } Up or down pressed?
$00:CD62 F0 15        BEQ $CD79                       ; /
$00:CD64 A4 72        LDY RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:CD66 D0 0A        BNE $CD72                       ; } In the air: start climbing
$00:CD68 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; \
$00:CD6A D0 06        BNE $CD72                       ; / On the ground: only if up is pressed
$00:CD6C A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$00:CD6E 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; |
$00:CD70 F0 07        BEQ $CD79                       ; / Unused path: needs [$8B] bit 2, else no climb
$00:CD72 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$00:CD74 85 74        STA RAM_IsClimbing              ; / Start climbing: [$74] = [$8B]
$00:CD76 4C 17 DB     JMP.W $DB17                     ; Run the climbing code ($DB17)

$00:CD79 A5 75        LDA RAM_IsSwimming              ; \
$00:CD7B F0 05        BEQ $CD82                       ; / Not swimming: normal ground/air physics
$00:CD7D 20 88 D9     JSR.W $D988                     ; Underwater physics ($D988)
$00:CD80 80 0D        BRA $CD8F                       ; Then the Yoshi check

$00:CD82 20 F2 D5     JSR.W $D5F2                     ; Generic physics ($D5F2)
$00:CD85 20 62 D0     JSR.W $D062                     ; Power-up specific physics ($D062)
$00:CD88 20 E4 D7     JSR.W $D7E4                     ; Flying/cape physics ($D7E4)
$00:CD8B 22 B1 CE 00  JSL.L $CEB1                     ; Update the cape image and animation timer ($CEB1)
$00:CD8F AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:CD92 D0 19        BNE $CDAD                       ; / Riding Yoshi: set Mario's Yoshi pose ($CDAD)
$00:CD94 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CD95 A9 42        LDA.B #$42                      ; \
$00:CD97 A6 19        LDX RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$00:CD99 F0 02        BEQ $CD9D                       ; | A = $42 (small) or $43 (powered up): pipe entry pose
$00:CD9B A9 43        LDA.B #$43                      ; /
$00:CD9D 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:CD9E F0 05        BEQ $CDA5                       ; / [$13F3]-- : zero reached? Use the pose in A
$00:CDA0 8C F3 13     STY.W $13F3                     ; Store the counter
$00:CDA3 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; Frame = $0F while the counter runs
$00:CDA5 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; Set Mario's pose
$00:CDA8 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CDA9: Yoshi poses and L/R scrolling (OnYoshiAnimations) ;;;
;; Table of Mario poses on Yoshi, then $CDAD (picks the pose from the Yoshi tongue timer [$14A3] and
;;     ducking) and $CDDD (hold L or R to scroll the screen).
$00:CDA9              .db $20,$21,$27,$28             ; Mario poses on Yoshi: $20 normal, $21, $27 tongue out, $28 tongue shorter

$00:CDAD AE A3 14     LDX.W $14A3                     ; \
$00:CDB0 F0 08        BEQ $CDBA                       ; } [$14A3] (Yoshi tongue timer) non-zero?
$00:CDB2 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; \
$00:CDB4 E0 0C        CPX.B #$0C                      ; |
$00:CDB6 B0 02        BCS $CDBA                       ; | Y = 3 for timer >= $0C
$00:CDB8 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; / Y = 4 for a shorter timer
$00:CDBA B9 A8 CD     LDA.W $CDA8,Y                   ; A = pose from the table (index Y - 1)
$00:CDBD 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:CDBE D0 06        BNE $CDC6                       ; } Default pose (index 0)?
$00:CDC0 A4 73        LDY RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$00:CDC2 F0 02        BEQ $CDC6                       ; } Ducking?
$00:CDC4 A9 1D        LDA.B #$1D                      ; / Yes: frame $1D
$00:CDC6 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; Set Mario's pose
$00:CDC9 AD 1E 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; \
$00:CDCC C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Yoshi wings flag [$141E] = 1? (never true)
$00:CDCE D0 0C        BNE $CDDC                       ; / No: return
$00:CDD0 24 16        BIT $16                         ; \ Unreachable
$00:CDD2 50 08        BVC $CDDC                       ; | Y button newly pressed?
$00:CDD4 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; |
$00:CDD6 8D DB 18     STA.W $18DB                     ; | [$18DB] = 8
$00:CDD9 20 A8 FE     JSR.W ShootFireball             ; / Shoot a fireball while on Yoshi
$00:CDDC 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:CDDD AD 11 14     LDA.W $1411                     ; \
$00:CDE0 F0 FA        BEQ $CDDC                       ; / L/R screen scrolling disabled ([$1411] = 0): return
$00:CDE2 AC FE 13     LDY.W $13FE                     ; Y = [$13FE] (scroll direction)
$00:CDE5 AD FD 13     LDA.W $13FD                     ; \
$00:CDE8 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; / Sprites locked = [$13FD]
$00:CDEA D0 60        BNE $CE4C                       ; Locked: continue scrolling
$00:CDEC AD 00 14     LDA.W $1400                     ; \
$00:CDEF F0 05        BEQ $CDF6                       ; / [$1400] (camera scroll type) = 0?
$00:CDF1 9C FE 13     STZ.W $13FE                     ; [$13FE] = 0
$00:CDF4 80 52        BRA $CE48                       ; Cancel the L/R hold timer

$00:CDF6 A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; \
$00:CDF8 29 CF        AND.B #$CF                      ; |
$00:CDFA 05 15        ORA RAM_ControllerA             ; } Any button besides L/R pressed?
$00:CDFC D0 4B        BNE $CE49                       ; / Yes: cancel
$00:CDFE A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; \
$00:CE00 29 30        AND.B #$30                      ; | L or R pressed?
$00:CE02 F0 45        BEQ $CE49                       ; / No: cancel
$00:CE04 C9 30        CMP.B #$30                      ; \
$00:CE06 F0 41        BEQ $CE49                       ; / Both: cancel

;;; $CE08: L/R screen scrolling (ScrollScreen) ;;;
;; Holding L or R for $10 frames moves the static camera region [$142A] toward the left or right limit,
;;     freezing sprites while it moves, with a sound effect.
$00:CE08 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:CE09 4A           LSR                             ; | A = $04 for L, $02 for R
$00:CE0A 4A           LSR                             ; /
$00:CE0B EE 01 14     INC.W $1401                     ; Hold timer [$1401]++
$00:CE0E AE 01 14     LDX.W $1401                     ; \
$00:CE11 E0 10        CPX.B #$10                      ; } Held less than $10 frames: keep waiting
$00:CE13 90 37        BCC $CE4C                       ; /
$00:CE15 AA           TAX                             ; X = A
$00:CE16 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CE18 AD 2A 14     LDA.W $142A                     ; \
$00:CE1B DD CB F6     CMP.W $F6CB,X                   ; } Static camera position [$142A] compared to the target for this direction
$00:CE1E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CE20 F0 2A        BEQ $CE4C                       ; Already there: skip
$00:CE22 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:CE24 1C 2A 14     TRB.W $142A                     ; / Clear bit 0 of [$142A]
$00:CE27 EE FD 13     INC.W $13FD                     ; [$13FD]++: freeze sprites while the screen scrolls
$00:CE2A A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$00:CE2C E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; \
$00:CE2E D0 03        BNE $CE33                       ; / R pressed (X = 2): A = last screen - 1
$00:CE30 A5 5E        LDA $5E                         ; \
$00:CE32 3A           DEC A                           ; / (from [$5E])
$00:CE33 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CE35 EB           XBA                             ; \
$00:CE36 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; | Compare the last screen position against the screen X [$1A]
$00:CE39 C5 1A        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$00:CE3B E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /
$00:CE3D F0 05        BEQ $CE44                       ; Equal: already at the edge, no sound
$00:CE3F A0 0E        LDY.B #$0E                      ; \
$00:CE41 8C FC 1D     STY.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $0E (scroll)
$00:CE44 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:CE45 8D FE 13     STA.W $13FE                     ; / [$13FE] = scroll direction
$00:CE48 A8           TAY                             ; Y = direction
$00:CE49 9C 01 14     STZ.W $1401                     ; Hold timer [$1401] = 0
$00:CE4C A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$00:CE4E A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$00:CE50 0A           ASL                             ; | [$13FF] = Mario direction * 2
$00:CE51 8D FF 13     STA.W $13FF                     ; /
$00:CE54 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:CE56 AD 2A 14     LDA.W $142A                     ; \
$00:CE59 D9 CB F6     CMP.W $F6CB,Y                   ; } Static camera position equal to the target?
$00:CE5C F0 0F        BEQ $CE6D                       ; / Yes: done scrolling
$00:CE5E 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:CE5F 79 BF F6     ADC.W $F6BF,Y                   ; / Move the camera region toward the target by the step in $F6BF
$00:CE62 AC FF 13     LDY.W $13FF                     ; Y = Mario direction * 2
$00:CE65 D9 B3 F6     CMP.W $F6B3,Y                   ; \
$00:CE68 D0 06        BNE $CE70                       ; } Reached the limit?
$00:CE6A 8E FE 13     STX.W $13FE                     ; Yes: stop scrolling
$00:CE6D 8E FD 13     STX.W $13FD                     ; Unfreeze sprites ([$13FD] = 0)
$00:CE70 8D 2A 14     STA.W $142A                     ; Store the camera region position
$00:CE73 8E 00 14     STX.W $1400                     ; [$1400] = 0
$00:CE76 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:CE78 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $CE79..CE97: Data: Mario slide poses ;;;
;; Frame numbers $2A-$2F, and the slope sliding table indexed by slope and direction.
$00:CE79              .db $2A,$2B,$2C,$2D,$2E,$2F     ; Mario poses for sliding: $2A-$2F

$00:CE7F              .db $2C,$2C,$2C,$2B,$2B,$2C,$2C,$2B ; Mario poses sliding on slopes, indexed by slope and direction
$00:CE87              .db $2B,$2C,$2D,$2A,$2A,$2D,$2D,$2A ; (slide poses continue)
$00:CE8F              .db $2A,$2D,$2D,$2A,$2A,$2D,$2E,$2A ; (slide poses continue)
$00:CE97              .db $2A,$2E                     ; (slide poses end)


;;; $CE99..CEA9: Data: spin jump tables ;;;
;; $CE99: frame values, $CEA1: Mario facing during a spin jump, $CEA9: cape images.
$00:CE99              .db $00,$00,$25,$44,$00,$00,$0F,$45 ; Spin jump poses (indexed by frame counter), used with the cape code
$00:CEA1              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$01,$01,$01 ; Mario direction during a spin jump: 0 = left, 1 = right
$00:CEA9              .db $02,$07,$06,$09,$02,$07,$06,$09 ; Cape images during a spin jump


;;; $CEB1: Cape image update (air) ;;;
;; Called from ResetAni with JSL. Updates the cape image [$13DF] and its animation timer [$14A2] depending on
;;     Mario being in the air, falling, swimming or running; continues in the next chunk with the spin jump code.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:94F2: Cutscene, ending and game mode code (castle scenes, credits, game over) (CutsceneCastlePal)
;;     $00:CD8B: Mario animation 0: normal per-frame handling (ResetAni)
;;     $00:D19D: Mario animation 5: horizontal pipe (DoorPipeAni)
;;     $00:DA7F: Swimming physics and controls
;;     $04:85C5: Draw border icon and player map sprites (DrawOWBoarder?)
;;     $0C:A75F: Ending: eggshell fragments and Yoshi helpers
$00:CEB1 AD A2 14     LDA.W $14A2                     ; \
$00:CEB4 D0 60        BNE lbl14A2Not0                 ; } Cape animation timer [$14A2] running: skip the update
$00:CEB6 AE DF 13     LDX.W $13DF                     ; X = cape image [$13DF]
$00:CEB9 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:CEBB F0 21        BEQ MarioAnimAir                ; / On the ground: ground handling (MarioAnimAir)
$00:CEBD A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4: timer base in the air
$00:CEBF 24 7D        BIT RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:CEC1 10 0A        BPL $CECD                       ; / Mario falling: $CECD
$00:CEC3 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; \
$00:CEC5 F0 36        BEQ $CEFD                       ; / Run jump ($72 = $0C): $CEFD
$00:CEC7 A5 75        LDA RAM_IsSwimming              ; \
$00:CEC9 D0 32        BNE $CEFD                       ; / Swimming: $CEFD
$00:CECB 80 17        BRA MrioNtInWtr                 ; Otherwise $CEE4

$00:CECD E8           INX                             ; \
$00:CECE E0 05        CPX.B #$05                      ; |
$00:CED0 B0 04        BCS $CED6                       ; | Falling: cape image + 1; if below 5 set it to 5
$00:CED2 A2 05        LDX.B #$05                      ; |
$00:CED4 80 34        BRA $CF0A                       ; /

$00:CED6 E0 0B        CPX.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:CED8 90 30        BCC $CF0A                       ; / Image < $0B: keep
$00:CEDA A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; \
$00:CEDC 80 2C        BRA $CF0A                       ; / Else image = 7


;;; $CEDE: Cape update: on ground (MarioAnimAir) ;;;
;; On the ground: X speed non-zero goes to the speed based timer, else Y = 8.
$00:CEDE A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:CEE0 D0 0E        BNE $CEF0                       ; / On the ground, moving: $CEF0
$00:CEE2 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Standing still: Y = 8

;;; $CEE4: Cape update: step image down (MrioNtInWtr) ;;;
;; Decreases the cape image toward 2 and ends in the shared store of [$13DF]/[$14A2] at $CF0A.
$00:CEE4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:CEE5 F0 23        BEQ $CF0A                       ; / Cape image zero: keep
$00:CEE7 CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:CEE8 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; |
$00:CEEA 90 1E        BCC $CF0A                       ; | Cape image - 1; if < 3 keep it
$00:CEEC A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; |
$00:CEEE 80 1A        BRA $CF0A                       ; / Else image = 2

$00:CEF0 10 03        BPL $CEF5                       ; \
$00:CEF2 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; | A = abs(X speed)
$00:CEF4 1A           INC A                           ; /
$00:CEF5 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:CEF6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:CEF7 4A           LSR                             ; | A = speed / 8
$00:CEF8 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:CEF9 B9 7C DC     LDA.W $DC7C,Y                   ; \
$00:CEFC A8           TAY                             ; / Y = cape timer from $DC7C
$00:CEFD E8           INX                             ; \
$00:CEFE E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; |
$00:CF00 B0 02        BCS $CF04                       ; |
$00:CF02 A2 05        LDX.B #$05                      ; / Cape image + 1; if < 3, image = 5
$00:CF04 E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; \
$00:CF06 90 02        BCC $CF0A                       ; |
$00:CF08 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; / Image >= 7: image = 3
$00:CF0A 8E DF 13     STX.W $13DF                     ; [$13DF] = cape image
$00:CF0D 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:CF0E A4 75        LDY RAM_IsSwimming              ; | A = timer
$00:CF10 F0 01        BEQ $CF13                       ; |
$00:CF12 0A           ASL                             ; / Doubled when swimming
$00:CF13 8D A2 14     STA.W $14A2                     ; [$14A2] = timer

;;; $CF16: Choose Mario pose: spin, slide, duck, walk (lbl14A2Not0) ;;;
;; Second half of the Mario pose selector (earlier part is in the chunk before). Picks the pose number for
;;     this frame and ends by
;; storing it in MarioFrame via $D01A.
;; Order: spin jump or cape spin, slope slide, ducking, fireball, kick, pick-up, face camera, then
;;     walking/standing based on
;; |X speed|. Falls into MarioAnimNoAbs1.
$00:CF16 AD 0D 14     LDA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; \
$00:CF19 0D A6 14     ORA.W $14A6                     ; / Spin jump or cape spin active ([RAM_IsSpinJump] | [$14A6])?
$00:CF1C F0 30        BEQ $CF4E                       ; Neither: go to the normal pose selection at $CF4E
$00:CF1E 64 73        STZ RAM_IsDucking               ; Not ducking
$00:CF20 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$00:CF22 29 06        AND.B #$06                      ; |
$00:CF24 AA           TAX                             ; |
$00:CF25 A8           TAY                             ; / X = Y = [RAM_FrameCounterB] & 6 (cycles through 4 spin poses)
$00:CF26 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:CF28 F0 05        BEQ $CF2F                       ; / On the ground: skip the Y adjustment
$00:CF2A A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:CF2C 30 01        BMI $CF2F                       ; / Moving up: skip the Y adjustment
$00:CF2E C8           INY                             ; Falling: Y += 1 (second cape image of the pair)
$00:CF2F B9 A9 CE     LDA.W $CEA9,Y                   ; \
$00:CF32 8D DF 13     STA.W $13DF                     ; / Cape image [$13DF] = $CEA9[Y]
$00:CF35 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = power-up status
$00:CF37 F0 01        BEQ $CF3A                       ; Small Mario: leave X alone
$00:CF39 E8           INX                             ; Big/cape/fire: X += 1
$00:CF3A BD A1 CE     LDA.W $CEA1,X                   ; \
$00:CF3D 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Mario direction = $CEA1[X] (spin makes Mario face left/right in turn)
$00:CF3F A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:CF41 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; |
$00:CF43 D0 03        BNE $CF48                       ; |
$00:CF45 20 44 D0     JSR.W $D044                     ; / Cape Mario: set the cape interaction point ($D044)
$00:CF48 BD 99 CE     LDA.W $CE99,X                   ; \
$00:CF4B 4C 1A D0     JMP.W $D01A                     ; / A = $CE99[X] (spin pose), go store it as Mario's pose ($D01A)

$00:CF4E AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \
$00:CF51 F0 0F        BEQ $CF62                       ; |
$00:CF53 10 30        BPL $CF85                       ; / [$13ED] = 0: go to $CF62; 1-$7F: use it as the pose ($CF85)
$00:CF55 AD E1 13     LDA.W $13E1                     ; \
$00:CF58 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:CF59 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:CF5A 05 76        ORA RAM_MarioDirection          ; |
$00:CF5C A8           TAY                             ; / Y = ([$13E1] >> 2) | direction (sliding on a slope)
$00:CF5D B9 7F CE     LDA.W $CE7F,Y                   ; A = slide pose $CE7F[Y]
$00:CF60 80 23        BRA $CF85                       ; Go store the pose

$00:CF62 A9 3C        LDA.B #$3C                      ; \
$00:CF64 AC 8F 14     LDY.W $148F                     ; |
$00:CF67 F0 02        BEQ $CF6B                       ; |
$00:CF69 A9 1D        LDA.B #$1D                      ; / A = $3C (probably ducking pose), or $1D if carrying an item ([$148F] != 0)
$00:CF6B A4 73        LDY RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$00:CF6D D0 16        BNE $CF85                       ; / Ducking while jumping: use that pose ($CF85)
$00:CF6F AD 9C 14     LDA.W RAM_FireballImgTimer      ; \
$00:CF72 F0 0A        BEQ $CF7E                       ; / Fireball pose timer = 0: go to $CF7E
$00:CF74 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; A = $3F: probably throwing-fireball pose on the ground
$00:CF76 A4 72        LDY RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:CF78 F0 0B        BEQ $CF85                       ; / On the ground: use $3F
$00:CF7A A9 16        LDA.B #$16                      ; \
$00:CF7C 80 07        BRA $CF85                       ; / In the air: A = $16 instead, use it

$00:CF7E A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; A = $0E: kick pose
$00:CF80 AC 9A 14     LDY.W RAM_KickImgTimer          ; \
$00:CF83 F0 03        BEQ $CF88                       ; / Kick timer = 0: go on to $CF88, else fall into the store
$00:CF85 4C 1A D0     JMP.W $D01A                     ; Use A as Mario's pose: go to $D01A

$00:CF88 A9 1D        LDA.B #$1D                      ; A = $1D: pick-up pose
$00:CF8A AC 98 14     LDY.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer        ; \
$00:CF8D D0 F6        BNE $CF85                       ; / Pick-up timer non-zero: use that pose
$00:CF8F A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; A = $0F: facing-the-camera pose
$00:CF91 AC 99 14     LDY.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; \
$00:CF94 D0 EF        BNE $CF85                       ; / Face-camera timer non-zero: use that pose
$00:CF96 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0: default pose
$00:CF98 AE C2 18     LDX.W $18C2                     ; X = [$18C2] (purpose unknown)
$00:CF9B D0 26        BNE MarioAnimNoAbs1             ; Non-zero: go to MarioAnimNoAbs1 (A = 0, acts as standing still)
$00:CF9D A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:CF9F F0 16        BEQ $CFB7                       ; / On the ground: go to $CFB7
$00:CFA1 AC A0 14     LDY.W $14A0                     ; \
$00:CFA4 D0 16        BNE $CFBC                       ; / [$14A0] non-zero: go to the walk animation code ($CFBC)
$00:CFA6 AC 07 14     LDY.W $1407                     ; Y = [$1407] (cape flight phase)
$00:CFA9 F0 03        BEQ $CFAE                       ; Zero: keep A = 0
$00:CFAB B9 78 CE     LDA.W $CE78,Y                   ; A = table at $00CE78[Y] (cape flying pose)
$00:CFAE AC 8F 14     LDY.W $148F                     ; \
$00:CFB1 F0 67        BEQ $D01A                       ; / Not carrying anything: use A as the pose
$00:CFB3 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:CFB5 80 63        BRA $D01A                       ; / Carrying an item in the air: pose $09

$00:CFB7 AD DD 13     LDA.W RAM_ChangingDir           ; \
$00:CFBA D0 5E        BNE $D01A                       ; / Turning around: keep pose 0
$00:CFBC A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:CFBE 10 03        BPL MarioAnimNoAbs1             ; |
$00:CFC0 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:CFC2 1A           INC A                           ; / A = |Mario X speed| (also entered by JSL from DoorPipeAni)

;;; $CFC3: Walk animation frame counter (MarioAnimNoAbs1) ;;;
;; Takes A = |X speed|. If standing still, resets the walk frame (or sets 'looking up' pose offset 3 when Up
;;     is held).
;; Otherwise counts the walk frame [$13DB] down whenever the animation timer [$1496] has run out and reloads
;;     the timer from
;; $DC7C (shorter timer at higher speeds). Leaves the new frame in B for Remember.
$00:CFC3 AA           TAX                             ; X = |X speed|
$00:CFC4 D0 0E        BNE $CFD4                       ; Moving: go to $CFD4
$00:CFC6 EB           XBA                             ; Stash A (= 0) in B: walk frame resets to 0
$00:CFC7 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:CFC9 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$00:CFCB F0 35        BEQ $D002                       ; / Up not held: go to $D002
$00:CFCD A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:CFCF 8D DE 13     STA.W $13DE                     ; |
$00:CFD2 80 2E        BRA $D002                       ; / Up held: pose offset [$13DE] = 3 (looking up), go to $D002

$00:CFD4 A5 86        LDA $86                         ; \
$00:CFD6 F0 0B        BEQ $CFE3                       ; / Level not slippery ([$86] = 0): go to $CFE3
$00:CFD8 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:CFDA 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:CFDC F0 25        BEQ $D003                       ; / Left/Right not held: go to $D003 (A = 0)
$00:CFDE A9 68        LDA.B #$68                      ; \
$00:CFE0 8D E5 13     STA.W $13E5                     ; / [$13E5] = $68: animation speed class used in slippery levels
$00:CFE3 AD DB 13     LDA.W $13DB                     ; A = [$13DB] (walk frame number)
$00:CFE6 AC 96 14     LDY.W $1496                     ; \
$00:CFE9 D0 18        BNE $D003                       ; / Animation timer [$1496] non-zero: keep the frame, go to $D003
$00:CFEB 3A           DEC A                           ; Previous walk frame: A -= 1
$00:CFEC 10 05        BPL $CFF3                       ; \
$00:CFEE A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$00:CFF0 B9 78 DC     LDA.W NumWalkingFrames,Y        ; / Underflow: wrap to NumWalkingFrames[power-up] (last frame)
$00:CFF3 EB           XBA                             ; Stash the frame number in B
$00:CFF4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:CFF5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:CFF6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:CFF7 4A           LSR                             ; / A = |X speed| / 8
$00:CFF8 0D E5 13     ORA.W $13E5                     ; \
$00:CFFB A8           TAY                             ; / Y = A | [$13E5]
$00:CFFC B9 7C DC     LDA.W $DC7C,Y                   ; A = $DC7C[Y]: frames to show the next walk frame (shorter when faster)
$00:CFFF 8D 96 14     STA.W $1496                     ; Animation timer [$1496] = A

;;; $D002: Finish pose: add offsets, store frame (Remember) ;;;
;; Parameters: A = walk frame, X = |X speed|.
;; Stores the walk frame in [$13DB], adds the pose offset [$13DE] (+7 carrying an item, +4 when fast), then
;;     handles the 45 degree
;; slope poses. Entries at $D01A (A = final pose) and $D003 are jumped to from the code above.
; You can get somewhere quick by pressing ctrl+f and typing in the address.

$00:D002 EB           XBA                             ; A = new walk frame (swap B back into A)
$00:D003 8D DB 13     STA.W $13DB                     ; Walk frame [$13DB] = A
$00:D006 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:D007 6D DE 13     ADC.W $13DE                     ; / A += [$13DE] (pose offset: walking, running...)
$00:D00A AC 8F 14     LDY.W $148F                     ; \
$00:D00D F0 05        BEQ $D014                       ; |
$00:D00F 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D010 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; |
$00:D012 80 06        BRA $D01A                       ; / Carrying an item: A += 7, go to $D01A

$00:D014 E0 2F        CPX.B #$2F                      ; \
$00:D016 90 02        BCC $D01A                       ; |
$00:D018 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; / |X speed| >= $2F (running): A += 4 (carry is set)
$00:D01A AC E3 13     LDY.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; \
$00:D01D F0 11        BEQ MarioAnimNo45               ; / Not on a 45 degree slope: go to MarioAnimNo45
$00:D01F 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:D020 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$00:D022 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Mario direction = [RAM_WallWalkStatus] & 1
$00:D024 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$00:D026 C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; |
$00:D028 90 06        BCC MarioAnimNo45               ; / Status < 6: pose = $10, go store it
$00:D02A AD DB 13     LDA.W $13DB                     ; \
$00:D02D 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D02E 69 11        ADC.B #$11                      ; / Status >= 6: pose = [$13DB] + $11

;;; $D030: Store Mario pose and return (MarioAnimNo45) ;;;
;; Writes A to MarioFrame and returns (RTL), ending the pose selector.
$00:D030 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; Mario pose [MarioFrame] = A
$00:D033 6B           RTL                             ; Return



;;; $D034..D03C: Table: cape interaction offsets ;;;
;; Two tables of four 16-bit offsets from Mario's position, indexed by 2 * A; used by $D044 for the cape
;;     hit point.
$00:D034              .db $0C,$00,$F4,$FF,$08,$00,$F8,$FF ; Cape point X offsets, 16-bit words: +$0C, -$0C, +$08, -$08
$00:D03C              .db $10,$00,$10,$00,$02,$00,$02,$00 ; Cape point Y offsets, 16-bit words: $10, $10, 2, 2


;;; $D044: Cape hit point, cape spin and fireball input ;;;
;; $D044: sets the cape interaction point [$13E9]/[$13EB] from Mario's position plus a table offset.
;; $D062: called each frame; Cape Mario starts a spin ([$14A6] = $12) when Y is pressed (not ducking, on Yoshi
;;     or already spinning).
;; Fire Mario shoots a fireball when Y is pressed, or alternately left and right every 16 frames while spin
;;     jumping.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:CF45: Choose Mario pose: spin, slide, duck, walk (lbl14A2Not0)
;;     $00:DB8C: Mario climbing, tile and position tables (ClimbPunchingImgs)
$00:D044 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; \
$00:D046 8C E8 13     STY.W $13E8                     ; / Cape interaction flag [$13E8] = 1
$00:D049 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:D04A A8           TAY                             ; / Y = A * 2 (word index)
$00:D04B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:D04D A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:D04F 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D050 79 34 D0     ADC.W $D034,Y                   ; |
$00:D053 8D E9 13     STA.W $13E9                     ; / Cape interaction X [$13E9] = Mario X + $D034[Y]
$00:D056 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:D058 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D059 79 3C D0     ADC.W $D03C,Y                   ; |
$00:D05C 8D EB 13     STA.W $13EB                     ; / Cape interaction Y [$13EB] = Mario Y + $D03C[Y]
$00:D05F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:D061 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:D062 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:D064 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; |
$00:D066 D0 19        BNE $D081                       ; / Not cape Mario: go to $D081
$00:D068 24 16        BIT $16                         ; \
$00:D06A 50 41        BVC $D0AD                       ; / Y not newly pressed: return
$00:D06C A5 73        LDA RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$00:D06E 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$00:D071 0D 0D 14     ORA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; |
$00:D074 D0 37        BNE $D0AD                       ; / Ducking, on Yoshi or spin jumping: return
$00:D076 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$00:D078 8D A6 14     STA.W $14A6                     ; / Cape spin timer [$14A6] = $12 (start cape spin)
$00:D07B A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:D07D 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $04 on $1DFC
$00:D080 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:D081 C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$00:D083 D0 28        BNE $D0AD                       ; / Not Fire Mario: return
$00:D085 A5 73        LDA RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$00:D087 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$00:D08A D0 21        BNE $D0AD                       ; / Ducking or on Yoshi: return
$00:D08C 24 16        BIT $16                         ; \
$00:D08E 70 1A        BVS $D0AA                       ; / Y newly pressed: shoot a fireball ($D0AA)
$00:D090 AD 0D 14     LDA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; \
$00:D093 F0 18        BEQ $D0AD                       ; / Not spin jumping: return
$00:D095 EE E2 13     INC.W $13E2                     ; \
$00:D098 AD E2 13     LDA.W $13E2                     ; |
$00:D09B 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$00:D09D D0 0E        BNE $D0AD                       ; / Spin jump: count frames in [$13E2], act only every 16th frame
$00:D09F A8           TAY                             ; Y = 0
$00:D0A0 AD E2 13     LDA.W $13E2                     ; \
$00:D0A3 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$00:D0A5 F0 01        BEQ $D0A8                       ; |
$00:D0A7 C8           INY                             ; / Y = bit 4 of the counter (alternates every 16 frames)
$00:D0A8 84 76        STY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Mario direction = Y (fireballs alternate left and right)
$00:D0AA 20 A8 FE     JSR.W ShootFireball             ; Shoot a fireball (ShootFireball)
$00:D0AD 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D0AE..D0AE: Unused data ;;;
$00:D0AE              .db $7C,$00,$80,$00,$00,$06,$00,$01 ; Unused data, purpose unknown


;;; $D0B6: Mario animation 9: death (MarioDeathAni) ;;;
;; Sets the death pose and counts down the death timer [$1496] (every 4 frames). When it expires: exits the
;;     level with no event
;; ([$0DD5] = $80), loses Yoshi, takes a life and chooses Game Over, Time Up or fade to overworld.
$00:D0B6 64 19        STZ RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Power-up = 0 (small)
$00:D0B8 A9 3E        LDA.B #$3E                      ; \
$00:D0BA 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / Mario pose = $3E (death pose)
$00:D0BD A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:D0BF 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:D0C1 D0 03        BNE $D0C6                       ; |
$00:D0C3 CE 96 14     DEC.W $1496                     ; / Every 4th frame: [$1496] -= 1 (death timer)
$00:D0C6 AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:D0C9 D0 3D        BNE DeathNotDone                ; / Timer non-zero: go to DeathNotDone
$00:D0CB A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:D0CD 8D D5 0D     STA.W $0DD5                     ; / [$0DD5] = $80: leave the level with no exit event
$00:D0D0 AD 9B 1B     LDA.W $1B9B                     ; \
$00:D0D3 D0 03        BNE $D0D8                       ; / [$1B9B] set: skip clearing
$00:D0D5 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; Clear [RAM_OWHasYoshi] (Yoshi is lost on death)
$00:D0D8 CE BE 0D     DEC.W RAM_StatusLives           ; Lives -= 1
$00:D0DB 10 09        BPL DeathNotGameOver            ; Lives still >= 0: go to DeathNotGameOver
$00:D0DD A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$00:D0DF 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request $0A on $1DFB (probably Game Over music)
$00:D0E2 A2 14        LDX.B #$14                      ; X = $14: death message = GAME OVER
$00:D0E4 80 0F        BRA DeathShowMessage            ; Show the message


;;; $D0E6: Death: choose fade to overworld or Time Up (DeathNotGameOver) ;;;
;; Y = game mode $0B (fade to overworld) unless the level timer ran out, in which case X = $1D (TIME UP
;;     message) is used.
$00:D0E6 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: game mode = fade to overworld
$00:D0E8 AD 31 0F     LDA.W $0F31                     ; \
$00:D0EB 0D 32 0F     ORA.W $0F32                     ; |
$00:D0EE 0D 33 0F     ORA.W $0F33                     ; |
$00:D0F1 D0 11        BNE DeathNotTimeUp              ; / Level time digits [$0F31]-[$0F33] non-zero: go to $D104
$00:D0F3 A2 1D        LDX.B #$1D                      ; X = $1D: death message = TIME UP

;;; $D0F5: Death: start the message and set game mode (DeathShowMessage) ;;;
;; Parameters: X = message number ($14 GAME OVER, $1D TIME UP), Y = game mode to switch to.
;; Sets the message number, animation and timer, then game mode $15 (fade to Game Over).
$00:D0F5 8E 3B 14     STX.W $143B                     ; Death message [$143B] = X
$00:D0F8 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$00:D0FA 8D 3C 14     STA.W $143C                     ; / Death message animation [$143C] = $C0
$00:D0FD A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:D0FF 8D 3D 14     STA.W $143D                     ; / Death message timer [$143D] = $FF
$00:D102 A0 15        LDY.B #$15                      ; Y = $15: game mode = fade to Game Over

;;; $D104: Death: set game mode and return (DeathNotTimeUp) ;;;
;; Game mode = Y.
$00:D104 8C 00 01     STY.W RAM_GameMode              ; Game mode = Y
$00:D107 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $D108: Death: Mario falls, flips pose (DeathNotDone) ;;;
;; While the death timer is < $26 Mario's X speed is zeroed, Y speed is applied and the death pose flips
;;     left/right every 4 frames.
$00:D108 C9 26        CMP.B #$26                      ; \
$00:D10A B0 10        BCS DeathNotDoneEnd             ; / Death timer >= $26: return (Mario hangs in place first)
$00:D10C 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$00:D10E 20 2D DC     JSR.W $DC2D                     ; Apply Mario Y speed ($DC2D)
$00:D111 20 2E D9     JSR.W $D92E                     ; Update Mario Y speed ($D92E)
$00:D114 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:D116 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D117 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D118 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$00:D11A 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Mario direction = bit 2 of frame counter (flips every 4 frames)

;;; $D11C: Return (DeathNotDoneEnd) ;;;
$00:D11C 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D11D: Table: Mario poses while changing size (GrowingAniImgs) ;;;
$00:D11D              .db $00,$3D,$00,$3D,$00,$3D,$46,$3D ; Pose numbers used while changing size, indexed by timer / 4
$00:D125              .db $46,$3D,$46,$3D             ; (continued)


;;; $D129: Mario animation 1: power down (PowerDownAni) ;;;
;; Counts [$1496] down, showing poses from GrowingAniImgs. When it reaches 0, starts the invincibility flash
;;     ([$1497] = $7F) and
;; ends the animation.
$00:D129 AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:D12C F0 12        BEQ $D140                       ; / Animation timer [$1496] = 0: finished, go to $D140
$00:D12E 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:D12F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D130 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = timer / 4
$00:D131 B9 1D D1     LDA.W GrowingAniImgs,Y          ; \
$00:D134 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / Mario pose = GrowingAniImgs[Y]
$00:D137 AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:D13A F0 03        BEQ $D13F                       ; / Timer = 0: return
$00:D13C CE 96 14     DEC.W $1496                     ; Timer -= 1
$00:D13F 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:D140 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$00:D142 8D 97 14     STA.W $1497                     ; / Invincibility flash timer [$1497] = $7F (about 2 seconds)
$00:D145 80 11        BRA $D158                       ; Go end the animation and unlock sprites ($D158)


;;; $D147: Mario animation 2: mushroom power up (MushroomAni) ;;;
;; Plays the grow poses in reverse as [$1496] counts down; then power-up += 1 and the animation ends.
$00:D147 AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:D14A F0 0A        BEQ $D156                       ; / Timer = 0: done, go to $D156
$00:D14C 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:D14D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D14E 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:D150 1A           INC A                           ; |
$00:D151 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D152 69 0B        ADC.B #$0B                      ; / Y = $0B - timer / 4 (poses played in reverse)
$00:D154 80 DA        BRA $D130                       ; Go look up the pose ($D130)

$00:D156 E6 19        INC RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Power-up += 1
$00:D158 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:D15A 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation [RAM_MarioAnimation] = 0 (none)
$00:D15C 64 9D        STZ RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Unlock sprites
$00:D15E 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $D15F: Mario animation 3: cape power up (CapeAni) ;;;
;; Hides Mario under the smoke puff. When the timer ends: small/big go to the flash code, cape/fire end the
;;     animation directly.
$00:D15F A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$00:D161 85 78        STA $78                         ; / [$78] = $7F: hide Mario (smoke puff)
$00:D163 CE 96 14     DEC.W $1496                     ; Timer [$1496] -= 1
$00:D166 D0 F6        BNE $D15E                       ; Not finished: return
$00:D168 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:D16A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D16B F0 D3        BEQ $D140                       ; / Small or big Mario: go to $D140 (flash)
$00:D16D D0 E9        BNE $D158                       ; Cape or fire: go to $D158 (no flash)

;;; $D16F: Mario animation 4: flower power up (FlowerAni) ;;;
;; Cancels cape flight and sliding, resets the pose, and counts down the flashing palette timer. Ends the
;;     animation when it is 0.
$00:D16F AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \
$00:D172 29 80        AND.B #$80                      ; |
$00:D174 0D 07 14     ORA.W $1407                     ; |
$00:D177 F0 0E        BEQ $D187                       ; / [$13ED] bit 7 and [$1407] both clear: go to $D187
$00:D179 9C 07 14     STZ.W $1407                     ; Cape flight phase [$1407] = 0
$00:D17C AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \
$00:D17F 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; |
$00:D181 8D ED 13     STA.W $13ED                     ; / Clear bit 7 of [$13ED]
$00:D184 9C E0 13     STZ.W MarioFrame                ; Mario pose = 0
