$00:D187 CE 9B 14     DEC.W RAM_FlashingPalTimer      ; Flashing palette timer -= 1
$00:D18A F0 CC        BEQ $D158                       ; Done: go to $D158
$00:D18C 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D18D: Table: pipe X speeds (left, right) (PipeSpeedX) ;;;
$00:D18D              .db $F8,$08                     ; X speed for pipe direction 0 (left), 1 (right)


;;; $D18F: Table: pipe Y speeds (PipeSpeedY) ;;;
$00:D18F              .db $00,$00,$F0                 ; Pipe speed bytes: $00,$00 (X speed for up/down), $F0 (Y speed, up)

$00:D192              .db $10                         ; Y speed for down pipe


;;; $D193: Table: Mario hide values by pipe type (HIDEPIPESETS) ;;;
$00:D193              .db $00,$63,$1C,$00             ; Values for [$78] by pipe type, indexed [$89] / 2 + 1


;;; $D197: Mario animation 5: horizontal pipe (DoorPipeAni) ;;;
;; Ignores the controller, picks a walking pose, centers Mario on the pipe tile vertically, handles the face-
;;     camera timer and hides
;; Mario while he moves through the pipe. Shares its tail with VertPipeAni ($D22D). Helper at $D1F4 ticks
;;     [$14A2] and the animation timer.
$00:D197 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Ignore controller input (NoButtons)
$00:D19A 9C DE 13     STZ.W $13DE                     ; Pose offset [$13DE] = 0
$00:D19D 22 B1 CE 00  JSL.L $CEB1                     ; Run the pose selection start ($CEB1)
$00:D1A1 22 BC CF 00  JSL.L $CFBC                     ; Pick a walking pose from the X speed (enters at $CFBC)
$00:D1A5 20 F4 D1     JSR.W $D1F4                     ; Tick timers ($D1F4)
$00:D1A8 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:D1AB F0 05        BEQ $D1B2                       ; / Not on Yoshi: skip
$00:D1AD A9 29        LDA.B #$29                      ; \
$00:D1AF 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / On Yoshi: pose $29 (entering horizontal pipe)
$00:D1B2 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:D1B4 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:D1B6 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:D1B7 E9 08 00     SBC.W #$0008                    ; |
$00:D1BA 29 F0 FF     AND.W #$FFF0                    ; |
$00:D1BD 09 0E 00     ORA.W #$000E                    ; |
$00:D1C0 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y = ((Y - 8) & $FFF0) | $0E (center on the pipe)
$00:D1C2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:D1C4 A5 89        LDA $89                         ; \
$00:D1C6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D1C7 A8           TAY                             ; |
$00:D1C8 C8           INY                             ; / Y = [$89] / 2 + 1 (pipe type index)
$00:D1C9 B9 92 D1     LDA.W $D192,Y                   ; A = $D192[Y]
$00:D1CC AE 8F 14     LDX.W $148F                     ; \
$00:D1CF F0 0A        BEQ $D1DB                       ; / Not carrying: go to $D1DB
$00:D1D1 49 1C        EOR.B #$1C                      ; Carrying: A ^= $1C
$00:D1D3 CE 99 14     DEC.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; \
$00:D1D6 10 03        BPL $D1DB                       ; |
$00:D1D8 EE 99 14     INC.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; / Face-camera timer -= 1, but not below 0
$00:D1DB A6 88        LDX $88                         ; \
$00:D1DD E0 1D        CPX.B #$1D                      ; |
$00:D1DF B0 0F        BCS $D1F0                       ; / Pipe timer [$88] >= $1D: go store A to [$78] ($D1F0)
$00:D1E1 C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; \
$00:D1E3 90 08        BCC $D1ED                       ; / Y < 3: skip the Y adjustment
$00:D1E5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:D1E7 E6 96        INC RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:D1E9 E6 96        INC RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y += 2
$00:D1EB E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:D1ED B9 93 D1     LDA.W HIDEPIPESETS,Y            ; A = HIDEPIPESETS[Y]
$00:D1F0 85 78        STA $78                         ; [$78] = A (hide Mario for the pipe)
$00:D1F2 80 39        BRA $D22D                       ; Go to the shared pipe code ($D22D)

$00:D1F4 AD A2 14     LDA.W $14A2                     ; \
$00:D1F7 F0 03        BEQ $D1FC                       ; |
$00:D1F9 CE A2 14     DEC.W $14A2                     ; / Decrement [$14A2] if non-zero
$00:D1FC 4C 37 D1     JMP.W $D137                     ; Go decrement the animation timer ($D137)



;;; $D1FF: Table: pipe X center targets (PipeCntrBoundryX) ;;;
$00:D1FF              .db $0A,$06                     ; Mario X & $F targets for centering on a pipe: direction 0 = $0A, 1 = $06


;;; $D201: Table: pipe centering speed (PipeCntringSpeed) ;;;
$00:D201              .db $FF,$01                     ; X nudge per frame: -1 or +1


;;; $D203: Mario animation 6: vertical pipe (VertPipeAni) ;;;
;; Handles all pipe travel (vertical and horizontal). Centers Mario on Yoshi, sets pose, fakes X/Y held, puts
;;     Mario behind scenery,
;; sets his speed from [$89] & 3 while the timer [$88] counts down, hides him when it ends, and then either
;;     finishes (leaving a pipe)
;; or loads the next level (game mode $0F, entering a pipe). $D27C is unused.
$00:D203 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Ignore controller input (NoButtons)
$00:D206 9C DF 13     STZ.W $13DF                     ; Cape image [$13DF] = 0
$00:D209 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$00:D20B AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$00:D20E F0 1A        BEQ $D22A                       ; / A = $0F (facing camera); not on Yoshi: use it ($D22A)
$00:D210 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: nudge index
$00:D212 A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Y = Mario direction
$00:D214 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:D216 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$00:D218 D9 FF D1     CMP.W PipeCntrBoundryX,Y        ; / Compare [X pos] & $F with PipeCntrBoundryX[Y]
$00:D21B F0 0B        BEQ $D228                       ; Equal: centered, go to $D228
$00:D21D 10 01        BPL $D220                       ; At or past the target: nudge left (X = 0)
$00:D21F E8           INX                             ; Before the target: X = 1 (nudge right)
$00:D220 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:D222 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D223 7D 01 D2     ADC.W PipeCntringSpeed,X        ; |
$00:D226 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X += PipeCntringSpeed[X]
$00:D228 A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; A = $21: pose going down a pipe on Yoshi
$00:D22A 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; Mario pose = A
$00:D22D A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$00:D22F 85 15        STA RAM_ControllerA             ; / Fake controller input: X/Y held
$00:D231 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:D233 8D F9 13     STA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; / Behind-scenery flag = 2
$00:D236 A5 89        LDA $89                         ; \
$00:D238 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; |
$00:D23A A4 88        LDY $88                         ; |
$00:D23C F0 2A        BEQ $D268                       ; / C = [$89] >= 4 (leaving a pipe); Y = [$88]: timer 0: go to $D268
$00:D23E 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$00:D240 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$89] & 3 (0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down)
$00:D241 C6 88        DEC $88                         ; Pipe timer [$88] -= 1
$00:D243 D0 09        BNE $D24E                       ; \
$00:D245 B0 07        BCS $D24E                       ; / Still counting or leaving: go to $D24E
$00:D247 A9 7F        LDA.B #$7F                      ; \
$00:D249 85 78        STA $78                         ; / [$78] = $7F: hide Mario
$00:D24B EE 05 14     INC.W $1405                     ; [$1405] += 1 (probably marks the pipe entry as done)
$00:D24E A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:D250 05 7D        ORA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; |
$00:D252 D0 05        BNE $D259                       ; |
$00:D254 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; |
$00:D256 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Mario not moving yet: play sound $04 on $1DF9 (pipe)
$00:D259 B9 8D D1     LDA.W PipeSpeedX,Y              ; \
$00:D25C 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = PipeSpeedX[Y]
$00:D25E B9 8F D1     LDA.W PipeSpeedY,Y              ; \
$00:D261 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = PipeSpeedY[Y]
$00:D263 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Not flying
$00:D265 4C 2D DC     JMP.W $DC2D                     ; Apply the speed ($DC2D), return

$00:D268 90 09        BCC $D273                       ; Entering a pipe: go to $D273 to load the next level
$00:D26A 9C F9 13     STZ.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; \
$00:D26D 9C 19 14     STZ.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; / Clear behind-scenery and Yoshi-in-pipe flags
$00:D270 4C 58 D1     JMP.W $D158                     ; End the animation and unlock sprites ($D158)

$00:D273 EE 1A 14     INC.W $141A                     ; \
$00:D276 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; |
$00:D278 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / [$141A] += 1 and game mode = $0F (load level)
$00:D27B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:D27C A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Unused code: [$88] += Mario Y - [$D3]
$00:D27E 38           SEC                             ;  |
$00:D27F E5 D3        SBC $D3                         ;  |
$00:D281 18           CLC                             ;  |
$00:D282 65 88        ADC $88                         ;  |
$00:D284 85 88        STA $88                         ;  |
$00:D286 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $D287: Mario animation 7: shot from pipe cannon (PipeCannonAni) ;;;
;; Flies Mario out of a diagonal pipe at X speed $40, Y speed $C0 while the timer [$88] counts down. Plays a
;;     sound at $18 and then
;; puts Mario in front of the scenery, unlocks sprites; finishes like leaving a pipe.
$00:D287 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Ignore controller input (NoButtons)
$00:D28A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:D28C 8D F9 13     STA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; / Behind-scenery flag = 2
$00:D28F A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$00:D291 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / [RAM_IsFlying] = $0C (airborne)
$00:D293 20 8B CD     JSR.W $CD8B                     ; Pose selection ($CD8B)
$00:D296 C6 88        DEC $88                         ; Timer [$88] -= 1
$00:D298 D0 03        BNE $D29D                       ; Not 0: go to $D29D
$00:D29A 4C 6A D2     JMP.W $D26A                     ; Timer ran out: finish like leaving a pipe ($D26A)

$00:D29D A5 88        LDA $88                         ; \
$00:D29F C9 18        CMP.B #$18                      ; |
$00:D2A1 90 07        BCC $D2AA                       ; |
$00:D2A3 D0 0D        BNE $D2B2                       ; / Timer < $18: go to $D2AA; > $18: go to $D2B2
$00:D2A5 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:D2A7 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $09 on $1DFC (probably the cannon blast)
$00:D2AA 9C F9 13     STZ.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; \
$00:D2AD 9C 19 14     STZ.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; |
$00:D2B0 64 9D        STZ RAM_SpritesLocked           ; / Behind-scenery flag = 0, Yoshi-in-pipe = 0, sprites unlocked
$00:D2B2 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; \
$00:D2B4 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / Mario X speed = $40
$00:D2B6 A9 C0        LDA.B #$C0                      ; \
$00:D2B8 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $C0 (up)
$00:D2BA 4C 2D DC     JMP.W $DC2D                     ; Apply the speed ($DC2D)

;;; $D5EA: Mario X speed on ground, jump start (00D5EA) ;;;
;; Handles Mario's horizontal movement and the start of a jump. Starts a normal or spin jump when B or A is
;;     pressed, sets the Y speed
;; from the X speed, turns Mario around, picks the max speed/acceleration from the slope, run state and
;;     direction, and adds acceleration
;; or deceleration to Mario X speed ([$7A]/[RAM_MarioSpeedX]). Also updates the dash timer [$13E4] (P-meter).
;; Contains several tables: dash timer steps, cape-flight slope values, spin jump timer values. Part of the
;;     DATA at $00D5EA is the end of the autoslide speed table.
$00:D5EA              .db $F8                         ; Last byte of the autoslide speed table at $00D5C9

$00:D5EB              .db $FF,$FF,$02                 ; Dash timer step by state: $FF = -1 (walking), $FF = -1 (run held, slow), $02 = +2 (running fast)

$00:D5EE              .db $68,$70                     ; Slope value [$13E1] forced while cape flying: $68 facing left, $70 facing right

$00:D5F0              .db $1C,$0C                     ; [$13E2] set at spin jump start: $1C facing left, $0C facing right

$00:D5F2 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D5F4 F0 03        BEQ $D5F9                       ; / In the air: skip the jump start checks
$00:D5F6 4C 82 D6     JMP.W $D682                     ; Go to the air/slide handling

$00:D5F9 64 73        STZ RAM_IsDucking               ; Not ducking (reset every frame on the ground)
$00:D5FB AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \
$00:D5FE D0 0B        BNE $D60B                       ; / Already sliding down a slope: do not check for a new duck-slide
$00:D600 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:D602 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Down not held: skip ahead
$00:D604 F0 05        BEQ $D60B                       ; /
$00:D606 85 73        STA RAM_IsDucking               ; Down held: [RAM_IsDucking] = 4 (non-zero, ducking)
$00:D608 9C E8 13     STZ.W $13E8                     ; Cancel the cape interaction with sprites
$00:D60B AD 71 14     LDA.W $1471                     ; \

$00:D610 F0 0C        BEQ $D61E                       ; /

$00:D614 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Blocked from above: skip the jump check
$00:D616 D0 06        BNE $D61E                       ; /
$00:D618 A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$00:D61A 05 18        ORA $18                         ; } B or A newly pressed: start a jump at $00D630
$00:D61C 30 12        BMI $D630                       ; /
$00:D61E A5 73        LDA RAM_IsDucking               ; \
$00:D620 F0 60        BEQ $D682                       ; / Not ducking: go to the air/slide handling
$00:D622 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \

$00:D626 A5 86        LDA $86                         ; \

$00:D638 4A           LSR                             ; |

$00:D640 AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \

$00:D645 1A           INC A                           ; \

$00:D64E A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; \

$00:D65B E8           INX                             ; X += 1: spin jump uses the next (odd) jump height entry

$00:D663 BD BD D2     LDA.W $D2BD,X                   ; \

$00:D66F 90 0C        BCC $D67D                       ; /

$00:D682 AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \

$00:D68B D0 24        BNE $D6B1                       ; /
$00:D68D AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \

$00:D692 20 4A FE     JSR.W $FE4A                     ; Spawn skid dust ($FE4A)
$00:D695 AD EE 13     LDA.W $13EE                     ; \

$00:D69D AD E1 13     LDA.W $13E1                     ; \

$00:D6A1 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = slope index >> 2

$00:D6A6 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:D6A7 4A           LSR                             ; |

$00:D6AB 4C 42 D7     JMP.W $D742                     ; Go to the speed limit/accelerate code

$00:D6B1 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; Not sliding any more

$00:D6B6 AC 07 14     LDY.W $1407                     ; \

$00:D6BF A4 16        LDY $16                         ; \

$00:D6C3 A6 76        LDX RAM_MarioDirection          ; X = facing direction
$00:D6C5 BC EE D5     LDY.W $D5EE,X                   ; \
$00:D6C8 8C E1 13     STY.W $13E1                     ; / [$13E1] = cape flight slope value for this direction

$00:D6CD 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:D6CE 0A           ASL                             ; |

$00:D6D5 A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Y = facing direction
$00:D6D7 C5 76        CMP RAM_MarioDirection          ; \

$00:D6DB AC 8F 14     LDY.W $148F                     ; \

$00:D6E0 AC 99 14     LDY.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; \

$00:D6E5 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; \
$00:D6E7 8C 99 14     STY.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; / Carrying: face the camera for 8 frames while turning
$00:D6EA 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; Face the held direction

$00:D6EE 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:D6EF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:D6F0 0D E1 13     ORA.W $13E1                     ; } X = direction << 2 | [$13E1]: acceleration table index
$00:D6F3 AA           TAX                             ; /

$00:D6FD AD A1 14     LDA.W $14A1                     ; \

$00:D702 A5 86        LDA $86                         ; \

$00:D706 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \

$00:D70B 20 4A FE     JSR.W $FE4A                     ; Spawn skid dust ($FE4A)
$00:D70E 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:D70F 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D710 69 90        ADC.B #$90                      ; } X += $90: use the skidding acceleration entries
$00:D712 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:D713 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: walking
$00:D715 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; \

$00:D719 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:D71A E8           INX                             ; } Run held: X += 2 (next acceleration set), Y = 1
$00:D71B C8           INY                             ; /
$00:D71C A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \

$00:D720 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = |speed|
$00:D722 1A           INC A                           ; /

$00:D727 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \

$00:D72B A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$00:D72D 8D A0 14     STA.W $14A0                     ; / On the ground: running animation timer [$14A0] = $10
$00:D730 80 04        BRA $D736                       ; Y += 1 (go to $00D736)

$00:D732 C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; \
$00:D734 D0 01        BNE $D737                       ; / In the air state $0C (full-speed jump): Y += 1, else skip
$00:D736 C8           INY                             ; Y += 1: Y = 2 means running at speed
$00:D737 20 6A D9     JSR.W $D96A                     ; Update the dash timer, add or subtract by Y
$00:D73A 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:D73B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:D73C 0D E1 13     ORA.W $13E1                     ; |
$00:D73F 05 01        ORA $01                         ; } Y = dash state << 1 | slope [$13E1] | direction [$01]: max speed index
$00:D741 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:D742 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:D744 38           SEC                             ; } A = speed - max speed[Y]
$00:D745 F9 35 D5     SBC.W $D535,Y                   ; /
$00:D748 F0 21        BEQ $D76B                       ; Exactly at max speed: go to the slowdown
$00:D74A 59 35 D5     EOR.W $D535,Y                   ; \
$00:D74D 10 1C        BPL $D76B                       ; / Same sign as max speed: exceeding it, go to the slowdown
$00:D74F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:D751 BD 45 D3     LDA.W MarioAccel?,X             ; A = acceleration table [X] (16-bit)
$00:D754 A4 86        LDY $86                         ; \
$00:D756 F0 07        BEQ $D75F                       ; / Not slippery: keep it
$00:D758 A4 72        LDY RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D75A D0 03        BNE $D75F                       ; } Slippery and on the ground: use the slippery accel table instead
$00:D75C BD 3D D4     LDA.W $D43D,X                   ; /
$00:D75F 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:D760 65 7A        ADC $7A                         ; / Mario X speed (16-bit [$7A]) += acceleration
$00:D762 80 3C        BRA $D7A0                       ; Store it and finish

$00:D764 20 68 D9     JSR.W $D968                     ; Update the dash timer (decrease)
$00:D767 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D769 D0 39        BNE $D7A4                       ; / In the air: return
$00:D76B AD E1 13     LDA.W $13E1                     ; A = slope index [$13E1]
$00:D76E 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:D76F A8           TAY                             ; |
$00:D770 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = slope >> 1, X = slope >> 2
$00:D771 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:D772 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \

$00:D775 FD CA D5     SBC.W $D5CA,X                   ; |

$00:D77B C8           INY                             ; /
$00:D77C AD 93 14     LDA.W $1493                     ; \
$00:D77F 05 72        ORA RAM_IsFlying                ; / Level ending or in the air: use the normal deceleration table
$00:D781 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:D783 D0 07        BNE $D78C                       ; Ending/in the air: go to $00D78C
$00:D785 B9 09 D3     LDA.W $D309,Y                   ; A = water deceleration table [Y]
$00:D788 24 85        BIT RAM_IsWaterLevel            ; \

$00:D792 85 7A        STA $7A                         ; /

$00:D795 FD C9 D5     SBC.W $D5C9,X                   ; |
$00:D798 59 CD D2     EOR.W $D2CD,Y                   ; } Reached or passed the autoslide target speed?
$00:D79B 30 05        BMI $D7A2                       ; /
$00:D79D BD C9 D5     LDA.W $D5C9,X                   ; Yes: clamp speed to the autoslide target
$00:D7A0 85 7A        STA $7A                         ; Store the new X speed
$00:D7A2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:D7A4 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $D7A5..D7AD: Table: Y acceleration (gravity) ;;;
;; Added to Mario Y speed each frame by state; index 3+ is used by cape flight phases.
$00:D7A5              .db $06,$03,$04,$10,$F4,$01,$03,$04 ; Y acceleration (gravity) by state: $06 fall, $03 jump held, $04 float, $10, then cape phases
$00:D7AD              .db $05,$06                     ; Cape flight phase 5 and 6 gravity


;;; $D7AF..D7B7: Table: max fall speed ;;;
$00:D7AF              .db $40,$40,$20,$40,$40,$40,$40,$40 ; Max fall speed: $40, $40, $20 (floating), rest $40
$00:D7B7              .db $40,$40


;;; $D7B9..D7C1: Table: cape and Yoshi wings float limits ;;;
$00:D7B9              .db $10,$C8,$E0,$02,$03,$03,$04,$03 ; Cape or winged Yoshi float speed limits: $10 slow fall, then rising limits
$00:D7C1              .db $02,$00,$01,$00,$00,$00,$00


;;; $D7C8..D7C8: Table: cape flight max fall speed ;;;
$00:D7C8              .db $01,$10,$30,$30,$38,$38,$40 ; Cape flight max fall speed by phase [$1407]


;;; $D7CF: Cape flight phase tables, then Mario Y speed (CapeSpeed) ;;;
;; CapeSpeed: phase step by pitch input. $00D7D4: target phase. $00D7D9: takeoff boost table.
;; Code from $00D7E4: Mario Y physics. Adds gravity, limits fall speed, handles cape takeoff and the 6 cape
;;     flight phases ([$1407]),
;; and floating with cape/winged Yoshi. Pitch input is set by held direction relative to facing; dash button
;;     released stops flight.
;; $00D94F: picks the takeoff boost [$1409] from the fall speed. $00D968/$00D96A: updates the dash timer
;;     [$13E4], capped at $70.
$00:D7CF              .db $FF,$01,$01,$FF,$FF         ; Phase step for [$1407] by pitch input X: -1, +1, +1, -1, -1

$00:D7D4              .db $01,$06,$03,$01,$00         ; Phase [$1407] target by pitch input X: 1, 6, 3, 1, 0

$00:D7D9              .db $00,$00,$00,$F8,$F8,$F8,$F4,$F0 ; Cape takeoff upward boost, indexed by fall speed / 8
$00:D7E1              .db $C8,$02,$01

$00:D7E4 AC 07 14     LDY.W $1407                     ; \
$00:D7E7 D0 3B        BNE $D824                       ; / Cape phase [$1407]: not flying yet?
$00:D7E9 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D7EB F0 24        BEQ $D811                       ; / On the ground: no takeoff
$00:D7ED AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$00:D7F0 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$00:D7F3 0D 0D 14     ORA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; } Carrying, on Yoshi or spin jumping: no cape flight
$00:D7F6 D0 19        BNE $D811                       ; /
$00:D7F8 AD ED 13     LDA.W $13ED                     ; \
$00:D7FB 30 02        BMI $D7FF                       ; } Sliding flag > 0: no takeoff
$00:D7FD D0 12        BNE $D811                       ; /
$00:D7FF 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; Clear the sliding flag
$00:D802 A6 19        LDX RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:D804 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; } Only caped Mario (power-up 2) can take off
$00:D806 D0 09        BNE $D811                       ; /
$00:D808 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D80A 30 05        BMI $D811                       ; / Must be falling (speed >= 0)
$00:D80C AD 9F 14     LDA.W $149F                     ; \
$00:D80F D0 03        BNE $D814                       ; / Cape takeoff timer [$149F] set: start cape flight at $00D814
$00:D811 4C CD D8     JMP.W $D8CD                     ; Normal gravity

$00:D814 64 73        STZ RAM_IsDucking               ; Not ducking
$00:D816 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:D818 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / [RAM_IsFlying] = $0B: rising
$00:D81A 9C 09 14     STZ.W $1409                     ; [$1409] = 0: upward boost, set by the next call
$00:D81D 20 4F D9     JSR.W $D94F                     ; Pick the takeoff boost from the fall speed
$00:D820 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; \
$00:D822 80 37        BRA $D85B                       ; / X = 2: pitch input 'level'

$00:D824 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; \
$00:D826 90 03        BCC $D82B                       ; } Already flying: phase >= 2, refresh the boost
$00:D828 20 4F D9     JSR.W $D94F                     ; /
$00:D82B AE 08 14     LDX.W $1408                     ; \
$00:D82E E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; } Previous pitch input [$1408] = 4 (dash released)?
$00:D830 F0 24        BEQ $D856                       ; /
$00:D832 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: default pitch input
$00:D834 A4 7D        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D836 30 1E        BMI $D856                       ; / Rising (negative Y speed): keep X = 3
$00:D838 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:D83A 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } A = held left/right bits
$00:D83C A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:D83D D0 0A        BNE $D849                       ; Direction held: go to $00D849
$00:D83F AD 07 14     LDA.W $1407                     ; \
$00:D842 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; |
$00:D844 B0 10        BCS $D856                       ; } No direction: phase >= 4 keeps X = 3, else X = 2

$00:D849 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:D84A A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; |
$00:D84C F0 02        BEQ $D850                       ; |
$00:D84E 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } X = 0 if holding away from facing, 1 if toward it (nose up/down)
$00:D850 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:D851 EC 08 14     CPX.W $1408                     ; \
$00:D854 D0 05        BNE $D85B                       ; / Pitch input unchanged: skip to timer check
$00:D856 AD A4 14     LDA.W $14A4                     ; \
$00:D859 D0 23        BNE $D87E                       ; / Phase timer [$14A4] still running: do not change phase yet
$00:D85B 24 15        BIT RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:D85D 70 02        BVS $D861                       ; } Dash button not held: X = 4 (stop flying)
$00:D85F A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; /
$00:D861 AD 07 14     LDA.W $1407                     ; \
$00:D864 DD D4 D7     CMP.W $D7D4,X                   ; } Target phase reached: skip
$00:D867 F0 15        BEQ $D87E                       ; /
$00:D869 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:D86A 7D CF D7     ADC.W CapeSpeed,X               ; } [$1407] += phase step[X]
$00:D86D 8D 07 14     STA.W $1407                     ; /
$00:D870 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; A = 8: frames until the next phase change
$00:D872 AC 09 14     LDY.W $1409                     ; \
$00:D875 C0 C8        CPY.B #$C8                      ; |
$00:D877 D0 02        BNE $D87B                       ; } Boost [$1409] = $C8: faster change (2 frames)
$00:D879 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; /
$00:D87B 8D A4 14     STA.W $14A4                     ; Set the phase timer [$14A4]
$00:D87E 8E 08 14     STX.W $1408                     ; Remember the pitch input in [$1408]
$00:D881 AC 07 14     LDY.W $1407                     ; \
$00:D884 F0 47        BEQ $D8CD                       ; / Y = phase; 0 = not cape flying: normal gravity
$00:D886 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D888 10 08        BPL $D892                       ; / Falling: skip the upward clamp
$00:D88A C9 C8        CMP.B #$C8                      ; \
$00:D88C B0 0C        BCS $D89A                       ; } Rising faster than $C8 speed: limit it to $C8
$00:D88E A9 C8        LDA.B #$C8                      ; /
$00:D890 80 08        BRA $D89A                       ; Go store

$00:D892 D9 C8 D7     CMP.W $D7C8,Y                   ; \
$00:D895 90 03        BCC $D89A                       ; } Clamp fall speed to max fall speed for this phase
$00:D897 B9 C8 D7     LDA.W $D7C8,Y                   ; /

$00:D89B C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; \
$00:D89D D0 27        BNE $D8C6                       ; / Phase 1 (rising start)?
$00:D89F AE 09 14     LDX.W $1409                     ; \
$00:D8A2 F0 20        BEQ $D8C4                       ; / [$1409] (cape boost) is 0: skip
$00:D8A4 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D8A6 30 07        BMI $D8AF                       ; |
$00:D8A8 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; } Not rising yet: play the cape rise sound
$00:D8AA 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; /
$00:D8AD 80 0A        BRA $D8B9                       ; Skip the boost compare

$00:D8AF CD 09 14     CMP.W $1409                     ; \
$00:D8B2 B0 05        BCS $D8B9                       ; / Rising faster than the boost? Then skip
$00:D8B4 86 7D        STX RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D8B6 9C 09 14     STZ.W $1409                     ; / Use the boost as Y speed and clear it
$00:D8B9 A6 76        LDX RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$00:D8BB A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / X = facing, A = X speed
$00:D8BD F0 05        BEQ $D8C4                       ; Standing still: no lift, use gravity index 2
$00:D8BF 5D 35 D5     EOR.W $D535,X                   ; \
$00:D8C2 10 02        BPL $D8C6                       ; / Moving backwards: no lift
$00:D8C4 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: phase gravity index
$00:D8C6 68           PLA                             ; A = clamped speed
$00:D8C7 C8           INY                             ; \
$00:D8C8 C8           INY                             ; } Y += 3: index into the gravity table
$00:D8C9 C8           INY                             ; /
$00:D8CA 4C 48 D9     JMP.W $D948                     ; Add gravity

$00:D8CD A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D8CF F0 57        BEQ $D928                       ; / In the air? If not, go to $00D928
$00:D8D1 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$00:D8D3 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:D8D6 F0 0F        BEQ $D8E7                       ; / Not on Yoshi: go to $00D8E7
$00:D8D8 AD 1E 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; \
$00:D8DB 4A           LSR                             ; } Yoshi has no wings: go to $00D8E7
$00:D8DC F0 09        BEQ $D8E7                       ; /
$00:D8DE A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; \
$00:D8E0 C4 19        CPY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; |
$00:D8E2 F0 01        BEQ $D8E5                       ; } X = 0 if caped, else 1 (controller byte to read)
$00:D8E4 E8           INX                             ; /
$00:D8E5 80 18        BRA $D8FF                       ; Go to the float timer

$00:D8E7 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:D8E9 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Needs cape power-up (2)
$00:D8EB D0 3B        BNE $D928                       ; /
$00:D8ED A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D8EF C9 0C        CMP.B #$0C                      ; } Not in air state $0C: go to $00D8FD
$00:D8F1 D0 0A        BNE $D8FD                       ; /
$00:D8F3 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; \
$00:D8F5 CC 9F 14     CPY.W $149F                     ; } Takeoff timer [$149F] >= 2: leave it
$00:D8F8 90 05        BCC $D8FF                       ; /
$00:D8FA EE 9F 14     INC.W $149F                     ; [$149F] += 1
$00:D8FD A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$00:D8FF AD A5 14     LDA.W $14A5                     ; \
$00:D902 D0 09        BNE $D90D                       ; / Float timer [$14A5] running: go to $00D90D
$00:D904 B5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA,X           ; \
$00:D906 10 1C        BPL $D924                       ; / Button not pressed: no float
$00:D908 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$00:D90A 8D A5 14     STA.W $14A5                     ; / Start float: [$14A5] = $10
$00:D90D A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D90F 10 0A        BPL $D91B                       ; / Y speed positive (falling)? go to $00D91B
$00:D911 BE B9 D7     LDX.W $D7B9,Y                   ; \
$00:D914 10 0E        BPL $D924                       ; / Rising: limit entry positive? then no float
$00:D916 D9 B9 D7     CMP.W $D7B9,Y                   ; \
$00:D919 90 09        BCC $D924                       ; / Rising slower than limit: no float
$00:D91B B9 B9 D7     LDA.W $D7B9,Y                   ; \
$00:D91E C5 7D        CMP RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; |
$00:D920 F0 2A        BEQ $D94C                       ; } Falling too fast: clamp to the float limit
$00:D922 30 28        BMI $D94C                       ; /
$00:D924 C0 02        CPY.B #$02                      ; \
$00:D926 F0 08        BEQ $D930                       ; / Y = 2 (winged Yoshi/cape): keep it
$00:D928 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: gravity index, jump held
$00:D92A A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:D92C 30 02        BMI $D930                       ; / B held: keep Y = 1
$00:D92E A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: gravity index, jump not held
$00:D930 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D932 30 14        BMI $D948                       ; / Rising: skip the fall limit
$00:D934 D9 AF D7     CMP.W $D7AF,Y                   ; \
$00:D937 90 03        BCC $D93C                       ; } Clamp Y speed to max fall speed[Y]
$00:D939 B9 AF D7     LDA.W $D7AF,Y                   ; /
$00:D93C A6 72        LDX RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D93E F0 08        BEQ $D948                       ; |
$00:D940 E0 0B        CPX.B #$0B                      ; |
$00:D942 D0 04        BNE $D948                       ; |
$00:D944 A2 24        LDX.B #$24                      ; } State $0B (rising) -> $24 (falling)
$00:D946 86 72        STX RAM_IsFlying                ; /
$00:D948 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:D949 79 A5 D7     ADC.W $D7A5,Y                   ; } Mario Y speed += gravity[Y]
$00:D94C 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; /
$00:D94E 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:D94F 9C 0A 14     STZ.W $140A                     ; [$140A] = 0
$00:D952 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:D954 10 02        BPL $D958                       ; } A = Y speed if falling, else 0
$00:D956 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; /
$00:D958 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:D959 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:D95A 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = A / 8: index into the boost table
$00:D95B A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:D95C B9 D9 D7     LDA.W $D7D9,Y                   ; \
$00:D95F CD 09 14     CMP.W $1409                     ; |
$00:D962 10 03        BPL $D967                       ; } Keep the stronger (more negative) boost in [$1409]
$00:D964 8D 09 14     STA.W $1409                     ; /

$00:D96A AD E4 13     LDA.W $13E4                     ; \

$00:D96E 79 EB D5     ADC.W $D5EB,Y                   ; /
$00:D971 10 02        BPL $D975                       ; \

$00:D975 C9 70        CMP.B #$70                      ; \

$00:D97A A9 70        LDA.B #$70                      ; /
$00:D97C 8D E4 13     STA.W $13E4                     ; Store the dash timer ([$13E4], the P-meter)

;Swimming physics/controls

;;; $D988: Swimming physics and controls ;;;
;; Mario movement in water: disables sliding, ducking, cape and spin jump. B/A paddles upward, down sinks
;;     faster, the layer 3 tide
;; pushes Mario, and the horizontal speed is limited by a reduced max speed set. Also picks the swim pose and
;;     cape animation.
;; $00DAA9: plays the swim sound and sets the swim animation bit.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:CD7D: Mario animation 0: normal per-frame handling (ResetAni)
$00:D988 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; No slope sliding
$00:D98B 64 73        STZ RAM_IsDucking               ; Not ducking
$00:D98D 9C 07 14     STZ.W $1407                     ; No cape flight
$00:D990 9C 0D 14     STZ.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; No spin jump
$00:D993 A4 7D        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Y = Mario Y speed
$00:D995 AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$00:D998 F0 51        BEQ $D9EB                       ; / Not carrying anything: go to $00D9EB
$00:D99A A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D99C D0 11        BNE $D9AF                       ; / In the air: skip the paddle
$00:D99E A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$00:D9A0 05 18        ORA $18                         ; } B or A newly pressed: paddle up
$00:D9A2 10 0B        BPL $D9AF                       ; /
$00:D9A4 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:D9A6 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / [RAM_IsFlying] = $0B: Mario is rising
$00:D9A8 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; No sliding
$00:D9AB A0 F0        LDY.B #$F0                      ; Y = $F0: swim up speed
$00:D9AD 80 06        BRA $D9B5                       ; Go to the sound and speed code

$00:D9AF A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:D9B1 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Down held? If not skip
$00:D9B3 F0 08        BEQ $D9BD                       ; /
$00:D9B5 20 A9 DA     JSR.W $DAA9                     ; Play the swim sound and swim animation
$00:D9B8 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:D9B9 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:D9BA 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; } Y += 8
$00:D9BC A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:D9BD C8           INY                             ; Y += 1: water sinks
$00:D9BE AD FA 13     LDA.W $13FA                     ; \
$00:D9C1 D0 09        BNE $D9CC                       ; / Can exit water ([$13FA])? Skip the slowdown
$00:D9C3 88           DEY                             ; Y -= 1
$00:D9C4 A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$00:D9C6 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:D9C8 D0 02        BNE $D9CC                       ; |
$00:D9CA 88           DEY                             ; } Every 4th frame: Y -= 2 more
$00:D9CB 88           DEY                             ; /
$00:D9CC 98           TYA                             ; A = new Y speed
$00:D9CD 30 08        BMI $D9D7                       ; Negative: go to the upward clamp
$00:D9CF C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; \
$00:D9D1 90 0A        BCC $D9DD                       ; |
$00:D9D3 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; } Limit downward speed to $10
$00:D9D5 80 06        BRA $D9DD                       ; /

$00:D9D7 C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; \
$00:D9D9 B0 02        BCS $D9DD                       ; } Limit upward speed to $F0
$00:D9DB A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; /
$00:D9DD 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Store Mario Y speed
$00:D9DF A0 80        LDY.B #$80                      ; Y = $80: max X speed set
$00:D9E1 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:D9E3 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Left or right held: go to $00DA48
$00:D9E5 D0 61        BNE $DA48                       ; /
$00:D9E7 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; A = facing direction
$00:D9E9 80 5B        BRA $DA46                       ; Go to set the max speed

$00:D9EB A5 16        LDA $16                         ; \
$00:D9ED 05 18        ORA $18                         ; } B or A newly pressed? If not, skip
$00:D9EF 10 1A        BPL $DA0B                       ; /
$00:D9F1 AD FA 13     LDA.W $13FA                     ; \
$00:D9F4 D0 15        BNE $DA0B                       ; / Can exit water: skip
$00:D9F6 20 A9 DA     JSR.W $DAA9                     ; Play swim sound
$00:D9F9 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:D9FB D0 09        BNE $DA06                       ; / In the air: skip
$00:D9FD A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:D9FF 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / [RAM_IsFlying] = $0B: Mario is rising
$00:DA01 9C ED 13     STZ.W $13ED                     ; No sliding
$00:DA04 A0 F0        LDY.B #$F0                      ; Y = $F0
$00:DA06 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:DA07 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:DA08 E9 20        SBC.B #$20                      ; } Y -= $20: stronger upward stroke
$00:DA0A A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:DA0B A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$00:DA0D 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:DA0F D0 02        BNE $DA13                       ; |
$00:DA11 C8           INY                             ; } Every 4th frame: Y += 2
$00:DA12 C8           INY                             ; /
$00:DA13 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:DA15 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; |
$00:DA17 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:DA18 4A           LSR                             ; } X = up/down held bits (0, 1, 2)
$00:DA19 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:DA1A 98           TYA                             ; A = Y
$00:DA1B 30 08        BMI $DA25                       ; Negative: go to the upward limit
$00:DA1D C9 40        CMP.B #$40                      ; \
$00:DA1F 90 0C        BCC $DA2D                       ; |
$00:DA21 A9 40        LDA.B #$40                      ; } Limit downward speed to $40
$00:DA23 80 08        BRA $DA2D                       ; /

$00:DA25 DD 84 D9     CMP.W $D984,X                   ; \
$00:DA28 B0 03        BCS $DA2D                       ; } Limit upward speed to $D984[X]
$00:DA2A BD 84 D9     LDA.W $D984,X                   ; /
$00:DA2D 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Store Mario Y speed
$00:DA2F A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:DA31 D0 0D        BNE $DA40                       ; / In the air: skip the ducking code
$00:DA33 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:DA35 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; } Down held and on the ground: duck
$00:DA37 F0 07        BEQ $DA40                       ; /
$00:DA39 9C E8 13     STZ.W $13E8                     ; Cancel cape sprite interaction
$00:DA3C E6 73        INC RAM_IsDucking               ; Ducking = 1 (water)
$00:DA3E 80 29        BRA $DA69                       ; Go to no-direction movement

$00:DA40 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:DA42 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Left or right held? If not, go to $00DA69
$00:DA44 F0 23        BEQ $DA69                       ; /
$00:DA46 A0 78        LDY.B #$78                      ; Y = $78: max speed set when walking
$00:DA48 84 00        STY $00                         ; [$00] = Y
$00:DA4A 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$00:DA4C 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Facing direction = right bit
$00:DA4E 48           PHA                             ; Save A
$00:DA4F 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:DA50 0A           ASL                             ; } X = right bit << 2
$00:DA51 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:DA52 68           PLA                             ; Restore A
$00:DA53 05 00        ORA $00                         ; A |= [$00]
$00:DA55 AC 03 14     LDY.W $1403                     ; \
$00:DA58 F0 03        BEQ $DA5D                       ; |
$00:DA5A 18           CLC                             ; } Layer 3 tide ([$1403]): A += 4
$00:DA5B 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; /
$00:DA5D A8           TAY                             ; Y = A: max speed index
$00:DA5E A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:DA60 F0 02        BEQ $DA64                       ; |
$00:DA62 C8           INY                             ; } In the air: Y += 2
$00:DA63 C8           INY                             ; /
$00:DA64 20 42 D7     JSR.W $D742                     ; Accelerate toward the speed limit ($D742)
$00:DA67 80 13        BRA $DA7C                       ; Go to the common tail

$00:DA69 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$00:DA6B BB           TYX                             ; X = Y
$00:DA6C AD 03 14     LDA.W $1403                     ; \
$00:DA6F F0 08        BEQ $DA79                       ; / Layer 3 tide active?
$00:DA71 A2 1E        LDX.B #$1E                      ; X = $1E: tide deceleration index
$00:DA73 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:DA75 D0 02        BNE $DA79                       ; |
$00:DA77 E8           INX                             ; } In the air: X += 2
$00:DA78 E8           INX                             ; /
$00:DA79 20 72 D7     JSR.W $D772                     ; Decelerate ($D772)
$00:DA7C 20 62 D0     JSR.W $D062                     ; Apply air physics ($D062)
$00:DA7F 22 B1 CE 00  JSL.L $CEB1                     ; Cape animation ($CEB1)
$00:DA83 AD A6 14     LDA.W $14A6                     ; \
$00:DA86 D0 04        BNE $DA8C                       ; / Cape spin running: return
$00:DA88 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:DA8A D0 01        BNE $DA8D                       ; / In the air? If on the ground, return
$00:DA8C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:DA8D A9 18        LDA.B #$18                      ; A = $18: swim pose
$00:DA8F AC 9C 14     LDY.W RAM_FireballImgTimer      ; \
$00:DA92 D0 0B        BNE $DA9F                       ; / Fireball pose running ([RAM_FireballImgTimer]): keep A
$00:DA94 AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:DA97 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:DA98 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:DA99 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:DA9B A8           TAY                             ; } Swim pose from $D980 by animation timer [$1496] / 4
$00:DA9C B9 80 D9     LDA.W $D980,Y                   ; /
$00:DA9F AC 8F 14     LDY.W $148F                     ; \
$00:DAA2 F0 01        BEQ $DAA5                       ; } Carrying something: A += 1 (holding pose)
$00:DAA4 1A           INC A                           ; /
$00:DAA5 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; Store Mario pose
$00:DAA8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:DAA9 A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; \
$00:DAAB 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play swim sound ($0E)
$00:DAAE AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:DAB1 09 10        ORA.B #$10                      ; } Set bit 4 of animation timer [$1496]: swim stroke animation
$00:DAB3 8D 96 14     STA.W $1496                     ; /
$00:DAB6 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $DADD: Mario climbing, tile and position tables (ClimbPunchingImgs) ;;;
;; Starts with the tables and the second half of Mario's climbing code. $00DB17 (entered with a JMP from
;;     $CD76): climbing a net or vine.
;; Handles the net door punch/spin ([$149D], [$1878]), jumping off with B, punching the net with A (swaps
;;     sides), left/right/up/down
;; movement from the controller, and the climbing animation flip. Stops climbing by clearing [RAM_IsClimbing]
;;     ($00DC00).
;; $00DC2D: moves Mario by his speed without gravity (Y speed saved in [$8A], wall running swaps the axes).
;;     Calls $00DC4F once per axis.
;; $00DC4F: adds speed * 16 to the position fraction [$13DA,X], then the whole pixels (sign extended, carry
;;     included) to [$94,X].
;; Parameters ($00DC4F): X = 0 for X axis, 2 for Y axis.
$00:DADD              .db $1E,$23                     ; $1E / $23: Mario image while punching a net: [in front, behind]

$00:DADF              .db $10,$0F,$0E,$0D,$0C,$0B,$0A,$09 ; Net door spin: X speed by |[$1878]| (index 0-17)
$00:DAE7              .db $08,$07,$06,$05,$05,$05,$05,$05 ; (continued)
$00:DAEF              .db $05,$05                     ; (continued)

$00:DAF1              .db $20,$01,$40,$01,$2A,$01,$2A,$01 ; Net door spin: word added to X speed/fraction [$7A] by |[$1878]| * 2
$00:DAF9              .db $30,$01,$33,$01,$32,$01,$34,$01 ; (continued)
$00:DB01              .db $36,$01,$38,$01,$3A,$01,$3B,$01 ; (continued)
$00:DB09              .db $45,$01,$45,$01,$45,$01,$45,$01 ; (continued)
$00:DB11              .db $45,$01,$45,$01,$08,$F8     ; (continued; last word $F808)

$00:DB17 64 72        STZ RAM_IsFlying                ; Entry (from $CD76): Mario is climbing a net or vine. Not flying
$00:DB19 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Y speed = 0
$00:DB1B 9C DF 13     STZ.W $13DF                     ; Cape image [$13DF] = 0
$00:DB1E 9C 0D 14     STZ.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; Not spin jumping
$00:DB21 AC 9D 14     LDY.W $149D                     ; Y = [$149D] (net door punch/spin timer)
$00:DB24 F0 57        BEQ $DB7D                       ; Zero: normal climbing, go to $00DB7D
$00:DB26 AD 78 18     LDA.W $1878                     ; A = [$1878] (signed net door spin position)
$00:DB29 10 03        BPL $DB2E                       ; Positive: keep
$00:DB2B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:DB2D 1A           INC A                           ; / A = |A|
$00:DB2E AA           TAX                             ; X = |[$1878]|
$00:DB2F C0 1E        CPY.B #$1E                      ; Timer < $1E?
$00:DB31 90 12        BCC $DB45                       ; Yes: skip the speed override, go to $00DB45
$00:DB33 BD DF DA     LDA.W $DADF,X                   ; A = X speed from $DADF[|[$1878]|]
$00:DB36 2C 78 18     BIT.W $1878                     ; N flag = sign of [$1878]
$00:DB39 10 03        BPL $DB3E                       ; Positive: keep sign
$00:DB3B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:DB3D 1A           INC A                           ; / Negate the speed for a negative position
$00:DB3E 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = A
$00:DB40 64 7A        STZ $7A                         ; X speed fraction ([$7A]) = 0
$00:DB42 9C DA 13     STZ.W $13DA                     ; X position fraction [$13DA] = 0
$00:DB45 8A           TXA                             ; A = |[$1878]|
$00:DB46 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:DB47 AA           TAX                             ; / X = |[$1878]| * 2: word index
$00:DB48 AD 78 18     LDA.W $1878                     ; A = [$1878]
$00:DB4B C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Timer < 8?
$00:DB4D B0 02        BCS $DB51                       ; No: keep
$00:DB4F 49 80        EOR.B #$80                      ; Yes: invert the sign bit
$00:DB51 0A           ASL                             ; Carry = sign: set means add the table word
$00:DB52 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:DB54 BD F1 DA     LDA.W $DAF1,X                   ; A = $DAF1[X]
$00:DB57 B0 04        BCS $DB5D                       ; Carry set: keep positive
$00:DB59 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$00:DB5C 1A           INC A                           ; / Negate A
$00:DB5D 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:DB5E 65 7A        ADC $7A                         ; A += [$7A] (X speed with fraction)
$00:DB60 85 7A        STA $7A                         ; Store back to [$7A]/[$7B]
$00:DB62 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:DB64 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:DB65 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = (timer >> 1) & $0E
$00:DB66 29 0E        AND.B #$0E                      ; /
$00:DB68 0D F0 13     ORA.W $13F0                     ; Y |= [$13F0] (side/facing bit)
$00:DB6B A8           TAY                             ; Transfer to Y
$00:DB6C B9 BD DA     LDA.W $DABD,Y                   ; A = Mario direction from $DABD[Y]
$00:DB6F 2C 78 18     BIT.W $1878                     ; N flag = sign of [$1878]
$00:DB72 30 02        BMI $DB76                       ; Negative: keep direction
$00:DB74 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; Positive: flip direction
$00:DB76 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; Mario direction = A
$00:DB78 B9 CD DA     LDA.W $DACD,Y                   ; A = Mario image from $DACD[Y] (net punch frames)
$00:DB7B 80 15        BRA $DB92                       ; Go store the image

$00:DB7D 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Not punching: X speed = 0
$00:DB7F 64 7A        STZ $7A                         ; X speed fraction = 0
$00:DB81 AE F9 13     LDX.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; X = [$13F9] (Mario is behind scenery: 0 front, 1 behind)
$00:DB84 AD 9E 14     LDA.W $149E                     ; A = [$149E] (net punch timer)
$00:DB87 F0 0D        BEQ $DB96                       ; Zero: not punching, go to $00DB96
$00:DB89 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:DB8A 1A           INC A                           ; } A = X + 2: index for the cape/punch hitbox
$00:DB8B 1A           INC A                           ; /
$00:DB8C 20 44 D0     JSR.W $D044                     ; Set punch hitbox position ($D044)
$00:DB8F BD DD DA     LDA.W ClimbPunchingImgs,X       ; A = Mario image from ClimbPunchingImgs[X]
$00:DB92 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; Mario image = A
$00:DB95 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:DB96 A4 75        LDY RAM_IsSwimming              ; Y = [RAM_IsSwimming] (swimming flag)
$00:DB98 24 16        BIT $16                         ; N = bit 7 of [$16] (B newly pressed), V = bit 6 (A newly pressed)
$00:DB9A 10 10        BPL $DBAC                       ; B not pressed: go to $00DBAC
$00:DB9C A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:DB9E 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / [RAM_IsFlying] = $0B: air flag set (jumping off)
$00:DBA0 B9 BB DA     LDA.W $DABB,Y                   ; \
$00:DBA3 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $DABB[Y] (jump: $B0 land, $F0 water)
$00:DBA5 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:DBA7 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; / Play jump sound effect ($1DFA = 1)
$00:DBAA 80 54        BRA $DC00                       ; Stop climbing: go to $00DC00

$00:DBAC 50 1C        BVC $DBCA                       ; A not pressed: go to $00DBCA
$00:DBAE A5 74        LDA RAM_IsClimbing              ; A = [RAM_IsClimbing]
$00:DBB0 10 18        BPL $DBCA                       ; Bit 7 clear (vine): go to $00DBCA
$00:DBB2 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:DBB4 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect ($1DF9 = 1): punch the net
$00:DBB7 8E F0 13     STX.W $13F0                     ; [$13F0] = X (side Mario was on)
$00:DBBA A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; A = Mario X position low
$00:DBBC 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; \
$00:DBBE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:DBBF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:DBC0 4A           LSR                             ; } A = ((X pos & 8) >> 3) ^ 1
$00:DBC1 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; /
$00:DBC3 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; Mario direction = A (facing depends on net column)
$00:DBC5 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$00:DBC7 8D 9E 14     STA.W $149E                     ; / Net punch timer [$149E] = 8
$00:DBCA BD DB DA     LDA.W ClimbingImgs,X            ; \
$00:DBCD 8D E0 13     STA.W MarioFrame                ; / Mario image = ClimbingImgs[X] (front or behind net)
$00:DBD0 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:DBD2 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:DBD4 F0 1C        BEQ $DBF2                       ; / Left/Right not pressed: skip to $00DBF2
$00:DBD6 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:DBD7 AA           TAX                             ; / X = 0 for right, 1 for left
$00:DBD8 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; A = [$8B] (climb tile flags)
$00:DBDA 29 18        AND.B #$18                      ; \
$00:DBDC C9 18        CMP.B #$18                      ; |
$00:DBDE F0 08        BEQ $DBE8                       ; / Bits 3 and 4 both set? Yes: go move at $00DBE8
$00:DBE0 A5 74        LDA RAM_IsClimbing              ; \
$00:DBE2 10 1C        BPL $DC00                       ; / Vine (bit 7 clear): stop climbing, go to $00DC00
$00:DBE4 E4 8C        CPX $8C                         ; \
$00:DBE6 F0 0A        BEQ $DBF2                       ; / Same direction as [$8C] (blocked): go to $00DBF2
$00:DBE8 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:DBE9 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:DBEA 05 75        ORA RAM_IsSwimming              ; } X = direction * 2 | swimming flag
$00:DBEC AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:DBED BD B7 DA     LDA.W $DAB7,X                   ; \
$00:DBF0 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; / X speed = $DAB7[X] ($10,$08,$F0,$F8)
$00:DBF2 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:DBF4 29 0C        AND.B #$0C                      ; |
$00:DBF6 F0 1E        BEQ $DC16                       ; / Up/Down not pressed: go to $00DC16
$00:DBF8 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; \
$00:DBFA D0 07        BNE $DC03                       ; / Up pressed: go to $00DC03
$00:DBFC 46 8B        LSR $8B                         ; \
$00:DBFE B0 0B        BCS $DC0B                       ; / Down: shift [$8B]; carry set: go to $00DC0B
$00:DC00 64 74        STZ RAM_IsClimbing              ; Mario is not climbing
$00:DC02 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:DC03 C8           INY                             ; \
$00:DC04 C8           INY                             ; / Y += 2: use the upward speeds
$00:DC05 A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; \
$00:DC07 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$00:DC09 F0 0B        BEQ $DC16                       ; / [$8B] bit 1 clear: go to $00DC16
$00:DC0B A5 74        LDA RAM_IsClimbing              ; A = [RAM_IsClimbing]
$00:DC0D 30 02        BMI $DC11                       ; Net (bit 7): keep X speed, go to $00DC11
$00:DC0F 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Vine: X speed = 0
$00:DC11 B9 B7 DA     LDA.W $DAB7,Y                   ; \
$00:DC14 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $DAB7[Y]
$00:DC16 05 7B        ORA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; A = Y speed | X speed (also true when no key pressed)
$00:DC18 F0 12        BEQ $DC2C                       ; Not moving: Return
$00:DC1A AD 96 14     LDA.W $1496                     ; \
$00:DC1D 09 08        ORA.B #$08                      ; } [$1496] |= $08 (climb animation timer)
$00:DC1F 8D 96 14     STA.W $1496                     ; /
$00:DC22 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; \
$00:DC24 D0 06        BNE $DC2C                       ; / Low 3 bits non-zero: Return
$00:DC26 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$00:DC28 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Flip Mario direction (climb animation)
$00:DC2A 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; /
$00:DC2C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:DC2D A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:DC2F 85 8A        STA $8A                         ; / Save Mario Y speed in [$8A]
$00:DC31 AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; \
$00:DC34 F0 0A        BEQ $DC40                       ; / [$13E3] (wall run status) zero: normal movement
$00:DC36 4A           LSR                             ; Carry = bit 0 of wall run status
$00:DC37 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; A = Mario X speed
$00:DC39 90 03        BCC $DC3E                       ; Bit clear: keep sign
$00:DC3B 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:DC3D 1A           INC A                           ; / Negate A
$00:DC3E 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Wall run: Mario Y speed = +/- X speed
$00:DC40 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$00:DC42 20 4F DC     JSR.W $DC4F                     ; / Move X: add speed to X position (X = 0)
$00:DC45 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; \
$00:DC47 20 4F DC     JSR.W $DC4F                     ; / Move Y: add speed to Y position (X = 2)
$00:DC4A A5 8A        LDA $8A                         ; \
$00:DC4C 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Restore Mario Y speed
$00:DC4E 60           RTS                             ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Make mario's speed move his XY position.
;X: #$00 = x speed, #$02 = Y speed.
;
;Mario's speed is handled like this:
;
;Mario's smallest amount of movement is not units of pixels, but subpixels-
;1/16 of a pixel. This is to enable the player to have more precise movement
;and have smaller-than-a-pixel movement.
;
;Therefore, his position value can be represented using fixed point binary:
; %PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP.ssss0000
;  -ssss = subpixels (i.e. %0000 = 0/16, %1111 = 15/16)
;  -PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP = Position, in pixels
; -They are stored in RAM as follows:
;  -$13DA and $13DC holds the ssss0000 data.
;  -$94-$97 holds the PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP data.
; -Other than movement, most things relating to position such as hitboxes/collision
;  do not check for fractional movements, only whole pixels of movement. Essentially
;  taking the "floor function" of the XY position.
;
;His speed value ($7B and $7D) can be represented as this in binary:
; %SPPPssss
;
; -ssss = subpixels
; -PPP = whole pixels. When sign bit is clear, it is treated as 0000000000000PPP
;  otherwise it is treated as 1111111111111PPP. Therefore increasing the data size
;  and keeping the value it represents, so that it can add by mario's pixel position.
; -S = sign bit
;
;When performing math (it adds Mario's position by this value each frame),
;it first handles the ssss and using the carry bit, then PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP without
;the CLC, like pseudo 16-bit math. For negative XY speed, this handles it using
; two's complement: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Two%27s_complement
;  Keep in mind for the carry and adding by negative: it assumes
;  the value is unsigned (so #$FFFF + 1 would be #$0000 with carry
;  being set). When ADC with carry set, it adds an additional 1, and
;  zero otherwise.
;
;  positive speed:
;   %PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP.ssss0000
;  +%0000000000000PPP.ssss
;
;  negative speed:
;   %PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPP.ssss0000
;  +%1111111111111PPP.ssss
;
;
;There exists multiple versions of these, but for other types of sprites:
; -For a sprite version, see $01ABD8 (SubSprYPosNoGrvty)
; -For bounce sprites, see $02B526
; -For extended sprites, see $02B560
; -For spinning coin from block, see $02B58E
; -For minor extended sprites, see $02B5C8
; -For overworld sprites, see $04FEAB
; Their code may be different because:
;-Their XY position high byte is not adjicent to their XY low byte due to using tables.
;-Main sprites also use $1491 so that platforms will move the player with it.
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$00:DC4F B5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX,X           ; A = speed byte ([$7B] or [$7D])
$00:DC51 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:DC52 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:DC53 0A           ASL                             ; } A = speed * 16: new fraction bits
$00:DC54 0A           ASL                             ; /
$00:DC55 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:DC56 7D DA 13     ADC.W $13DA,X                   ; / A += position fraction [$13DA,X]; carry = overflow
$00:DC59 9D DA 13     STA.W $13DA,X                   ; Store the new fraction
$00:DC5C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:DC5E 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$00:DC5F B5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX,X           ; A = speed (16-bit read)
$00:DC61 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:DC62 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:DC63 4A           LSR                             ; } A = speed >> 4 (whole pixels)
$00:DC64 4A           LSR                             ; /
$00:DC65 29 0F 00     AND.W #$000F                    ; Keep the low 4 bits
$00:DC68 C9 08 00     CMP.W #$0008                    ; \
$00:DC6B 90 03        BCC $DC70                       ; / >= 8 (negative speed): go sign extend
$00:DC6D 09 F0 FF     ORA.W #$FFF0                    ; Sign extend to $FFFx
$00:DC70 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry
$00:DC71 75 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos,X             ; \
$00:DC73 95 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos,X             ; / Position [$94,X] += A + carry
$00:DC75 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:DC77 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $E18C: Mario OAM drawing and cape data tables, draw routine (MarioPalIndex) ;;;
;; MarioPalIndex: OAM X flip bit by direction. $E18E..E266: cape tile data and layouts. $E292:
;;     invincibility flash masks.
;; $E2A2: Mario/Luigi palette pointers by powerup (entries 4-7 cycle for the star). $E2B2..E2B9:
;;     OAM offsets and priority.
;; $00E2BD (called with JSL from banks 01, 02, 04, 0C): Mario graphics. Handles Yoshi, star and power-up
;;     palette flashing, the star
;; timer and its music restore, invincibility flicker, then writes Mario's OAM tiles (four body tiles plus up
;;     to three cape tiles) and
;; ends with $F636 (Mario graphics DMA setup). $00E45D: adds one tile at OAM offset Y from tile set
;;     [$06] and offsets [$05].
$00:E18C              .db $00,$40                     ; OAM property bits by direction: no flip, X flip

$00:E2AA              .db $C8,$B2,$DC,$B2,$F0,$B2,$04,$B3 ; (continued; star cycle uses entries 4-7)
$00:E2B2              .db $10,$D4,$10,$E8             ; OAM buffer offset of Mario's tiles: in front, behind scenery

; 
$00:E2BD 8B           PHB                             ; \
$00:E2BE 4B           PHK                             ; |
$00:E2BF AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $00
$00:E2C0 A5 78        LDA $78                         ; \
$00:E2C2 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:E2C4 F0 04        BEQ $E2CA                       ; / [$78] = $FF: Mario fully hidden, skip Yoshi handling
$00:E2C6 22 70 EA 01  JSL.L $EA70                     ; Handle Yoshi if Mario is riding ($EA70)
$00:E2CA AC 9B 14     LDY.W RAM_FlashingPalTimer      ; Y = [RAM_FlashingPalTimer]
$00:E2CD D0 39        BNE $E308                       ; Non-zero (power-up flash): go to palette cycling at $00E308
$00:E2CF AC 90 14     LDY.W $1490                     ; Y = [$1490] (star timer)
$00:E2D2 F0 40        BEQ $E314                       ; No star: use the normal palette
$00:E2D4 A5 78        LDA $78                         ; \
$00:E2D6 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:E2D8 F0 09        BEQ $E2E3                       ; / Mario hidden: do not count down the star timer
$00:E2DA A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$00:E2DC 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:E2DE D0 03        BNE $E2E3                       ; / Only every 4th frame (frame counter B)
$00:E2E0 CE 90 14     DEC.W $1490                     ; Star timer--
$00:E2E3 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$00:E2E5 C0 1E        CPY.B #$1E                      ; \
$00:E2E7 90 21        BCC $E30A                       ; / Timer < $1E: slow flashing, go to $00E30A
$00:E2E9 D0 21        BNE $E30C                       ; Timer > $1E: fast flashing, go to $00E30C
$00:E2EB AD DA 0D     LDA.W $0DDA                     ; \
$00:E2EE C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; |
$00:E2F0 F0 16        BEQ $E308                       ; / Timer = $1E: [$0DDA] (level music) = $FF: no change
$00:E2F2 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; \
$00:E2F4 8D DA 0D     STA.W $0DDA                     ; / [$0DDA] bit 7 cleared (restore level music)
$00:E2F7 AA           TAX                             ; X = music number
$00:E2F8 AD AD 14     LDA.W RAM_BluePowTimer          ; \
$00:E2FB 0D AE 14     ORA.W RAM_SilverPowTimer        ; |
$00:E2FE 0D 0C 19     ORA.W $190C                     ; |
$00:E301 F0 02        BEQ $E305                       ; / P-switch/coin timers all zero: keep music in X
$00:E303 A2 0E        LDX.B #$0E                      ; Otherwise X = $0E (P-switch music)
$00:E305 8E FB 1D     STX.W $1DFB                     ; Request music X
$00:E308 A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; A = frame counter
$00:E30A 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:E30B 4A           LSR                             ; / A = frame counter >> 2
$00:E30C 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; A &= 3
$00:E30E 1A           INC A                           ; \
$00:E30F 1A           INC A                           ; |
$00:E310 1A           INC A                           ; } A += 4: palette entries 4-7 (star colours)
$00:E311 1A           INC A                           ; /
$00:E312 80 06        BRA $E31A                       ; Go to $00E31A

$00:E314 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:E316 0A           ASL                             ; } A = [RAM_MarioPowerUp] * 2 | [$0DB3] (player)
$00:E317 0D B3 0D     ORA.W $0DB3                     ; /
$00:E31A 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:E31B A8           TAY                             ; / Y = A * 2: word index
$00:E31C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:E31E B9 A2 E2     LDA.W $E2A2,Y                   ; \
$00:E321 8D 82 0D     STA.W $0D82                     ; / Palette pointer [$0D82] = $E2A2[Y]
$00:E324 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:E326 AE E0 13     LDX.W MarioFrame                ; X = Mario image [MarioFrame]
$00:E329 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$00:E32B CD E3 13     CMP.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; |

$00:E32E B0 0E        BCS $E33E                       ; / Wall run status <= 5: go to $00E33E
$00:E330 AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; A = wall run status
$00:E333 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:E335 F0 04        BEQ $E33B                       ; / Y = powerup; small: go to $00E33B
$00:E337 E0 13        CPX.B #$13                      ; \
$00:E339 D0 02        BNE $E33D                       ; / Image $13: skip the invert
$00:E33B 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; Invert bit 0
$00:E33D 4A           LSR                             ; Shift right: carry for the position subtraction
$00:E33E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:E340 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:E342 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$00:E344 85 7E        STA $7E                         ; / [$7E] = Mario X position - screen X (X on screen)
$00:E346 AD 8B 18     LDA.W $188B                     ; \
$00:E349 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$00:E34C 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:E34D 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; / A = [$188B] + Mario Y position
$00:E34F A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:E351 C0 01        CPY.B #$01                      ; |
$00:E353 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; |
$00:E355 B0 02        BCS $E359                       ; / Y = 1; powerup >= 1: skip the adjustment
$00:E357 3A           DEC A                           ; \
$00:E358 88           DEY                             ; / Small Mario: A--, Y--
$00:E359 E0 0A        CPX.B #$0A                      ; \
$00:E35B B0 03        BCS $E360                       ; |
$00:E35D CC DB 13     CPY.W $13DB                     ; / Image >= $0A: skip compare, else compare Y with [$13DB]
$00:E360 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; A -= screen Y
$00:E362 E0 1C        CPX.B #$1C                      ; \
$00:E364 D0 03        BNE $E369                       ; / Image $1C: add 1 with carry
$00:E366 69 01 00     ADC.W #$0001                    ; A += 1 + carry
$00:E369 85 80        STA $80                         ; [$80] = Mario Y on screen
$00:E36B E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:E36D AD 97 14     LDA.W $1497                     ; \
$00:E370 F0 13        BEQ $E385                       ; / [$1497] (invincibility timer) = 0: draw normally
$00:E372 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:E373 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:E374 4A           LSR                             ; } Y = timer >> 3
$00:E375 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:E376 B9 92 E2     LDA.W $E292,Y                   ; \
$00:E379 2D 97 14     AND.W $1497                     ; |
$00:E37C 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; |
$00:E37E 0D FB 13     ORA.W $13FB                     ; |
$00:E381 D0 02        BNE $E385                       ; / Flash mask & timer, | sprites locked | frozen: non-zero draws
$00:E383 AB           PLB                             ; \
$00:E384 6B           RTL                             ; / Skip drawing this frame (flicker), Return

$00:E385 A9 C8        LDA.B #$C8                      ; \
$00:E387 E0 43        CPX.B #$43                      ; |
$00:E389 D0 02        BNE $E38D                       ; |
$00:E38B A9 E8        LDA.B #$E8                      ; |
$00:E38D 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = $C8 (tile size bits: 16x16, 16x16, 8x8, 8x8, 16x16...); $E8 for image $43
$00:E38F E0 29        CPX.B #$29                      ; \
$00:E391 D0 06        BNE $E399                       ; / Image $29: check powerup, else go to $00E399
$00:E393 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:E395 D0 02        BNE $E399                       ; / Not small: keep image
$00:E397 A2 20        LDX.B #$20                      ; Small: X = $20 (small version of image $29)
$00:E399 BD EC DC     LDA.W $DCEC,X                   ; \
$00:E39C 05 76        ORA RAM_MarioDirection          ; |
$00:E39E A8           TAY                             ; / Y = $DCEC[X] | direction
$00:E39F B9 32 DD     LDA.W $DD32,Y                   ; \
$00:E3A2 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = $DD32[Y] (tile layout offset)
$00:E3A4 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Y = powerup
$00:E3A6 AD E0 13     LDA.W MarioFrame                ; \
$00:E3A9 C9 3D        CMP.B #$3D                      ; |
$00:E3AB B0 03        BCS $E3B0                       ; / Image >= $3D: no tileset offset
$00:E3AD 79 16 DF     ADC.W TilesetIndex,Y            ; A += TilesetIndex[powerup]
$00:E3B0 A8           TAY                             ; Y = image + tileset offset
$00:E3B1 B9 1A DF     LDA.W TileExpansion?,Y          ; \
$00:E3B4 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = TileExpansion?[Y] (8x8 tile set index)
$00:E3B6 B9 0C E0     LDA.W $E00C,Y                   ; \
$00:E3B9 85 0A        STA $0A                         ; / [$0A] = $E00C[Y] (upper body graphic tile)
$00:E3BB B9 CC E0     LDA.W $E0CC,Y                   ; \
$00:E3BE 85 0B        STA $0B                         ; / [$0B] = $E0CC[Y] (lower body graphic tile)
$00:E3C0 A5 64        LDA $64                         ; A = [$64] (Mario OAM priority property)
$00:E3C2 AE F9 13     LDX.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; \
$00:E3C5 F0 03        BEQ $E3CA                       ; / X = [$13F9]; in front of scenery: keep A
$00:E3C7 BD B9 E2     LDA.W $E2B9,X                   ; Behind scenery: A = $E2B9[X]
$00:E3CA BC B2 E2     LDY.W $E2B2,X                   ; Y = OAM offset from $E2B2[X]
$00:E3CD A6 76        LDX RAM_MarioDirection          ; X = direction
$00:E3CF 1D 8C E1     ORA.W MarioPalIndex,X           ; A |= $E18C[X] (X flip by direction)
$00:E3D2 99 03 03     STA.W OAM_Prop,Y                ; \
$00:E3D5 99 07 03     STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y           ; |
$00:E3D8 99 0F 03     STA.W OAM_Tile4Prop,Y           ; |
$00:E3DB 99 13 03     STA.W $0313,Y                   ; |
$00:E3DE 99 FB 02     STA.W $02FB,Y                   ; |
$00:E3E1 99 FF 02     STA.W $02FF,Y                   ; } Set OAM properties of six of Mario's slots
$00:E3E4 A6 04        LDX $04                         ; \
$00:E3E6 E0 E8        CPX.B #$E8                      ; |
$00:E3E8 D0 02        BNE $E3EC                       ; / [$04] = $E8 (image $43): leave flip alone
$00:E3EA 49 40        EOR.B #$40                      ; Otherwise toggle X flip for slot 3
$00:E3EC 99 0B 03     STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y           ; Store the property of slot 3

$00:E3F2 20 5D E4     JSR.W $E45D                     ; |
$00:E3F5 20 5D E4     JSR.W $E45D                     ; |

$00:E3FF D0 57        BNE $E458                       ; / Not cape powerup: go to $00E458

$00:E402 A9 2C        LDA.B #$2C                      ; \
