$00:E41A 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = $E1D5[X]
$00:E41C C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$00:E41E B0 12        BCS $E432                       ; / [$0C] >= 4: go to $00E432
$00:E420 AD DF 13     LDA.W $13DF                     ; \
$00:E423 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:E424 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:E425 05 0C        ORA $0C                         ; / Y = [$13DF] (cape image) * 4 | [$0C]
$00:E427 A8           TAY                             ; Transfer to Y
$00:E428 B9 3A E2     LDA.W $E23A,Y                   ; \
$00:E42B 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = $E23A[Y]
$00:E42D B9 66 E2     LDA.W $E266,Y                   ; A = $E266[Y]
$00:E430 80 03        BRA $E435                       ; Go to $00E435

$00:E432 BD D6 E1     LDA.W $E1D6,X                   ; A = $E1D6[X]
$00:E435 05 76        ORA RAM_MarioDirection          ; A |= direction
$00:E437 A8           TAY                             ; Y = A
$00:E438 B9 1A E2     LDA.W $E21A,Y                   ; \
$00:E43B 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = $E21A[Y] (cape layout offset)
$00:E43D 7A           PLY                             ; Restore OAM offset
$00:E43E BD D4 E1     LDA.W $E1D4,X                   ; A = $E1D4[X]
$00:E441 04 78        TSB $78                         ; Set bits in tile mask [$78]
$00:E443 30 03        BMI $E448                       ; Bit 7 of the data set: skip the first cape tile
$00:E445 20 5D E4     JSR.W $E45D                     ; Draw first cape tile
$00:E448 AE F9 13     LDX.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; X = [$13F9]
$00:E44B BC B6 E2     LDY.W $E2B6,X                   ; Y = cape OAM offset $E2B6[X]
$00:E44E 20 5D E4     JSR.W $E45D                     ; Draw second cape tile
$00:E451 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$00:E453 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = [$0E]: third tile set
$00:E455 20 5D E4     JSR.W $E45D                     ; Draw third cape tile
$00:E458 20 36 F6     JSR.W $F636                     ; Set up Mario graphics DMA tile addresses ($F636)
$00:E45B AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$00:E45C 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$00:E45D 46 78        LSR $78                         ; \
$00:E45F B0 3E        BCS $E49F                       ; / Next bit of tile mask [$78] set: skip this tile
$00:E461 A6 06        LDX $06                         ; X = [$06] (index into Mario8x8Tiles)
$00:E463 BD DA DF     LDA.W Mario8x8Tiles,X           ; A = tile number
$00:E466 30 37        BMI $E49F                       ; $80 and up: tile unused, skip
$00:E468 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; OAM tile = A
$00:E46B A6 05        LDX $05                         ; X = [$05] (position table offset)
$00:E46D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:E46F A5 80        LDA $80                         ; A = [$80] (Mario Y screen position)
$00:E471 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:E472 7D 32 DE     ADC.W $DE32,X                   ; A += Y offset $DE32[X]
$00:E475 48           PHA                             ; Save tile Y
$00:E476 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:E477 69 10 00     ADC.W #$0010                    ; |
$00:E47A C9 00 01     CMP.W #$0100                    ; / Carry set if Y + $10 >= $100 (off-screen)
$00:E47D 68           PLA                             ; Restore tile Y
$00:E47E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:E480 B0 1D        BCS $E49F                       ; Off-screen: skip
$00:E482 99 01 03     STA.W OAM_DispY,Y               ; OAM Y position = A
$00:E485 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:E487 A5 7E        LDA $7E                         ; A = [$7E] (Mario X screen position)
$00:E489 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:E48A 7D 4E DD     ADC.W $DD4E,X                   ; A += X offset $DD4E[X]
$00:E48D 48           PHA                             ; Save tile X
$00:E48E 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:E48F 69 80 00     ADC.W #$0080                    ; |
$00:E492 C9 00 02     CMP.W #$0200                    ; / Carry set if X + $80 >= $200 (off-screen)
$00:E495 68           PLA                             ; Restore tile X
$00:E496 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:E498 B0 05        BCS $E49F                       ; Off-screen: skip
$00:E49A 99 00 03     STA.W OAM_DispX,Y               ; OAM X position = A
$00:E49D EB           XBA                             ; Swap to the high byte
$00:E49E 4A           LSR                             ; Carry = X position bit 8
$00:E49F 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$00:E4A0 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:E4A1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:E4A2 4A           LSR                             ; } X = Y / 4: OAM size table index
$00:E4A3 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:E4A4 06 04        ASL $04                         ; Carry = next size bit of [$04]
$00:E4A6 2A           ROL                             ; Rotate size bit into A
$00:E4A7 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry (X bit 8)
$00:E4A8 2A           ROL                             ; Rotate X bit 8 into A
$00:E4A9 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; Keep both bits
$00:E4AB 9D 60 04     STA.W OAM_TileSize,X            ; OAM size/X high table [X] = A
$00:E4AE C8           INY                             ; \
$00:E4AF C8           INY                             ; |
$00:E4B0 C8           INY                             ; } OAM offset Y += 4: next slot
$00:E4B1 C8           INY                             ; /
$00:E4B2 E6 05        INC $05                         ; \
$00:E4B4 E6 05        INC $05                         ; / [$05] += 2: next position entry
$00:E4B6 E6 06        INC $06                         ; [$06]++: next tile
$00:E4B8 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $E92B: Mario level collision, borders and water ;;;
;; Per-frame Mario vs level interaction. Clears the contact flags, runs the tile collision ($EADB) for
;;     layer 2 (with its displacement
;; [$26]/[$28] applied to Mario) when [$5B] bit 7 is set, then for layer 1, unless [$185C] diverts to
;;     $EE1D.
;; Then handles the screen edges: side exits call SubSideExit; otherwise a solid left/right border keeps Mario
;;     8 px inside, carrying him with
;; the scroll when scrolling is off. Being crushed ([$77] & $1C) or off the right edge kills Mario. Finally
;;     updates swimming ([$8A] water bits):
;; entering/leaving water, splashes, bubbles, and the Up+B jump out of the water.
;; Quirk: the BEQ at $00E9CA is redundant (BPL covers it). Several [$13xx]/[$8x] flags are hedged in the line
;;     comments.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:CD33: Mario animation 0: normal per-frame handling (ResetAni)
;;     $00:F8FA: Mario vs Mode 7 boss room platform/ceiling
$00:E92B 20 A6 EA     JSR.W $EAA6                     ; Reset Mario's collision and water flags ($EAA6)
$00:E92E AD 5C 18     LDA.W $185C                     ; \
$00:E931 F0 05        BEQ $E938                       ; / [$185C] = 0: normal tile collision, go to $00E938
$00:E933 20 1D EE     JSR.W $EE1D                     ; [$185C] set: run the alternate handler instead ($EE1D)
$00:E936 80 54        BRA $E98C                       ; Skip the tile collision, go to $00E98C

$00:E938 AD EF 13     LDA.W $13EF                     ; \
$00:E93B 85 8D        STA $8D                         ; / [$8D] = [$13EF] (saved copy of the tile-contact flag)
$00:E93D 9C EF 13     STZ.W $13EF                     ; [$13EF] = 0
$00:E940 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:E942 85 8F        STA $8F                         ; / [$8F] = [RAM_IsFlying] (backup of the in-air flag)
$00:E944 A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$00:E946 10 30        BPL $E978                       ; / Bit 7 of [$5B] clear (layer 2 not solid): go to $00E978
$00:E948 29 82        AND.B #$82                      ; \
$00:E94A 85 8E        STA $8E                         ; / [$8E] = [$5B] & $82 (level orientation bits for layer 2)
$00:E94C A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:E94E 8D 33 19     STA.W $1933                     ; / [$1933] = 1: process layer 2
$00:E951 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:E953 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:E955 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:E956 65 26        ADC $26                         ; |
$00:E958 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X += [$26] (layer 2 X displacement)
$00:E95A A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:E95C 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:E95D 65 28        ADC $28                         ; |
$00:E95F 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y += [$28] (layer 2 Y displacement)
$00:E961 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:E963 20 DB EA     JSR.W $EADB                     ; Check Mario against the tiles of layer 2 ($EADB)
$00:E966 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:E968 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:E96A 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:E96B E5 26        SBC $26                         ; |
$00:E96D 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X -= [$26] (undo the displacement)
$00:E96F A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:E971 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:E972 E5 28        SBC $28                         ; |
$00:E974 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; / Mario Y -= [$28] (undo the displacement)

$00:E9FF C9 1C        CMP.B #$1C                      ; |

$00:EA13 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; \
$00:EA15 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = 0 if blocked on the right, 2 if blocked on the left
$00:EA16 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit

$00:EA1A 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:EA1B 79 0D E9     ADC.W $E90D,Y                   ; |
$00:EA1E 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; / Mario X += [DATA_00E90D+Y]: push out of the wall by 1 pixel (-1 or +1)
$00:EA20 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:EA22 A5 77        LDA RAM_MarioObjStatus          ; \
$00:EA24 30 0E        BMI $EA34                       ; / [$77] bit 7 (touching the screen edge) set: go to $00EA34
$00:EA26 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:EA28 8D E5 13     STA.W $13E5                     ; / [$13E5] = 3 (probably the wall-push animation timer)
$00:EA2B A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:EA2D 59 0D E9     EOR.W $E90D,Y                   ; |
$00:EA30 10 02        BPL $EA34                       ; / X speed EOR [DATA_00E90D+Y] positive (moving away from the wall): go to $00EA34
$00:EA32 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0
$00:EA34 AD F9 13     LDA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; \
$00:EA37 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$00:EA39 D0 07        BNE $EA42                       ; |
$00:EA3B A5 8B        LDA $8B                         ; |
$00:EA3D D0 03        BNE $EA42                       ; |
$00:EA3F 9C F9 13     STZ.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; / If [RAM_IsBehindScenery] = 1 and [$8B] = 0 (probably no longer on a scenery tile), clear it

$00:EA45 A5 85        LDA RAM_IsWaterLevel            ; \

$00:EA49 46 8A        LSR $8A                         ; \
$00:EA4B 90 56        BCC $EAA3                       ; / [$8A] bit 0 (touching a water tile) clear: leave the water, go to $00EAA3
$00:EA4D A5 75        LDA RAM_IsSwimming              ; \

$00:EA51 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \

$00:EA55 46 8A        LSR $8A                         ; \

$00:EA89 1A           INC A                           ; \

;;; $EAB9..EAD9: Data: wall-walk tables and slope tile list ;;;
;; Small tables used by $EADB: $EAB9/00EABB/00EABD (indexed by wall-walk side, purpose unclear)
;;     and $EAC1,
;; a 26-byte list of tile numbers (probably slope tiles).
$00:EAB9              .db $DE,$23                     ; Table: $DE, $23 (speed values indexed by wall-walk side, purpose unclear)

$00:EABB              .db $20,$E0                     ; Table: $20, $E0 (+32 / -32, purpose unclear)

$00:EABD              .db $08,$00,$F8,$FF             ; Words: +8, -8 (purpose unclear)

$00:EAC1              .db $71,$72,$76,$77,$7B,$7C,$81,$86 ; Tile numbers $71-$B3 (probably slope tiles), 26 bytes
$00:EAC9              .db $8A,$8B,$8F,$90,$94,$95,$99,$9A ; Tile numbers, continued
$00:EAD1              .db $9E,$9F,$A3,$A4,$A8,$A9,$AD,$AE ; Tile numbers, continued
$00:EAD9              .db $B2,$B3                     ; Tile numbers, end (next routine at $00EADB)


;;; $EADB: Mario block and slope collision (rest) ;;;
;; Second half of Mario's tile collision. Sets up the collision points for Mario's size, then checks body,
;;     side, head and feet points
;; against the Map16 tile. Page 0 tiles run effects (doors, coins), tiles $11-$6D are solid blocks, $6E-$D7
;;     are slopes whose shape
;; comes from the table at [$82]. Handles wall-running ([$13E3]), floor landing, switch palace blocks, ledge
;;     pushing and Mario's state on landing.
;; Parameters: [RAM_MarioXPos]/[RAM_MarioYPos]; Y = tile number from $F44D. $00EAE9: wall-run handling,
;;     $00EB77: normal collision.
;; Contains helper entries: $00EFBC conveyor tiles, $00EFE8 wall-run point check, $00F005 wall-run start,
;;     $00F04D slope tile test (RTL).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:E963: Mario level collision, borders and water
;;     $00:E989: Mario level collision, borders and water
$00:EADB A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:EADD 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$90] = [RAM_MarioYPos] & $0F: Mario's Y offset inside the 16x16 block
$00:EADF 85 90        STA $90                         ; /
$00:EAE1 AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; A = wall-run status [$13E3]
$00:EAE4 D0 03        BNE $EAE9                       ; Wall-running: go to EAE9
$00:EAE6 4C 77 EB     JMP.W $EB77                     ; Not wall-running: normal block collision at $00EB77

$00:EAE9 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$00:EAEB A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$13E3] & 1: wall side (0 = left, 1 = right)
$00:EAEC A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:EAEE 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:EAEF F9 B9 EA     SBC.W $EAB9,Y                   ; } N = 1 if Mario's X speed has not reached the wall-run speed limit $EAB9[Y]
$00:EAF2 59 B9 EA     EOR.W $EAB9,Y                   ; /
$00:EAF5 30 51        BMI $EB48                       ; Too slow: fall off the wall
$00:EAF7 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:EAF9 0D 8F 14     ORA.W $148F                     ; |
$00:EAFC 05 73        ORA RAM_IsDucking               ; } A = [RAM_IsFlying] | [$148F] | [RAM_IsDucking] | [RAM_OnYoshi]
$00:EAFE 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; /
$00:EB01 D0 45        BNE $EB48                       ; Any of those set: fall off the wall
$00:EB03 AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; A = wall-run status
$00:EB06 C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; Status >= 6: already running up the wall
$00:EB08 B0 18        BCS $EB22                       ; Go to EB22 (wall-run collision checks)
$00:EB0A A6 90        LDX $90                         ; X = [$90] (Mario Y offset inside the block)
$00:EB0C E0 08        CPX.B #$08                      ; Offset < 8: not far enough into the wall yet
$00:EB0E 90 66        BCC $EB76                       ; Return
$00:EB10 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; Status >= 4: already started, clear status (EB73)
$00:EB12 B0 5F        BCS $EB73                       ; Branch to EB73
$00:EB14 09 04        ORA.B #$04                      ; Set bit 2: Mario has started up the wall
$00:EB16 8D E3 13     STA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; Store the new wall-run status
$00:EB19 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:EB1B 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$00:EB1D 09 08        ORA.B #$08                      ; } Center Mario's X in the block column: [RAM_MarioXPos] = ([RAM_MarioXPos] & $F0) | 8
$00:EB1F 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$00:EB21 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:EB22 A2 60        LDX.B #$60                      ; X = $60: collision point set for a left wall
$00:EB24 98           TYA                             ; A = wall side
$00:EB25 F0 02        BEQ $EB29                       ; Left wall: keep X = $60
$00:EB27 A2 66        LDX.B #$66                      ; X = $66: collision point set for a right wall
$00:EB29 20 E8 EF     JSR.W $EFE8                     ; Check this wall-run collision point (EFE8)
$00:EB2C A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = [RAM_MarioPowerUp]
$00:EB2E D0 04        BNE $EB34                       ; Big or better: check a second point
$00:EB30 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:EB31 E8           INX                             ; / Small Mario: X += 2, skip the extra point
$00:EB32 80 03        BRA $EB37                       ; Skip to EB37

$00:EB34 20 E8 EF     JSR.W $EFE8                     ; Check the extra collision point (EFE8)
$00:EB37 20 4D F4     JSR.W $F44D                     ; Check the next collision point ($F44D)
$00:EB3A D0 DD        BNE $EB19                       ; Solid: keep Mario centered in the wall column (EB19)
$00:EB3C A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = %00000010
$00:EB3E 1C E3 13     TRB.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; Clear bit 1 of the wall-run status: wall contact lost
$00:EB41 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:EB42 AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; A = wall-run status (entry from $EFE8 when Mario hits a solid block)
$00:EB45 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$00:EB47 A8           TAY                             ; / Y = wall side (0 = left, 1 = right)
$00:EB48 B9 BB EA     LDA.W $EABB,Y                   ; A = $EABB[Y]: X speed pushing Mario away from the wall ($20 / $E0)
$00:EB4B 85 7B        STA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = A
$00:EB4D 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:EB4E 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = Y * 2: word index
$00:EB4F A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:EB50 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:EB52 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; A = Mario X position
$00:EB54 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:EB55 79 BD EA     ADC.W $EABD,Y                   ; Add $EABD[Y] (+8 or -8): step away from the wall
$00:EB58 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; Store Mario X position
$00:EB5A A9 08 00     LDA.W #$0008                    ; A = 8 (small Mario)
$00:EB5D A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Y = power-up
$00:EB5F F0 03        BEQ $EB64                       ; Small: keep 8
$00:EB61 A9 10 00     LDA.W #$0010                    ; A = $10 (big Mario)
$00:EB64 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:EB65 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; Add Mario Y position
$00:EB67 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Mario Y position += 8 (small) or $10 (big)
$00:EB69 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:EB6B A9 24        LDA.B #$24                      ; \
$00:EB6D 85 72        STA RAM_IsFlying                ; / In-air flag [RAM_IsFlying] = $24 (falling)
$00:EB6F A9 E0        LDA.B #$E0                      ; \
$00:EB71 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $E0 (small hop off the wall)
$00:EB73 9C E3 13     STZ.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; Clear the wall-run status [$13E3]
$00:EB76 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:EB77 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: collision point set for small Mario
$00:EB79 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = power-up
$00:EB7B F0 06        BEQ $EB83                       ; Small: keep X = 0
$00:EB7D A5 73        LDA RAM_IsDucking               ; A = ducking flag
$00:EB7F D0 02        BNE $EB83                       ; Ducking: keep X = 0
$00:EB81 A2 18        LDX.B #$18                      ; X = $18: collision point set for big Mario
$00:EB83 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = on Yoshi flag
$00:EB86 F0 05        BEQ $EB8D                       ; Not on Yoshi: skip
$00:EB88 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:EB89 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:EB8A 69 30        ADC.B #$30                      ; } On Yoshi: X += $30 (taller collision point set)
$00:EB8C AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:EB8D A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; A = Mario X position
$00:EB8F 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; A = X offset inside the block
$00:EB91 A8           TAY                             ; Y = X offset inside the block
$00:EB92 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:EB93 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; Add 8
$00:EB95 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; Modulo 16
$00:EB97 85 92        STA $92                         ; [$92] = (X offset + 8) & $0F: column used for slope height lookups
$00:EB99 64 93        STZ $93                         ; [$93] = 0: Mario is in the left half of the block
$00:EB9B C0 08        CPY.B #$08                      ; Compare X offset with 8
$00:EB9D 90 06        BCC $EBA5                       ; Left half: skip
$00:EB9F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:EBA0 69 0B        ADC.B #$0B                      ; } Right half: X += $0C (carry set), use the right-side collision points
$00:EBA2 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:EBA3 E6 93        INC $93                         ; [$93] = 1: Mario is in the right half of the block
$00:EBA5 A5 90        LDA $90                         ; A = [$90] (Mario Y offset inside the block)
$00:EBA7 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:EBA8 7D A4 E8     ADC.W $E8A4,X                   ; Add $E8A4[X]: Y offset of this collision point
$00:EBAB 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; Modulo 16
$00:EBAD 85 91        STA $91                         ; [$91] = Y offset of the collision point inside its block
$00:EBAF 20 4D F4     JSR.W $F44D                     ; Check the first collision point (body); Y = tile number, Z = 1 for a page 0 tile
$00:EBB2 F0 29        BEQ $EBDD                       ; Page 0 tile (doors, coins, water...): go to EBDD
$00:EBB4 C0 11        CPY.B #$11                      ; Tile < $11: not solid
$00:EBB6 90 6C        BCC $EC24                       ; Skip to the next check (EC24)
$00:EBB8 C0 6E        CPY.B #$6E                      ; Tile $11-$6D: solid block

$00:EE3A AC 93 16     LDY.W $1693                     ; Y = current tile
$00:EE3D AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; A = tileset
$00:EE40 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Tileset 2 (Rope 1)?
$00:EE42 F0 04        BEQ $EE48                       ; Yes: rope conveyor check

$00:EE46 D0 0F        BNE $EE57                       ; No: go to EE57
$00:EE48 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:EE49 38           SEC                             ; } A = tile - $0C
$00:EE4A E9 0C        SBC.B #$0C                      ; /
$00:EE4C C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Tile $0C or $0D (rope conveyor)?

$00:EE57 20 67 F2     JSR.W $F267                     ; Handle tile $2E ($F267)
$00:EE5A A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3
$00:EE5C AD 93 16     LDA.W $1693                     ; A = current tile
$00:EE5F C9 1E        CMP.B #$1E                      ; Turn block?

$00:EE65 F0 1C        BEQ $EE83                       ; On the ground: go to EE83

$00:EE69 F0 18        BEQ $EE83                       ; Small: go to EE83
$00:EE6B AE 0D 14     LDX.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; X = spin jump flag
$00:EE6E F0 13        BEQ $EE83                       ; Not spin jumping: go to EE83
$00:EE70 A9 21        LDA.B #$21                      ; A = $21
$00:EE72 22 7F F1 00  JSL.L $F17F                     ; Break the turn block ($F17F)
$00:EE76 80 A5        BRA $EE1D                       ; Not landed: go to EE1D

$00:EE78 C9 32        CMP.B #$32                      ; Tile $32?

$00:EE7C 9C 09 19     STZ.W $1909                     ; [$1909] = 0
$00:EE7F 22 20 F1 00  JSL.L $F120                     ; Touch the block from above ($F120: spikes and munchers hurt)
$00:EE83 A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; Y = $20 (flat floor shape)
$00:EE85 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; \
$00:EE87 10 06        BPL $EE8F                       ; / Mario moving up: layer floors are passable
$00:EE89 A5 8D        LDA $8D                         ; \
$00:EE8B C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } [$8D] < 2: return
$00:EE8D 90 AA        BCC $EE39                       ; /
$00:EE8F AE 23 14     LDX.W $1423                     ; X = [$1423] (switch palace block side)
$00:EE92 F0 3D        BEQ $EED1                       ; No switch: go to EED1
$00:EE94 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:EE95 8A           TXA                             ; A = X
$00:EE96 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; A = A & 3
$00:EE98 F0 10        BEQ $EEAA                       ; Zero: go to EEAA
$00:EE9A C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; A >= 2?
$00:EE9C B0 33        BCS $EED1                       ; Yes: go to EED1
$00:EE9E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; \
$00:EEA0 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; |
$00:EEA2 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:EEA3 E9 10 00     SBC.W #$0010                    ; |
$00:EEA6 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; } [RAM_BlockXLo] -= $10 (use the left block of the switch)
$00:EEA8 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; /
$00:EEAA 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:EEAB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:EEAC 4A           LSR                             ; } X = (X - 1) / 4: switch color index
$00:EEAD AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:EEAE BD 27 1F     LDA.W $1F27,X                   ; A = switch active flag [$1F27 + X]
$00:EEB1 D0 1E        BNE $EED1                       ; Already active: go to EED1
$00:EEB3 1A           INC A                           ; A = 1
$00:EEB4 9D 27 1F     STA.W $1F27,X                   ; Activate the switch block
$00:EEB7 8D D2 13     STA.W $13D2                     ; [$13D2] = 1 (a switch was pressed)
$00:EEBA 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$00:EEBB 8E 1E 19     STX.W $191E                     ; [$191E] = switch index
$00:EEBE 20 45 FA     JSR.W FlatPalaceSwitch          ; Activate the switch palace switch (FlatPalaceSwitch)
$00:EEC1 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$00:EEC2 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; \
$00:EEC4 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request $0C (switch palace jingle)
$00:EEC7 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:EEC9 8D DA 0D     STA.W $0DDA                     ; / [$0DDA] = $FF (force the level music to reload afterwards)
$00:EECC A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$00:EECE 8D 93 14     STA.W $1493                     ; / [$1493] = 8 (end level timer)
$00:EED1 EE EF 13     INC.W $13EF                     ; [$13EF]++ (Mario was pushed out of the floor)
$00:EED4 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:EED6 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:EED7 E5 91        SBC $91                         ; } Mario Y position low -= [$91]
$00:EED9 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$00:EEDB A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$00:EEDD E5 90        SBC $90                         ; } Mario Y position high -= [$90] (with borrow)
$00:EEDF 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$00:EEE1 B9 3D E5     LDA.W $E53D,Y                   ; A = $E53D[Y]: slope X direction ($FF, 0, $01)
$00:EEE4 D0 09        BNE $EEEF                       ; On a slope: go to EEEF
$00:EEE6 AE ED 13     LDX.W $13ED                     ; X = [$13ED] (slide timer)
$00:EEE9 F0 1A        BEQ $EF05                       ; Zero: go to EF05
$00:EEEB A6 7B        LDX RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; X = Mario X speed
$00:EEED F0 13        BEQ $EF02                       ; Standing still: stop sliding (EF02)
$00:EEEF 8D EE 13     STA.W $13EE                     ; [$13EE] = slope direction
$00:EEF2 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; A = held buttons [RAM_ControllerA]
$00:EEF4 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; Down held?
$00:EEF6 F0 0D        BEQ $EF05                       ; No: go to EF05
$00:EEF8 AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$00:EEFB 0D ED 13     ORA.W $13ED                     ; / A = [$148F] | [$13ED]
$00:EEFE D0 05        BNE $EF05                       ; Carrying something or already sliding: go to EF05
$00:EF00 A2 1C        LDX.B #$1C                      ; X = $1C: start sliding down the slope
$00:EF02 8E ED 13     STX.W $13ED                     ; [$13ED] = X
$00:EF05 BE B9 E4     LDX.W $E4B9,Y                   ; X = $E4B9[Y]
$00:EF08 8E E1 13     STX.W $13E1                     ; [$13E1] = X (slope angle for Mario's pose)
$00:EF0B C0 1C        CPY.B #$1C                      ; Shape >= $1C (not a slope)?
$00:EF0D B0 29        BCS $EF38                       ; Yes: go to EF38
$00:EF0F A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; A = Mario X speed
$00:EF11 F0 1E        BEQ $EF31                       ; Zero: go to EF31
$00:EF13 B9 3D E5     LDA.W $E53D,Y                   ; A = slope X direction
$00:EF16 F0 19        BEQ $EF31                       ; Flat: go to EF31
$00:EF18 45 7B        EOR RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Direction EOR X speed
$00:EF1A 10 15        BPL $EF31                       ; Positive (running downhill): go to EF31
$00:EF1C 8E E5 13     STX.W $13E5                     ; [$13E5] = X (running uphill)
$00:EF1F A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:EF21 10 03        BPL $EF26                       ; |
$00:EF23 49 FF        EOR.B #$FF                      ; } A = |Mario X speed|
$00:EF25 1A           INC A                           ; /
$00:EF26 C9 28        CMP.B #$28                      ; Speed < $28?
$00:EF28 90 05        BCC $EF2F                       ; Yes: go to EF2F
$00:EF2A B9 FB E4     LDA.W $E4FB,Y                   ; A = $E4FB[Y]: Y speed for running uphill fast
$00:EF2D 80 31        BRA $EF60                       ; Go to EF60

$00:EF2F A0 20        LDY.B #$20                      ; Y = $20 (treat as flat)
$00:EF31 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$00:EF33 D9 DA E4     CMP.W $E4DA,Y                   ; Compare with $E4DA[Y] (maximum Y speed)

$00:EF38 B9 DA E4     LDA.W $E4DA,Y                   ; A = $E4DA[Y]

$00:EF3F EE 0E 14     INC.W $140E                     ; [$140E]++
$00:EF42 48           PHA                             ; Save A
$00:EF43 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:EF45 AD BE 17     LDA.W $17BE                     ; A = [$17BE] (probably layer 2 X movement this frame)
$00:EF48 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; \
$00:EF4B 10 03        BPL $EF50                       ; } A = sign-extended high byte of [$17BE]
$00:EF4D 09 FF 00     ORA.W #$00FF                    ; /

$00:EF54 1A           INC A                           ; / Negate A

$00:EF65 EE EF 13     INC.W $13EF                     ; [$13EF]++

$00:EF79 AC 07 14     LDY.W $1407                     ; Y = [$1407] (cape flight state)
$00:EF7C D0 1B        BNE $EF99                       ; Non-zero: go to EF99

$00:EF90 A9 25        LDA.B #$25                      ; \

;;; $EFAE: Cape ground pound on landing (CallGroundPound) ;;;
;; Called when Mario lands with [$1407] >= 5 (cape dive). If he came from the air ([$8F] non-zero) runs
;;     GroundPound and plays sound $09.
$00:EFAE A5 8F        LDA $8F                         ; A = [$8F] (was in the air)
$00:EFB0 F0 09        BEQ $EFBB                       ; On the ground: return
$00:EFB2 22 C1 94 02  JSL.L GroundPound               ; Cape ground pound (GroundPound)
$00:EFB6 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:EFB8 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $09 ($1DFC: impact)
$00:EFBB 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:EFBC AE 93 16     LDX.W $1693                     ; X = current tile
$00:EFBF E0 CE        CPX.B #$CE                      ; Tile < $CE?
$00:EFC1 90 24        BCC $EFE7                       ; Yes: return
$00:EFC3 E0 D2        CPX.B #$D2                      ; Tile >= $D2?
$00:EFC5 B0 20        BCS $EFE7                       ; Yes: return
$00:EFC7 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:EFC8 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:EFC9 E9 CC        SBC.B #$CC                      ; |
$00:EFCB 0A           ASL                             ; } X = (tile - $CC) * 2: word index
$00:EFCC AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:EFCD A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:EFCF 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / Every 4th frame only (A = [RAM_FrameCounter] & 3)
$00:EFD1 D0 14        BNE $EFE7                       ; Other frames: return
$00:EFD3 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:EFD5 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; A = Mario X position
$00:EFD7 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:EFD8 7D 13 E9     ADC.W $E913,X                   ; Add $E913[X]
$00:EFDB 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; Store Mario X position
$00:EFDD A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; A = Mario Y position
$00:EFDF 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:EFE0 7D 1F E9     ADC.W $E91F,X                   ; Add $E91F[X]
$00:EFE3 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Store Mario Y position: Mario is carried 1 pixel
$00:EFE5 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:EFE7 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:EFE8 20 4D F4     JSR.W $F44D                     ; Check the next collision point for wall-running
$00:EFEB D0 03        BNE $EFF0                       ; Non-page-0 tile: go to EFF0
$00:EFED 4C 09 F3     JMP.W $F309                     ; Apply the page 0 tile effect ($F309) and return

$00:EFF0 C0 11        CPY.B #$11                      ; Tile < $11?
$00:EFF2 90 10        BCC $F004                       ; Yes: return
$00:EFF4 C0 6E        CPY.B #$6E                      ; Tile >= $6E?
$00:EFF6 B0 0C        BCS $F004                       ; Yes: return
$00:EFF8 98           TYA                             ; A = tile
$00:EFF9 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$00:EFFB 22 60 F1 00  JSL.L $F160                     ; Block touch ($F160)
$00:EFFF 68           PLA                             ; \
$00:F000 68           PLA                             ; / Discard the caller's return address: exit the whole routine
$00:F001 4C 42 EB     JMP.W $EB42                     ; Mario hit a wall: fall off it (EB42)

$00:F004 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F005 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:F006 38           SEC                             ; } A = slope shape - $0E
$00:F007 E9 0E        SBC.B #$0E                      ; /
$00:F009 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; Shape $0E or $0F?
$00:F00B B0 3F        BCS $F04C                       ; No: return
$00:F00D 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; Flip bit 0
$00:F00F C5 76        CMP RAM_MarioDirection          ; Same as Mario's facing direction?
$00:F011 D0 39        BNE $F04C                       ; No: return
$00:F013 AA           TAX                             ; X = side
$00:F014 4A           LSR                             ; Carry = side
$00:F015 A5 92        LDA $92                         ; A = X column [$92]
$00:F017 90 02        BCC $F01B                       ; Carry clear: skip
$00:F019 49 0F        EOR.B #$0F                      ; Mirror the column
$00:F01B C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Column < 8?
$00:F01D B0 2D        BCS $F04C                       ; No: return
$00:F01F AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = on Yoshi flag
$00:F022 F0 11        BEQ $F035                       ; Not on Yoshi: go to F035
$00:F024 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$00:F026 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $08
$00:F029 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$00:F02B 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $80
$00:F02D 8D 06 14     STA.W $1406                     ; [$1406] = $80
$00:F030 68           PLA                             ; \
$00:F031 68           PLA                             ; / Discard the caller's return address
$00:F032 4C 35 EE     JMP.W $EE35                     ; Set the in-air flag (EE35) and return

$00:F035 A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; A = Mario X speed

$00:F040 AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$00:F043 05 73        ORA RAM_IsDucking               ; / A = [$148F] | [RAM_IsDucking]
$00:F045 D0 05        BNE $F04C                       ; Carrying or ducking: return
$00:F047 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:F048 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$00:F049 8E E3 13     STX.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; Start wall-running: [$13E3] = 2 (left) or 3 (right)
$00:F04C 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F04D DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F04E A2 19        LDX.B #$19                      ; X = $19: last of 26 slope tiles
$00:F050 DF C1 EA 00  CMP.L $EAC1,X                   ; Compare A with $EAC1[X]
$00:F054 F0 04        BEQ $F05A                       ; Match: done (carry set)
$00:F056 CA           DEX                             ; Next entry
$00:F057 10 F7        BPL $F050                       ; Loop until X < 0
$00:F059 18           CLC                             ; No match: carry clear
$00:F05A FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F05B 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

;The table below here handles what bounce block image to show when hit.

;;; $F05C..F07C: Table: bounce block sprite by block ;;;
;; Indexed by acts-like tile - $11 ($24 entries): which bounce block sprite is shown when the block is hit.
$00:F05C              .db $01,$05,$01,$02,$01,$01,$00,$00 ; Entries $00-$07: bounce block sprite shown (acts-like tiles $11-$18)
$00:F064              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$06,$02,$02 ; Entries $08-$0F
$00:F06C              .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02 ; Entries $10-$17
$00:F074              .db $02,$03,$03,$04,$02,$02,$02,$01 ; Entries $18-$1F
$00:F07C              .db $01,$07,$11,$10             ; Entries $20-$23


;;; $F080..F0A0: Table: item spawned by block ;;;
;; Which power-up/sprite a block releases. Bit 7 set marks special cases: $FF uses a fixed item, others pick
;;     one by block X position.
$00:F080              .db $80,$00,$00,$1E,$00,$00,$05,$09 ; Entries $00-$07: item spawned (bit 7 set = special case)
$00:F088              .db $06,$81,$0E,$0C,$14,$00,$05,$09 ; Entries $08-$0F
$00:F090              .db $06,$07,$0E,$0C,$16,$18,$1A,$1A ; Entries $10-$17
$00:F098              .db $00,$09,$00,$00,$FF,$0C,$0A,$00 ; Entries $18-$1F
$00:F0A0              .db $00,$00,$08,$02             ; Entries $20-$23


;;; $F0A4..F0C4: Table: hit directions that trigger block ;;;
;; Bit masks ANDed with $F0EC[Y]; zero means the hit direction does not activate this block.
$00:F0A4              .db $0C,$08,$0C,$08,$0C,$0F,$08,$08 ; Entries $00-$07: hit directions that trigger the block (bit mask)
$00:F0AC              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Entries $08-$0F
$00:F0B4              .db $08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Entries $10-$17
$00:F0BC              .db $08,$03,$03,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Entries $18-$1F
$00:F0C4              .db $08,$04,$08,$08             ; Entries $20-$23


;;; $F0C8..F0E8: Table: tile a block turns into ;;;
;; Value stored in $07 for the bounce block; most entries are $0D (used block).
$00:F0C8              .db $0E,$13,$0E,$0D,$0E,$10,$0D,$0D ; Entries $00-$07: tile the block turns into ($0D = used block)
$00:F0D0              .db $0D,$0D,$0A,$0D,$0D,$0C,$0D,$0D ; Entries $08-$0F
$00:F0D8              .db $0D,$0D,$0B,$0D,$0D,$16,$0D,$0D ; Entries $10-$17
$00:F0E0              .db $0D,$11,$11,$12,$0D,$0D,$0D,$0E ; Entries $18-$1F
$00:F0E8              .db $0F,$0C,$0D,$0D             ; Entries $20-$23


;;; $F0EC..F0F4: Table: bit masks for block hits ;;;
;; First four bytes: hit direction masks. The rest are more masks (purpose uncertain).
$00:F0EC              .db $08,$01,$02,$04,$ED,$F6,$00,$7D ; Bit masks: $08, $01, $02, $04 = hit direction 0-3, then more masks
$00:F0F4              .db $BE,$00,$6F,$B7             ; More bit masks (probably used with $13F3)


;;; $F0F8..F118: Table: block X positions and ? block contents ;;;
;; $F0F8: X low bytes of blocks regenerated as used blocks. $F100: contents of special ? blocks by
;;     X position.
$00:F0F8              .db $40,$50,$00,$70,$80,$00,$A0,$B0 ; X position low bytes of 8 blocks regenerated as used blocks
$00:F100              .db $05,$09,$06,$05,$09,$06,$05,$09 ; Special ? block contents by block X position (same format as the item table)
$00:F108              .db $06,$05,$09,$06,$05,$09,$06,$05 ; Contents, cont.
$00:F110              .db $07,$0A,$10,$07,$0A,$10,$07,$0A ; Contents, cont.
$00:F118              .db $10,$07,$0A,$10,$07,$0A,$10,$07 ; Contents, cont.


;;; $F120: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins ;;;
;; Tail of the Mario-versus-tile code. Several entry points share it, all working on the touched tile number
;;     (Y or A) and the hit side (Y):
;; $00F120: spikes/munchers. Tile $2F always hurts; castle spike tiles hurt in castle tilesets ($1931 = 1) and
;;     some ghost house ones; skipped on Yoshi.
;; $00F160: tiles $11-$2D and $6A/$6B that can be hit from below. Looks up bounce sprite, contents and
;;     replacement block, then spawns the bounce sprite.
;; Switch palace blocks keep hit flags in $13F3. $00F267: grab a turn block. $00F28C: invisible 1-up
;;     checkpoint tiles ($6F-$72, must be touched in order).
;; $00F2C0: other tile classes (climbing flags, $38 pickup, 3-up moon $6E, coins, Yoshi coins).
;;     $00F377/$00F38A: spawn a score sprite at Mario.
;; $00F3B2: bit array helper for the level number. $00F3C4: pipe entry check for tile $3F.
;; Parameters: Y = tile number / side as described per entry. Several parts are only hedged guesses (see line
;;     comments).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:EE7F: Mario block and slope collision (rest)
$00:F120 EB           XBA                             ; Stash the tile number in the hidden half of A
$00:F121 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:F124 D0 39        BNE $F15F                       ; / Riding Yoshi: skip the hurt tiles ($00F15F)
$00:F126 EB           XBA                             ; Tile number back in A
$00:F127 C9 2F        CMP.B #$2F                      ; \
$00:F129 F0 29        BEQ $F154                       ; / Tile $2F (muncher): hurt Mario ($00F154)
$00:F12B C9 59        CMP.B #$59                      ; \
$00:F12D 90 15        BCC $F144                       ; |
$00:F12F C9 5C        CMP.B #$5C                      ; } Tiles < $59: go to $00F144; $59-$5B (castle spikes) continue; >= $5C: go to $00F140
$00:F131 B0 0D        BCS $F140                       ; /
$00:F133 EB           XBA                             ; Stash the tile number again
$00:F134 AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; \
$00:F137 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; } Ghost house tileset ([$1931] = 5): spikes hurt
$00:F139 F0 19        BEQ $F154                       ; /
$00:F13B C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; \
$00:F13D F0 15        BEQ $F154                       ; / Ghost house 2 tileset ([$1931] = $0D): spikes hurt
$00:F13F EB           XBA                             ; Tile number back in A
$00:F140 C9 5D        CMP.B #$5D                      ; \
$00:F142 90 08        BCC $F14C                       ; / Tile $5C: go check for the castle tileset
$00:F144 C9 66        CMP.B #$66                      ; \
$00:F146 90 18        BCC $F160                       ; / Tiles $5D-$65 are harmless: go to $00F160
$00:F148 C9 6A        CMP.B #$6A                      ; \
$00:F14A B0 14        BCS $F160                       ; / Tiles >= $6A are harmless too: go to $00F160
$00:F14C EB           XBA                             ; Stash the tile number
$00:F14D AD 31 19     LDA.W $1931                     ; \
$00:F150 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; } Tiles $59-$5C and $66-$69 only hurt in tileset 1 (castle); else skip
$00:F152 D0 0B        BNE $F15F                       ; /
$00:F154 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$00:F155 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F157 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $01
$00:F158 AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F159 22 B7 F5 00  JSL.L HurtMario                 ; Hurt Mario (HurtMario)
$00:F15D AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$00:F15E 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:F15F EB           XBA                             ; Tile number back in A
$00:F160 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:F161 E9 11        SBC.B #$11                      ; |
$00:F163 C9 1D        CMP.B #$1D                      ; } Entry from $00EFFB: tiles $11-$2D (tile - $11 < $1D): go to $00F17F
$00:F165 90 18        BCC $F17F                       ; /
$00:F167 EB           XBA                             ; Stash tile - $11 (A = high byte)
$00:F168 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F169 AE 31 19     LDX.W $1931                     ; X = tileset number ([$1931])
$00:F16C BF 25 A6 00  LDA.L $A625,X                   ; A = page behaviour flags for this tileset ($A625)
$00:F170 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F171 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; \
$00:F173 F0 01        BEQ $F176                       ; / Low 2 bits of the flags zero: also test tiles $6A/$6B ($00F176)
$00:F175 6B           RTL                             ; Return (flags non-zero: tile does nothing)

$00:F176 EB           XBA                             ; Tile - $11 back in A
$00:F177 E9 59        SBC.B #$59                      ; \
$00:F179 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Only tiles $6A and $6B (tile - $6A < 2) continue; others return
$00:F17B B0 7B        BCS $F1F8                       ; /
$00:F17D 69 22        ADC.B #$22                      ; Table index $22/$23 for tiles $6A/$6B
$00:F17F DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F180 48           PHA                             ; Save the table index
$00:F181 BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (side of the block that was touched)
$00:F182 BF EC F0 00  LDA.L $F0EC,X                   ; A = bit mask for that side ($F0EC)
$00:F186 FA           PLX                             ; X = table index
$00:F187 3F A4 F0 00  AND.L $F0A4,X                   ; Mask with the sides this block can be hit from ($F0A4)
$00:F18B F0 69        BEQ $F1F6                       ; Cannot be hit from this side: restore X and return ($00F1F6)
$00:F18D 84 06        STY $06                         ; [$06] = side that was hit
$00:F18F BF C8 F0 00  LDA.L $F0C8,X                   ; \
$00:F193 85 07        STA $07                         ; / [$07] = block the tile turns into ($F0C8)
$00:F195 BF 5C F0 00  LDA.L $F05C,X                   ; \
$00:F199 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = bounce sprite graphic ($F05C)
$00:F19B BF 80 F0 00  LDA.L $F080,X                   ; \
$00:F19F 10 19        BPL $F1BA                       ; / A = block contents ($F080); bit 7 clear: use it directly ($00F1BA)
$00:F1A1 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:F1A3 D0 09        BNE $F1AE                       ; / Contents $FF: special case; other values with bit 7 set go to $00F1AE
$00:F1A5 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; Contents = 5 if [$0DC0] is zero
$00:F1A7 AC C0 0D     LDY.W $0DC0                     ; \
$00:F1AA F0 24        BEQ $F1D0                       ; / [$0DC0] = 0: keep 5 ($00F1D0)
$00:F1AC 80 20        BRA $F1CE                       ; Otherwise use contents 6 ($00F1CE)

$00:F1AE 4A           LSR                             ; A = contents >> 1, carry = bit 0
$00:F1AF A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:F1B1 6A           ROR                             ; |
$00:F1B2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F1B3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F1B4 4A           LSR                             ; } X = block column + 16 * (bit 0 of contents); contents vary with the block's X position
$00:F1B5 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:F1B6 BF 00 F1 00  LDA.L $F100,X                   ; A = contents from $F100 (repeating 5,9,6 pattern: position dependent)
$00:F1BA 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:F1BB 90 13        BCC $F1D0                       ; / Shift out bit 0: clear = use A as the contents ($00F1D0)
$00:F1BD C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; \
$00:F1BF F0 08        BEQ $F1C9                       ; / Contents 3: go check the star timer ($00F1C9)
$00:F1C1 A4 19        LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:F1C3 D0 0B        BNE $F1D0                       ; / Mario is not small: keep the value
$00:F1C5 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F1C7 80 07        BRA $F1D0                       ; / Mario is small: contents = 1

$00:F1C9 AC 90 14     LDY.W $1490                     ; \
$00:F1CC D0 02        BNE $F1D0                       ; / Contents 3: keep it only while the star timer [$1490] is non-zero
$00:F1CE A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; Otherwise contents = 6
$00:F1D0 85 05        STA $05                         ; [$05] = contents for the bounce sprite spawner
$00:F1D2 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$00:F1D4 D0 04        BNE $F1DA                       ; / Contents 5 (probably the vine)? Otherwise skip
$00:F1D6 A9 16        LDA.B #$16                      ; \
$00:F1D8 85 07        STA $07                         ; / Contents 5: block becomes $16 ([$07])
$00:F1DA A8           TAY                             ; Y = contents
$00:F1DB A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$00:F1DD 14 9A        TRB RAM_BlockXLo                ; } Snap the block position to the 16x16 grid (clear low nibbles)
$00:F1DF 14 98        TRB RAM_BlockYLo                ; /
$00:F1E1 C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; \
$00:F1E3 D0 07        BNE $F1EC                       ; / Contents 6? Otherwise spawn normally ($00F1EC)
$00:F1E5 AC 31 19     LDY.W $1931                     ; \
$00:F1E8 C0 04        CPY.B #$04                      ; } Contents 6 in tileset 4 (switch palace): go to $00F1F9
$00:F1EA F0 0D        BEQ $F1F9                       ; /
$00:F1EC 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$00:F1ED A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:F1EF 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $02
$00:F1F0 AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F1F1 22 52 87 02  JSL.L $8752                     ; Spawn the bounce sprite ($8752)
$00:F1F5 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$00:F1F6 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F1F7 18           CLC                             ; Carry clear
$00:F1F8 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:F1F9 A5 99        LDA RAM_BlockYHi                ; \
$00:F1FB 4A           LSR                             ; / Carry = bit 0 of block Y high byte
$00:F1FC A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:F1FE 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; |
$00:F200 2A           ROL                             ; |
$00:F201 2A           ROL                             ; |
$00:F202 2A           ROL                             ; } Y = (Y high bit 0) * 4 + Y low / $40: index of the 64 pixel row (0-7)
$00:F203 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:F204 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:F206 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F207 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F208 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F209 4A           LSR                             ; } X = block column (X low / 16)
$00:F20A AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:F20B B9 F3 13     LDA.W $13F3,Y                   ; \
$00:F20E 1F EC F0 00  ORA.L $F0EC,X                   ; |
$00:F212 BE F3 13     LDX.W $13F3,Y                   ; } [$13F3 + Y] |= bit mask for X ($F0EC); X = previous value
$00:F215 99 F3 13     STA.W $13F3,Y                   ; /
$00:F218 C9 FF        CMP.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:F21A D0 0A        BNE $F226                       ; / All bits set? Not yet: go to $00F226
$00:F21C A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$00:F21E 85 05        STA $05                         ; / [$05] = 5
$00:F220 A9 17        LDA.B #$17                      ; \
$00:F222 85 07        STA $07                         ; / [$07] = $17: block the tile turns into
$00:F224 80 C6        BRA $F1EC                       ; Spawn the bounce sprite ($00F1EC)

$00:F226 AD 1B 14     LDA.W $141B                     ; \
$00:F229 D0 0B        BNE $F236                       ; / [$141B] non-zero: go straight to $00F236
$00:F22B 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:F22C F0 02        BEQ $F230                       ; / A = 0 if no block was hit here before
$00:F22E A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; Otherwise A = 2
$00:F230 49 03        EOR.B #$03                      ; \
$00:F232 25 13        AND RAM_FrameCounter            ; / A = (A xor 3) AND frame counter: probably a timing check
$00:F234 D0 EA        BNE $F220                       ; Non-zero: use the $17 block variant ($00F220)
$00:F236 A9 2A        LDA.B #$2A                      ; \
$00:F238 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play sound effect $2A
$00:F23B 5A           PHY                             ; Save Y
$00:F23C 64 05        STZ $05                         ; [$05] = 0 (no contents)
$00:F23E 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$00:F23F A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:F241 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $02
$00:F242 AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F243 22 52 87 02  JSL.L $8752                     ; Spawn the bounce sprite ($8752)
$00:F247 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$00:F248 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$00:F249 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: loop over the eight blocks of the row group
$00:F24B B9 F3 13     LDA.W $13F3,Y                   ; A = hit flags [$13F3 + Y]
$00:F24E 4A           LSR                             ; Shift the next flag bit into carry
$00:F24F B0 10        BCS $F261                       ; Bit set: skip to the next block
$00:F251 48           PHA                             ; Save the shifted flags
$00:F252 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; \
$00:F254 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; / Block to generate = $0D (used block)
$00:F256 BF F8 F0 00  LDA.L $F0F8,X                   ; \
$00:F25A 85 9A        STA RAM_BlockXLo                ; / [BlockXLo] = X position of block X ($F0F8)
$00:F25C 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; Generate the tile
$00:F260 68           PLA                             ; Restore the shifted flags
$00:F261 CA           DEX                             ; Next block
$00:F262 10 EA        BPL $F24E                       ; Loop for X = 7..0
$00:F264 4C F6 F1     JMP.W $F1F6                     ; Restore X and return ($00F1F6)

$00:F267 C0 2E        CPY.B #$2E                      ; \
$00:F269 D0 20        BNE $F28B                       ; / Only for tile $2E (turn block); others return
$00:F26B 24 16        BIT $16                         ; \
$00:F26D 50 1C        BVC $F28B                       ; / Return unless the Y/X button was just pressed ([$16] bit 6)
$00:F26F AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$00:F272 0D 7A 18     ORA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; } Return if carrying something ([$148F]) or riding Yoshi
$00:F275 D0 14        BNE $F28B                       ; /
$00:F277 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:F279 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $02
$00:F27A AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F27B 22 2F 86 02  JSL.L $862F                     ; Try to spawn a carried throw block sprite ($862F); N set = failed
$00:F27F 30 08        BMI $F289                       ; Failed: skip the tile change
$00:F281 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:F283 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; } Block to generate = $02 (empty): the turn block disappears
$00:F285 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; /
$00:F289 4B           PHK                             ; \
$00:F28A AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = $00 (program bank)
$00:F28B 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F28C 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:F28D 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F28E E9 6F        SBC.B #$6F                      ; } Tiles $6F-$72 (invisible 1-up checkpoints): A = tile - $6F; others go to $00F2C0
$00:F290 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; /
$00:F292 B0 2C        BCS $F2C0                       ; Not a checkpoint tile: go to $00F2C0
$00:F294 CD 21 14     CMP.W $1421                     ; \
$00:F297 F0 0F        BEQ $F2A8                       ; / Touched the one the counter expects ([$1421]): advance
$00:F299 1A           INC A                           ; \
$00:F29A CD 21 14     CMP.W $1421                     ; } Touched the one before the counter: ignore
$00:F29D F0 20        BEQ $F2BF                       ; /
$00:F29F AD 21 14     LDA.W $1421                     ; \
$00:F2A2 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; } Counter already complete (>= 4): ignore
$00:F2A4 B0 19        BCS $F2BF                       ; /
$00:F2A6 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; Wrong order: A = $FF so that the counter restarts at 0
$00:F2A8 1A           INC A                           ; Advance, or reset to 0
$00:F2A9 8D 21 14     STA.W $1421                     ; Store [$1421], the checkpoint progress counter
$00:F2AC C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; \
$00:F2AE D0 0F        BNE $F2BF                       ; / Not yet 4: return
$00:F2B0 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F2B1 22 D9 C2 03  JSL.L TriggerInivis1Up          ; Spawn the invisible 1-up (TriggerInivis1Up)
$00:F2B5 20 B2 F3     JSR.W $F3B2                     ; Y = byte index, A = bit mask for the current level number ($F3B2)
$00:F2B8 19 3C 1F     ORA.W $1F3C,Y                   ; \
$00:F2BB 99 3C 1F     STA.W $1F3C,Y                   ; / Set the level's flag in the bit array at [$1F3C + Y]
$00:F2BE FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F2BF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F2C0 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$00:F2C2 C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; \
$00:F2C4 B0 03        BCS $F2C9                       ; / Tiles $06 and up: go to $00F2C9
$00:F2C6 04 8A        TSB $8A                         ; Tiles $00-$05: set bit 0 of [$8A]
$00:F2C8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F2C9 C0 38        CPY.B #$38                      ; \
$00:F2CB D0 21        BNE $F2EE                       ; / Tile $38: handle it here, everything else goes on to $00F2EE
$00:F2CD A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$00:F2CF 85 9C        STA RAM_BlockBlock              ; } Block to generate = $02: remove the tile
$00:F2D1 22 B0 BE 00  JSL.L GenerateTile              ; /
$00:F2D5 20 5A FD     JSR.W $FD5A                     ; Spawn a twinkle effect ($FD5A)
$00:F2D8 AD CD 13     LDA.W $13CD                     ; \
$00:F2DB F0 03        BEQ $F2E0                       ; / [$13CD] clear: skip the next call
$00:F2DD 20 2B CA     JSR.W $CA2B                     ; Flag set: run $CA2B
$00:F2E0 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:F2E2 D0 04        BNE $F2E8                       ; / Mario already big: no change
$00:F2E4 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F2E6 85 19        STA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; / Small Mario becomes big
$00:F2E8 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$00:F2EA 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $05
$00:F2ED 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F2EE C0 06        CPY.B #$06                      ; \
$00:F2F0 F0 0A        BEQ $F2FC                       ; / Tile $06: go to $00F2FC with A = 1
$00:F2F2 C0 07        CPY.B #$07                      ; \
$00:F2F4 90 13        BCC $F309                       ; / Tiles < $07: go to $00F309
$00:F2F6 C0 1D        CPY.B #$1D                      ; \
$00:F2F8 B0 0F        BCS $F309                       ; / Tiles >= $1D: go to $00F309
$00:F2FA 09 80        ORA.B #$80                      ; Tiles $07-$1C: A = $81
$00:F2FC C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F2FE D0 02        BNE $F302                       ; / Tile $06 (A = 1): also set bits $18
$00:F300 09 18        ORA.B #$18                      ; A = $19
$00:F302 04 8B        TSB $8B                         ; Set the flag bits in [$8B] (probably the climbing / tile-contact flags)
$00:F304 A5 93        LDA $93                         ; \
$00:F306 85 8C        STA $8C                         ; / [$8C] = [$93]
$00:F308 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F309 C0 2F        CPY.B #$2F                      ; \
$00:F30B B0 04        BCS $F311                       ; / Tiles >= $2F: go to $00F311
$00:F30D C0 2A        CPY.B #$2A                      ; \
$00:F30F B0 1A        BCS $F32B                       ; / Tiles $2A-$2E: go to $00F32B
$00:F311 C0 6E        CPY.B #$6E                      ; \
$00:F313 D0 61        BNE $F376                       ; / Only tile $6E (3-up moon) continues
$00:F315 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$00:F317 22 8A F3 00  JSL.L $F38A                     ; / Spawn the 3-up score sprite at Mario ($F38A, A = $0F)
$00:F31B EE C5 13     INC.W $13C5                     ; [$13C5]++: moon collected
$00:F31E DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F31F 20 B2 F3     JSR.W $F3B2                     ; Y = byte index, A = bit mask for the current level number
$00:F322 19 EE 1F     ORA.W $1FEE,Y                   ; \
$00:F325 99 EE 1F     STA.W $1FEE,Y                   ; / Set the level's flag in the bit array at [$1FEE + Y] (moon collected)
$00:F328 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F329 80 40        BRA $F36B                       ; Remove the tile ($00F36B)

$00:F32B D0 05        BNE $F332                       ; Not tile $2A: go to $00F332
$00:F32D AD AD 14     LDA.W RAM_BluePowTimer          ; \
$00:F330 F0 44        BEQ $F376                       ; / Tile $2A only counts while the blue POW timer is running
$00:F332 C0 2D        CPY.B #$2D                      ; \
$00:F334 F0 09        BEQ $F33F                       ; / Tile $2D: go to $00F33F
$00:F336 90 2F        BCC $F367                       ; Tiles $2B-$2C: coins ($00F367)
$00:F338 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:F33A 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F33B E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; } Tile $2E: move the block position up one block (other half of the Yoshi coin)
$00:F33D 85 98        STA RAM_BlockYLo                ; /
$00:F33F 22 77 F3 00  JSL.L $F377                     ; Spawn the escalating score sprite for Yoshi coins ($F377)
$00:F343 EE 22 14     INC.W $1422                     ; \
$00:F346 AD 22 14     LDA.W $1422                     ; } [$1422]++ : Yoshi coins collected in this level
$00:F349 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; /
$00:F34B 90 0B        BCC $F358                       ; Fewer than 5: skip the flag
$00:F34D DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F34E 20 B2 F3     JSR.W $F3B2                     ; Y = byte index, A = bit mask for the current level number
$00:F351 19 2F 1F     ORA.W $1F2F,Y                   ; \
$00:F354 99 2F 1F     STA.W $1F2F,Y                   ; / 5 Yoshi coins: set the level's flag in the bit array at [$1F2F + Y]
$00:F357 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F358 A9 1C        LDA.B #$1C                      ; \
$00:F35A 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $1C

;;; $F3E5: Pipe entry, map16 lookup at collision point (PIPE_BUTTONS) ;;;
;; PIPE_BUTTONS: controller bit needed to enter a pipe, indexed 0-3 (Left, Right, Up, Down).
;; $00F3E9: entry for tiles $37/$38 (A = button index). Checks alignment, the button in [$15], then starts the
;;     pipe animation ([$71], [$1419], [$88], [$89]).
;; $00F443: carry = Mario's center is in the right half of a block. $00F44D: sets the collision point
;;     [$9A]/[$98] from Mario's position plus table offset.
;; $00F465: converts the collision point to a map16 address for layer 1 or 2, horizontal or vertical level
;;     ([$8E]), reads the tile low byte into [$1693]
;; and the high byte into A, then adjusts for switches via $00F545. Out of range: Y = $25 (empty), A = 0.
;; Returns: Y = [$1693], A = high byte, Z set from A.
;; $00F545: P-switch tile swapping, first part (tile $29 invisible POW block becomes $24 while the blue POW is
;;     active).
$00:F3E5              .db $02,$01,$08,$04             ; Button for each pipe index: $02 Left, $01 Right, $08 Up, $04 Down

$00:F3E9 EB           XBA                             ; Stash the button index in B
$00:F3EA 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:F3EB 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F3EC E9 37        SBC.B #$37                      ; |
$00:F3EE C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; } Tiles $37/$38 only (Y = tile - $37); others return
$00:F3F0 B0 50        BCS $F442                       ; /
$00:F3F2 A8           TAY                             ; Y = 0 or 1
$00:F3F3 A5 92        LDA $92                         ; A = [$92]
$00:F3F5 F9 E3 F3     SBC.W $F3E3,Y                   ; Subtract the entry alignment offset ($F3E3)
$00:F3F8 C9 05        CMP.B #$05                      ; \
$00:F3FA B0 43        BCS $F43F                       ; / Not within 5 of the pipe: restore Y and return ($00F43F)
$00:F3FC DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F3FD EB           XBA                             ; \
$00:F3FE AA           TAX                             ; / X = button index
$00:F3FF A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20: pipe entry timer
$00:F401 AC 7A 18     LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:F404 F0 02        BEQ $F408                       ; / Riding Yoshi?
$00:F406 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; Then $30
$00:F408 A0 06        LDY.B #$06                      ; Y = 6: Mario animation for the pipe entry
$00:F40A 85 88        STA $88                         ; [$88] = pipe entry timer
$00:F40C A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:F40E 3D E5 F3     AND.W PIPE_BUTTONS,X            ; } Required direction button not pressed in [$15]: no pipe ($00F43E)
$00:F411 F0 2B        BEQ $F43E                       ; /
$00:F413 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Lock sprites
$00:F415 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F417 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; / Mario faces right if the pressed button was Right
$00:F419 86 89        STX $89                         ; [$89] = pipe direction index
$00:F41B 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:F41C 4A           LSR                             ; } X = index / 2: 0 = horizontal, 1 = vertical
$00:F41D AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:F41E D0 10        BNE $F430                       ; Vertical pipe: skip the carry check
$00:F420 AD 8F 14     LDA.W $148F                     ; \
$00:F423 F0 0B        BEQ $F430                       ; / Horizontal pipe, carrying something ([$148F])?
$00:F425 A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$00:F427 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Turn Mario around
$00:F429 85 76        STA RAM_MarioDirection          ; /
$00:F42B A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$00:F42D 8D 99 14     STA.W RAM_FaceCamImgTimer       ; / Face-the-camera timer = 8
$00:F430 E8           INX                             ; X + 1
$00:F431 8E 19 14     STX.W RAM_YoshiInPipe           ; [$1419] = 1 (horizontal) or 2 (vertical): entering a pipe
$00:F434 84 71        STY RAM_MarioAnimation          ; Mario animation = Y
$00:F436 20 2D F6     JSR.W NoButtons                 ; Clear the controller mirrors (NoButtons)
$00:F439 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:F43B 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $04 (pipe)
$00:F43E FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F43F AC 93 16     LDY.W $1693                     ; Y = [$1693]: the tile number
$00:F442 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F481 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = Y position rounded down to a block row (high nibble)
$00:F483 A6 9B        LDX RAM_BlockXHi                ; \

$00:F487 B0 17        BCS $F4A0                       ; /

$00:F491 18           CLC                             ; \

$00:F496 85 00        STA $00                         ; /

$00:F4AA B0 3B        BCS $F4E7                       ; /
$00:F4AC A6 99        LDX RAM_BlockYHi                ; \
$00:F4AE E4 5D        CPX RAM_ScreensInLvl            ; } Y screen >= screens in level: outside
$00:F4B0 B0 35        BCS $F4E7                       ; /
$00:F4B2 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:F4B4 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } $00 = Y position rounded down to a block row
$00:F4B6 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:F4B8 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:F4BA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F4BB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F4BC 4A           LSR                             ; } Column: X position / 16
$00:F4BD 4A           LSR                             ; /
$00:F4BE 05 00        ORA $00                         ; Row | column
$00:F4C0 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:F4C1 7F 80 BA 00  ADC.L $BA80,X                   ; } Add the screen's start offset ($BA80), low byte
$00:F4C5 85 00        STA $00                         ; /

$00:F4CD 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = high byte of the map16 pointer
$00:F4CF A9 7E        LDA.B #$7E                      ; \

$00:F525 B0 C0        BCS $F4E7                       ; /
