;;; $F55A: P-switch: coin and switch palace tiles (PSwitchNotInvQBlk) ;;;
;; Tile $2B (coin) goes to PSwitchCoinBrown; tiles $EC-$FB set [$1423] and become a brown block ($32); others
;;     return with A = 0.
$00:F55A C0 2B        CPY.B #$2B                      ; \
$00:F55C F0 0E        BEQ PSwitchCoinBrown            ; / Tile $2B (coin): go to PSwitchCoinBrown
$00:F55E 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:F55F 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F560 E9 EC        SBC.B #$EC                      ; |
$00:F562 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; } Tiles $EC-$FB only; others return with A = 0
$00:F564 B0 2C        BCS $F592                       ; /
$00:F566 1A           INC A                           ; \
$00:F567 8D 23 14     STA.W $1423                     ; / [$1423] = tile - $EC + 1 (switch palace color)
$00:F56A 80 05        BRA $F571                       ; Make it a brown block


;;; $F56C: P-switch tile swaps and fall-off kill (PSwitchCoinBrown) ;;;
;; PSwitchCoinBrown: coin becomes a brown block ($32) while the blue POW is active.
;; $00F577: high byte non-zero: brown block becomes a coin while blue POW is active; muncher becomes a coin
;;     while the silver POW is active.
;; $00F595: called each frame: stops Mario rising more than $80 pixels above the screen, kills him (or
;;     finishes the level via $00C95B in special
;; levels, [$1B95]) when he is more than a screen below.
$00:F56C AC AD 14     LDY.W RAM_BluePowTimer          ; \
$00:F56F F0 23        BEQ $F594                       ; / POW not active: return
$00:F571 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; \
$00:F573 8D 93 16     STA.W $1693                     ; / Tile = $32 (brown block)
$00:F576 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:F577 AC 93 16     LDY.W $1693                     ; Y = tile number
$00:F57A C0 32        CPY.B #$32                      ; \
$00:F57C D0 06        BNE $F584                       ; / Tile $32 (brown block)?
$00:F57E AC AD 14     LDY.W RAM_BluePowTimer          ; \
$00:F581 D0 0A        BNE $F58D                       ; / Blue POW active: make it a coin ($00F58D)
$00:F583 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:F584 C0 2F        CPY.B #$2F                      ; \
$00:F586 D0 0C        BNE $F594                       ; / Tile $2F (muncher)? No: return
$00:F588 AC AE 14     LDY.W RAM_SilverPowTimer        ; \
$00:F58B F0 07        BEQ $F594                       ; / Silver POW timer is zero: return
$00:F58D A0 2B        LDY.B #$2B                      ; \
$00:F58F 8C 93 16     STY.W $1693                     ; / Tile = $2B (coin)
$00:F592 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$00:F594 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:F595 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F597 A9 80 FF     LDA.W #$FF80                    ; \
$00:F59A 18           CLC                             ; } A = Y position of screen top - $80
$00:F59B 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; /
$00:F59D C5 96        CMP RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:F59F 30 02        BMI $F5A3                       ; / Mario is below that line: fine
$00:F5A1 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Clamp: Mario Y = top of screen - $80
$00:F5A3 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F5A5 A5 81        LDA $81                         ; \
$00:F5A7 3A           DEC A                           ; } [$81] = 0 (Mario is not below the screen): return
$00:F5A8 30 0C        BMI $F5B6                       ; /
$00:F5AA AD 95 1B     LDA.W $1B95                     ; \
$00:F5AD F0 03        BEQ $F5B2                       ; / [$1B95] zero: kill Mario
$00:F5AF 4C 5B C9     JMP.W $C95B                     ; Special case: finish the level instead ($00C95B)

$00:F5B2 22 0A F6 00  JSL.L $F60A                     ; Kill Mario without the upward speed ($F60A)
$00:F5B6 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $F5B7: Hurt Mario (HurtMario) ;;;
;; Ignored during an animation, flashing, star power or level end. Small Mario dies, cape Mario soaring loses
;;     the soaring, others power down.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:F159: Block interaction: hurt tiles, bounce blocks, coins
;;     $01:A917: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt (ReturnNoContact2)
;;     $01:B101: Cheep Cheep main (Fish)
;;     $01:D319: Koopa Kid boss: landing, stomp, fireballs
;;     $01:E604: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
;;     $01:FD05: Iggy/Larry: tilting-platform Koopaling (PlatformKoopaKids)
;;     $02:8CF6: Minor extended sprite 0A: Boo stream (BooStreamTiles)
;;     $02:A4AE: Extended sprite: smoke puff, contact with Mario (SmokePuff)
;;     $02:C815: Chuck: interact with Mario
;;     $02:D4D7: Layer 3 smash: states and Mario collision (Layer3SmashPtrs)
;;     $02:F296: Wiggler draw, contact and flower spawn (WigglerTiles)
;;     $02:F9FA: Sumo Bro flame: contact with Mario
;;     ... and 8 more
$00:F5B7 A5 71        LDA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; \
$00:F5B9 D0 6D        BNE $F628                       ; / Return if an animation is running
$00:F5BB AD 97 14     LDA.W $1497                     ; \
$00:F5BE 0D 90 14     ORA.W $1490                     ; |
$00:F5C1 0D 93 14     ORA.W $1493                     ; } Return if flashing ([$1497]), star ([$1490]) or level ending ([$1493])
$00:F5C4 D0 62        BNE $F628                       ; /
$00:F5C6 9C E3 18     STZ.W $18E3                     ; [$18E3] = 0
$00:F5C9 AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; \
$00:F5CC F0 07        BEQ $F5D5                       ; / Not wall-walking: skip
$00:F5CE 8B           PHB                             ; \
$00:F5CF 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = $00
$00:F5D0 AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F5D1 20 42 EB     JSR.W $EB42                     ; Stop wall-walking ($EB42)
$00:F5D4 AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank
$00:F5D5 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; \
$00:F5D7 F0 2D        BEQ KillMario                   ; / Small Mario: kill him
$00:F5D9 C9 02        CMP.B #$02                      ; \
$00:F5DB D0 16        BNE PowerDown                   ; / Not cape Mario: power down
$00:F5DD AD 07 14     LDA.W $1407                     ; \
$00:F5E0 F0 11        BEQ PowerDown                   ; / Cape Mario that is not soaring ([$1407] = 0): power down

;;; $F5E2: Hurt: cape soaring ends (CancelSoaring) ;;;
;; Plays a sound, sets the spin jump flag and a flashing timer of $30 and clears the cape status.
$00:F5E2 A0 0F        LDY.B #$0F                      ; \
$00:F5E4 8C F9 1D     STY.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $0F (soaring ends)
$00:F5E7 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F5E9 8D 0D 14     STA.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; / [RAM_IsSpinJump] = 1
$00:F5EC A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$00:F5EE 8D 97 14     STA.W $1497                     ; / Flashing timer [$1497] = $30
$00:F5F1 80 2F        BRA $F622                       ; Common ending ($00F622)


;;; $F5F3: Hurt: shrink to small Mario (PowerDown) ;;;
;; Plays sound $04, drops the reserve item, starts animation 1, sets Mario to small and sets the hurt timer to
;;     $2F.
$00:F5F3 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; \
$00:F5F5 8C F9 1D     STY.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect $04 (power down)
$00:F5F8 22 08 80 02  JSL.L $8008                     ; Drop the reserve item ($8008)
$00:F5FC A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:F5FE 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = 1 (power down)
$00:F600 64 19        STZ RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; Mario power-up = 0 (small)
$00:F602 A9 2F        LDA.B #$2F                      ; A = $2F: hurt timer
$00:F604 80 17        BRA $F61D                       ; Set the timers ($00F61D)


;;; $F606: Kill Mario (KillMario) ;;;
;; Mario Y speed = $90, death music, animation 9, hurt/lock timer $30, clears cape status. $00F60A is the
;;     entry without the upward speed.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:8E6B: Status bar: update counters and tiles (DMAdata_StBr2)
;;     $00:F629: Kill Mario (KillMario)
$00:F606 A9 90        LDA.B #$90                      ; \
$00:F608 85 7D        STA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; / Mario Y speed = $90 (jump up)
$00:F60A A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:F60C 8D FB 1D     STA.W $1DFB                     ; / Music request [$1DFB] = $09 (death)
$00:F60F A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; \
$00:F611 8D DA 0D     STA.W $0DDA                     ; / [$0DDA] = $FF (probably forces the music to restart)
$00:F614 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$00:F616 85 71        STA RAM_MarioAnimation          ; / Mario animation = 9 (dying)
$00:F618 9C 0D 14     STZ.W RAM_IsSpinJump            ; Spin jump flag = 0
$00:F61B A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; A = $30
$00:F61D 8D 96 14     STA.W $1496                     ; [$1496] = hurt timer (A)
$00:F620 85 9D        STA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; Sprites locked for the same time
$00:F622 9C 07 14     STZ.W $1407                     ; Cape status [$1407] = 0
$00:F625 9C 8A 18     STZ.W $188A                     ; [$188A] = 0
$00:F628 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:F629 22 06 F6 00  JSL.L KillMario                 ; Kill Mario (KillMario)

;;; $F62D: Clear controller, Mario GFX DMA setup (NoButtons) ;;;
;; NoButtons: clears the controller mirrors [$15]-[$18]. $00F629 kills Mario first.
;; $00F636: builds Mario's graphics DMA list ($0D85-$0D99) from the tile words [$09]-[$0C] and sets [$0D84] =
;;     $0A. Called from $E458.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:96D8: Game mode 11: Mario Start, level music (MarioStartGameMode)
;;     $00:9C6C: Game mode 07: title screen and demo (GAMEMODE_07)
;;     $00:A1F2: Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode)
;;     $00:A59F: Game mode 12: prepare level (GM04Load)
;;     $00:C5DB: Mario animation B: freeze with message box (UnknownAniB)
;;     $00:C6E7: Mario animation C: scripted cutscene movement (UnknownAniC)
;;     $00:C7FD: Mario animation 8: Yoshi wings exit (YoshiWingsAni)
;;     $00:C893: Mario animation A: scripted walk, level end (EnterCastleAni)
;;     $00:C8BF: Mario animation A: scripted walk, level end (EnterCastleAni)
;;     $00:C915: Mario animation A: scripted walk, level end (EnterCastleAni)
;;     $00:D197: Mario animation 5: horizontal pipe (DoorPipeAni)
;;     $00:D203: Mario animation 6: vertical pipe (VertPipeAni)
;;     ... and 3 more
$00:F62D 64 15        STZ RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:F62F 64 16        STZ $16                         ; |
$00:F631 64 17        STZ RAM_ControllerB             ; } Clear the controller mirrors [$15]-[$18]
$00:F633 64 18        STZ $18                   :/    ; /
$00:F635 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F636 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F638 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0 (unused)
$00:F63A A5 09        LDA $09                         ; \
$00:F63C 09 00 08     ORA.W #$0800                    ; |
$00:F63F C5 09        CMP $09                         ; |
$00:F641 F0 01        BEQ $F644                       ; } Carry = bit 11 of [$09]
$00:F643 18           CLC                             ; /
$00:F644 29 00 F7     AND.W #$F700                    ; \
$00:F647 6A           ROR                             ; |
$00:F648 4A           LSR                             ; } A = ([$09] AND $F700) / 4 plus carry in bit 13, + $2000
$00:F649 69 00 20     ADC.W #$2000                    ; /
$00:F64C 8D 85 0D     STA.W $0D85                     ; [$0D85] = DMA source for Mario graphics part 1
$00:F64F 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:F650 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; } [$0D8F] = [$0D85] + $0200 (second row)
$00:F653 8D 8F 0D     STA.W $0D8F                     ; /
$00:F656 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0 (unused)
$00:F658 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$00:F65A 09 00 08     ORA.W #$0800                    ; |
$00:F65D C5 0A        CMP $0A                         ; |
$00:F65F F0 01        BEQ $F662                       ; } Carry = bit 11 of [$0A]
$00:F661 18           CLC                             ; /
$00:F662 29 00 F7     AND.W #$F700                    ; \
$00:F665 6A           ROR                             ; |
$00:F666 4A           LSR                             ; } A = ([$0A] AND $F700) / 4 plus carry in bit 13, + $2000
$00:F667 69 00 20     ADC.W #$2000                    ; /
$00:F66A 8D 87 0D     STA.W $0D87                     ; [$0D87] = DMA source for Mario graphics part 2
$00:F66D 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:F66E 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; } [$0D91] = [$0D87] + $0200
$00:F671 8D 91 0D     STA.W $0D91                     ; /
$00:F674 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$00:F676 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; |
$00:F679 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F67A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F67B 4A           LSR                             ; } A = ([$0B] high byte) * 32 + $2000
$00:F67C 69 00 20     ADC.W #$2000                    ; /
$00:F67F 8D 89 0D     STA.W $0D89                     ; [$0D89] = DMA source for Mario graphics part 3
$00:F682 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:F683 69 00 02     ADC.W #$0200                    ; } [$0D93] = [$0D89] + $0200
$00:F686 8D 93 0D     STA.W $0D93                     ; /
$00:F689 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$00:F68B 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; |
$00:F68E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F68F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F690 4A           LSR                             ; } A = ([$0C] high byte) * 32 + $2000
$00:F691 69 00 20     ADC.W #$2000                    ; /
$00:F694 8D 99 0D     STA.W $0D99                     ; [$0D99] = DMA source for Mario graphics part 4
$00:F697 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F699 A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$00:F69B 8D 84 0D     STA.W $0D84                     ; / [$0D84] = $0A: size of the DMA list processed by MarioGFXDMA
$00:F69E 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $F69F..F6BB: Table: vertical scroll thresholds and steps ;;;
$00:F69F              .db $64,$00,$7C,$00             ; Vertical scroll: Mario screen Y: $0064 (scroll up), $007C (scroll down)

$00:F6A3              .db $00,$00,$FF,$FF             ; Sign flip masks: $0000, $FFFF

$00:F6A7              .db $FD,$FF,$05,$00,$FA,$FF     ; Vertical scroll step: -3 (up), +5 (down), -6 (other)

$00:F6AD              .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$C0,$00     ; Vertical scroll limit: $0000, $0000, $00C0

$00:F6B3              .db $90,$00,$60,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Static camera limits: $0090, $0060, then zeros
$00:F6BB              .db $00,$00,$00,$00             ; zeros (continued)


;;; $F6BF..F6C7: Table: horizontal scroll steps ;;;
$00:F6BF              .db $00,$00,$FE,$FF,$02,$00,$00,$00 ; Horizontal scroll step: $0000, -2, +2 (and again)
$00:F6C7              .db $FE,$FF,$02,$00             ; -2, +2 (continued)


;;; $F6CB..F6D7: Table: static camera region values ;;;
$00:F6CB              .db $00,$00,$20,$00             ; Static camera region: $0000, $0020

$00:F6CF              .db $D0,$00,$00,$00,$20,$00,$D0,$00 ; Static camera values: $00D0, $0000, $0020, $00D0, $0001, $FFFF
$00:F6D7              .db $01,$00,$FF,$FF             ; $0001, $FFFF (continued)

;scrolling routine:

;;; $F6DB: Scroll screen to follow Mario ;;;
;; Per-frame camera update, called via JSL from the level game modes. Builds the left/right scroll lines from
;;     the dead-zone centre [$142A],
;; moves layer 1 toward Mario (horizontal and vertical), derives layer 2 scroll from it, and stores the per-
;;     frame scroll deltas.
;; Writes [$1A]-[$1D] (layer 1 X/Y), [$1E]/[$20] (layer 2 X/Y), deltas [$17BC]-[$17BF], and copies the new
;;     positions to [$1462]-[$1469].
;; Subroutines: $00F7F4 vertical scroll (Y = A limit), $00F8AB look-ahead adjustment. Uses tables
;;     $F69F-00F6CF.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9712: Game mode 11: Mario Start, level music (MarioStartGameMode)
;;     $00:9A58: Boss room frame code (bit 6 set)
;;     $00:A299: Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode)
$00:F6DB 8B           PHB                             ; \
$00:F6DC 4B           PHK                             ; } Save and set data bank = program bank ($00)
$00:F6DD AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F6DE C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F6E0 AD 2A 14     LDA.W $142A                     ; \
$00:F6E3 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F6E4 E9 0C 00     SBC.W #$000C                    ; } Left scroll line [$142C] = [$142A] - $0C
$00:F6E7 8D 2C 14     STA.W $142C                     ; /
$00:F6EA 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:F6EB 69 18 00     ADC.W #$0018                    ; } Right scroll line [$142E] = left line + $18
$00:F6EE 8D 2E 14     STA.W $142E                     ; /
$00:F6F1 AD 62 14     LDA.W $1462                     ; \
$00:F6F4 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; / Layer 1 X = [$1462] (previous frame position, so scrolling starts from it)
$00:F6F6 AD 64 14     LDA.W $1464                     ; \
$00:F6F9 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; / Layer 1 Y = [$1464]
$00:F6FB AD 66 14     LDA.W $1466                     ; \
$00:F6FE 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; / Layer 2 X = [$1466]
$00:F700 AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$00:F703 85 20        STA $20                         ; / Layer 2 Y = [$1468]
$00:F705 A5 5B        LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl           ; \
$00:F707 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F708 90 03        BCC $F70D                       ; } Vertical level? (bit 0 of [$5B]) If so go to $00F75C
$00:F70A 4C 5C F7     JMP.W $F75C                     ; /

;Horizontal level horizontal scrolling
$00:F70D A9 C0 00     LDA.W #$00C0                    ; A = lowest Y the screen may scroll down to in horizontal levels
$00:F710 20 F4 F7     JSR.W $F7F4                     ; Vertical scrolling
$00:F713 AC 11 14     LDY.W $1411                     ; \
$00:F716 F0 42        BEQ $F75A                       ; / Horizontal scroll disabled ([$1411] = 0): go to layer 2 scrolling
$00:F718 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2 (Mario right of the left line)
$00:F71A A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:F71C 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F71D E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } [$00] = A = Mario X on screen ([94] - [$1A])
$00:F71F 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:F721 CD 2A 14     CMP.W $142A                     ; \
$00:F724 10 02        BPL $F728                       ; / If Mario is right of the dead-zone centre [$142A] keep Y = 2
$00:F726 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Else Y = 0 (left)
$00:F728 84 55        STY $55                         ; \
$00:F72A 84 56        STY $56                         ; / Scroll direction [$55] = [$56] = Y
$00:F72C 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:F72D F9 2C 14     SBC.W $142C,Y                   ; } A = distance of Mario from the left or right scroll line; zero: no scroll
$00:F730 F0 28        BEQ $F75A                       ; /
$00:F732 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = distance
$00:F734 59 A3 F6     EOR.W $F6A3,Y                   ; Invert by side (tables $F6A3): only scroll when Mario is beyond the line
$00:F737 10 21        BPL $F75A                       ; Within the dead zone: no scroll
$00:F739 20 AB F8     JSR.W $F8AB                     ; Look-ahead adjustment of [$02] ($00F8AB)
$00:F73C A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$00:F73E 18           CLC                             ; } A = [$02] + layer 1 X
$00:F73F 65 1A        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; /
$00:F741 10 03        BPL $F746                       ; Not negative: keep it
$00:F743 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; \
$00:F746 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; / Clamp: do not scroll past the left edge (X = 0)
$00:F748 A5 5E        LDA $5E                         ; \
$00:F74A 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$00:F74B EB           XBA                             ; |
$00:F74C 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; |
$00:F74F 10 03        BPL $F754                       ; |
$00:F751 A9 80 00     LDA.W #$0080                    ; |
$00:F754 C5 1A        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$00:F756 10 02        BPL $F75A                       ; } Limit X to the last screen of the level ([$5E] - 1 screens, in the high byte)
$00:F758 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; /
$00:F75A 80 41        BRA $F79D                       ; Go to layer 2 scrolling

;Vertical Level horizontal scrolling
$00:F75C A5 5F        LDA $5F                         ; \
$00:F75E 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$00:F75F EB           XBA                             ; } A = (last screen of vertical level [$5F] - 1) << 8
$00:F760 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; /
$00:F763 20 F4 F7     JSR.W $F7F4                     ; Vertical scrolling
$00:F766 AC 11 14     LDY.W $1411                     ; \
$00:F769 F0 32        BEQ $F79D                       ; / Horizontal scroll disabled: go to layer 2 scrolling
$00:F76B A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (left)
$00:F76D A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:F76F 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F770 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; } [$00] = A = Mario X on screen
$00:F772 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:F774 CD 2A 14     CMP.W $142A                     ; \
$00:F777 30 02        BMI $F77B                       ; / Mario left of the dead-zone centre: keep Y = 0
$00:F779 A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Else Y = 2
$00:F77B 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:F77C F9 2C 14     SBC.W $142C,Y                   ; } [$02] = distance of Mario from the scroll line
$00:F77F 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$00:F781 59 A3 F6     EOR.W $F6A3,Y                   ; Invert by side
$00:F784 10 17        BPL $F79D                       ; Within the dead zone: no scroll
$00:F786 20 AB F8     JSR.W $F8AB                     ; Look-ahead adjustment ($00F8AB)
$00:F789 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$00:F78B 18           CLC                             ; } A = [$02] + layer 1 X
$00:F78C 65 1A        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; /
$00:F78E 10 03        BPL $F793                       ; Not negative: keep it
$00:F790 A9 00 00     LDA.W #$0000                    ; Clamp to 0 on the left
$00:F793 C9 01 01     CMP.W #$0101                    ; Compare with $0101 (always less than a fixed value, so the cap is probably never hit via the branch)
$00:F796 30 03        BMI $F79B                       ; Branch always taken when A < $101
$00:F798 A9 00 01     LDA.W #$0100                    ; Right limit = $0100
$00:F79B 85 1A        STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; Layer 1 X = A
;Layer 2 scrolling
$00:F79D AC 13 14     LDY.W $1413                     ; \
$00:F7A0 F0 08        BEQ $F7AA                       ; / [$1413] = 0 (layer 2 no horizontal scroll): layer 2 X stays put
$00:F7A2 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; A = layer 1 X
$00:F7A4 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:F7A5 F0 01        BEQ $F7A8                       ; / [$1413] = 1: layer 2 X = layer 1 X
$00:F7A7 4A           LSR                             ; [$1413] = 2: layer 2 X = layer 1 X / 2
$00:F7A8 85 1E        STA $1E                         ; Store layer 2 X
$00:F7AA AC 14 14     LDY.W $1414                     ; \
$00:F7AD F0 13        BEQ $F7C2                       ; / [$1414] = 0 (no vertical scroll for layer 2): leave it
$00:F7AF A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; A = layer 1 Y
$00:F7B1 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:F7B2 F0 08        BEQ $F7BC                       ; / [$1414] = 1: layer 2 Y = layer 1 Y
$00:F7B4 4A           LSR                             ; / 2
$00:F7B5 88           DEY                             ; \
$00:F7B6 F0 04        BEQ $F7BC                       ; / [$1414] = 2: layer 2 Y = layer 1 Y / 2
$00:F7B8 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:F7B9 4A           LSR                             ; |
$00:F7BA 4A           LSR                             ; } Else layer 2 Y = layer 1 Y / 16
$00:F7BB 4A           LSR                             ; /
$00:F7BC 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:F7BD 6D 17 14     ADC.W $1417                     ; / Add the layer 2 Y offset [$1417]
$00:F7C0 85 20        STA $20                         ; Store layer 2 Y
$00:F7C2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F7C4 A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$00:F7C6 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F7C7 ED 62 14     SBC.W $1462                     ; } [$17BD] = layer 1 X scroll delta this frame
$00:F7CA 8D BD 17     STA.W $17BD                     ; /
$00:F7CD A5 1C        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; \
$00:F7CF 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F7D0 ED 64 14     SBC.W $1464                     ; } [$17BC] = layer 1 Y scroll delta this frame
$00:F7D3 8D BC 17     STA.W $17BC                     ; /
$00:F7D6 A5 1E        LDA $1E                         ; \
$00:F7D8 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F7D9 ED 66 14     SBC.W $1466                     ; } [$17BF] = layer 2 X scroll delta (positive = scrolled left)
$00:F7DC 8D BF 17     STA.W $17BF                     ; /
$00:F7DF A5 20        LDA $20                         ; \
$00:F7E1 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F7E2 ED 68 14     SBC.W $1468                     ; } [$17BE] = layer 2 Y scroll delta
$00:F7E5 8D BE 17     STA.W $17BE                     ; /
$00:F7E8 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7
$00:F7EA B5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,X        ; \
$00:F7EC 9D 62 14     STA.W $1462,X                   ; / Copy the 8 scroll position bytes [$1A]-[$21] to [$1462]-[$1469] (previous frame)
$00:F7EF CA           DEX                             ; \
$00:F7F0 10 F8        BPL $F7EA                       ; / Loop for X = 7..0
$00:F7F2 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:F7F3 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

;Vertical Scrolling
$00:F7F4 AE 12 14     LDX.W $1412                     ; \
$00:F7F7 D0 01        BNE $F7FA                       ; / Vertical scroll disabled ([$1412] = 0): return
$00:F7F9 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F7FA 85 04        STA $04                         ; [$04] = bottom limit of the screen Y (A)
$00:F7FC A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0 (scroll up)
$00:F7FE A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:F800 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:F801 E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; } [$00] = A = Mario Y on screen
$00:F803 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:F805 C9 70 00     CMP.W #$0070                    ; \
$00:F808 30 02        BMI $F80C                       ; / Mario above Y = $70 on screen: keep Y = 0
$00:F80A A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Else Y = 2 (scroll down)
$00:F80C 84 55        STY $55                         ; \
$00:F80E 84 56        STY $56                         ; / Scroll direction [$55] = [$56] = Y (0 up, 2 down, 4 misc)
$00:F810 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:F811 F9 9F F6     SBC.W $F69F,Y                   ; / A = Mario screen Y - $64 (up) or - $7C (down)
$00:F814 85 02        STA $02                         ; [$02] = A
$00:F816 59 A3 F6     EOR.W $F6A3,Y                   ; Invert by direction
$00:F819 30 04        BMI $F81F                       ; Beyond the threshold: go on to scroll
$00:F81B A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2 (down)
$00:F81D 64 02        STZ $02                         ; [$02] = 0 (no scroll)
$00:F81F A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$00:F821 30 07        BMI $F82A                       ; / [$02] negative: go to $00F82A
$00:F823 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$00:F825 8E 04 14     STX.W $1404                     ; / Clear free vertical scroll [$1404]
$00:F828 80 59        BRA $F883                       ; Go to $00F883

$00:F82A E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F82C AD E3 13     LDA.W RAM_WallWalkStatus        ; \
$00:F82F C9 06        CMP.B #$06                      ; / Wall-run status [$13E3] >= 6: go to $00F845 with A = it
$00:F831 B0 12        BCS $F845                       ; Branch if wall running
$00:F833 AD 10 14     LDA.W RAM_YoshiHasWingsB        ; \
$00:F836 4A           LSR                             ; / Winged Yoshi ([$1410] >> 1)
$00:F837 0D 9F 14     ORA.W $149F                     ; OR fly timer [$149F]
$00:F83A 05 74        ORA RAM_IsClimbing              ; OR climbing flag
$00:F83C 0D F3 13     ORA.W $13F3                     ; OR P-balloon [$13F3]
$00:F83F 0D C2 18     ORA.W $18C2                     ; OR riding Lakitu cloud [$18C2]
$00:F842 0D 06 14     ORA.W $1406                     ; OR springboard/trampoline flag [$1406]
$00:F845 AA           TAX                             ; X = combined flags (non-zero = keep scrolling up freely)
$00:F846 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F848 D0 1F        BNE $F869                       ; Flags set: go to $00F869
$00:F84A AE 7A 18     LDX.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; \
$00:F84D F0 07        BEQ $F856                       ; |
$00:F84F AE 1E 14     LDX.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; |
$00:F852 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; } On Yoshi: wings [$141E] >= 2: go to $00F869
$00:F854 B0 13        BCS $F869                       ; /
$00:F856 A6 75        LDX RAM_IsSwimming              ; \
$00:F858 F0 04        BEQ $F85E                       ; |
$00:F85A A6 72        LDX RAM_IsFlying                ; } Swimming: allow scroll up unless in the air ([$72]) then go to $00F869
$00:F85C D0 0B        BNE $F869                       ; /
$00:F85E AE 12 14     LDX.W $1412                     ; \
$00:F861 CA           DEX                             ; } [$1412] = 1: go to $00F875
$00:F862 F0 11        BEQ $F875                       ; /
$00:F864 AE F1 13     LDX.W $13F1                     ; \
$00:F867 D0 0C        BNE $F875                       ; / Vertical scroll enable flag [$13F1] set: go to $00F875
$00:F869 8E F1 13     STX.W $13F1                     ; [$13F1] = X
$00:F86C AE F1 13     LDX.W $13F1                     ; \
$00:F86F D0 10        BNE $F881                       ; / [$13F1] non-zero: continue at $00F881
$00:F871 A0 04        LDY.B #$04                      ; Y = 4 (misc scroll up)
$00:F873 80 0C        BRA $F881                       ; Continue at $00F881

$00:F875 AE 04 14     LDX.W $1404                     ; \
$00:F878 D0 07        BNE $F881                       ; / Free scroll [$1404] set: continue
$00:F87A A6 72        LDX RAM_IsFlying                ; \
$00:F87C D0 2C        BNE $F8AA                       ; / In the air: return without scrolling
$00:F87E EE 04 14     INC.W $1404                     ; Enable free vertical scroll [$1404]
$00:F881 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = [$02]
$00:F883 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:F884 F9 A7 F6     SBC.W $F6A7,Y                   ; / A - $F6A7[Y] ($FFFD up, $0005 down, $FFFA misc)
$00:F887 59 A7 F6     EOR.W $F6A7,Y                   ; EOR with the same value to test for overshoot
$00:F88A 0A           ASL                             ; Shift sign into carry
$00:F88B A5 02        LDA $02                         ; A = [$02]
$00:F88D B0 03        BCS $F892                       ; Overshoot: use [$02]
$00:F88F B9 A7 F6     LDA.W $F6A7,Y                   ; Else use the table value (limit)
$00:F892 18           CLC                             ; Add to screen Y
$00:F893 65 1C        ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ;/
$00:F895 D9 AD F6     CMP.W $F6AD,Y                   ; Compare with the minimum Y ($0000, or $00C0 for misc)
$00:F898 10 03        BPL $F89D                       ; Not below it: keep
$00:F89A B9 AD F6     LDA.W $F6AD,Y                   ; Else clamp to the minimum
$00:F89D 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Layer 1 Y = A
$00:F89F A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$00:F8A1 C5 1C        CMP RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; / Past the bottom limit [$04]?
$00:F8A3 10 05        BPL $F8AA                       ; No: return
$00:F8A5 85 1C        STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; Clamp layer 1 Y to the limit
$00:F8A7 9C F1 13     STZ.W $13F1                     ; Clear [$13F1] (and [$13F2], A is 16-bit)
$00:F8AA 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F8AB AC FD 13     LDY.W $13FD                     ; \
$00:F8AE D0 2E        BNE $F8DE                       ; / Camera look-ahead: L/R button scroll [$13FD] active: return
$00:F8B0 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F8B2 AE FF 13     LDX.W $13FF                     ; X = Mario facing direction [$13FF]
$00:F8B5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F8B7 A0 08        LDY.B #$08                      ; Y = 8
$00:F8B9 AD 2A 14     LDA.W $142A                     ; \
$00:F8BC DD B3 F6     CMP.W $F6B3,X                   ; } Compare dead-zone centre [$142A] with $F6B3[facing]
$00:F8BF 10 02        BPL $F8C3                       ; /
$00:F8C1 A0 0A        LDY.B #$0A                      ; Else Y = $0A
$00:F8C3 B9 BF F6     LDA.W $F6BF,Y                   ; A = $F6BF[Y]
$00:F8C6 45 02        EOR $02                         ; Same sign as the distance [$02]?
$00:F8C8 10 14        BPL $F8DE                       ; Yes: return
$00:F8CA BD BF F6     LDA.W $F6BF,X                   ; A = $F6BF[X]
$00:F8CD 45 02        EOR $02                         ; Same sign as [$02]?
$00:F8CF 10 0D        BPL $F8DE                       ; Yes: return
$00:F8D1 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$00:F8D3 18           CLC                             ; } [$02] += $F6CF[Y]
$00:F8D4 79 CF F6     ADC.W $F6CF,Y                   ; /
$00:F8D7 F0 05        BEQ $F8DE                       ; Zero: return
$00:F8D9 85 02        STA $02                         ; Store the adjusted distance
$00:F8DB 8C 00 14     STY.W $1400                     ; [$1400] = Y (remember the look-ahead adjustment)
$00:F8DE 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $F8DF..F8E7: Table: Y tile offsets by platform tilt ;;;
$00:F8DF              .db $0C,$0C,$08,$00,$20,$04,$0A,$0D ; Offsets indexed by (tilt + $48) >> 4: $0C,$0C,$08,$00,$20,$04,$0A,$0D,$0D
$00:F8E7              .db $0D


;;; $F8E8..F8F0: Table: Mario ceiling Y limit per boss room ;;;
;; 16-bit words indexed by [$13FC] * 2: $002A, $002A, $0012, $0000, $FFED. Entry $2A also enables extra checks
;;     in the routine at $00F8F2.
$00:F8E8              .db $2A,$00,$2A,$00,$12,$00,$00,$00 ; $13FC = 0: Y limit $2A
$00:F8F0              .db $ED,$FF


;;; $F8F2: Mario vs Mode 7 boss room platform/ceiling ;;;
;; Called from Mario's per-frame code ($00CD1F) in Mode 7 boss rooms. If [$0D9B] bit 6 is set: clamps Mario's
;;     Y to the ceiling limit
;; from $F8E8, then (for entry $2A) tests Mario against a boss-room object. If bit 6 is clear: tests
;;     Mario against the tilting
;; platform ($00F9A8, using JSL $01:CC9D) and applies the slope/standing response. Semantics are inferred;
;;     exact object not confirmed.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:CD1F: Mario animation 0: normal per-frame handling (ResetAni)
$00:F8F2 20 A6 EA     JSR.W $EAA6                     ; Mario Y interaction setup ($EAA6)
$00:F8F5 2C 9B 0D     BIT.W $0D9B                     ; Test [$0D9B] (V = bit 6)
$00:F8F8 50 54        BVC $F94E                       ; Bit 6 clear: go to $00F94E
$00:F8FA 20 2B E9     JSR.W $E92B                     ; Run $E92B
$00:F8FD AD FC 13     LDA.W $13FC                     ; \
$00:F900 0A           ASL                             ; } X = [$13FC] * 2 (room index)
$00:F901 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:F902 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:F903 A4 7D        LDY RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Y = Mario Y speed
$00:F905 10 17        BPL $F91E                       ; Not moving up: skip the ceiling clamp
$00:F907 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F909 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; A = Mario Y
$00:F90B DD E8 F8     CMP.W $F8E8,X                   ; Compare with the ceiling limit
$00:F90E 10 0E        BPL $F91E                       ; Below the limit: skip
$00:F910 BD E8 F8     LDA.W $F8E8,X                   ; Mario Y = ceiling limit
$00:F913 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos
$00:F915 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F917 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$00:F919 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; SFX $01 (hit head)
$00:F91B 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; / Play sound effect
$00:F91E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F920 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:F921 BD E8 F8     LDA.W $F8E8,X                   ; A = low byte of the limit
$00:F924 C9 2A        CMP.B #$2A                      ; Is it $2A?
$00:F926 D0 25        BNE $F94D                       ; No: return
$00:F928 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F92A A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$00:F92C AD 17 16     LDA.W $1617                     ; A = [$1617] & $FF + 1
$00:F92F 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF
$00:F932 1A           INC A
$00:F933 C5 94        CMP RAM_MarioXPos               ; Compare with Mario X
$00:F935 F0 13        BEQ $F94A                       ; Equal: go to $00F94A
$00:F937 30 11        BMI $F94A                       ; A < Mario X: go to $00F94A
$00:F939 AD 3D 15     LDA.W $153D                     ; A = [$153D] & $FF
$00:F93C 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF
$00:F93F 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = it
$00:F941 C8           INY                             ; Y = 1
$00:F942 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; A = Mario X + $0F
$00:F944 18           CLC 
$00:F945 69 0F 00     ADC.W #$000F
$00:F948 C5 00        CMP $00                         ; Compare with [$00] (result used by $E9C8)
$00:F94A 4C C8 E9     JMP.W $E9C8                     ; Continue at $E9C8

$00:F94D 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F94E A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$00:F950 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$00:F952 10 03        BPL $F957                       ; Falling or standing: go to $00F957
$00:F954 4C 97 F9     JMP.W $F997                     ; Moving up: skip to $00F997

$00:F957 20 A8 F9     JSR.W $F9A8                     ; Test Mario against the platform ($00F9A8)
$00:F95A B0 06        BCS $F962                       ; Carry set (touching): go to $00F962
$00:F95C 20 1D EE     JSR.W $EE1D                     ; Not touching: $EE1D
$00:F95F 4C 97 F9     JMP.W $F997                     ; Go to $00F997

$00:F962 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; Mario in the air?
$00:F964 F0 1D        BEQ $F983                       ; No: go to $00F983
$00:F966 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F968 AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; A = [$14B8] & $FF (contact X)
$00:F96B 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF
$00:F96E 8D B4 14     STA.W $14B4                     ; [$14B4] = A
$00:F971 8D 36 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos1           ; KeyHolePos1 ([$1436]) = A
$00:F974 AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; A = [$14BA] & $F0 (contact Y)
$00:F977 29 F0 00     AND.W #$00F0
$00:F97A 8D B6 14     STA.W $14B6                     ; [$14B6] = A
$00:F97D 8D 38 14     STA.W RAM_KeyHolePos2           ; KeyHolePos2 ([$1438]) = A
$00:F980 20 C9 F9     JSR.W $F9C9                     ; Run the mirrored test ($00F9C9)
$00:F983 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; A = [$36] (platform tilt)
$00:F985 18           CLC                             ; + $48
$00:F986 69 48        ADC.B #$48
$00:F988 4A           LSR 
$00:F989 4A           LSR 
$00:F98A 4A           LSR 
$00:F98B 4A           LSR 
$00:F98C AA           TAX                             ; X = (tilt + $48) >> 4
$00:F98D BC DF F8     LDY.W $F8DF,X                   ; Y = $F8DF[X]
$00:F990 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; [$8E] = $80
$00:F992 85 8E        STA $8E
$00:F994 20 E1 EE     JSR.W $EEE1                     ; Apply slope response ($EEE1)
$00:F997 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F999 A5 80        LDA $80                         ; A = [$80]
$00:F99B C9 AE 00     CMP.W #$00AE                    ; Compare with $00AE
$00:F99E E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F9A0 30 03        BMI $F9A5                       ; Less: skip
$00:F9A2 20 29 F6     JSR.W $F629                     ; Unreachable: JSR $F629
$00:F9A5 4C 8C E9     JMP.W $E98C                     ; Continue at $E98C

$00:F9A8 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F9AA A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:F9AC 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:F9AD 69 08 00     ADC.W #$0008                    ; } [$14B4] = Mario X + 8
$00:F9B0 8D B4 14     STA.W $14B4                     ; /
$00:F9B3 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:F9B5 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:F9B6 69 20 00     ADC.W #$0020                    ; } [$14B6] = Mario Y + $20
$00:F9B9 8D B6 14     STA.W $14B6                     ; /
$00:F9BC E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F9BE 8B           PHB                             ; \
$00:F9BF A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; |
$00:F9C1 48           PHA                             ; } Data bank = $01
$00:F9C2 AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:F9C3 22 9D CC 01  JSL.L $CC9D                     ; Platform collision test in bank 01 (carry = touching)
$00:F9C7 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:F9C8 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:F9C9 A5 36        LDA $36                         ; A = [$36] (tilt)
$00:F9CB 48           PHA                             ; Save it
$00:F9CC 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$00:F9CF 1A           INC A                           ; } [$36] = -[$36] (mirror the tilt)
$00:F9D0 85 36        STA $36                         ; /
$00:F9D2 20 BC F9     JSR.W $F9BC                     ; Run the platform test with the mirrored tilt ($00F9BC)
$00:F9D5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:F9D7 68           PLA                             ; Restore the tilt
$00:F9D8 85 36        STA $36                         ; [$36] = original
$00:F9DA AD B8 14     LDA.W $14B8                     ; A = [$14B8] & $FF
$00:F9DD 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF
$00:F9E0 38           SEC                             ; - 8
$00:F9E1 E9 08 00     SBC.W #$0008
$00:F9E4 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; Mario X = result
$00:F9E6 AD BA 14     LDA.W $14BA                     ; A = [$14BA] & $FF
$00:F9E9 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF
$00:F9EC 38           SEC                             ; - $20
$00:F9ED E9 20 00     SBC.W #$0020
$00:F9F0 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; Mario Y = result
$00:F9F2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:F9F4 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $F9F5..FA0D: Freespace ;;;
$00:F9F5              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$00:F9FD              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

$00:FA0D              .db $FF,$FF,$FF


;;; $FA10: Unused clear sprites, then slope pointer setup ;;;
;; $00FA10: Unused. Clears the 12 sprite status bytes and returns (RTL).
;; $00FA19: sets up a long pointer in [$05]-[$07] ($00:E632, probably a slope steepness table), reads
;;     [[$82]+A-$6E] into [$08],
;; and returns Y = (([$0A] & 15) | (value * 16 low byte)) as an index. Called from sprite code in banks 01 and
;;     02 (JSL).
;; Parameters: A = tile number ($6E-$D5 range). Returns: Y = index; [$00] = [$0C] & 15, [$01] = value * 16.
$00:FA10 A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; \
$00:FA12 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; |
$00:FA15 CA           DEX                             ; } Unused: clear the 12 sprite status bytes
$00:FA16 10 FA        BPL $FA12                       ; /
$00:FA18 6B           RTL                             ; Return long

$00:FA19 A0 32        LDY.B #$32                      ; \
$00:FA1B 84 05        STY $05                         ; |
$00:FA1D A0 E6        LDY.B #$E6                      ; |
$00:FA1F 84 06        STY $06                         ; |
$00:FA21 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; } [$05]-[$07] = $00E632 (long pointer, probably slope data)
$00:FA23 84 07        STY $07                         ; /
$00:FA25 38           SEC                             ; \
$00:FA26 E9 6E        SBC.B #$6E                      ; } Y = A - $6E
$00:FA28 A8           TAY                             ; /
$00:FA29 B7 82        LDA [$82],Y                     ; A = [[$82] + Y]
$00:FA2B 85 08        STA $08                         ; [$08] = A
$00:FA2D 0A           ASL                             ; \
$00:FA2E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:FA2F 0A           ASL                             ; } A *= 16
$00:FA30 0A           ASL                             ; /
$00:FA31 85 01        STA $01                         ; [$01] = A * 16 (low byte)
$00:FA33 90 02        BCC $FA37                       ; No carry: skip
$00:FA35 E6 06        INC $06                         ; Carry: [$06]++ (pointer high byte)
$00:FA37 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$00:FA39 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = [$0C] & $0F
$00:FA3B 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$00:FA3D A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$00:FA3F 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } A = ([$0A] & $0F) | [$01]
$00:FA41 05 01        ORA $01                         ; /
$00:FA43 A8           TAY                             ; Y = A (index)
$00:FA44 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


;;; $FA45: Spawn Flat Palace Switch (FlatPalaceSwitch) ;;;
;; Starts the ground shake and creates the Flat Palace Switch (sprite $60) in slot 2 at the position of the
;;     block Mario hit.
;; Position: X = [$9A] & $F0 (+[$9B]), Y = ([$98] & $F0) + $10 (+[$99] + carry). Sets status 8 and the timer
;;     [$1540,Y] = $5F.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:EEBE: Mario block and slope collision (rest)
$00:FA45 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Ground shake timer = $20
$00:FA47 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; /
$00:FA4A A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; Y = 2: sprite slot 2
$00:FA4C A9 60        LDA.B #$60                      ; Sprite number $60 (Flat Palace Switch)
$00:FA4E 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; /
$00:FA51 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; Status 8 (normal)
$00:FA53 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; /
$00:FA56 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:FA58 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } Sprite X low = block X [$9A] & $F0
$00:FA5A 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; /
$00:FA5D A5 9B        LDA RAM_BlockXHi                ; Sprite X high = block X high [$9B]
$00:FA5F 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$00:FA62 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:FA64 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$00:FA66 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FA67 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Sprite Y low = ([$98] & $F0) + $10
$00:FA69 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; /
$00:FA6C A5 99        LDA RAM_BlockYHi                ; \
$00:FA6E 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Sprite Y high = [$99] + carry
$00:FA70 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; /
$00:FA73 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:FA74 BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (sprite slot)
$00:FA75 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialise the sprite tables
$00:FA79 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:FA7A A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; Timer [$1540,Y] = $5F
$00:FA7C 99 40 15     STA.W $1540,Y                   ; /
$00:FA7F 60           RTS                             ; Return


;;; $FA80: Level end: clear effects, start sprite loop (TriggerGoalTape) ;;;
;; Clears P-balloon [$13F3], [$1891], sprite respawn timer, generator number and [$18DD], then falls into the
;;     sprite loop below.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:C128: Goal tape movement, check and draw
$00:FA80 9C F3 13     STZ.W $13F3                     ; [$13F3] = 0 (P-balloon off)
$00:FA83 9C 91 18     STZ.W $1891                     ; [$1891] = 0
$00:FA86 9C C0 18     STZ.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn       ; Respawn timer = 0: do not respawn sprites
$00:FA89 9C B9 18     STZ.W RAM_GeneratorNum          ; Generator number = 0
$00:FA8C 9C DD 18     STZ.W $18DD                     ; [$18DD] = 0
$00:FA8F A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = 11: loop over sprites

;;; $FA91: Level end: process every sprite (LvlEndSprLoopStrt) ;;;
;; Loops over sprite slots 11..0. Sprites with status < 8 are skipped. A sprite carried by Mario (status $0B)
;;     becomes a powerup.
;; Goal tape, and on-screen sprites without tweaker bit $20 in [$1686], become status 6 (turn into coin).
;;     Others are erased unless
;; tweaker bit 1 of [$190F] (don't erase) is set. Afterwards all 8 extended sprites are cleared.
$00:FA91 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; A = sprite status
$00:FA94 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status < 8: skip the sprite
$00:FA96 90 39        BCC LvlEndNextSprite            ; /
$00:FA98 C9 0B        CMP.B #$0B                      ; Status $0B (carried past the goal)?
$00:FA9A D0 07        BNE $FAA3                       ; No: go to $00FAA3
$00:FA9C DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:FA9D 20 00 FB     JSR.W LvlEndPowerUp             ; Turn the sprite into a powerup
$00:FAA0 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:FAA1 80 2E        BRA LvlEndNextSprite            ; Next sprite

$00:FAA3 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = sprite number
$00:FAA6 C9 7B        CMP.B #$7B                      ; Goal tape ($7B)?
$00:FAA8 F0 08        BEQ $FAB2                       ; Yes: go to $00FAB2
$00:FAAA B9 A0 15     LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,Y       ; \
$00:FAAD 19 6C 18     ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,Y       ; / On screen? (off-screen horizontal | vertical)
$00:FAB0 D0 13        BNE $FAC5                       ; Off screen: go to $00FAC5
$00:FAB2 B9 86 16     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y         ; \
$00:FAB5 29 20        AND.B #$20                      ; } Tweaker bit $20 ([$1686]: don't turn into coin) set: go to $00FAC5
$00:FAB7 D0 0C        BNE $FAC5                       ; /
$00:FAB9 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; A = $10
$00:FABB 99 40 15     STA.W $1540,Y                   ; Coin animation timer [$1540,Y] = $10
$00:FABE A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; A = 6
$00:FAC0 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Status 6: level end, turn into coin
$00:FAC3 80 0C        BRA LvlEndNextSprite            ; Next sprite

$00:FAC5 B9 0F 19     LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,Y         ; \
$00:FAC8 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; } Tweaker bit 2 ([$190F]: don't erase) set: keep sprite
$00:FACA D0 05        BNE LvlEndNextSprite            ; /
$00:FACC A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$00:FACE 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Erase the sprite (status 0)

;;; $FAD1: Level end: next sprite, clear extended sprites (LvlEndNextSprite) ;;;
;; Decrements the sprite index and loops; when done, clears all 8 extended sprite slots and returns (RTL).
$00:FAD1 88           DEY                             ; Y--: next sprite
$00:FAD2 10 BD        BPL LvlEndSprLoopStrt           ; Loop while Y >= 0
$00:FAD4 A0 07        LDY.B #$07                      ; Y = 7: extended sprites
$00:FAD6 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; A = 0
$00:FAD8 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; Clear extended sprite number
$00:FADB 88           DEY                             ; Y--
$00:FADC 10 FA        BPL $FAD8                       ; Loop
$00:FADE 6B           RTL                             ; Return long



;;; $FADF..FAF7: Table: powerup sprite given at level end ;;;
;; 28 sprite numbers, four groups of 7 indexed by Mario powerup/state. Group 0: normal. Group 1 (+7): carrying
;;     springboard or P-switch.
;; Group 2 (+14): carrying key. Group 3 (+21): carrying baby Yoshi. $74 mushroom, $75 flower, $76 star, $77
;;     feather, $E0-$FF = 1-Up variants.
$00:FADF              .db $74,$74,$77,$75,$76,$E0,$F0,$74 ; Group 0: normal (powerup 0-6)
$00:FAE7              .db $74,$77,$75,$76,$E0,$F1,$F0,$F0
$00:FAEF              .db $F0,$F0,$F1,$E0,$F2,$E0,$E0,$E0
$00:FAF7              .db $E0,$F1,$E0,$E4


;;; $FAFB..FAFB: Table: item box contents to match ;;;
$00:FAFB              .db $FF,$74,$75,$76,$77         ; $FF,$74,$75,$76,$77: item box contents (0 = empty, 1-4) compared to the result


;;; $FB00: Level end: choose bonus powerup for carried sprite (LvlEndPowerUp) ;;;
;; Used when Mario carries a sprite past the goal. Picks an index X from Mario's powerup (or Yoshi), adds
;;     7/14/21 depending on the carried
;; sprite (springboard/P-switch, key, baby Yoshi), reads $FADF, and replaces the result by a 1-Up ($78)
;;     if it equals the current
;; item box contents. Values >= $E0 become a 1-Up, with the low nibble saved in [$0F]. Parameters: Y = sprite
;;     slot.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:FA9D: Level end: process every sprite (LvlEndSprLoopStrt)
$00:FB00 A6 19        LDX RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; X = Mario powerup
$00:FB02 AD 90 14     LDA.W $1490                     ; Star timer [$1490]?
$00:FB05 F0 02        BEQ $FB09                       ; Zero: skip (cleared earlier, so always skipped)
$00:FB07 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; Unreachable: X = 4
$00:FB09 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; On Yoshi?
$00:FB0C F0 02        BEQ $FB10                       ; No: skip
$00:FB0E A2 05        LDX.B #$05                      ; X = 5
$00:FB10 B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = carried sprite number
$00:FB13 C9 2F        CMP.B #$2F                      ; Springboard ($2F)?
$00:FB15 F0 16        BEQ $FB2D                       ; Yes: X += 7
$00:FB17 C9 3E        CMP.B #$3E                      ; P-switch ($3E)?
$00:FB19 F0 12        BEQ $FB2D                       ; Yes: X += 7
$00:FB1B C9 80        CMP.B #$80                      ; Key ($80)?
$00:FB1D F0 09        BEQ $FB28                       ; Yes: X += 14
$00:FB1F C9 2D        CMP.B #$2D                      ; Baby Yoshi ($2D)?
$00:FB21 D0 0F        BNE $FB32                       ; No: go to $00FB32
$00:FB23 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:FB24 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FB25 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; } X += 7 (baby Yoshi: three times, +21 total)
$00:FB27 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:FB28 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:FB29 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FB2A 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; } X += 7
$00:FB2C AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:FB2D 8A           TXA                             ; \
$00:FB2E 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FB2F 69 07        ADC.B #$07                      ; } X += 7
$00:FB31 AA           TAX                             ; /
$00:FB32 BF DF FA 00  LDA.L $FADF,X                   ; A = $FADF[X]
$00:FB36 AE C2 0D     LDX.W $0DC2                     ; X = [$0DC2] (item box)
$00:FB39 DF FB FA 00  CMP.L $FAFB,X                   ; Same as the item box contents?
$00:FB3D D0 02        BNE $FB41                       ; No: keep
$00:FB3F A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; Yes: use $78 (1-Up) instead
$00:FB41 64 0F        STZ $0F                         ; [$0F] = 0
$00:FB43 C9 E0        CMP.B #$E0                      ; Below $E0: normal sprite
$00:FB45 90 0E        BCC LvlEndStoreSpr
$00:FB47 48           PHA                             ; Save A
$00:FB48 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; [$0F] = low nibble
$00:FB4A 85 0F        STA $0F
$00:FB4C 68           PLA                             ; Restore A
$00:FB4D C9 F0        CMP.B #$F0                      ; $F0 or more?
$00:FB4F A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; A = $78 (1-Up)
$00:FB51 B0 02        BCS LvlEndStoreSpr
$00:FB53 A9 78        LDA.B #$78                      ; A = $78 (1-Up)

;;; $FB55: Level end: convert sprite to bonus powerup (LvlEndStoreSpr) ;;;
;; Makes sprite slot Y the chosen powerup, re-initialises it, gives it status $0C (goal tape powerup) with an
;;     upward launch, plays SFX $0C
;; and spawns a smoke sprite at its position in the first free of 4 slots.
;; Parameters: A = sprite number, Y = slot, [$0F] = extra value for [$1594,Y].
$00:FB55 99 9E 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; Sprite number = A
$00:FB58 C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; Star ($76)?
$00:FB5A D0 03        BNE $FB5F                       ; No: skip
$00:FB5C EE CB 13     INC.W $13CB                     ; [$13CB]++
$00:FB5F BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (sprite slot)
$00:FB60 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Initialise the sprite tables
$00:FB64 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = [$0F]
$00:FB66 99 94 15     STA.W $1594,Y                   ; [$1594,Y] = [$0F]
$00:FB69 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; A = $0C
$00:FB6B 99 C8 14     STA.W $14C8,Y                   ; Status $0C: goal tape powerup
$00:FB6E A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; A = $D0
$00:FB70 99 AA 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y        ; Sprite Y speed = $D0 (up)
$00:FB73 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; A = 5
$00:FB75 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; Sprite X speed = 5
$00:FB78 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; A = $20
$00:FB7A 99 4C 15     STA.W RAM_DisableInter,Y        ; Interaction disabled for $20 frames
$00:FB7D A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; A = $0C
$00:FB7F 8D F9 1D     STA.W $1DF9                     ; Play SFX $0C
$00:FB82 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; X = 3: smoke sprite slots
$00:FB84 BD C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,X                   ; Slot free ([$17C0,X] = 0)?
$00:FB87 F0 04        BEQ $FB8D                       ; Yes: go to $00FB8D
$00:FB89 CA           DEX                             ; X--
$00:FB8A 10 F8        BPL $FB84                       ; Loop
$00:FB8C 60           RTS                             ; No free slot: return

$00:FB8D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$00:FB8F 9D C0 17     STA.W $17C0,X                   ; Smoke sprite type 1 (puff of smoke)
$00:FB92 B9 D8 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; A = sprite Y low
$00:FB95 9D C4 17     STA.W $17C4,X                   ; Smoke Y = sprite Y
$00:FB98 B9 E4 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; A = sprite X low
$00:FB9B 9D C8 17     STA.W $17C8,X                   ; Smoke X = sprite X
$00:FB9E A9 1B        LDA.B #$1B                      ; A = $1B
$00:FBA0 9D CC 17     STA.W $17CC,X                   ; Smoke timer = $1B
$00:FBA3 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $FBA4: Table: level end smoke tiles (probably) (LvlEndSmokeTiles) ;;;
$00:FBA4              .db $66,$64,$62,$60,$E8,$EA,$EC,$EA ; Tile numbers


;;; $FBAC: Level end sprites to coins (long wrapper) (LvlEndSprCoins) ;;;
;; Sets the data bank to $00, calls LvlEndSprCoinsRt and returns with RTL. Called from the sprite status 6
;;     handler in bank 01.
;; Called by:
;;     $01:816D: Handle sprite at level end (status 6) (HandleSprLvlEnd)
$00:FBAC 8B           PHB                             ; \
$00:FBAD 4B           PHK                             ; } Save and set data bank = program bank
$00:FBAE AB           PLB                             ; /
$00:FBAF 20 B4 FB     JSR.W LvlEndSprCoinsRt          ; Run the coin conversion (LvlEndSprCoinsRt)
$00:FBB2 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$00:FBB3 6B           RTL                             ; Return long


;;; $FBB4: Level-end coin sprite and helpers (LvlEndSprCoinsRt) ;;;
;; Sprite routine for the coin that a sprite turns into at the end of a level: a smoke puff while [$1540,X]
;;     counts down, then the coin
;; hops up, falls, awards points ([$18DD] index, +2 per coin, capped at $0D) and erases itself. Scrolls with
;;     layer 1 via [$17BD].
;; Also holds unrelated spawn helpers:
;; $00FC23 (unused): runs Yoshi in from the left edge; $00FC7A: spawns a mounted Yoshi at Mario; $00FCEC:
;;     erase all sprites;
;; $00FCF5: put sprite at (160,0); $00FD08: spawn swimming bubble (finds a free extended sprite slot, falls
;;     into s00FD26).
;; Called by:
;;     $00:FBAF: Level end sprites to coins (long wrapper) (LvlEndSprCoins)
$00:FBB4 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: high byte for sign extension
$00:FBB6 AD BD 17     LDA.W $17BD                     ; A = [$17BD] (layer 1 X movement this frame)
$00:FBB9 10 01        BPL $FBBC                       ; Positive: keep Y = 0
$00:FBBB 88           DEY                             ; Negative: Y = $FF
$00:FBBC 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:FBBD 75 E4        ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$00:FBBF 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$00:FBC1 98           TYA                             ; |
$00:FBC2 7D E0 14     ADC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; } } Sprite X += signed [$17BD]: coin follows layer 1 scrolling
$00:FBC5 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$00:FBC8 BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540,X] (smoke puff timer)
$00:FBCB F0 23        BEQ $FBF0                       ; Timer = 0: smoke is over, go handle the coin
$00:FBCD C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; Timer = 1?
$00:FBCF D0 04        BNE $FBD5                       ; No: skip
$00:FBD1 A9 D0        LDA.B #$D0                      ; \
$00:FBD3 95 AA        STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / } Timer just hit 1: sprite Y speed = $D0 (kick the coin upward)
$00:FBD5 DA           PHX                             ; Save sprite index
$00:FBD6 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:FBD8 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / } Sprite palette = 4 (palette A)
$00:FBDB 22 B2 90 01  JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2          ; Draw a 16x16 sprite tile (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$00:FBDF BD 40 15     LDA.W $1540,X                   ; A = [$1540,X] (smoke timer)
$00:FBE2 4A           LSR                             ; \
$00:FBE3 4A           LSR                             ; / } A = timer / 4: smoke animation frame
$00:FBE4 BC EA 15     LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X         ; Y = OAM index of this sprite
$00:FBE7 AA           TAX                             ; X = animation frame
$00:FBE8 BD A4 FB     LDA.W LvlEndSmokeTiles,X        ; A = tile number for this frame (LvlEndSmokeTiles)
$00:FBEB 99 02 03     STA.W OAM_Tile,Y                ; Override the drawn tile with the smoke tile
$00:FBEE FA           PLX                             ; Restore sprite index
$00:FBEF 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:FBF0 FE 70 15     INC.W $1570,X                   ; [$1570,X]++: sprite frame counter (animates the coin)
$00:FBF3 22 1A 80 01  JSL.L UpdateYPosNoGrvty         ; Apply sprite speed to position, no gravity (UpdateYPosNoGrvty)
$00:FBF7 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; \
$00:FBF9 F6 AA        INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; / } Sprite Y speed += 2 (gravity)
$00:FBFB B5 AA        LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X          ; A = sprite Y speed
$00:FBFD C9 20        CMP.B #$20                      ; Speed < $20 (still rising or slowly falling)?
$00:FBFF 30 1D        BMI $FC1E                       ; Yes: just draw the coin
$00:FC01 22 4A B3 05  JSL.L $B34A                     ; Spawn glitter/sparkle effect at the sprite ($B34A)
$00:FC05 AD DD 18     LDA.W $18DD                     ; A = [$18DD] (next point value index)
$00:FC08 C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; Below $0D?
$00:FC0A 90 02        BCC $FC0E                       ; Yes: use it as is
$00:FC0C A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; Cap at $0D (1UP)
$00:FC0E 22 E5 AC 02  JSL.L GivePoints                ; Give points for this coin (GivePoints)
$00:FC12 AD DD 18     LDA.W $18DD                     ; \
$00:FC15 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FC16 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } } [$18DD] += 2: next coin is worth more
$00:FC18 8D DD 18     STA.W $18DD                     ; /
$00:FC1B 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Erase the sprite (status = 0)
$00:FC1E 22 41 C6 01  JSL.L CoinSprGfx                ; Draw the coin (CoinSprGfx)
$00:FC22 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:FC23 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: sprite slot loop
$00:FC25 B9 C8 14     LDA.W $14C8,Y                   ; A = sprite status of slot Y
$00:FC28 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; Status 8 (normal)?
$00:FC2A D0 47        BNE $FC73                       ; No: next slot
$00:FC2C B9 9E 00     LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y           ; A = sprite number of slot Y
$00:FC2F C9 35        CMP.B #$35                      ; Yoshi ($35)?
$00:FC31 D0 40        BNE $FC73                       ; No: next slot
$00:FC33 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$00:FC35 8D C1 0D     STA.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; / } [$0DC1] = 1: Yoshi is on the overworld
$00:FC38 9C 1E 14     STZ.W RAM_YoshiHasWings         ; No Yoshi wings
$00:FC3B B9 F6 15     LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,Y           ; \
$00:FC3E 29 F1        AND.B #$F1                      ; |
$00:FC40 09 0A        ORA.B #$0A                      ; } } Palette bits: keep bit 0, set palette 5 (A = A & $F1 | $0A)
$00:FC42 99 F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,Y           ; /
$00:FC45 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Mario already on Yoshi?
$00:FC48 D0 28        BNE $FC72                       ; Yes: done
$00:FC4A A5 1A        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; \
$00:FC4C 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:FC4D E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; |
$00:FC4F 99 E4 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y           ; |
$00:FC52 A5 1B        LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi          ; |
$00:FC54 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; } } Yoshi X = screen left edge X - $10 (just off-screen, 16-bit)
$00:FC56 99 E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y           ; /
$00:FC59 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:FC5B 99 D8 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y           ; } } Yoshi Y = Mario Y
$00:FC5E A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; /
$00:FC60 99 D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y           ; \
$00:FC63 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; } } Yoshi state = 3 (running in)
$00:FC65 99 C2 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y         ; /
$00:FC68 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:FC6A 99 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,Y           ; / } Yoshi direction = 0
$00:FC6D A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$00:FC6F 99 B6 00     STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y        ; / } Yoshi X speed = $10
$00:FC72 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:FC73 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$00:FC74 10 AF        BPL $FC25                       ; Loop for all 12 slots
$00:FC76 9C C1 0D     STZ.W RAM_OWHasYoshi            ; No Yoshi sprite found: [$0DC1] = 0
$00:FC79 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:FC7A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; A = 2
$00:FC7C 8D FA 1D     STA.W $1DFA                     ; Sound effect request in [$1DFA]
$00:FC7F A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: use slot 0 by default
$00:FC81 AD 94 1B     LDA.W $1B94                     ; A = [$1B94]
$00:FC84 D0 12        BNE $FC98                       ; Non-zero: use slot 0
$00:FC86 A2 05        LDX.B #$05                      ; X = 5: fallback slot
$00:FC88 AD 92 16     LDA.W $1692                     ; A = [$1692]
$00:FC8B C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; Equal to $0A?
$00:FC8D F0 09        BEQ $FC98                       ; Yes: use slot 5
$00:FC8F 22 E4 A9 02  JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot           ; Find a free sprite slot (FindFreeSprSlot)
$00:FC93 BB           TYX                             ; X = Y (slot, or $FF if none)
$00:FC94 10 02        BPL $FC98                       ; Found one: use it
$00:FC96 A2 03        LDX.B #$03                      ; None free: use slot 3
$00:FC98 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$00:FC9A 9D C8 14     STA.W $14C8,X                   ; / } Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$00:FC9D A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; \
$00:FC9F 95 9E        STA RAM_SpriteNum,X             ; / } Sprite number = $35 (Yoshi)
$00:FCA1 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:FCA3 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; |
$00:FCA5 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; } } Yoshi X = Mario X
$00:FCA7 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; /
$00:FCAA A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:FCAC 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:FCAD E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; |
$00:FCAF 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; |
$00:FCB1 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; |
$00:FCB3 A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; |
$00:FCB5 E9 00        SBC.B #$00                      ; |
$00:FCB7 85 97        STA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; } } Yoshi Y = Mario Y - $10 and Mario Y -= $10 as well
$00:FCB9 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; /
$00:FCBC 22 D2 F7 07  JSL.L InitSpriteTables          ; Reset all sprite tables for the new sprite (InitSpriteTables)
$00:FCC0 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$00:FCC2 9D E2 1F     STA.W $1FE2,X                   ; / } [$1FE2,X] = 4 (probably a Yoshi timer)
$00:FCC5 AD C7 13     LDA.W RAM_YoshiColor            ; \
$00:FCC8 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / } Sprite palette = Yoshi color [$13C7]
$00:FCCB AD 95 1B     LDA.W $1B95                     ; A = [$1B95]
$00:FCCE F0 05        BEQ $FCD5                       ; Zero: keep Yoshi color
$00:FCD0 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$00:FCD2 9D F6 15     STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X           ; / } Non-zero: sprite palette = 6
$00:FCD5 EE 7A 18     INC.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; Mario is on Yoshi: [$187A]++
$00:FCD8 F6 C2        INC RAM_SpriteState,X           ; Sprite state++: Yoshi is mounted
$00:FCDA A5 76        LDA RAM_MarioDirection          ; \
$00:FCDC 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } } Yoshi direction = Mario direction EOR 1
$00:FCDE 9D 7C 15     STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X           ; /
$00:FCE1 DE 0E 16     DEC.W $160E,X                   ; [$160E,X]-- (probably clears the Yoshi mouth/swallow slot to $FF)
$00:FCE4 E8           INX                             ; X++
$00:FCE5 8E DF 18     STX.W $18DF                     ; [$18DF] = slot + 1 (Yoshi slot index + 1)
$00:FCE8 8E E2 18     STX.W $18E2                     ; [$18E2] = slot + 1
$00:FCEB 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:FCEC A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; X = $0B: all 12 sprite slots
$00:FCEE 9E C8 14     STZ.W $14C8,X                   ; Sprite status = 0 (erase)
$00:FCF1 CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$00:FCF2 10 FA        BPL $FCEE                       ; Loop
$00:FCF4 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:FCF5 A9 A0        LDA.B #$A0                      ; \
$00:FCF7 95 E4        STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; / } Sprite X low = $A0
$00:FCF9 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:FCFB 9D E0 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; / } Sprite X high = 0
$00:FCFE A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:FD00 95 D8        STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X             ; / } Sprite Y low = 0
$00:FD02 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:FD04 9D D4 14     STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X           ; / } Sprite Y high = 0
$00:FD07 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:FD08 A0 3F        LDY.B #$3F                      ; Y = $3F: spawn rate mask when swimming
$00:FD0A A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; A = controller 1 held
$00:FD0C 29 83        AND.B #$83                      ; A = held & $83 (B, left, right)
$00:FD0E D0 02        BNE $FD12                       ; Any pressed: keep $3F
$00:FD10 A0 7F        LDY.B #$7F                      ; None pressed: slower rate mask $7F
$00:FD12 98           TYA                             ; A = rate mask
$00:FD13 25 14        AND RAM_FrameCounterB           ; A = mask & [$14] (frame counter B)
$00:FD15 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; A |= [$9D] (sprites locked)
$00:FD17 D0 0A        BNE $FD23                       ; Not zero: skip this frame
$00:FD19 A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = 7: search extended sprite slots
$00:FD1B BD 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X         ; A = extended sprite number in slot X
$00:FD1E F0 06        BEQ $FD26                       ; Empty slot found: go spawn the bubble
$00:FD20 CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$00:FD21 10 F8        BPL $FD1B                       ; Loop for all 8 slots
$00:FD23 60           RTS                             ; Return, no free slot



;;; $FD24..FD24: Table: bubble X offset by direction ;;;
