;;; $FD26: Spawn bubble, block smoke puff ;;;
;; $00FD26: creates a water bubble (extended sprite $12) at Mario's mouth: X = Mario X + $02/$0A by direction,
;; Y = Mario Y + 4 (big, standing) or $0C (small or ducking). Parameters: X = free extended sprite slot.
;; $00FD5A: spawns a type 5 smoke puff at the block position [$98]/[$9A] (aligned to 16), unless Mario is off-
;;     screen; uses layer 2 scroll if [$1933] is set.
$00:FD26 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$00:FD28 9D 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X         ; / } Extended sprite = $12 (water bubble)
$00:FD2B A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Y = Mario direction
$00:FD2D A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:FD2F 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FD30 79 24 FD     ADC.W $FD24,Y                   ; } } Bubble X = Mario X + [$FD24+direction]
$00:FD33 9D 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X         ; /
$00:FD36 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$00:FD38 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } } Bubble X high with carry
$00:FD3A 9D 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X         ; /
$00:FD3D A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = Mario power-up
$00:FD3F F0 06        BEQ $FD47                       ; Small Mario: offset $0C
$00:FD41 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; A = 4: offset for big Mario
$00:FD43 A4 73        LDY RAM_IsDucking               ; Y = ducking flag
$00:FD45 F0 02        BEQ $FD49                       ; Not ducking: keep 4
$00:FD47 A9 0C        LDA.B #$0C                      ; Offset $0C (small or ducking: mouth is lower)
$00:FD49 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:FD4A 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; } } Bubble Y = Mario Y + offset
$00:FD4C 9D 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X         ; /
$00:FD4F A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$00:FD51 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } } Bubble Y high with carry
$00:FD53 9D 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X         ; /
$00:FD56 9E 6F 17     STZ.W $176F,X                   ; [$176F,X] = 0 (bubble timer/phase)
$00:FD59 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:FD5A A5 7F        LDA $7F                         ; A = [$7F]
$00:FD5C 05 81        ORA $81                         ; A |= [$81]
$00:FD5E D0 0A        BNE $FD6A                       ; Mario off-screen horizontally or vertically: return
$00:FD60 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: search smoke sprite slots
$00:FD62 B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; A = [$17C0,Y] (smoke type)
$00:FD65 F0 04        BEQ $FD6B                       ; Empty slot: spawn
$00:FD67 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$00:FD68 10 F8        BPL $FD62                       ; Loop for slots 3..0
$00:FD6A 60           RTS                             ; Return, none free

$00:FD6B A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$00:FD6D 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / } Smoke type = 5
$00:FD70 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:FD72 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } } Smoke X = block X & $F0 (aligned to tile)
$00:FD74 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; /
$00:FD77 A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; \
$00:FD79 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } } Smoke Y = block Y & $F0 (aligned to tile)
$00:FD7B 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; /
$00:FD7E AD 33 19     LDA.W $1933                     ; A = [$1933] (layer 2 flag)
$00:FD81 F0 14        BEQ $FD97                       ; Zero: skip layer 2 adjustment
$00:FD83 A5 9A        LDA RAM_BlockXLo                ; \
$00:FD85 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:FD86 E5 26        SBC $26                         ; |
$00:FD88 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$00:FD8A 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; |
$00:FD8D A5 98        LDA RAM_BlockYLo                ; |
$00:FD8F 38           SEC                             ; |
$00:FD90 E5 28        SBC $28                         ; |
$00:FD92 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } } Layer 2 level: subtract layer 2 scroll [$26]/[$28] from X and Y
$00:FD94 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; /
$00:FD97 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$00:FD99 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / } Smoke timer = $10
$00:FD9C 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $FD9D..FDA1: Table: water splash Y offsets ;;;
$00:FD9D              .db $08,$FC,$10,$04             ; Y offset: small $08

$00:FDA1              .db $00,$FF,$00,$00             ; High byte of the Y offset: small $00


;;; $FDA5: Spawn water splash and bubbles ;;;
;; Mario enters water: spawns a water splash (minor extended sprite type 7) on the surface row at Mario's
;;     feet, zeroes Mario's
;; Y speed (and X speed if airborne) unless rising, then fills free extended sprite slots with water bubbles
;;     (up to 4, 3 for small Mario).
;; Quirk: if Mario is not in the air the slot search is skipped and Y is the caller's Y plus 1.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:EA59: Mario level collision, borders and water
;;     $00:EA98: Mario level collision, borders and water
$00:FDA5 A5 72        LDA RAM_IsFlying                ; A = [$72] (Mario in air)
$00:FDA7 F0 0A        BEQ $FDB3                       ; On ground: skip the search
$00:FDA9 A0 0B        LDY.B #$0B                      ; Y = $0B: search minor extended sprite slots
$00:FDAB B9 F0 17     LDA.W $17F0,Y                   ; A = [$17F0,Y] (type)
$00:FDAE F0 04        BEQ $FDB4                       ; Empty: use this slot
$00:FDB0 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$00:FDB1 10 F8        BPL $FDAB                       ; Loop
$00:FDB3 C8           INY                             ; Y++ (no free slot found: wraps $FF to 0; on ground uses caller's Y + 1)
$00:FDB4 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:FDB5 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0
$00:FDB7 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = Mario power-up
$00:FDB9 F0 01        BEQ $FDBC                       ; Small: keep X = 0
$00:FDBB E8           INX                             ; X = 1 for big Mario
$00:FDBC AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = [$187A] (on Yoshi)
$00:FDBF F0 02        BEQ $FDC3                       ; Not on Yoshi: keep
$00:FDC1 E8           INX                             ; \
$00:FDC2 E8           INX                             ; / } X += 2 for Yoshi
$00:FDC3 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; A = Mario Y low
$00:FDC5 18           CLC                             ; Clear carry
$00:FDC6 7D 9D FD     ADC.W $FD9D,X                   ; A += Y offset from $FD9D[X]
$00:FDC9 08           PHP                             ; Save carry
$00:FDCA 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; \
$00:FDCC 18           CLC                             ; } } Align down to a 16-pixel row and add 3
$00:FDCD 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; /
$00:FDCF 99 FC 17     STA.W $17FC,Y                   ; Splash Y low = A
$00:FDD2 A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$00:FDD4 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; / } A = Mario Y high + carry
$00:FDD6 28           PLP                             ; Restore carry from the offset add
$00:FDD7 7D A1 FD     ADC.W $FDA1,X                   ; A += Y high offset from $FDA1[X]
$00:FDDA 99 14 18     STA.W $1814,Y                   ; Splash Y high = A
$00:FDDD FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:FDDE A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:FDE0 99 08 18     STA.W $1808,Y                   ; / } Splash X low = Mario X low
$00:FDE3 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$00:FDE5 99 EA 18     STA.W $18EA,Y                   ; / } Splash X high = Mario X high
$00:FDE8 A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$00:FDEA 99 F0 17     STA.W $17F0,Y                   ; / } Minor extended sprite type = 7 (water splash)
$00:FDED A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:FDEF 99 50 18     STA.W $1850,Y                   ; / } [$1850,Y] = 0 (splash timer/frame)
$00:FDF2 A5 7D        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; A = Mario Y speed
$00:FDF4 30 17        BMI $FE0D                       ; Rising: no bubbles, return
$00:FDF6 64 7D        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY             ; Mario Y speed = 0
$00:FDF8 A4 72        LDY RAM_IsFlying                ; Y = Mario in air
$00:FDFA F0 02        BEQ $FDFE                       ; On ground: keep X speed
$00:FDFC 64 7B        STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; Mario X speed = 0 (airborne entry stops horizontal motion)
$00:FDFE A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: bubble slots 3..0 (big Mario)
$00:FE00 A5 19        LDA RAM_MarioPowerUp            ; A = Mario power-up
$00:FE02 D0 01        BNE $FE05                       ; Big: keep 3 bubbles' worth (slots 0-3)
$00:FE04 88           DEY                             ; Small: slots 0-2
$00:FE05 B9 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; A = extended sprite number in slot Y
$00:FE08 F0 0C        BEQ $FE16                       ; Empty: spawn a bubble here
$00:FE0A 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$00:FE0B 10 F8        BPL $FE05                       ; Loop
$00:FE0D 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $FE0E..FE12: Table: bubble offsets from Mario ;;;

;;; $FE16: Spawn bubble, skid smoke puff ;;;
;; $00FE16: initializes water bubble number Y (extended sprite $12) around Mario using the two offset tables.
;; $00FE4A: spawns a type 3 smoke puff at Mario's feet every 4th frame while running on the ground; if Down is
;;     held it needs some speed.
;; Returns early if Mario is flying, off-screen or sprites are locked.
$00:FE16 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$00:FE18 99 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y         ; / } Extended sprite = $12 (water bubble)
$00:FE1B 98           TYA                             ; \
$00:FE1C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:FE1D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:FE1E 0A           ASL                             ; |
$00:FE1F 69 F7        ADC.B #$F7                      ; } } [$1765,Y] = slot * 8 - 9 (staggers the bubbles)
$00:FE21 99 65 17     STA.W $1765,Y                   ; /
$00:FE24 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:FE26 79 0E FE     ADC.W $FE0E,Y                   ; } } Bubble Y = Mario Y + $FE0E[Y]
$00:FE29 99 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y         ; /
$00:FE2C A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$00:FE2E 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } } Bubble Y high with carry
$00:FE30 99 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y         ; /
$00:FE33 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:FE35 79 12 FE     ADC.W $FE12,Y                   ; } } Bubble X = Mario X + $FE12[Y]
$00:FE38 99 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y         ; /
$00:FE3B A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$00:FE3D 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } } Bubble X high with carry
$00:FE3F 99 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y         ; /
$00:FE42 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$00:FE44 99 6F 17     STA.W $176F,Y                   ; / } [$176F,Y] = 0 (bubble timer/phase)
$00:FE47 4C 0A FE     JMP.W $FE0A                     ; Continue with the next slot

$00:FE4A A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$00:FE4C 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$00:FE4E 05 72        ORA RAM_IsFlying                ; |
$00:FE50 05 7F        ORA $7F                         ; |
$00:FE52 05 81        ORA $81                         ; |
$00:FE54 05 9D        ORA RAM_SpritesLocked           ; } } Return unless: frame counter & 3 = 0, on ground, not off-screen, sprites not locked
$00:FE56 D0 19        BNE $FE71                       ; /
$00:FE58 A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; \
$00:FE5A 29 04        AND.B #$04                      ; / } A = held buttons & 4 (Down)
$00:FE5C F0 09        BEQ $FE67                       ; Down not held: skip the speed check
$00:FE5E A5 7B        LDA RAM_MarioSpeedX             ; \
$00:FE60 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FE61 69 08        ADC.B #$08                      ; |
$00:FE63 C9 10        CMP.B #$10                      ; } } Down held: return if Mario X speed is within -8..+7 (too slow)
$00:FE65 90 0A        BCC $FE71                       ; /
$00:FE67 A0 03        LDY.B #$03                      ; Y = 3: search smoke sprite slots
$00:FE69 B9 C0 17     LDA.W $17C0,Y                   ; A = [$17C0,Y] (smoke type)
$00:FE6C F0 04        BEQ $FE72                       ; Empty: spawn
$00:FE6E 88           DEY                             ; Next slot
$00:FE6F D0 F8        BNE $FE69                       ; Loop for slots 3..1
$00:FE71 60           RTS                             ; Return, none free

$00:FE72 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$00:FE74 99 C0 17     STA.W $17C0,Y                   ; / } Smoke type = 3
$00:FE77 A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:FE79 69 04        ADC.B #$04                      ; } } Smoke X = Mario X + 4
$00:FE7B 99 C8 17     STA.W $17C8,Y                   ; /
$00:FE7E A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:FE80 69 1A        ADC.B #$1A                      ; / } A = Mario Y + $1A
$00:FE82 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$00:FE83 AE 7A 18     LDX.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; X = on Yoshi flag
$00:FE86 F0 02        BEQ $FE8A                       ; Not on Yoshi: skip
$00:FE88 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; On Yoshi: A += $10
$00:FE8A 99 C4 17     STA.W $17C4,Y                   ; Smoke Y = A
$00:FE8D FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$00:FE8E A9 13        LDA.B #$13                      ; \
$00:FE90 99 CC 17     STA.W $17CC,Y                   ; / } Smoke timer = $13
$00:FE93 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $FE94..FEA2: Table: fireball speed and offsets ;;;
;; FE94: fireball X speed by direction; FE96/FE9C: X offset low/high; FEA2: Y offset. Indexed by direction + 2
;;     per Yoshi state.
$00:FE94              .db $FD,$03                     ; Fireball X speed: left $FD (-3)

;;; $FEA8: Shoot Mario fireball (ShootFireball) ;;;
;; Finds a free fireball slot (extended sprite slots 8-9) and spawns a Mario fireball (type 5) with Y speed
;;     $30 and X speed +-3, positioned
;; by Mario's direction, Yoshi and [$18DC]. Plays the fireball sound and starts the shoot pose timer [$149C].
;; Followed by unused routines: $00FF07 (move Mario by layer 1 scroll delta), $00FF32 and $00FF61 (set layer 3
;;     scroll [$22]/[$24] from a sprite position),
;; then $FF padding and the SNES header and vectors at $00FFC0.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:CDD9: Yoshi poses and L/R scrolling (OnYoshiAnimations)
;;     $00:D0AA: Cape hit point, cape spin and fireball input
$00:FEA8 A2 09        LDX.B #$09                      ; X = 9: fireball slots are 8 and 9
$00:FEAA BD 0B 17     LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X         ; A = extended sprite number in slot X
$00:FEAD F0 06        BEQ $FEB5                       ; Empty: spawn
$00:FEAF CA           DEX                             ; Next slot
$00:FEB0 E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; Reached slot 7?
$00:FEB2 D0 F6        BNE $FEAA                       ; No: keep searching
$00:FEB4 60           RTS                             ; Return, both fireball slots busy

$00:FEB5 A9 06        LDA.B #$06                      ; \
$00:FEB7 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / } Sound effect: fireball
$00:FEBA A9 0A        LDA.B #$0A                      ; \
$00:FEBC 8D 9C 14     STA.W RAM_FireballImgTimer      ; / } Fireball shoot pose timer [$149C] = $0A
$00:FEBF A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$00:FEC1 9D 0B 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X         ; / } Extended sprite = 5 (Mario fireball)
$00:FEC4 A9 30        LDA.B #$30                      ; \
$00:FEC6 9D 3D 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X         ; / } Fireball Y speed = $30 (down)
$00:FEC9 A4 76        LDY RAM_MarioDirection          ; Y = Mario direction
$00:FECB B9 94 FE     LDA.W $FE94,Y                   ; \
$00:FECE 9D 47 17     STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X         ; / } Fireball X speed = $FE94[direction]
$00:FED1 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; A = on Yoshi
$00:FED4 F0 09        BEQ $FEDF                       ; Not on Yoshi: use index = direction
$00:FED6 C8           INY                             ; \
$00:FED7 C8           INY                             ; / } Y += 2: Yoshi table entries
$00:FED8 AD DC 18     LDA.W $18DC                     ; A = [$18DC]
$00:FEDB F0 02        BEQ $FEDF                       ; Zero: keep
$00:FEDD C8           INY                             ; \
$00:FEDE C8           INY                             ; / } Y += 2 more
$00:FEDF A5 94        LDA RAM_MarioXPos               ; \
$00:FEE1 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FEE2 79 96 FE     ADC.W $FE96,Y                   ; } } Fireball X = Mario X + $FE96[Y]
$00:FEE5 9D 1F 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X         ; /
$00:FEE8 A5 95        LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi             ; \
$00:FEEA 79 9C FE     ADC.W $FE9C,Y                   ; } } Fireball X high = Mario X high + $FE9C[Y]
$00:FEED 9D 33 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X         ; /
$00:FEF0 A5 96        LDA RAM_MarioYPos               ; \
$00:FEF2 18           CLC                             ; |
$00:FEF3 79 A2 FE     ADC.W $FEA2,Y                   ; } } Fireball Y = Mario Y + $FEA2[Y]
$00:FEF6 9D 15 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X         ; /
$00:FEF9 A5 97        LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi             ; \
$00:FEFB 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } } Fireball Y high = Mario Y high + carry
$00:FEFD 9D 29 17     STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X         ; /
$00:FF00 AD F9 13     LDA.W RAM_IsBehindScenery       ; \
$00:FF03 9D 79 17     STA.W $1779,X                   ; / } [$1779,X] = Mario behind-scenery flag
$00:FF06 60           RTS                             ; Return

$00:FF07 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$00:FF09 AD BC 17     LDA.W $17BC                     ; \
$00:FF0C 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; / } A = [$17BD] sign-extended later (high byte of [$17BC] word)
$00:FF0F 10 03        BPL $FF14                       ; \
$00:FF11 09 FF 00     ORA.W #$00FF                    ; / } Negative: fill upper byte with $FF
$00:FF14 EB           XBA                             ; Swap: A = signed 16-bit [$17BD]
$00:FF15 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:FF16 65 94        ADC RAM_MarioXPos               ; } } Mario X += signed [$17BD] (layer 1 X movement)
$00:FF18 85 94        STA RAM_MarioXPos               ; /
$00:FF1A AD BB 17     LDA.W $17BB                     ; \
$00:FF1D 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; / } A = [$17BC] (layer 1 Y movement) in the high byte
$00:FF20 10 03        BPL $FF25                       ; \
$00:FF22 09 FF 00     ORA.W #$00FF                    ; / } Negative: fill upper byte with $FF
$00:FF25 EB           XBA                             ; Swap: A = signed 16-bit [$17BC]
$00:FF26 49 FF FF     EOR.W #$FFFF                    ; \
$00:FF29 1A           INC A                           ; / } A = -A
$00:FF2A 18           CLC                             ; \
$00:FF2B 65 96        ADC RAM_MarioYPos               ; } } Mario Y += -[$17BC] (follows layer 1 Y movement)
$00:FF2D 85 96        STA RAM_MarioYPos               ; /
$00:FF2F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$00:FF31 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$00:FF32 BD E0 14     LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X           ; \
$00:FF35 EB           XBA                             ; } } A = sprite X (16-bit, high byte swapped in)
$00:FF36 B5 E4        LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X             ; /
